4e07615fab0f75c50d1e.en: Why does a timber door stick after rain?
4e07615fab0f75c50d1e.zh: 为什么木门在雨后会卡住？

a3e4a0e83ccfb3bda655.en: A timber door can stick after rain because moisture changes its dimensions or those of the frame. Loose hinges, coating build-up and water entry can produce similar symptoms, so trimming the edge is not always the right first repair.
a3e4a0e83ccfb3bda655.zh: 雨后受潮可能改变木门或门框的尺寸，造成卡阻。铰链松动、涂层过厚和进水也可能出现相似表现，因此削边不一定是应先采取的维修方法。

e233c564ef5d6fbc1dcb.en: Deck boards or framing: what needs repair?
e233c564ef5d6fbc1dcb.zh: 露台板或框架：什么需要修理？

c596458c7c529317b73e.en: Deck boards form the walking surface; joists, bearers, posts and connections support it. A damaged board can be a local repair only when the retained supports are suitable. A fresh surface does not establish that the frame is sound.
c596458c7c529317b73e.zh: 露台板构成行走表面，托梁、承梁、立柱与连接件在下方提供支撑。只有保留的支撑合适时，损坏板材才适合局部更换；换新板面并不能证明框架完好。

0974cd2293dc6b5a6b13.en: Can a rotten timber window sill be repaired?
0974cd2293dc6b5a6b13.zh: 腐烂的木窗台可以修复吗？

67cdc587bc1c218311b4.en: A rotten timber sill may suit a local repair when the remaining timber and adjoining frame can support a suitable replacement section. Decay across the sill, at joints or into the frame can require a wider repair. The visible soft spot alone does not define the boundary.
67cdc587bc1c218311b4.zh: 如果剩余木材和相邻窗框能够连接合适的新部件，腐朽窗台可能适合局部维修。腐朽若贯穿窗台、接头或延伸到窗框，则可能需要扩大范围；不能只按可见的松软位置判断。

1f88b487bd63f1177004.en: ELLIS SERVICES GROUP PTY LTD operates this website as Ellis Services Group. Our Canberra carpentry team handles enquiries, inspects or measures the requested work and prepares the proposed carpentry work and written quote.

b307c9ea03dc97b6c5f5.en: For repairs, we check the damaged component and its connections before choosing adjustment or replacement. For a new deck or fitted storage, we measure the site and discuss the layout, materials and finish. The project records show composite deck construction, timber deck repairs and care, IKEA wardrobe fitting and separate under-stair installations.
b307c9ea03dc97b6c5f5.zh: 对于维修，我们在选择调整或更换之前检查损坏的部件及其连接。对于新的露台或已安装的收纳空间，我们会测量场地并讨论布局、材料和饰面。项目记录显示了复合材料露台施工、木材露台维修和保养、IKEA 衣柜安装以及独立的楼梯下安装。

44273d432aef831c93e4.en: An on-site assessment or measure establishes what to include in the quote: materials, replacement parts, fitting, finishing, access and disposal. Their responsibilities must be agreed for the project, and additional findings are discussed before extra work proceeds.

910602fa8b3ce75e82f7.zh: 包括您的郊区、项目、发生的变化以及任何财产使用安排。对于多个任务，每行使用一个项目。现有计划或在安全条件下拍摄的照片是可选的；不要拆除木材或进入不安全区域提供木材。

878adf23bcf526cc2756.en: Before accepting a visit, confirm any assessment, call-out or minimum booking charge. Before accepting the work, check the proposed materials, removal, finishing and price inclusions. Ask how labour is priced and when a visit is available before making booking plans.
878adf23bcf526cc2756.zh: 在接受访问之前，请确认任何评估、上门服务或最低预约费用。在接受工作之前，请检查建议的材料、拆除、收尾处理和价格。在制定预约计划之前，询问劳动力的定价方式以及何时可以访问。

8f91ce7b680bba15c64c.en: Read what affects a carpentry quote
8f91ce7b680bba15c64c.zh: 了解影响木工报价的因素

bc72758557f20af12e14.en: Describe the timber item, the issue you can see and any access details.
bc72758557f20af12e14.zh: 请说明需要处理的部件、可见问题和现场通行条件。

fee01e89705018870cb4.en: Contact us with a description of the work. Photos are optional: email safe photos separately to
fee01e89705018870cb4.zh: 联系我们并提供工作描述。照片是可选的：将在安全条件下拍摄的照片单独通过电子邮件发送至

d7c81d796e520b68c74e.en: I agree that Ellis Services Group may use the details in this enquiry to contact me about the requested carpentry work, as explained in the
d7c81d796e520b68c74e.zh: 我同意 Ellis Services Group 可以使用此咨询中的详细信息就所请求的木工工作与我联系，如

2fa7347cad841b493cbe.en: Send your details to Ellis Services Group. Our team will contact you to arrange the assessment and confirm your repair plan and quote.
2fa7347cad841b493cbe.zh: 将您的详细信息发送至 Ellis Services Group。我们的团队将联系您安排评估并确认您的维修计划和报价。

6ffd84b65fa8824bbc04.en: Carpentry Questions & Answers | Ellis Services Group
6ffd84b65fa8824bbc04.zh: 木作常见问题与解答 | Ellis Services Group

31547d83fd84f2b701b0.en: Answers about local carpentry enquiries, photos, materials, quotes and appointments, with links to detailed repair and installation questions.
31547d83fd84f2b701b0.zh: 有关当地木工咨询、照片、材料、报价和预约的答案，以及详细维修和安装问题的链接。

0c92a065b71c00a581b4.en: Browse answers about booking, quotes, doors, windows, decks, fences and interior or exterior timber. Choose a topic or search for the affected item to find repair options and any specialist work needed.
0c92a065b71c00a581b4.zh: 查找预约、报价、门窗、露台、围栏及室内外木作的常见问题。可按类别浏览或搜索具体部件，了解维修选择和相关专业工作的要求。

8a66ba034e6eedd14824.zh: 可搜索问题及答案中的内容。

8e6d2d1d8d0195c8d4ad.en: No questions match. Try a different word or clear the filter.
8e6d2d1d8d0195c8d4ad.zh: 未找到匹配的问题，请换一个关键词或清空搜索。

28b5e084e3bc39802c65.en: Small jobs, assessment, appointments and what your written quote should include.
28b5e084e3bc39802c65.zh: 小工作、评估、约会以及您的书面报价应包括的内容。

5ce32880f913901158f8.en: How can I find a carpenter near me for small timber repairs?
5ce32880f913901158f8.zh: 我如何找到附近的木工进行小型木材维修？

e32a610c0326ecec0c87.en: Look for relevant timber repair experience and suitable skills for the task when choosing a carpenter or handyman. Check qualifications and licences where the work requires them, and agree a written scope that identifies any specialist or qualified work arrangements. Ellis Services Group handles small carpentry jobs, including timber doors, trim, cupboard fittings and local timber repairs. Contact us with your task list and suburb so we can confirm availability and visit arrangements; optional photos help us prepare. We assess the components and access, confirm the carpentry and qualified work needed, and provide one clear repair plan and quote.
e32a610c0326ecec0c87.zh: 选择木工或维修人员时，应了解其相关木材维修经验与技能。涉及资质或执照要求的工作，应核对对应证明，并通过书面施工范围明确专业工作的安排。Ellis Services Group 承接木门、收边线条、橱柜配件及局部木材维修等小型木工项目。请提供项目清单与所在城区，以便确认时间及上门安排；照片可自行提供，帮助我们准备。我们会查看部件与现场条件，确认木工及相关专业工作的范围，再提供明确的维修方案和报价。

3b7ceb64a625767e60f0.en: Can several small repairs be quoted together?
3b7ceb64a625767e60f0.zh: 几个小修可以一起报价吗？

130286b6694f1275d35f.en: Yes. Describe each repair and send optional safe photos. We assess the listed tasks together and itemise the agreed work. The appointment plan accounts for access, materials and the time needed for each task.
130286b6694f1275d35f.zh: 是的。描述每次维修并发送可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片。我们一起评估列出的任务并逐项列出商定的工作。预约计划考虑了每项任务所需的现场进入条件、材料和时间。

72951499036728976204.en: How is your itemised carpentry repair quote prepared?
72951499036728976204.zh: 您的详木作维修报价是如何准备的？

28353f5ab849984240c9.en: We inspect the affected components and prepare a written quote identifying the repair extent, retained and replaced parts, labour, supplied materials, access, removal and waste disposal, finishing, price and agreed project requirements. Additional findings are documented, and changes are agreed with you before extra work proceeds.
28353f5ab849984240c9.zh: 我们检查受影响的组件并准备一份书面报价，确定维修范围、保留和更换的零件、劳动力、供应的材料、通道、拆除和废物处理、收尾处理、价格和商定的项目要求。记录其他发现，并在进行额外工作之前与您商定更改。

8b224dfb032b641bcbaf.en: Can I send photos before booking?
8b224dfb032b641bcbaf.zh: 我可以在预约前发送照片吗？

a11542d34d0ab87747c5.en: Yes. Email optional safe photos to brian@elliservices.com.au before booking. You can also contact Ellis with a description alone; our team checks the timber and cause on site and confirms the repair plan and quote.
a11542d34d0ab87747c5.zh: 是的。预约前，将可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。您也可以联系 Ellis 仅提供描述；我们的团队现场检查木材和原因并确认修复计划和报价。

c567c758002bd1ce8a98.en: How much does a carpenter charge for a small job?
c567c758002bd1ce8a98.zh: 木工做一份小活要多少钱？

682dc61f215af2807fa5.en: A small-job quote covers the tasks, labour, materials, access and finishing required. Contact Ellis with your repair list; we confirm the assessment arrangements and provide the price for the agreed scope.
682dc61f215af2807fa5.zh: 小工作报价涵盖所需的任务、劳动力、材料、进出条件和收尾处理。联系 Ellis 并提供您的维修清单；我们确认评估安排并提供商定范围内的价格。

c1fa4040ad7dc7b0aa79.en: Do carpenters charge a call-out fee or a minimum booking fee?
c1fa4040ad7dc7b0aa79.zh: 木工收取上门费或最低预约费吗？

88250cd8f55d2361387b.en: We confirm any call-out or minimum booking charge before you agree to an appointment. The written quote identifies the work and charges included, so you know the cost basis before proceeding.
88250cd8f55d2361387b.zh: 在您同意预约之前，我们会确认任何呼叫费用或最低预约费用。书面报价标明了所包含的工作和费用，以便您在继续之前了解成本基础。

186b6cadbc5612ba9444.en: Can you work around tenants and provide before-and-after photos?
186b6cadbc5612ba9444.zh: 您能在租户周围工作并提供前后照片吗？

b95a8aa70c2348f49299.en: Contact us with the property and tenant access arrangements. We agree the appointment access and requested before-and-after record with the authorised contact when the work is scoped.
b95a8aa70c2348f49299.zh: 联系我们了解财产和租户的出入安排。当确定工作范围时，我们同意授权联系人的预约现场进入条件和要求的前后记录。

f763d6fe9e05ecbab7fe.en: Are appointments available for carpentry repairs this week?
f763d6fe9e05ecbab7fe.zh: 本周可以预约木工维修吗？

f462ba75cf021cbcac0e.en: Call 0405 878 406 with your suburb and repair request. We check the current schedule and confirm the available appointment and access arrangements with you before booking.
f462ba75cf021cbcac0e.zh: 请致电 0405 878 406 提出您的郊区和维修请求。在预约前，我们会检查当前的时间表并与您确认可用的预约和上门安排。

1dd1a7efc9b8ec4d457d.en: What qualifications, insurance and licences should I check for my carpentry project?
1dd1a7efc9b8ec4d457d.zh: 我应该为我的木工项目检查哪些资格、保险和许可证？

89d3430d24d141917c45.en: Ask Ellis for the qualifications, applicable licence details and insurance information for the people carrying out the agreed work. We confirm the project-specific practitioner and approval requirements before work is scheduled.
89d3430d24d141917c45.zh: 向 Ellis 询问执行约定工作的人员的资格、适用的许可证详细信息和保险信息。我们在安排工作之前确认项目特定的从业者和批准要求。

4155c2f4e7c098ba0ab7.en: Can existing material or items I supply be used?
4155c2f4e7c098ba0ab7.zh: 可以使用我提供的现有材料或物品吗？

6940c3cd24f8ff8330d3.en: The condition, dimensions, fixing points and available matching material determine what can be retained. Confirm supplied-item compatibility and quantity before ordering, including the profile, hardware and finish. Ask the quote to distinguish supplied products from installation, making good and finishing so the responsibilities are clear.
6940c3cd24f8ff8330d3.zh: 条件、尺寸、固定点和可用的匹配材料决定了可以保留的内容。订购前请确认所提供物品的兼容性和数量，包括型材、硬件和表面处理。要求报价将所提供的产品与安装、制造和收尾处理区分开来，以便明确责任。

e7b4d5e0fc23000f4f24.en: How should I compare repair and replacement options?
e7b4d5e0fc23000f4f24.zh: 我应该如何比较维修和更换选项？

9faaf90f003e6ef731cf.en: A local repair retains suitable surrounding material. Connected damage or a changed layout can lead to a wider scope. Compare the retained parts, replacement extent, expected appearance, finish and access rather than a headline price alone. Where supporting timber is damaged, the assessment must establish its condition before a smaller cosmetic repair is chosen.
9faaf90f003e6ef731cf.zh: 局部修复保留了合适的周围材料。相连的损坏或布局的改变可能会导致范围扩大。比较保留的零件、更换范围、预期外观、表面处理和现场进入条件，而不是单独比较标题价格。如果支撑木材受损，则必须在选择较小的装饰性修复之前进行评估以确定其状况。

1ab94692e3790dcab87c.en: Sticking doors, damaged frames and sills, window operation and the right trade for the fault.
1ab94692e3790dcab87c.zh: 门卡住、框架和门槛损坏、窗户操作以及故障的正确处理。

3ce04fa254d908cd5259.en: Can a timber door be adjusted after new flooring?
3ce04fa254d908cd5259.zh: 木门铺新地板后可以调整吗？

8569a2832042c33ae41f.en: New flooring can reduce clearance, but trimming depends on the door construction and its permitted allowance. The assessment should check the finished floor, hinges and frame first. Confirm the clearance and sealing of any cut edge; a fire-rated door needs its specialist requirements checked before alteration.
8569a2832042c33ae41f.zh: 新地板可以减少间隙，但修剪取决于门的结构及其允许的余量。评估应首先检查成品地板、铰链和框架。确认任何切边的间隙和密封；防火门在改造前需要检查其专业要求。

ae5d722bcc90855c77ba.en: Do I need a carpenter or a locksmith for a door that will not latch?
ae5d722bcc90855c77ba.zh: 我是否需要木工或锁匠来制作无法闩锁的门？

ac08fccd06b894676669.en: A carpenter can assess a dropped timber door, loose hinge support or a damaged frame when the latch misses the strike. A locksmith is the appropriate trade for a faulty lock mechanism, rekeying or a lockout. Some jobs need both trades. Describe whether the door rubs, the latch misses or the key will not turn so the right scope can be arranged.
ac08fccd06b894676669.zh: 木门下垂、铰链固定处松动或门框损坏，可能导致门闩与锁扣错位，可由木工检查。锁具内部故障、换锁芯或无法开锁等问题应由锁匠处理；部分项目需要两类专业人员配合。请说明是门扇摩擦、门闩对不准，还是钥匙转不动，以便确定工作范围。

105afc2e6221d7df61f1.en: Can a rotten timber window sill be repaired locally?
105afc2e6221d7df61f1.zh: 腐烂的木窗台可以就地修复吗？

d4e20919d6ec11fe0a38.en: A soft corner can extend into the frame or concealed joints, so a surface patch is not enough to define the scope. Local sill replacement is an option where a suitable joint can be made into sound timber. The assessment should trace water entry and check glazing interfaces; a glazier may be needed if the glass must be disturbed.
d4e20919d6ec11fe0a38.zh: 软角可以延伸到框架或隐藏的接缝中，因此表面补丁不足以定义范围。局部更换窗台是一种选择，可以将合适的接缝制成坚固的木材。评估应追踪进水情况并检查玻璃界面；如果必须破坏玻璃，则可能需要玻璃工。

e6204fa463a29b8040d6.en: Who can fix a timber door that will not close properly?
e6204fa463a29b8040d6.zh: 谁可以修理无法正常关闭的木门？

940f207b55404ff334f4.en: Contact Ellis Services Group for timber door repairs. We check hinges, clearances, the frame and latch on site, identify the closing fault and confirm the adjustment or repair and quote.
940f207b55404ff334f4.zh: 请联系 Ellis Services Group 进行木门维修。我们现场检查铰链、间隙、框架和插销，识别关闭故障并确认调整或维修并报价。

5a0d040108b024f46603.en: Can you replace the door frame without replacing the door?

acaeab53c78c684c180e.en: A soft lower jamb needs its damage boundary and moisture source checked, including the threshold and adjoining frame. The door may be retained if its condition, fit and hardware remain suitable. Compare local jamb replacement with a full frame replacement after inspection, and include the new joints, seals and finish in the agreed work.
acaeab53c78c684c180e.zh: 软质下侧柱需要检查其损坏边界和水分来源，包括门槛和相邻框架。如果门的状况、安装和硬件保持合适，则可以保留门。检查后将局部门框更换与全框架更换进行比较，并将新的接头、密封件和饰面纳入商定的工作中。

fa103e29db98e5db9c8d.en: Can a carpenter fit internal doors I have already bought?
fa103e29db98e5db9c8d.zh: 木工可以安装我已经购买的内门吗？

2f3c6c77b11614b9c04f.en: Contact Ellis about fitting your supplied internal doors. We measure the openings and check the door construction, dimensions and hardware compatibility before confirming the installation scope and price.
2f3c6c77b11614b9c04f.zh: 请联系 Ellis 了解如何安装所提供的内门。在确认安装范围和价格之前，我们会测量开口并检查门的结构、尺寸和硬件兼容性。

5b362c934685738f455e.en: How much does it cost to hang an internal door?

3246bc177dc8dad1c75a.en: The door-hanging quote accounts for door size and construction, the existing frame, hinges, latch work, trimming and finishing. We measure the opening and confirm the supplied items and installation price in writing.
3246bc177dc8dad1c75a.zh: 门挂报价考虑了门的尺寸和结构、现有框架、铰链、闩锁工作、修剪和表面与收边处理。我们测量开口并以书面形式确认所提供的物品和安装价格。

3197884b2ea2bb5f6e18.en: Can you repair a cavity sliding door without opening the whole wall?
3197884b2ea2bb5f6e18.zh: 您可以在不打开整面墙的情况下修理空心推拉门吗？

360e8c2361159a83d0ca.en: Start with the accessible rollers, track, guides and access points; the fault may be in hardware rather than the concealed cavity. Do not force or pull the door from the wall. Where hidden fittings cannot be reached, the quote should define the smallest suitable access opening and who reinstates the lining and finish. Access without wall work cannot be promised before inspection.
360e8c2361159a83d0ca.zh: 从可触及的滚轮、轨道、导轨和接入点开始；故障可能出在硬件上，而不是隐藏的空腔。请勿强行将门从墙上拉开。如果无法到达隐藏的配件，报价应定义最小的合适检修口以及由谁恢复衬里和饰面。检查前不能承诺不进行围墙施工的通道。

228c2bec8b4c0a61e737.en: A sash that drops can have failed cords, balances or worn hardware as well as timber damage. Keep clear of the unsupported sash and do not prop it for routine use. Ask for a timber-window or sash specialist familiar with that mechanism; confirm the required hardware capability before booking. Heritage requirements and glazing work should be checked separately where relevant.
228c2bec8b4c0a61e737.zh: 坠落的窗扇可能是由于绳索、平衡件故障或硬件磨损以及木材损坏造成的。远离无支撑的窗扇，并且不要在日常使用时支撑它。询问熟悉该机制的木窗或窗框专家；预约前确认所需的硬件功能。遗产要求和玻璃工程应在相关时单独检查。

4d62bbd6bf2ffcda162f.en: Can you match the profile of my existing timber window frame?
4d62bbd6bf2ffcda162f.zh: 您能匹配我现有木窗框的轮廓吗？

6909a48dccc236267fab.en: We measure the existing frame profile and review available timber and samples. The proposed replacement profile and finish are confirmed with you before materials are ordered.
6909a48dccc236267fab.zh: 我们测量现有的框架轮廓并审查可用的木材和样品。在订购材料之前，我们会与您确认建议的更换轮廓和表面处理。

e7839d6f72515474c526.en: Can you repair the timber frame while keeping the existing glass?
e7839d6f72515474c526.zh: 您可以在保留现有玻璃的同时修复木框架吗？

1ece08614506139f9575.en: Glass may be retained where its condition and the timber repair access allow it. Removal, reglazing or replacement needs a glazier. Confirm that scope before the frame is disturbed; retaining a frame does not guarantee that every pane can stay in place.
1ece08614506139f9575.zh: 在玻璃状况与木框维修操作条件允许时，可以保留原玻璃。拆卸、重新安装或更换玻璃须由玻璃专业人员处理，应在拆动木框前确认相关范围；保留木框不代表每块玻璃都能原位保留。

71fce265d2e1b8b453ef.en: Can a damaged door frame be repaired without replacing the whole frame?
71fce265d2e1b8b453ef.zh: 损坏的门框可以在不更换整个门框的情况下修复吗？

cd10e75e6b3619e661e5.en: We inspect the frame, joints, fixing substrate and door fit to locate the damaged sections. The quote defines a local repair where sound adjoining timber can be retained, or the replacement required.
cd10e75e6b3619e661e5.zh: 我们检查框架、接头、固定基板和门配合，以找到损坏的部分。报价定义了本地修复，可以保留完好的相邻木材，或者需要更换。

1a8f918ddbc3d0e249f3.en: Can every internal door be trimmed at the bottom?
1a8f918ddbc3d0e249f3.zh: 每扇内门的底部都可以修剪吗？

394160d1d2fa2fb35268.en: No. Trimming must suit the door construction and permitted trimming allowance. Ellis checks the door and finished floor clearance before specifying an adjustment and edge finish.
394160d1d2fa2fb35268.zh: 否。装饰必须适合门结构和允许的装饰余量。 Ellis 在指定调整和边缘处理之前检查门和成品地板间隙。

b4010373def76ebe6783.en: Should a window leak be fixed before timber repairs are carried out?
b4010373def76ebe6783.zh: 在进行木材修复之前是否应该修复窗户渗漏问题？

4250ffc6f95e533b4aa4.en: Yes. Persistent water entry needs attention before replacement timber is finished. Ellis checks the visible water path and defines the timber scope; glazing, flashing or other leak repairs require their relevant specialist scope to be confirmed in the work sequence.
4250ffc6f95e533b4aa4.zh: 是的。在更换木材完成之前，需要注意持续进水。 Ellis 检查可见水路并定义木材范围；玻璃、防水板或其他泄漏修复需要在工作顺序中确认其相关的专业范围。

bf79c9b41a8b02156818.en: What should be checked before repairing windows on a heritage-listed property?
bf79c9b41a8b02156818.zh: 在修复列入遗产名录的房产的窗户之前应该检查什么？

3182db9a19045a68a915.en: We check the property heritage requirements and the existing window profile, materials and glazing before defining the repair. Required approvals and the proposed retention and replacement details are confirmed before work.
3182db9a19045a68a915.zh: 在确定修复之前，我们会检查财产遗产要求以及现有的窗户轮廓、材料和玻璃。所需的批准以及建议的保留和更换细节在工作前得到确认。

e642ad7c24264012052b.en: Why does my timber door stick after rain?
e642ad7c24264012052b.zh: 为什么我的木门在雨后会卡住？

1abb1ec2e5c6e56a4157.en: Rain-related sticking can involve swelling, failed coatings, water entry or movement in the frame. Check the moisture path and how the door fits before deciding to trim: removing an edge while it is swollen can leave excessive gaps when it dries. Describe when the sticking starts and whether the frame also feels soft; do not force a jammed door.
1abb1ec2e5c6e56a4157.zh: 与雨水相关的粘附可能涉及膨胀、涂层失效、进水或框架移动。在决定修剪之前检查湿气路径以及门的贴合情况：在边缘膨胀时将其去除可能会在干燥时留下过多的间隙。描述何时开始粘贴以及框架是否也感觉柔软；请勿强行打开卡住的门。

6ae17d1d558768b7fee4.en: Can split timber around a door hinge be repaired?
6ae17d1d558768b7fee4.zh: 门铰链周围的裂开木材可以修复吗？

c8f72b96aeec405b75ad.en: The repair depends on whether sound timber remains around the hinge and whether the frame still supports the door. A local timber repair may be possible; a wider split, decay or movement can require replacement of the affected frame member. Longer screws alone do not establish that damaged timber is sound. The quote should identify the fixing repair, retained frame and finishing.
c8f72b96aeec405b75ad.zh: 修复取决于铰链周围是否仍有完好的木材以及框架是否仍支撑门。可以进行局部木材修复；更广泛的裂缝、腐烂或移动可能需要更换受影响的框架构件。仅较长的螺钉并不能证明受损的木材是完好的。报价应注明固定维修、保留框架和表面与收边处理。

a79d3c9854038bf99d44.en: Can a timber window painted shut be made to open again?
a79d3c9854038bf99d44.zh: 油漆关闭的木窗可以再次打开吗？

4c89a33063e2f4cb4b34.en: Paint may bridge the moving joints, but swelling, damaged hardware or a distorted frame can also prevent operation. Do not lever against the glass or scrape unknown old coatings yourself. An assessment should distinguish paint binding from timber or hardware faults, consider safe coating handling and specify the work needed to restore movement without damaging the original profile.
4c89a33063e2f4cb4b34.zh: 油漆可能会桥接移动关节，但肿胀、损坏的硬件或扭曲的框架也会妨碍操作。请勿自行撬动玻璃或刮擦未知的旧涂层。评估应区分油漆粘合与木材或硬件缺陷，考虑安全涂层处理，并指定在不损坏原始轮廓的情况下恢复运动所需的工作。

e791a8da4c4cbc68418f.en: Should a leak around a timber window be fixed before repairing the wood?
e791a8da4c4cbc68418f.zh: 在修复木窗之前是否应该先修复木窗周围的泄漏？

7c2d1e651570bcce8b08.en: Yes. Replacing timber while water continues to enter risks repeat damage. The water path may involve glazing, seals, flashings or adjacent cladding rather than the timber alone. Agree which trade will address the leak and how the timber will be checked and repaired afterwards. The quote should include interfaces and finishing, rather than assuming a bead of sealant will solve every leak.
7c2d1e651570bcce8b08.zh: 是的。在水继续进入时更换木材可能会造成重复损坏。水路可能涉及玻璃、密封件、防水板或相邻的覆层，而不仅仅是木材。商定哪个专业人员将解决泄漏问题以及之后如何检查和修复木材。报价应包括接口和表面处理，而不是假设一滴密封胶就能解决所有泄漏。

48c4e12f6d96f563319d.en: Boards, fixings and supports, repair or rebuilding, composite decking and timber surface care.
48c4e12f6d96f563319d.zh: 板、固定件和支撑件、维修或重建、复合材料露台板和木材表面护理。

afbfa3939c1c23815786.en: Can deck boards be replaced without rebuilding the frame?
afbfa3939c1c23815786.zh: 可以在不重建框架的情况下更换露台吗？

5073f7a51b5924174016.en: Soft boards need the supporting frame checked as well, including joists, bearers, posts and connections. Keep people off the affected area until its condition has been assessed. Board-only replacement is appropriate only where the retained supports are suitable. The quote should state any concealed inspection access and separate board replacement from support repair.
5073f7a51b5924174016.zh: 软板还需要检查支撑框架，包括托梁、支架、柱子和连接件。在评估状况之前，不要让人们远离受影响的区域。仅当保留的支撑合适时，仅更换板才合适。报价应说明任何隐藏的检查通道并将板更换与支持维修分开。

64f753049c7eca0caeb6.en: How much does deck board replacement cost?

b8cf1a4a26655cd518b3.en: Deck board replacement is priced from the area, timber profile, fixings, support condition, access, removal and finish. Ellis assesses these items and provides an itemised quote for the agreed work.
b8cf1a4a26655cd518b3.zh: 露台板更换的价格取决于面积、木材剖面、紧固件、支撑条件、通道、拆除和饰面。 Ellis 评估这些项目并为商定的工作提供逐项报价。

e36cc9c5e3d4b82b105a.en: Can you inspect the frame before quoting to replace the decking?
e36cc9c5e3d4b82b105a.zh: 您可以在报价更换面板之前检查框架吗？

38bff8bef1e0fcf2ea92.en: Yes. We inspect the accessible joists, bearers, posts and connections before agreeing board replacement. Required inspection access and support repairs are included in the work plan.
38bff8bef1e0fcf2ea92.zh: 是的。在同意更换木板之前，我们会检查可触及的托梁、支架、柱子和连接件。所需的检查通道和支持维修已包含在工作计划中。

5375afb1f1bbd1001475.en: Do I need deck repairs or just sanding and oiling?
5375afb1f1bbd1001475.zh: 我需要修理露台还是只需要打磨和上油？

057ffc63c5f3ffbd5f2f.en: With sound boards and supports, sanding and oiling may be suitable for surface weathering or an aged finish. Softness, splitting or other damage needs repair assessment before finishing. Movement underfoot can involve supports or connections and needs qualified assessment before surface finishing. Avoid using the moving area; photographs cannot confirm its structural safety. The repair scope should establish the cause, any engineering or approval requirements and the support work needed before sanding or oiling is considered.
057ffc63c5f3ffbd5f2f.zh: 对于音板和支架，打磨和涂油可能适合表面风化或老化表面处理。柔软、开裂或其他损坏需要在收尾处理前进行修复评估。脚下的运动可能涉及支撑或连接，并且需要在表面处理之前进行合格的评估。避免使用移动区域；照片无法确认其结构安全性。维修范围应确定原因、任何工程或批准要求以及考虑打磨或涂油之前所需的支持工作。

1f4b574a714d934b199b.en: Can you match the existing timber on my deck?
1f4b574a714d934b199b.zh: 你能匹配我露台上现有的木材吗？

516e897b8c9d684b1994.en: Split boards can be replaced locally where the adjoining boards and supports are suitable. Matching requires the timber dimensions, profile, available species and coating to be compared. Weathered timber rarely looks identical to a new board immediately, so review the proposed match and finish before ordering. The repair should also address the fixing or support condition contributing to the split.
516e897b8c9d684b1994.zh: 分割板可以在相邻板和支撑合适的地方进行本地更换。匹配需要对木材尺寸、轮廓、可用树种和涂层进行比较。风化的木材很少会立即看起来与新板完全相同，因此在订购前请检查建议的匹配和饰面。修复还应解决导致分裂的固定或支撑条件。

407210198582afcd39a9.en: Can you compare repairing my deck with rebuilding it?
407210198582afcd39a9.zh: 你能将修理我的露台和重建它进行比较吗？

ff34baf2935176d69334.en: Yes. We assess boards, supporting timber, connections and moisture together, then compare local repair, frame repair and rebuilding as distinct scopes with clear inclusions and quotes.
ff34baf2935176d69334.zh: 是的。我们一起评估木板、支撑木材、连接和湿度，然后将局部修复、框架修复和重建作为不同的范围进行比较，并提供明确的包含内容和报价。

08f24cde37b731a892f3.en: What ACT approvals should be checked before building a deck?
08f24cde37b731a892f3.zh: 在建造露台之前应检查哪些 ACT 批准？

927ee054f29f29636b91.en: Check development approval and building approval separately for the proposed deck; exemption from one does not establish exemption from the other. The design, location, height, supports and site constraints determine the project checks. Ask the relevant design professional, builder and building certifier to establish the applicable requirements before construction. An existing repair assessment does not approve a new deck or extension.
927ee054f29f29636b91.zh: 应分别核对拟建露台的规划审批与建筑审批；一项获豁免，不代表另一项也获豁免。设计、位置、高度、支撑方式和场地限制会影响所需检查。施工前，应请相关设计人员、建筑商和建筑认证人员确认适用要求。对现有露台的维修评估不等于批准新建或扩建。

4dbb07886a24723fea0c.en: What information helps a carpenter quote for deck repairs?
4dbb07886a24723fea0c.zh: 哪些信息可以帮助木工报价露台维修报价？

15820f4cd616333b7f96.en: Contact Ellis with your suburb and the deck issue. Optional safe photos and existing repair records help preparation; our on-site assessment establishes dimensions, support condition, access and the quoted repair scope.
15820f4cd616333b7f96.zh: 请与 Ellis 联系，了解您所在的郊区和露台问题。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片和现有的维修记录有助于准备；我们的现场评估确定了尺寸、支撑条件、通道和报价的维修范围。

8786d4f4d2a2ae7c4d13.en: Do development approval and building approval mean the same thing for a deck?
8786d4f4d2a2ae7c4d13.zh: 对于露台来说，开发批准和建筑批准意味着同样的事情吗？

7f6102e282e28560af4b.en: No. Development approval concerns planning requirements; building approval concerns the building work. Ellis confirms both applicable ACT pathways for the specific deck, including any exemption conditions, before construction is agreed.
7f6102e282e28560af4b.zh: 否。开发审批涉及规划要求；建筑审批涉及建筑工程。在同意施工之前，Ellis 确认特定露台的两条适用的 ACT 路径，包括任何豁免条件。

513484b2594c2bfa043b.en: What should be checked before extending an existing deck?
513484b2594c2bfa043b.zh: 在扩展现有露台之前应检查哪些内容？

97051cf48872a9fc3d63.en: We check the existing supports and connections, the new footprint, height, intended use, drainage, access and boundaries. The extension plan confirms structural assessments and applicable ACT approvals before pricing and construction.
97051cf48872a9fc3d63.zh: 我们检查现有的支撑和连接、新的占地面积、高度、预期用途、排水、通道和边界。扩建计划在定价和施工之前确认结构评估和适用的ACT批准。

6cd231c95aee41181c2b.en: What should be checked when deck fixings stick up?
6cd231c95aee41181c2b.zh: 露台固定件粘起时应检查什么？

a84f054dd2a315bb27d8.en: Raised nails or screws can accompany board movement, splitting, decay or a fixing that no longer holds in its support. The inspection should check the surrounding board and joist before choosing refixing or replacement. Keep the trip hazard out of use while awaiting assessment; simply hammering a fixing down does not establish that the connection will hold.
a84f054dd2a315bb27d8.zh: 钉子或螺丝翘起，可能与木板位移、开裂、腐朽或紧固件失去固定力有关。应检查周边木板及托梁后，再确定重新固定还是更换。在等待检查期间应避开有绊倒风险的区域；简单把钉子敲回去，并不能确认连接仍然牢固。

1f497372b4a511c26b1a.en: Can I get a written repair scope for damaged deck boards at a rental?
1f497372b4a511c26b1a.zh: 我可以在租赁时获得损坏露台的书面维修范围吗？

49adbc2ea0aecc9dbc5f.en: Include the property suburb, property-manager contact, tenant access arrangements and the observed damage when enquiring. A site inspection establishes the board and support condition; the written scope should identify affected areas, retained timber, repairs, access and finishing. Agree any requested before-and-after record with the authorised contact. Keep an unsafe area out of use pending assessment.
49adbc2ea0aecc9dbc5f.zh: 包括物业所在郊区、物业经理联系方式、租户出入安排以及咨询时观察到的损坏情况。现场检查确定板和支撑条件；书面施工范围应确定受影响的区域、保留的木材、维修、通道和收尾处理。与授权联系人同意任何要求的前后记录。在等待评估之前，请勿使用不安全区域。

da52a51f76dc8f9c1da9.zh: Ellis 是否安装复合材料露台板？

a890ae5cc34bcbefa8ca.en: Yes. Ellis Services Group’s carpentry team installs composite decking, also called WPC. The photographed Mitchell project includes site levelling, subframe construction and composite board fitting. Confirm the selected product, support frame, board layout and finishing details in the proposal before ordering materials.
a890ae5cc34bcbefa8ca.zh: 是的。 Ellis Services Group 的木工团队安装复合材料露台板，也称为 WPC。拍摄的Mitchell项目包括场地平整、露台支撑龙骨施工和复合板安装。订购材料前，请确认提案中所选产品、支撑框架、木板布局和饰面细节。

eeba58c215ced62910d6.en: Can I book deck cleaning and oiling without replacing the deck?
eeba58c215ced62910d6.zh: 我可以在不更换露台的情况下预约露台清洁和加油吗？

30f61a8d29afe91e70d4.en: Yes. Ellis offers deck cleaning and oiling as a separate service for suitable timber decks. The condition of boards, fixings and supports is assessed first; repairs are identified separately from surface preparation and oiling. Confirm the preparation, selected coating and any necessary repair work in the quote. Surface care does not establish the condition of concealed supports.
30f61a8d29afe91e70d4.zh: 是的。 Ellis 为合适的木质露台提供露台清洁和上油服务，作为一项单独的服务。首先评估木板、紧固件和支架的状况；维修与表面处理和涂油分开进行。在报价中确认准备工作、选定的涂层以及任何必要的维修工作。表面护理并不构成隐藏支撑的条件。

e8499970ffd0446094e6.en: Leaning fences, damaged posts and palings, gate alignment and shared-boundary quotes.
e8499970ffd0446094e6.zh: 倾斜的栅栏、损坏的柱子和栅栏、院门对齐和共享边界报价。

47dca76fafebee9fa8a4.en: Should a leaning timber fence be repaired or replaced?
47dca76fafebee9fa8a4.zh: 倾斜的木栅栏是否应该修理或更换？

827a063ec514ca5b2e41.en: A leaning section needs its posts, footings, rails and connections checked, not just the palings. Local repairs may retain sound neighbouring sections; widespread support damage can make replacement more appropriate. Keep clear of an unstable fence and confirm access before assessment. Ask the quote to distinguish repair and replacement extents rather than assuming the whole boundary must be rebuilt.
827a063ec514ca5b2e41.zh: 倾斜部分需要检查其柱子、基础、栏杆和连接件，而不仅仅是栅栏。局部修复可能会保留完好的邻近路段；大范围的支撑损坏可以使更换更加合适。远离不稳定的围栏，并在评估前确认是否可以进入。要求报价区分维修和更换范围，而不是假设必须重建整个边界。

b6c68b06e08d564f017a.en: How do you repair a sagging or misaligned timber gate?
b6c68b06e08d564f017a.zh: 如何修复下垂或错位的木院门？

75d3e4c54297b244bc8c.en: Ellis checks the whole gate assembly, including the post, footing, hinges, fixings, frame, latch and clearance. A moving post, loose hinge or distorted frame needs a cause-based repair, not hinge adjustment alone. We confirm the support, hardware or alignment work in your quote.
75d3e4c54297b244bc8c.zh: Ellis 检查整个门组件，包括门柱、基础、铰链、固定件、框架、门闩和间隙。移动的立柱、松动的铰链或扭曲的框架需要根据原因进行修复，而不仅仅是铰链调整。我们会在您的报价中确认支持、硬件或对齐工作。

c96256095284f71fa220.en: How much does it cost to replace timber fence posts?
c96256095284f71fa220.zh: 更换木栅栏柱需要多少钱？

59ae8ae1398de45c7186.en: The post-replacement price accounts for the number of posts, footing removal, retained rails and palings, access and waste disposal. We assess the fence and itemise these inclusions in the quote.
59ae8ae1398de45c7186.zh: 更换后价格考虑了柱子数量、基础拆除、保留的栏杆和栅栏、通道和废物处理。我们评估围栏并在报价中逐项列出这些内容。

9756bb49734962a606f2.en: Can you quote separately for fence repairs and full replacement?
9756bb49734962a606f2.zh: 围栏维修和全部更换可以单独报价吗？

9ddc7cde44a5b19e849d.en: Yes. Following the fence assessment, we can set out repair and replacement as separate scopes with their materials, retained components, removal and prices clearly identified.
9ddc7cde44a5b19e849d.zh: 是的。围栏评估后，我们可以将维修和更换列为单独的范围，并明确其材料、保留的部件、拆除和价格。

339de293e2ef53d9d433.en: Can I get a written fence quote to discuss with my neighbour?
339de293e2ef53d9d433.zh: 我可以获得书面围栏报价以与邻居讨论吗？

9ad78a24262b83ba1120.en: Yes. We provide a written fence scope and quote for you to discuss with your neighbour. Boundary position, ownership and access agreement are confirmed before shared-boundary work proceeds.
9ad78a24262b83ba1120.zh: 是的。我们提供书面围栏范围和报价供您与邻居讨论。边界位置、所有权和进出条件协议在共享边界工作开始之前得到确认。

189ac5b6d775e281252a.en: Who can fix a sagging wooden side gate?
189ac5b6d775e281252a.zh: 谁可以修理下垂的木质侧门？

decde39e7cc4a84db258.en: A moving post, loose hinges, failed fixings or a distorted gate frame can each reduce clearance and move the latch out of alignment. Check the full assembly before deciding on adjustment. The repair may retain the gate leaf while renewing a support or hardware. Powered gate motors and electrical controls require a gate-automation specialist and are separate from the timber repair.
decde39e7cc4a84db258.zh: 移动的立柱、松动的铰链、故障的固定件或扭曲的门框都会减少间隙并使闩锁失去对准。在决定调整之前检查整个组件。修复可能会保留门叶，同时更新支撑或硬件。电动门电机和电气控制装置需要门自动化专家，并且与木材维修分开。

4e8b7af0df8b53e5cc44.en: Can you keep the existing gate and replace its posts or hinges?
4e8b7af0df8b53e5cc44.zh: 您可以保留现有的门并更换其门柱或铰链吗？

b3b2586f3011f3d142f3.en: The fixing holes, surrounding timber and stability of the post and footing need inspection. A local fixing repair is an option only where suitable sound material remains; decay or post movement may require a wider repair or replacement. The gate leaf can be retained if its condition and fit allow it. Adding larger screws alone does not resolve every support defect.
b3b2586f3011f3d142f3.zh: 固定孔、周围木材以及柱和基础的稳定性需要检查。仅在保留合适的完好材料的情况下才可以选择局部固定修复；腐烂或立柱位移可能需要更广泛的维修或更换。如果门叶的状况和配合允许，则可以保留门叶。仅添加较大的螺钉并不能解决所有支撑缺陷。

8401bcbd4b5b63a19cc2.en: Can you install a timber gate to match my existing fence?
8401bcbd4b5b63a19cc2.zh: 您可以安装一个木院门来匹配我现有的围栏吗？

409a35eaff232bf88d18.en: We measure the gate opening and compare the fence timber, profile and finish. The gate design, posts, hinges, latch and proposed matching materials are confirmed in the installation quote.
409a35eaff232bf88d18.zh: 我们测量院门开口并比较栅栏木材、轮廓和饰面。门设计、立柱、铰链、门闩和建议的匹配材料均在安装报价中确认。

0c61e3b7b5e6e3bc4bb3.en: Can rotten fence posts be replaced while keeping the palings?
0c61e3b7b5e6e3bc4bb3.zh: 可以在保留栅栏的同时更换腐烂的栅栏柱吗？

b0256f0300c094fbd620.en: We check the palings and rails and plan safe support during post replacement. The quote specifies which existing components can be retained and the posts, footings and fixings to replace.
b0256f0300c094fbd620.zh: 我们检查栅栏和横档，并在更换后计划安全支撑。报价指定了哪些现有组件可以保留，以及哪些柱子、基础和固定件需要更换。

ebf3ddff88a3ec0feb33.en: What should a written timber fence repair quote include?
ebf3ddff88a3ec0feb33.zh: 书面木栅栏维修报价应包括哪些内容？

437b0c9aba9f4c01f795.en: The fence quote identifies the affected length, posts, rails and palings, retained timber, materials, removal, waste, access, finish and price. Shared-boundary and access arrangements are confirmed before work.
437b0c9aba9f4c01f795.zh: 围栏报价确定了受影响的长度、柱子、栏杆和栅栏、保留的木材、材料、清除、废物、通道、饰面和价格。共享边界和通道安排在工作前确认。

4ae46324e4c133373ec7.en: Should the gate post be checked before replacing the gate?
4ae46324e4c133373ec7.zh: 更换门之前是否应该检查门柱？

dcc7f5b403e5b52f2975.en: Yes. We inspect the supporting post, footing, hinges and latch before specifying a gate replacement. The work plan addresses support defects as well as the gate leaf.
dcc7f5b403e5b52f2975.zh: 是的。在指定更换院门之前，我们会检查支撑柱、基础、铰链和门闩。该工作计划解决了支撑缺陷以及门叶问题。

17694f39c4edcb349ebf.en: Can a rotten fence post be replaced while retaining sound palings?
17694f39c4edcb349ebf.zh: 可以在保留完好栅栏的同时更换腐烂的栅栏柱吗？

74661adc1938358f5d31.en: Partial repair may be possible if the rails, palings and adjoining supports remain suitable. The post base, footing and connections need inspection, and the work must account for safe support of retained sections during replacement. Ask for the post and footing work, retained components, removal and waste to be itemised; sound-looking palings alone do not prove the fence support is sound.
74661adc1938358f5d31.zh: 如果横档、栅栏和相邻支撑保持合适，则可以进行部分修复。柱基、基础和连接需要检查，并且工作必须考虑到更换期间保留部分的安全支撑。要求逐项列出柱子和基础工作、保留的部件、拆除和废物；仅仅看起来完好的栅栏并不能证明栅栏支撑是牢固的。

c05abb05261d203b5042.en: Can broken fence palings be replaced without rebuilding the fence?
c05abb05261d203b5042.zh: 可以在不重建围栏的情况下更换破损的围栏木板吗？

fc240fe8273b9d3b34ca.en: Individual palings can be considered where the rails, posts and fixing material remain sound. The quote should specify how many boards are affected, their size and profile, the available timber match and any finishing. Weathering may leave a visible difference between old and new timber. If a rail or post is also damaged, that support repair should be included before the palings are fitted.
fc240fe8273b9d3b34ca.zh: 在栏杆、柱子和固定材料保持完好的情况下，可以考虑单独设置栅栏。报价应具体说明受影响的木板数量、尺寸和轮廓、可用的木材搭配以及任何饰面。风化可能会在新旧木材之间留下明显的差异。如果横档或柱子也损坏，则应在安装栅栏之前进行支撑修复。

c2f3954d1fc9a2196ef3.en: Why is a timber gate hard to close after rain?
c2f3954d1fc9a2196ef3.zh: 为什么木院门雨后很难关闭？

b820cdfec1a1b00c3971.en: Moisture-related swelling can reduce the gap, but post movement, ground clearance and distorted framing may also contribute. Check when the problem occurs and the condition of exposed edges and coatings before deciding to plane the gate. Shaving a wet edge can leave an excessive gap in dry weather while leaving the underlying moisture or support problem unresolved.
b820cdfec1a1b00c3971.zh: 受潮膨胀可能减小院门间隙，立柱位移、离地距离和框架变形也可能造成摩擦。决定是否刨削前，应记录问题发生的时间，检查可见门边及涂层状况。门边受潮时削去材料，可能在干燥后留下过大间隙，却仍未解决受潮或支撑问题。

8de3d8f506707289a4eb.en: Skirting, architraves, cupboard hardware, shelving and measured storage choices.
8de3d8f506707289a4eb.zh: 踢脚线、门窗套线、橱柜硬件、搁架和测量收纳选择。

676f738417d8b010c866.en: What is the difference between skirting boards and architraves?
676f738417d8b010c866.zh: 踢脚线和门窗套线有什么区别？

bdbe66c87aaccf24a947.en: Skirting boards finish the base of a wall. Architraves trim around doors and windows. Both should be matched to the adjoining profile where possible.
bdbe66c87aaccf24a947.zh: 踢脚线用于墙面与地面的交接处，门窗套线用于门窗洞口周边。两者都应尽量与相邻线条的截面造型保持协调。

5289519dec999ce09866.en: Can one cupboard door or drawer runner be repaired?
5289519dec999ce09866.zh: 一个橱柜门或抽屉滑轨可以修理吗？

f66a7d01b5a08ace6488.en: We inspect the hinge or drawer runner and its fixing points on site, identify the compatible repair parts and confirm the work and quote.
f66a7d01b5a08ace6488.zh: 我们在现场检查铰链或抽屉滑轨及其固定点，确定兼容的维修零件并确认工作和报价。

37c3c296dc966cd1479e.en: Can you supply and install skirting boards to match the existing ones?
37c3c296dc966cd1479e.zh: 您能否提供并安装与现有踢脚线相匹配的踢脚线？

fe909d828c430cadbc48.en: Matching involves more than the colour: compare the profile, width, thickness, material and corner details. After a door replacement, check the frame and wall junction before ordering architraves. An existing profile may be unavailable, so agree a sample or the closest suitable alternative before purchase. The quote should define removal, joints and the areas to be painted.
fe909d828c430cadbc48.zh: 匹配不仅仅涉及颜色：比较轮廓、宽度、厚度、材料和边角细节。更换门后，在订购门窗套线之前检查框架和墙壁连接处。现有的截面造型可能不可用，因此请在购买前同意样品或最接近的合适替代方案。报价应定义拆除、接缝和要涂漆的区域。

d9bfeacdaff755d83ef0.en: Can I supply the skirting boards and pay for installation only?
d9bfeacdaff755d83ef0.zh: 我可以提供踢脚线并仅支付安装费用吗？

8566b5991e0a9f938aac.en: Contact us about installation of your supplied skirting. We check its profile, quantity, condition and fit to the walls and floor, then confirm the installation and finishing inclusions.
8566b5991e0a9f938aac.zh: 请联系我们了解有关您提供的踢脚线的安装事宜。我们检查其轮廓、数量、状况以及与墙壁和地板的配合情况，然后确认安装和装修内容。

6a4f217a7ac18183043b.en: How much does architrave installation cost?

b6f8bca2656f4ce021fd.en: Architrave installation is priced from the openings, lengths, profile, removal, joints and finish required. We measure the work and provide the supply and installation inclusions in writing.
b6f8bca2656f4ce021fd.zh: 门窗套线 安装的价格取决于所需的开口、长度、轮廓、拆除、接缝和饰面。我们测量工作并以书面形式提供供应和安装内容。

6bf30bf0017190441cdd.en: Can the skirting be removed and refitted after new flooring?
6bf30bf0017190441cdd.zh: 新地板安装后踢脚线可以拆除并重新安装吗？

312ade2d36c16b63be15.en: Options can include carefully removing and refitting suitable boards, replacing them with an appropriate profile, or using a compatible finishing detail. The flooring system, finished level and required expansion space determine the choice. Coordinate the detail with the flooring installer before fixing trim; do not fill a gap in a way that restricts a floor that needs to move.
312ade2d36c16b63be15.zh: 选项可以包括小心地拆卸和重新安装合适的板、用合适的型材替换它们或使用兼容的饰面细节。地板系统、完成面高度和所需的伸缩间隙决定了选择。在固定装饰之前与地板安装人员协调细节；不要以限制需要移动的地板的方式填充间隙。

f99dea5c9c79b1425219.en: Who can repair cupboard hinges without replacing the whole kitchen?
f99dea5c9c79b1425219.zh: 谁可以在不更换整个厨房的情况下修理橱柜铰链？

7b62c72089635fabf929.en: Often the decision is local to the door, hinge and mounting panel. The assessment needs to distinguish damaged screw holes from a swollen or broken cabinet side and check compatible hardware. A fixing or panel repair may retain the rest of the cabinet. If water has weakened the panel, address the leak first; adjustment alone will not restore damaged material.
7b62c72089635fabf929.zh: 通常，决定取决于门、铰链和安装面板。评估需要将损坏的螺丝孔与肿胀或破损的机柜侧面区分开来，并检查兼容的硬件。固定或面板维修可能会保留机柜的其余部分。如果水已经削弱了面板的强度，请首先解决泄漏问题；仅靠调整无法恢复损坏的材料。

7364f4381b409af3384c.en: Can a broken drawer runner be replaced on an older cabinet?
7364f4381b409af3384c.zh: 可以在旧柜子上更换损坏的抽屉滑轨吗？

f8904d01781fbdb11507.en: Identify the runner type, dimensions, mounting position and load requirements, then check the drawer box and cabinet fixing points. Compatible replacement hardware may be available even if the original model is discontinued, but this needs confirmation before purchase. The quote should identify whether runners, the drawer box or its mounting panel require work rather than promising a universal replacement part.
f8904d01781fbdb11507.zh: 确定抽屉滑轨类型、尺寸、安装位置和负载要求，然后检查抽屉盒和柜体固定点。即使原始型号已停产，也可能会提供兼容的替换硬件，但这需要在购买前确认。报价应明确滑轨、抽屉盒或其安装面板是否需要维修，而不是承诺通用更换部件。

20347e9c34e371644786.en: Can you replace just one damaged kitchen cupboard door?
20347e9c34e371644786.zh: 您可以只更换一扇损坏的厨房橱柜门吗？

c93b723ba850b9bb9661.en: We measure the damaged cupboard door and check its hinges and adjoining finishes. The replacement material, fit and approved finish are specified before the door is ordered.
c93b723ba850b9bb9661.zh: 我们测量损坏的橱柜门并检查其铰链和相邻饰面。在订购门之前指定替换材料、安装和批准的饰面。

95d3cc2ef1c135dcb180.en: Can you repair a wardrobe sliding door that keeps coming off its track?
95d3cc2ef1c135dcb180.zh: 您能修理经常脱轨的衣柜推拉门吗？

0f849c6547f703086ce2.en: Worn rollers, damaged guides, track damage, poor alignment or loose mountings can cause repeated derailment. Stop forcing or lifting a heavy or mirrored door yourself. The assessment should identify the mechanism and compatible parts and check the retained door and fixings. Glazing damage requires the relevant specialist; refitting the door without addressing the cause can lead to another failure.
0f849c6547f703086ce2.zh: 磨损的滚轮、损坏的导轨、轨道损坏、对准不良或安装松动可能导致反复脱轨。不要自己用力或抬起沉重的门或镜子门。评估应确定机构和兼容部件，并检查保留的门和紧固件。玻璃损坏需要相关专家；在不解决原因的情况下重新安装门可能会导致另一次故障。

c9d7e1b4298a9c2286f1.en: Can a carpenter finish the trims after our kitchen renovation?
c9d7e1b4298a9c2286f1.zh: 厨房装修后，木工可以完成装饰吗？

7d317f23892a799c250a.en: Contact Ellis for kitchen renovation trim and fix-out work. We measure the remaining junctions and define skirting, architraves, fillers, panels and finishing against the installed kitchen and floor.
7d317f23892a799c250a.zh: 联系 Ellis 进行厨房装修装饰和修理工作。我们测量剩余的连接处，并根据已安装的厨房和地板定义踢脚线、门窗套线、填充物、面板和饰面。

a1b48a62ef334bacda18.en: Can you install shelves in an alcove with uneven walls?
a1b48a62ef334bacda18.zh: 您可以在墙壁不平坦的凹室中安装架子吗？

4bd92ceb1ef0d246fe88.en: Measure the opening at several points and establish the intended shelf load and fixing substrate before choosing the layout. Scribed edges or suitable fillers can accommodate uneven walls, while shelf spans and supports need to suit their use. Check for concealed services before fixing. The proposal should specify dimensions, supports, finish and any wall preparation rather than assuming the alcove is square.
4bd92ceb1ef0d246fe88.zh: 在选择布局之前，在几个点测量开口并确定预期的货架负载和固定基材。划线边缘或合适的填充物可以适应不平坦的墙壁，而架子跨度和支撑需要适合其用途。固定安装前检查是否有隐蔽管线。该提案应指定尺寸、支撑、饰面和任何墙壁准备，而不是假设凹室是方形的。

0fa5759b5b31c569bee0.en: Can you quote for timber wall panelling in one room only?
0fa5759b5b31c569bee0.zh: 您能为仅一间房间的木墙板报价吗？

55476b6d314bb6831c29.en: Yes. We measure the room and confirm the panelling layout, wall condition, junctions and finish. The quote identifies the room-specific supply and installation work.
55476b6d314bb6831c29.zh: 是的。我们测量房间并确认镶板布局、墙壁状况、连接处和饰面。报价确定了特定于房间的供应和安装工作。

a2f290d97a3a72392af6.en: Do I need a joiner or a carpenter for custom built-in wardrobes?
a2f290d97a3a72392af6.zh: 定制内置衣柜需要木作或木工吗？

545ea91eae1f8b0a54ee.en: A joiner or cabinetmaker typically handles the measured design and manufacture of built-in wardrobes; fitting may also involve carpentry. A small cupboard-hardware repair is a different scope. Describe the storage use, dimensions and preferred finish, then confirm who designs, manufactures and installs the wardrobe in the proposal before ordering.
545ea91eae1f8b0a54ee.zh: 嵌入式衣柜通常由木作或柜体制作人员负责量尺设计和制作，安装也可能涉及木工。这与单独维修橱柜五金的范围不同。请说明收纳用途、尺寸和期望饰面，并在订购前通过方案确认谁负责设计、制作和安装。

d2b36adb6eff806d7d18.zh: 定制木作与嵌入式收纳 ↗

bdb622dc9335917738f1.en: Can you make new cabinet doors to fit my existing kitchen cabinets?
bdb622dc9335917738f1.zh: 您可以制作新的橱柜门来适合我现有的厨柜吗？

f2089b5880753b5ca206.en: Replacement cabinet doors need accurate measurements, a compatible hinge layout and a material and finish that suit the retained cabinets. New doors do not automatically require a whole new kitchen, but an exact match to an older finish may be unavailable. Confirm the manufacture and fitting arrangements, samples and price before ordering; a hinge-only repair quote does not cover new door manufacture.
f2089b5880753b5ca206.zh: 替换柜门需要精确的测量、兼容的铰链布局以及适合保留的柜子的材料和表面处理。新门并不自动需要一个全新的厨房，但可能无法与旧的饰面完全匹配。订购前确认制造和安装安排、样品和价格；仅铰链的维修报价不包括新门的制造。

5c2b26005c33edf85bd4.en: Can you design built-in storage for the space under my stairs?
5c2b26005c33edf85bd4.zh: 您能为我楼梯下的空间设计内置储物空间吗？

e21b360c069c8ac16da3.en: Under-stair storage starts with the usable space, access and intended contents. The layout must preserve stair supports and required clearances and account for concealed services. Discuss shelves, drawers or cupboards and the proposed finish, then confirm the measured design, manufacture and fitting scope. Structural changes need their own qualified assessment before installation is agreed.
e21b360c069c8ac16da3.zh: 楼梯下收纳从可用空间、通道和预期内容开始。布局必须保留楼梯支撑和所需的间隙，并考虑隐蔽管线。讨论架子、抽屉或橱柜以及建议的饰面，然后确认测量的设计、制造和安装范围。在同意安装之前，结构变更需要进行自己的合格评估。

254dd252c89efe70be12.en: Should skirting boards be fitted before or after new flooring?
254dd252c89efe70be12.zh: 踢脚线应该在新地板之前还是之后安装？

9a4e10772a06d00d4173.en: The flooring system and final junction determine the sequence. Confirm removal, expansion clearances and final floor levels with the flooring installer before trim is fitted. Ellis measures the finished junction and defines the selected profile and finishing in the installation quote.
9a4e10772a06d00d4173.zh: 地板系统和最终连接点决定顺序。在安装装饰件之前，与地板安装人员确认拆除、伸缩间隙和最终地板高度。 Ellis 测量成品连接处，并在安装报价中定义所选型材和饰面。

508a959fce12ecb541b1.en: Can water-damaged MDF skirting be repaired or does it need replacement?
508a959fce12ecb541b1.zh: 被水损坏的中密度纤维板踢脚线可以修复还是需要更换？

b020ea60da6a312a6318.en: We check the swelling, fixing condition and moisture source. Skirting that has lost its shape or sound fixing material is specified for replacement; retained trim and finishing are identified in the quote.
b020ea60da6a312a6318.zh: 我们检查膨胀、固定情况和水分来源。已变形的踢脚线或固定材料指定更换；保留的装饰和表面与收边处理在报价中注明。

2b3abc011e326959fa6c.en: Can loose cupboard hinges be repaired if the screw holes are damaged?
2b3abc011e326959fa6c.zh: 如果螺丝孔损坏，松动的橱柜铰链可以修复吗？

172115b64d7616734510.en: We inspect the cabinet panel and damaged fixing holes before selecting a hinge repair. The quote confirms compatible hardware and the fixing or panel repair needed for secure operation.
172115b64d7616734510.zh: 在选择铰链维修之前，我们检查橱柜面板和损坏的固定孔。报价确认了安全操作所需的兼容硬件以及固定或面板维修。

c39979f57d653dddddd9.en: Should a plumbing leak be fixed before replacing water-damaged cabinet panels?
c39979f57d653dddddd9.zh: 在更换被水损坏的橱柜面板之前是否应该修复管道泄漏？

9b0f3718e77eaa75d858.en: Yes. The plumbing leak should be fixed by the relevant plumbing trade before damaged panels are replaced. Ellis checks the remaining panel material and fixing points, then defines the panel and fitting repairs once the moisture-source work is confirmed.
9b0f3718e77eaa75d858.zh: 是的。在更换损坏的面板之前，应由相关水管专业人员修复管道泄漏。 Ellis 检查剩余的面板材料和固定点，然后在确认湿气源工作后确定面板和配件的维修。

1697cb13d8fc69385a87.en: Fix-out carpentry includes the fitted interior details, such as skirting, architraves, doors, trims, panels and selected fittings. Ellis measures the remaining work and confirms installation and finishing inclusions for your rooms.
1697cb13d8fc69385a87.zh: 木作收尾包括安装的内部细节，例如踢脚线、门窗套线、门、装饰、面板和选定的配件。 Ellis 测量剩余工作并确认房间的安装和安装内容。

604f92b8d25f748d51db.en: What information is needed to quote for built-in wardrobes?
604f92b8d25f748d51db.zh: 嵌入式衣柜报价需要哪些信息？

56747221f98ef3f624e3.en: Describe the storage use, room and preferred layout to Ellis. Optional photos, plans and approximate measurements help preparation; we measure on site and confirm dimensions, materials, hardware, finish and installation in the quote.
56747221f98ef3f624e3.zh: 向 Ellis 描述收纳用途、房间和首选布局。可自行提供的照片、平面图和近似测量值有助于准备；我们现场测量并在报价中确认尺寸、材料、硬件、表面处理和安装。

6b77ccc758450cc19c80.en: Can water-damaged skirting be replaced after a leak is fixed?
6b77ccc758450cc19c80.zh: 漏水修复后可以更换被水损坏的踢脚线吗？

5d3905aced3dd70f9701.en: Yes, damaged lengths can be considered for replacement once the leak is addressed and the remaining materials are suitable for repair. Swollen skirting that has lost its shape may not recover through sanding. Check adjacent wall surfaces and fixing points, and confirm the matching height, profile, joints and paint finish in the scope.
5d3905aced3dd70f9701.zh: 是的，一旦解决了泄漏并且剩余材料适合修复，就可以考虑更换损坏的长度。肿胀变形的踢脚线可能无法通过打磨恢复。检查相邻墙面和固定点，确认匹配范围内的高度、轮廓、接缝和油漆饰面。

004f401d716a9bce2b6d.en: Can a dog-chewed section of skirting be repaired locally?
004f401d716a9bce2b6d.zh: 踢脚线被狗咬断的部分可以就地修复吗？

3cbb50b034e89915d527.en: A shallow cosmetic mark and a deeply damaged board need different scopes. A local repair may suit limited damage; replacing the affected length can produce a stronger, neater result where the profile is badly lost. Compare the existing profile and paint finish, and include joints and preparation in the quote. The entire room does not automatically need replacement.
3cbb50b034e89915d527.zh: 浅的装饰标记和深度损坏的板需要不同的范围。局部修复可能会造成有限的损坏；替换受影响的长度可以在轮廓严重丢失的情况下产生更强、更整洁的结果。比较现有的型材和油漆表面，并在报价中包括接缝和准备工作。整个房间不会自动需要更换。

46852a26e961ee3c4b35.en: Can swollen kitchen kickboards be replaced after a plumbing leak?
46852a26e961ee3c4b35.zh: 管道泄漏后可以更换肿胀的厨房踢脚线吗？

06de8dd008f5fb606172.en: Have the plumbing leak fixed by the appropriate trade before replacement is planned. Check the cabinet bases and adjoining panels as well as the visible kickboard for remaining damage. Match the height, material, finish and attachment system, and confirm any ventilation or appliance-access requirements. The quote should identify the new lengths and any wider panel repair needed.
06de8dd008f5fb606172.zh: 在计划更换之前，请相应专业人员修复管道泄漏问题。检查橱柜底座和相邻面板以及可见的踢脚线是否有剩余损坏。匹配高度、材料、饰面和连接系统，并确认任何通风或设备通道要求。报价应确定新的长度以及所需的任何更宽的面板维修。

920daf9fad36fc22e034.en: Can doors, skirting and cupboard touch-ups before a sale be quoted together?
920daf9fad36fc22e034.zh: 出售前的门、踢脚线和橱柜修饰可以一起报价吗？

50fe02a21feba79518fa.en: Yes. Send a task list with one item per line, your suburb and any agent or property-access arrangements. Grouping the inspection helps identify compatible materials and the sequence of repairs and finishing. Ask for each task and any exclusions to be itemised. A presentation repair should not conceal unresolved moisture, timber decay or a safety issue.
50fe02a21feba79518fa.zh: 是的。发送一份任务列表，其中每行一项、您的郊区以及任何代理或财产上门安排。对检查进行分组有助于识别兼容材料以及维修和收尾处理的顺序。要求逐项列出每项任务和任何排除事项。演示修复不应掩盖未解决的潮湿、木材腐烂或安全问题。

3a4edaa200e1d4113aec.en: Can Ellis assemble and fit IKEA wardrobes?
3a4edaa200e1d4113aec.zh: Ellis 可以组装和安装 IKEA 衣柜吗？

cf30734e97e318fa1301.en: Yes. Ellis Services Group’s carpentry team can assess and quote assembly and fitting of agreed IKEA wardrobe products. Confirm component suitability, supply and finishing details before ordering. The Pearce project shows measured assembly, installation and edge finishing using IKEA products. Ellis handles the agreed fitting and finishing work.
cf30734e97e318fa1301.zh: 可以。Ellis Services Group 的木工团队可就约定 IKEA 衣柜产品的组装与安装进行现场查看和报价。订购前需确认组件是否适合、由谁供货，以及收边要求。Pearce 案例记录了使用 IKEA 产品的测量、组装、安装和封边；Ellis 负责约定的安装与收尾工作。

ec69ab3ba8a711ad42e8.en: Recurring moisture, roof-edge timber, weatherboards, stairs, pergolas and structural repair boundaries.
ec69ab3ba8a711ad42e8.zh: 反复出现的湿气、屋顶边缘木材、外墙木挂板、楼梯、凉棚和结构修复边界。

d0b53544b4bc1560b979.en: How do you address the cause of recurring timber rot?
d0b53544b4bc1560b979.zh: 您如何解决木材反复腐烂的原因？

e2c248c21b3335884a38.en: Recurring rot suggests that moisture is still reaching the timber or that the original damage extended beyond the patch. Inspect joints, drainage, adjoining materials and coatings before specifying another repair. A repair plan should define the sound timber boundary and the relevant leak or drainage work, with the appropriate trade responsible for each part.
e2c248c21b3335884a38.zh: 反复出现的腐烂表明水分仍然到达木材或原始损坏超出了补丁范围。在指定另一次维修之前，检查接缝、排水系统、毗邻材料和涂层。修复计划应确定完好的木材边界和相关的泄漏或排水工作，并由相应专业人员负责每个部分。

0bcee1a684a655712861.en: Can you replace only the rotten section of timber?
0bcee1a684a655712861.zh: 可以只更换木材腐烂的部分吗？

4b7877c1845a26b95384.en: Intact paint can hide timber that has lost its strength. The affected component, extent of decay and sound material at proposed joints determine whether a local section can be replaced. Filler is not a substitute for sound supporting timber. Load-bearing damage requires qualified structural assessment before removal, and the moisture source needs to be addressed alongside the repair.
4b7877c1845a26b95384.zh: 完整的油漆可以隐藏失去强度的木材。受影响的部件、腐烂程度和拟接缝处的完好材料决定了是否可以更换局部部分。填料不能替代坚固的支撑木材。承重损坏需要在拆除前进行由具备相应资质的人员进行结构评估，并且在修复的同时需要解决湿气源问题。

4397b57c48929c5addbf.en: Does your quote include priming and painting the repaired timber?
4397b57c48929c5addbf.zh: 您的报价是否包括对修复后的木材进行底漆和涂漆？

e964c4edffdb930815f5.en: Priming and painting inclusions are stated in your quote. We confirm the repaired area, coating preparation, finish and any adjoining painting before the work is agreed.
e964c4edffdb930815f5.zh: 底漆和喷漆内容已在您的报价中注明。在同意工作之前，我们会确认修复区域、涂层准备、饰面和任何相邻油漆。

b661b087a2d008e9015b.zh: 谁更换腐烂的檐口封板？

89261c41d9c79b996c0d.en: A carpenter assesses the timber fascia and its supports; a roofing or guttering trade checks overflow, leaks and roof-edge drainage. Both scopes may be needed. Retain suitable guttering only after its condition and fixing arrangements are checked. Agree safe access, temporary removal or refitting, the cause of wetting and finishing before the timber is replaced.
89261c41d9c79b996c0d.zh: 木工评估木质面板及其支撑件；屋面或排水沟专业人员检查溢出、泄漏和屋顶边缘排水。可能需要两个范围。仅在检查其状况和紧固件后才保留合适的排水沟。在更换木材之前，就安全通道、临时拆除或重新安装、受潮原因和收尾处理达成一致。

149d7b5bb5b76e4e96f8.en: Can fascia boards be replaced without replacing all the gutters?
149d7b5bb5b76e4e96f8.zh: 可以在不更换所有天沟的情况下更换檐口封板吗？

6c690d95bf9044393eae.en: We check the retained gutters, brackets and roof-edge fixings before defining fascia replacement. The quote sets out gutter removal, refitting or replacement required for the timber work.
6c690d95bf9044393eae.zh: 在确定面板更换之前，我们检查保留的排水沟、支架和屋顶边缘固定件。报价列出了木材工程所需的天沟拆除、改装或更换。

d08398eed67faa230341.en: How do you assess old eaves lining before replacement?
d08398eed67faa230341.zh: 在更换前您如何评估旧屋檐衬里？

7cb2174c30b05093b66c.en: Confirm that the leak has been addressed, then identify the lining material and the extent of damage before disturbing it. Eaves lining is not always timber, and unknown older sheets may need a qualified hazardous-material assessment. Do not cut, drill or sample suspect lining yourself. Where asbestos is suspected, use the appropriate licensed assessment and removal pathway before replacement work is scoped.
7cb2174c30b05093b66c.zh: 确认泄漏已得到解决，然后在拆动之前确定衬里材料和损坏程度。屋檐衬里并不总是木材，未知的旧板材可能需要合格的有害物质评估。请勿自行切割、钻孔或取样可疑衬里。如果怀疑存在石棉，请在确定更换工作范围之前使用适当的许可评估和清除途径。

aa3e5c42eafee07684e9.en: ACT asbestos assessment and removal licensing
aa3e5c42eafee07684e9.zh: ACT 石棉评估和清除许可

491ec17f16e5d3995458.en: Can you replace a few damaged weatherboards and match the existing profile?
491ec17f16e5d3995458.zh: 您可以更换一些损坏的外墙木挂板并与现有的型材相匹配吗？

1d42c9785ac594f0533c.en: Individual boards can be considered after the lap, profile, fixings and adjoining material are checked. Cracked ends may also expose vulnerable joints or water-entry details, so the repair should address the junction rather than only the visible board. Confirm the wall system, available matching profile and coating, and whether backing or flashing work needs a separate qualified scope.
1d42c9785ac594f0533c.zh: 在检查搭接、轮廓、固定件和毗邻材料后可以考虑单独的板。开裂的端部还可能暴露出脆弱的接缝或进水细节，因此维修应针对连接处而不仅仅是可见的木板。确认墙壁系统、可用的匹配型材和涂层，以及背衬或防水工作是否需要单独的合格范围。

67d65de7cc91bb69380b.en: Who can inspect loose timber stairs and quote for safe repairs?
67d65de7cc91bb69380b.zh: 谁可以检查松动的木楼梯并提供安全维修报价？

9aa8510d28ea09842522.en: A loose tread needs a qualified stair or structural assessment of its supports, fixings and connected members before a repair is chosen. Keep people off the unstable area while the condition is unresolved. Refitting one tread is appropriate only when the retained assembly is suitable. The quote should define the cause, replacement extent, safe access and any required structural or safety checks.
9aa8510d28ea09842522.zh: 在选择修复之前，松动的踏板需要对其支撑件、固定件和连接构件进行合格的楼梯或结构评估。在情况未解决时，让人员远离不稳定区域。仅当保留组件合适时，才适合重新安装一个胎面。报价应明确原因、更换范围、安全进出条件以及任何所需的结构或安全检查。

07f89c1a9eeb5c218c8c.en: Can you replace a damaged timber handrail without rebuilding the stairs?
07f89c1a9eeb5c218c8c.zh: 您可以在不重建楼梯的情况下更换损坏的木质扶手吗？

868cf66888f0ad1eab79.en: We assess the handrail, anchorage and retained stairs before defining replacement. The work plan confirms the new rail, fixings and applicable safety requirements without assuming the supporting assembly is sound.
868cf66888f0ad1eab79.zh: 在确定更换之前，我们会评估扶手、锚地和保留的楼梯。该工作计划确认了新的导轨、紧固件和适用的安全要求，但没有假设支撑组件完好。

44914337ccb04fef6883.en: Can a rotten pergola post be replaced without rebuilding the whole structure?
44914337ccb04fef6883.zh: 腐烂的凉棚柱可以在不重建整个结构的情况下更换吗？

4d7fb772b6d8bb2dc81d.en: The post supports a connected structure, so assess the beams, connections, footings and load path before removing any timber. A local replacement may be possible, but qualified structural input, safe temporary support and project-specific approval checks must be settled first. Do not cut or excavate around the post yourself to prepare an enquiry; share existing plans and observations from a safe position.
4d7fb772b6d8bb2dc81d.zh: 该柱支撑连接结构，因此在拆除任何木材之前评估梁、连接、基础和传力路径。当地更换是可能的，但必须首先解决合格的结构输入、安全的临时支撑和项目特定的审批检查。请勿自行在柱子周围切割或挖掘以准备咨询；从安全的位置分享现有的计划和观察结果。

200fbb01c8f04b1432ab.zh: 凉棚与廊檐木结构维修 ↗

2904d0d1d8547e0cc233.en: Who can check whether my pergola repair needs approvals in the ACT?
2904d0d1d8547e0cc233.zh: 谁可以检查我的凉棚维修是否需要 ACT 的批准？

ff1378be61faf262ac3a.en: The proposed repair or alteration determines the checks needed. Relevant qualified practitioners and the ACT approval authorities can establish the requirements; share existing drawings or reports with Ellis so the timber scope reflects them. A changed roof, footprint or support arrangement must be considered separately from a local repair.
ff1378be61faf262ac3a.zh: 拟议的维修或改造决定了所需的检查。相关合格从业人员和ACT审批机关可以制定要求；与 Ellis 共享现有图纸或报告，以便木材范围反映它们。屋顶、占地面积或支撑布置的改变必须与局部维修分开考虑。

c10ba804e9d96fc60d68.en: Can you quote for timber repairs after the termites have been treated?
c10ba804e9d96fc60d68.zh: 白蚁处理后，您可以报价木材修复吗？

55c7afd5ede4c84294c7.en: A pest controller handles termite inspection and treatment; the remaining timber damage needs a separate repair assessment. Share the completed treatment report and any structural reports if available. Damaged supporting members may require engineering and approval checks before disturbance. Treatment does not restore lost timber strength, and a carpentry quote does not replace pest-clearance advice.
55c7afd5ede4c84294c7.zh: 害虫防治员负责白蚁检查和处理；其余的木材损坏需要单独的修复评估。分享已完成的治疗报告和任何结构报告（如果有）。损坏的支撑构件可能需要在拆动前进行工程和批准检查。处理并不能恢复失去的木材强度，木工报价也不能取代虫害清除建议。

26cd9f62aef3973b07d8.en: Who should assess damaged floor joists before a carpenter replaces them?
26cd9f62aef3973b07d8.zh: 在木工更换损坏的地板托梁之前，谁应该评估损坏的地板托梁？

67c42f91ed77e6f498da.en: Damaged load-bearing floor joists need assessment by the relevant qualified structural practitioner, with engineering input where required. The repair scope must define access, temporary support, connected members and replacement details before disturbance. Existing reports help Ellis discuss the timber repair and quote arrangements.
67c42f91ed77e6f498da.zh: 损坏的承重地板托梁需要由相关合格的结构从业人员进行评估，并在需要时提供工程投入。维修范围必须定义拆动前的通道、临时支撑、连接构件和更换细节。现有报告有助于 Ellis 讨论木材修复和报价安排。

3bb086f92897b9197571.en: Can wood filler fix all types of rotten timber?
3bb086f92897b9197571.zh: 木材填料可以修复所有类型的腐烂木材吗？

09e8a334f22b7738f7ea.en: No. Filler does not restore the strength of decayed supporting timber. Ellis checks the component function and damage extent and specifies sound-timber repair or replacement with the moisture source addressed.
09e8a334f22b7738f7ea.zh: 否。填料不能恢复腐烂支撑木材的强度。 Ellis 检查组件功能和损坏程度，并指定修复或更换已解决的湿气源。

d1dadfff979c00f3426f.en: Should gutters be checked when replacing fascia boards?
d1dadfff979c00f3426f.zh: 更换檐口封板时是否应检查排水沟？

a25c7ded4498a338bb33.en: Yes. Gutter condition, brackets, overflow and roof-edge fixings can affect fascia damage and replacement access. The quote should distinguish the timber work from any gutter removal, refitting or leak correction, with the relevant roofing or guttering trade responsibilities confirmed.
a25c7ded4498a338bb33.zh: 是的。天沟状况、支架、溢水口和屋顶边缘固定件可能会影响面板损坏和更换通道。报价应将木材工程与任何排水沟拆除、改装或渗漏修复区分开来，并确认相关的屋顶或排水沟贸易责任。

08640e883244e2ff6125.en: What should be checked behind damaged timber cladding?
08640e883244e2ff6125.zh: 损坏的木材覆层后面应该检查什么？

db5c50c517760aaed922.en: We check accessible backing, fixings, adjoining timber and the water path behind the damaged boards. Any further opening is agreed, and additional findings are documented before the repair scope is extended.
db5c50c517760aaed922.zh: 我们检查可触及的背衬、固定件、相邻木材以及损坏板后面的水路。在扩大维修范围之前，任何进一步的开放都会得到同意，并记录其他发现。

224a0bdfa7f7c66af5ee.en: What should be checked when a timber stair tread is loose?
224a0bdfa7f7c66af5ee.zh: 木楼梯踏板松动时应检查什么？

16ccd9bf64f586025495.en: Ellis checks the tread, fixings, supporting members and adjacent stair connections together. Avoid loading a loose tread; contact us to arrange a safe assessment and confirm the repair.
16ccd9bf64f586025495.zh: Ellis 检查踏板、固定件、支撑构件和相邻楼梯连接。避免装载松动的胎面；请联系我们安排安全评估并确认修复。

f62bbb2051390ba96e8c.en: Is a loose handrail a cosmetic repair or a safety issue?
f62bbb2051390ba96e8c.zh: 扶手松动是美容修复还是安全问题？

20630bc93fa6554df75b.en: A loose handrail is a safety issue, not just a finish defect. Avoid relying on it until assessed. Ellis checks the anchorage and supporting material and confirms the secure repair and required safety checks.
20630bc93fa6554df75b.zh: 扶手松动是一个安全问题，而不仅仅是饰面缺陷。在评估之前避免依赖它。 Ellis 检查锚固和支撑材料并确认安全修复和所需的安全检查。

7766a7cdd6bc5ec667cc.en: Can stair repairs affect structural or safety requirements?
7766a7cdd6bc5ec667cc.zh: 楼梯维修会影响结构或安全要求吗？

9b5ace2c15315e5d7266.en: Yes. Treads, supports, handrails and balustrades affect safe use. Ellis confirms the qualified structural and applicable ACT requirements for the proposed repair before work is agreed.
9b5ace2c15315e5d7266.zh: 是的。踏板、支撑物、扶手和栏杆影响安全使用。在同意工作之前，Ellis 确认拟议维修的合格结构和适用的 ACT 要求。

c374f2e163b50cd94f41.en: Can a carpenter replace a load-bearing timber member without a structural assessment?
c374f2e163b50cd94f41.zh: 木工可以在不进行结构评估的情况下更换承重木构件吗？

ace41ffdd307e16fa5e3.en: No. A load-bearing repair needs the required qualified structural assessment and a defined support and replacement sequence. Engineering and applicable practitioner and approval requirements must be established before the timber scope is agreed or the member is disturbed.
ace41ffdd307e16fa5e3.zh: 否。承重维修需要所需的合格结构评估以及规定的支撑和更换顺序。在木材范围达成一致或成员受到拆动之前，必须制定工程和适用的从业者及批准要求。

5dcf253331f5d37527ce.en: Who should repair a leaking roof before damaged roof timbers are replaced?
5dcf253331f5d37527ce.zh: 在更换损坏的屋顶木材之前，谁应该修理漏水的屋顶？

98d0631ec3c6ec2dc943.en: A roofing leak needs the relevant roofing trade’s assessment and repair. Damaged load-bearing roof timber also needs qualified structural assessment. Confirm the water-source work and structural requirements before agreeing timber replacement and finishing; share existing reports with Ellis when discussing the repair quote.
98d0631ec3c6ec2dc943.zh: 屋顶漏水需要相关屋顶专业人员的评估和修复。受损的承重屋顶木材也需要由具备相应资质的人员进行结构评估。确认水源工程和结构要求后，同意木材更换和装修；在讨论维修报价时与 Ellis 共享现有报告。

9d0dbbea5d7d4d14cd61.en: Can splitting timber along the sloping roof edge be repaired?
9d0dbbea5d7d4d14cd61.zh: 沿倾斜屋顶边缘劈裂的木材可以修复吗？

cff96eefcf67877764c4.en: That sloping board is commonly called a bargeboard. Peeling paint alone may call for coating work, while splitting, softness or failed fixings can require timber repair or replacement. The assessment should check nearby roof details, joints and water entry from safe access. The quote needs the affected lengths, proposed profile, roof-edge trade coordination and finish; do not climb up to measure it yourself.
cff96eefcf67877764c4.zh: 该倾斜板通常称为“山墙封边板”。仅剥落的油漆就可能需要进行涂层工作，而开裂、柔软或固定失败可能需要修复或更换木材。评估应检查附近的屋顶细节、接缝和安全通道的进水口。报价需要受影响的长度、建议的轮廓、屋顶边缘贸易协调和表面处理；不要自己爬上去测量。

603157b2f0177ff0096e.en: An hourly rate is not the complete price of a repair. Materials, access, removal and finishing may be separate, and the time required follows the assessed condition. Ask Ellis how the proposed work will be priced and whether any visit or minimum booking charge applies before accepting an appointment.
603157b2f0177ff0096e.zh: 每小时费率并不是维修的完整价格。材料、进入、移除和收尾处理可能是分开的，所需的时间根据评估的情况而定。在接受预约之前，询问 Ellis 拟议的工作将如何定价，以及是否需要支付任何上门查看费或最低预约费。

b4ff37904412eb38ccfa.zh: 查找维修问题、比较露台方案或准备报价咨询。这些指南说明常见原因、可以安全观察的现象，以及需要与团队确认的工作。

0de914db87bacb9f2c86.zh: 木材与复合材料露台板：比较什么

4bee42c61a548ae9e055.zh: 木门铰链和相邻喷漆框架的近视图

4a7c966fb44440fa319c.en: Carpentry Quotes: What Affects the Cost?
4a7c966fb44440fa319c.zh: 木工报价：什么影响成本？

f5b8c270f404724b1309.en: A carpentry quote depends on the work, the condition of the timber and what is included. An hourly rate alone does not describe the cost of a completed repair. Compare materials, removal, access and the finished result on the same basis before accepting a price.
f5b8c270f404724b1309.zh: 木工报价取决于施工内容、木材状况和包含项目。单看小时费率，无法判断完成维修的总费用；接受报价前，应按相同口径比较材料、拆除、施工通道和最终效果。

8dda2cfa4cb5c285eb5a.en: How should you prioritise carpentry repairs before selling?
8dda2cfa4cb5c285eb5a.zh: 在出售之前您应该如何优先考虑木工维修？

1e81bd74deac36e2131d.en: Start a pre-sale carpentry list with safety and operation, then consider visible finishing. List doors, trim and cupboard faults by room so necessary repairs can be separated from optional upgrades. The effect on sale price is uncertain.
1e81bd74deac36e2131d.zh: 售房前的木作清单应先处理安全和日常使用问题，再考虑外观收尾。按房间列出门、线条与橱柜故障，区分必要维修和可选升级；这些工作的售房价格影响并不确定。

058bc5a63243712f005f.en: Why does timber rot return after a repair?
058bc5a63243712f005f.zh: 为什么木材修复后又会腐烂？

c2084127ac20976fd86a.en: Timber rot can return when moisture keeps reaching the component, decay remains beyond the earlier repair or the replacement detail traps water. A new painted surface alone does not show that the cause and damaged material were addressed.
c2084127ac20976fd86a.zh: 木材反复腐朽，可能是持续受潮、原维修范围外仍有腐朽，或新接头积水。表面重新刷漆，不能证明受潮原因和受损木材都已处理。

7fdab11a3916568a1aab.en: Fascia, bargeboard and eaves: what is the difference?
7fdab11a3916568a1aab.zh: 檐口封板、山墙封边板和檐底有什么区别？

7086e3c767c0261cd024.en: Fascia follows the lower roof edge, often beside the gutter. Bargeboard follows the sloping edge of a gable. Eaves lining closes the underside of an overhang and may be a different material. The material and its position determine which connections and water paths need checking.
7086e3c767c0261cd024.zh: 檐口封板沿屋面下缘设置，常靠近排水沟；山墙封边板沿山墙斜边设置；檐底板封闭屋檐悬挑的下方，材料也可能不同。部件位置及材料决定要检查的连接和水路。

168e5f9a606b9e407045.en: Can a few damaged timber weatherboards be replaced?
168e5f9a606b9e407045.zh: 外墙木挂板局部损坏可以单独更换吗？

6abbb726ed36c27ee246.en: Individual timber weatherboards may be replaced when suitable adjoining boards and backing can be retained. The board profile, overlap and water-entry detail determine more than the appearance of the repair.
6abbb726ed36c27ee246.zh: 周边挂板和背后支撑仍合适时，可以考虑单独更换损坏的外墙木挂板。板材截面、搭接与进水细节不仅影响外观，也会影响维修方案。

15a7bbabbf5ac6c9d1bb.en: Timber and composite decking should be compared as specified products, not just two labels. For your project, consider the proposed finish, care requirements, sun exposure, installation system and complete construction scope. Material choice does not establish whether an existing deck frame can be retained.
15a7bbabbf5ac6c9d1bb.zh: 比较木材与复合材料露台板时，应落实到具体产品，而不是只看材料类别。结合饰面、保养、日晒、安装系统和完整施工范围判断；选定材料并不代表现有支撑框架一定能保留。

39f672ae846cb7139342.en: Timber Deck Maintenance: Care or Repair?
39f672ae846cb7139342.zh: 木露台维护：保养还是修理？

c5576bfd70ef4b791079.en: Timber deck maintenance and deck repair are different decisions. Cleaning and renewing a finish concern the surface; loose boards, movement or deteriorated supports need assessment. For your deck, start with safe observations and the care information for the timber and coating already in place.
c5576bfd70ef4b791079.zh: 木露台保养与结构维修是不同的工作。清洗和更新涂层针对表面；木板松动、晃动或支撑损坏则需要检查。先从安全观察和现有木材、涂层的保养资料了解情况。

01a9546f308b86976fc1.en: Should you repair an existing deck or rebuild it?
01a9546f308b86976fc1.zh: 您应该修复现有的露台还是重建它？

7b659afe0a8fc5f61a2c.en: Repair suits an existing deck when the affected components can be defined and suitable boards, supports and connections retained. Widespread connected damage or a changed layout can lead to rebuilding. The proportion of worn boards alone cannot decide between them.
7b659afe0a8fc5f61a2c.zh: 受损部件范围明确、其余板材与支撑连接仍合适时，现有露台可以考虑维修。若相连部件广泛损坏或需要改变布局，则可能考虑重建；不能只按磨损板材的比例决定。

8ac6e0302c957d66744e.en: Why is a timber paling fence leaning?

9df172b49a186acc73e3.en: A timber fence can lean because a post, footing, rail or connection has moved or deteriorated. Replacing loose palings alone will not correct a failing support. The affected length and condition of the retained sections guide repair or replacement.
9df172b49a186acc73e3.zh: 木围栏倾斜可能来自立柱、基础、横档或连接件位移及损坏。只换松动竖板无法修复失效支撑，应根据受损长度和保留部分的状况确定维修或更换。

de70cb87156a2221c554.en: Why does a timber gate sag or stop latching?
de70cb87156a2221c554.zh: 为什么木院门会下垂或停止锁定？

2ae1d86c7d826ca29bb7.en: A sagging gate can involve loose hinge fixings, a distorted gate frame or movement in the supporting post. The latch is often where the symptom appears. Adjusting it alone can leave the cause unresolved.
2ae1d86c7d826ca29bb7.zh: 院门下垂可能与铰链固定件松动、门框变形或支柱位移有关。门闩对不准往往只是表现，单独调整门闩可能仍未解决原因。

e02778ea016185cb45c8.en: Does a rotten pergola post need repair or replacement?
e02778ea016185cb45c8.zh: 腐烂的凉棚柱是否需要修理或更换？

00fcdfa35cbc2235ac67.en: A rotten pergola or verandah post must be assessed with the beams, connections and supports it carries. The post base may be the visible defect, but its supporting role determines whether a local repair, post replacement or wider work is appropriate.
00fcdfa35cbc2235ac67.zh: 腐朽的凉棚或廊檐立柱，应与其承托的横梁、连接和支撑一并评估。柱脚可能只是可见的损坏位置，实际承重作用决定局部维修、更换立柱或扩大工作的选择。

0e8a6538192bdbbbeebe.en: How should skirting be planned after new flooring?
0e8a6538192bdbbbeebe.zh: 新地板铺设后踢脚线应如何规划？

2df7370fcc8dda16d9d7.en: New flooring changes the wall-to-floor junction. Skirting needs to suit the finished level, the flooring detail and adjoining trim. Matching board height alone can leave a poor junction at door architraves or existing skirting.
2df7370fcc8dda16d9d7.zh: 新铺地板会改变墙面与地面的交接。踢脚线需要配合完成面高度、地板构造和相邻线条；只匹配板高，可能使门窗套线或原有踢脚线的交接不协调。

5bbd715ab1312154cdd7.en: Can one cupboard hinge or drawer runner be repaired?
5bbd715ab1312154cdd7.zh: 一个橱柜铰链或抽屉滑轨可以维修吗？

4f4b47ba65fe239ddc0b.en: One faulty cupboard door or drawer does not automatically require new cabinetry. A local repair depends on compatible hardware and sound fixing points. Damaged panels may need replacement, and older fittings may need a compatible alternative.
4f4b47ba65fe239ddc0b.zh: 单个柜门或抽屉故障，不代表必须更换整套柜体。局部维修需要匹配的五金和牢固固定点；损坏面板可能需更换，旧配件也可能需要寻找合适替代品。

574962773587f34c174b.en: What should you do about a loose timber stair or handrail?
574962773587f34c174b.zh: 如果木楼梯或扶手松动，您该怎么办？

3c75f96b1bcae875026f.en: Stop relying on a loose timber tread or handrail and arrange an assessment of its supports and connections. Movement can come from the component, its fixing or the material holding it. A cosmetic repair does not establish that it is safe to use.
3c75f96b1bcae875026f.zh: 不要继续依靠已经松动的木踏板或扶手，应安排检查支撑与连接。松动可能来自部件、紧固件或承托它们的材料；外观修补不能证明仍可安全使用。
