17e500bf9d523edfef8d.zh: 从配件和固定配件的材料开始

8e62f0957fff584b69fa.en: Adjustment is useful only where the hinge can hold
8e62f0957fff584b69fa.zh: 调节仅在铰链能够固定的情况下才有用

7ab4aca01ede24c52130.en: Runner length is only one compatibility check
7ab4aca01ede24c52130.zh: 滑轨长度并非唯一匹配条件

a1280352784c03d32062.en: Check the moisture source behind a swollen kickboard
a1280352784c03d32062.zh: 查找橱柜底部踢脚板膨胀的受潮原因

f7503b9c38a891477730.en: Keep wardrobe mechanisms and new storage proposals distinct
f7503b9c38a891477730.zh: 区分衣柜五金维修与新增收纳方案

03ccf8ac1d091c67542e.en: Details to send about cabinet faults
03ccf8ac1d091c67542e.zh: 发送有关机柜故障的详细信息

66f2040dedfb4965d3fc.en: A dropped cupboard door may need hinge adjustment, a new fitting or repair to the panel holding its screws. A drawer can tilt because of its runners, mounts or drawer box. Check these parts together: new hardware will not solve a swollen cabinet side that cannot hold a fixing. An isolated fault can often be assessed without treating the whole kitchen as a replacement job.
66f2040dedfb4965d3fc.zh: 掉落的橱柜门可能需要调整铰链、重新安装或修理固定螺钉的面板。抽屉可能会因其滑轨、支架或抽屉盒而倾斜。一起检查这些部件：新硬件无法解决无法固定固定件的膨胀柜侧问题。通常可以评估孤立的故障，而无需将整个厨房视为替代工作。

b837c8412753873ab9ec.en: Stop using a loose door or unstable drawer rather than repeatedly opening it to show the fault. Do not remove a heavy panel or pull a drawer free for a hardware photograph. Describe the problem and which cabinet it affects. The assessor can then plan access and identify whether replacement parts, panel repair or a wider scope should be considered.
b837c8412753873ab9ec.zh: 停止使用松动的门或不稳定的抽屉，而不是反复打开它来显示故障。请勿拆除沉重的面板或拉出抽屉来拍摄硬件照片。描述问题及其影响哪个机柜。然后，评估员可以计划进出条件并确定是否应考虑更换零件、面板维修或更广泛的范围。

9227db5e663808a82fee.en: An otherwise serviceable hinge may need alignment; a damaged hinge needs compatible hardware. If screws have pulled out of a swollen or broken panel, the timber or sheet material needs assessment first. Installing a new hinge into an unsuitable fixing point can repeat the problem. Ask whether the repair retains the door, the mounting plate and the cabinet side.
9227db5e663808a82fee.zh: 原本可用的铰链可能需要对齐；损坏的铰链需要兼容的硬件。如果螺钉从肿胀或破损的面板中拔出，则首先需要评估木材或板材。将新铰链安装到不合适的固定点可能会重复出现该问题。询问维修是否保留门、安装板和柜边。

4dc3f2c6dbddd34cd17f.en: Overlay, opening angle and the surrounding clearances influence hinge selection. A soft-close upgrade should not be assumed to fit an older door simply because the hinge looks familiar. Before ordering owner-supplied hardware, have the model and mounting arrangement confirmed. A local repair may retain most of the kitchen, but its limits should be explained where a panel no longer supports the required fixing.
4dc3f2c6dbddd34cd17f.zh: 重叠、打开角度和周围间隙影响铰链的选择。不应仅仅因为铰链看起来很熟悉就认为软关闭升级适合旧门。在订购业主提供的硬件之前，请确认型号和安装布置。局部维修可能会保留厨房的大部分，但在面板不再支持所需固定的情况下，应解释其局限性。

8ac7ae77d4dc56939cd9.en: Drawer runners differ in mounting method, extension, load class and motion features as well as length. Blum’s Australian range shows these distinctions. The replacement must match the actual drawer and cabinet, so a runner from that range is not automatically a substitute for an unidentified older fitting.
8ac7ae77d4dc56939cd9.zh: 抽屉滑轨在安装方法、延伸范围、负载等级和运动特征以及长度方面有所不同。 Blum 的澳大利亚系列展示了这些区别。替换件必须与实际的抽屉和橱柜相匹配，因此该系列的滑轨不会自动替代未识别的旧配件。

92632abaded7af676af5.en: Record a visible brand or part number only if it can be seen safely without dismantling. Include whether one drawer or several are affected and whether the fault developed suddenly or gradually. The repair proposal should confirm the replacement system, suitable mounting points and any drawer-box work. Parts availability can influence whether a direct replacement or a different agreed solution is practical.
92632abaded7af676af5.zh: 仅在无需拆卸即可安全看到的情况下记录可见的品牌或零件号。包括是否影响一个或多个抽屉以及故障是突然发生还是逐渐发生。维修建议应确认更换系统、合适的安装点和任何抽屉盒工作。零件可用性会影响直接更换或不同商定的解决方案是否可行。

c00fe54dbd7e46487432.en: Blum Australia: drawer runner systems and compatibility
c00fe54dbd7e46487432.zh: Blum Australia：抽屉滑轨系统和兼容性

cc80e5c0354fe29d8de0.en: A kickboard is the panel closing the gap beneath cabinets, not the skirting running around the room. If a plumbing leak has damaged it, confirm that the leak is resolved before replacement. Ask whether adjacent panels, feet or fixing locations also need assessment. A fresh kickboard can hide a continuing problem if the enquiry is treated only as a colour match.
cc80e5c0354fe29d8de0.zh: 踢脚线是封闭橱柜下方间隙的面板，而不是房间周围的踢脚线。如果管道泄漏已损坏它，请在更换前确认泄漏已解决。咨询相邻的面板、支脚或固定位置是否也需要评估。如果仅将咨询视为颜色匹配，则新的踢脚线可能会隐藏持续存在的问题。

65d12663268ece9f03ca.en: Water-damaged sheet material may not return to its original dimensions or fixing condition just because the visible surface dries. The extent and material need checking. Plumbing work belongs with the relevant qualified professional; cabinet reinstatement is a separate scope. Confirm removal, matching finish, edge details and access around appliances before a new panel is ordered.
65d12663268ece9f03ca.zh: 水损坏的片材可能不会仅仅因为可见表面干燥而恢复到其原始尺寸或固定状态。范围和材料需要检查。管道工作由相关合格专业人员进行；内阁恢复是一个单独的范围。在订购新面板之前，请确认拆卸、匹配饰面、边缘细节以及电器周围的通道。

81c6fd4ea296ac7519ee.en: A wardrobe sliding door coming off its track requires its rollers, track, stops and fixing arrangement assessed together. Do not lift out a heavy or mirrored door to inspect it yourself. Glass and mirrored panels need appropriate specialist handling. Repairing the mechanism differs from redesigning the wardrobe or replacing every cabinet in the room.
81c6fd4ea296ac7519ee.zh: 衣柜推拉门脱离轨道需要对其滚轮、轨道、止动件和紧固件进行一起评估。请勿打开沉重的门或带镜子的门自行检查。玻璃和镜面面板需要适当的专业处理。修复机械装置与重新设计衣柜或更换房间中的每个橱柜不同。

47af66ecf503296a5b54.en: New fitted storage needs a measured layout, materials, supply and installation responsibilities. The
47af66ecf503296a5b54.zh: 新安装的收纳需要经过测量的布局、材料、供应和安装责任。的

4a34e006161115574269.en: shows IKEA product assembly and fitting, not in-house cabinet manufacture or an IKEA partnership. A cabinet repair enquiry should therefore identify whether you want to restore an existing fitting or discuss a new storage installation.
4a34e006161115574269.zh: 显示 IKEA 产品组装和装配，而不是内部橱柜制造或 IKEA 合作伙伴关系。因此，橱柜维修咨询应确定您是要修复现有配件还是讨论新的收纳安装。

12cfc18e5c2efa3f5e53.en: , send your suburb, the cabinet location and one symptom per item. Optional overview and safely visible hardware photos can help identify the task. Mention any known leak, glass panel, appliance obstruction and existing product records. Do not buy a runner based only on a photograph of a similar kitchen.
12cfc18e5c2efa3f5e53.zh: ，发送您所在的郊区、橱柜位置以及每件商品的一种症状。可选的概述和安全可见的硬件照片可以帮助识别任务。提及任何已知的泄漏、玻璃面板、设备阻塞和现有的产品记录。不要仅根据类似厨房的照片购买抽屉滑轨。

0e7bfe2d3b6d6ff845af.en: Ask the quote to separate hardware, fixing-point repair, panels and finish. For several units, list each fault so an adjustment is not confused with panel replacement. The
0e7bfe2d3b6d6ff845af.zh: 询问单独硬件、固定点维修、面板和饰面的报价。对于多个单元，列出每个故障，这样调整就不会与面板更换混淆。的

b989e5dd95865c61da54.en: explains how supply and fitting affect the price. A matching-looking hinge or runner is only suitable if its mounting arrangement and clearances also work.
b989e5dd95865c61da54.zh: 解释供应和安装如何影响价格。仅当安装布置和间隙也正常时，外观相匹配的铰链或滑轨才是合适的。

2ea27abf5f315d543115.en: Should I order a runner with the same visible length?
2ea27abf5f315d543115.zh: 我应该订购具有相同可见长度的跑步鞋吗？

bca3b5d72ce87a9e2313.en: Length is only one compatibility check. Mounting arrangement, clearances, load and fixing locations also need to suit the existing drawer and cabinet.
bca3b5d72ce87a9e2313.zh: 长度只是一项兼容性检查。安装布置、间隙、负载和固定位置也需要适合现有的抽屉和柜子。

a73d61438c760f50aa1e.en: Does a pulled-out hinge mean the whole cabinet is finished?
a73d61438c760f50aa1e.zh: 铰链拉出是否意味着整个橱柜已经完成？

5b5da4f6bf1b0dd047c0.en: Not necessarily. The panel condition and available repair method determine whether a sound fixing can be restored locally or a panel needs replacement.
5b5da4f6bf1b0dd047c0.zh: 不一定。面板状况和可用的修复方法决定是否可以在本地恢复完好修复或面板需要更换。

a22d30ec808a60eb93da.en: How do I know whether drawer runners can be replaced?
a22d30ec808a60eb93da.zh: 我如何知道抽屉滑轨是否可以更换？

7a09e3928288423b03cf.en: Runner length, mounting position, load requirements and sound fixing points determine compatibility. Our assessment identifies a suitable replacement and any panel repair needed before fitting.
7a09e3928288423b03cf.zh: 抽屉滑轨长度、安装位置、负载要求和完好固定点决定兼容性。我们的评估确定了合适的更换件以及安装前所需的任何面板维修。

9d9a36e48e50ce7fd2af.en: What is the difference between cabinet repairs and custom cabinetry?
9d9a36e48e50ce7fd2af.zh: 橱柜维修和定制橱柜有什么区别？

a0b7a677dbb732ac66ce.en: Cabinet repairs restore existing doors, drawers, fittings or panels. Custom cabinetry creates a measured storage layout with specified manufacture, materials and installation; the quote distinguishes the two scopes.
a0b7a677dbb732ac66ce.zh: 橱柜维修修复现有的门、抽屉、配件或面板。定制橱柜通过指定的制造、材料和安装创建了一个测量的收纳布局；引用区分了两个范围。

e8930f3679d01dda7607.en: Cabinet door and drawer repairs for loose hinges, failed runners, damaged fixing points and kickboards. Compatible parts and sound panel material determine the repair.
e8930f3679d01dda7607.zh: 维修柜门铰链松动、抽屉滑轨故障、固定点及橱柜底部踢脚板损坏等问题。维修方案取决于五金是否匹配，以及面板是否仍能牢固固定。

7711f23ab350f464e0a7.zh: 探索橱柜门和抽屉维修 ↗

fbfcea8dd4e7569b0e97.en: Contact Ellis for an on-site assessment and a written repair plan and quote.
fbfcea8dd4e7569b0e97.zh: 联系 Ellis 获取现场评估以及书面维修计划和报价。

e1ce617211670e05f4ad.en: How should you prioritise carpentry repairs before selling? ↗
e1ce617211670e05f4ad.zh: 在出售之前您应该如何优先考虑木工维修？ ↗

eaec2f4beb329f737597.en: How should skirting be planned after new flooring? ↗
eaec2f4beb329f737597.zh: 新地板铺设后踢脚线应如何规划？ ↗

64bef374b832292c3426.en: Carpentry Before Selling Your Home | Ellis Services Group
64bef374b832292c3426.zh: 在出售之前您应该如何优先考虑木工维修？ | Ellis Services Group

1ee4b1af7355a4b9b241.en: Plan pre-sale carpentry repairs by separating safety, operation and finish. Group the task list, confirm access and compare itemised repair inclusions.
1ee4b1af7355a4b9b241.zh: 将安全、操作和完成分开来规划售前木工维修。对任务列表进行分组、确认进出条件并比较逐项修复内容。

ef7703eaec0079df4801.en: Carpenter measuring an upright timber member beside a workbench
ef7703eaec0079df4801.zh: 木工测量工作台旁边的直立木材构件

83b263d3da80697d208f.en: Illustrative detail: measuring and defining each task helps prioritise a list of carpentry repairs. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
83b263d3da80697d208f.zh: 说明性细节：测量和定义每项任务有助于确定木工维修列表的优先顺序。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

1a7d0e76502faf058755.en: Put safety and everyday operation ahead of cosmetic lists
1a7d0e76502faf058755.zh: 先处理安全与使用问题，再考虑外观修整

6b4e57c26821e828edfe.en: Make a room-by-room list the assessor can use
6b4e57c26821e828edfe.zh: 制作评估员可以使用的逐个房间的列表

ecac3b0f1250c435b4c1.en: Coordinate fix-out carpentry with flooring and painting
ecac3b0f1250c435b4c1.zh: 协调木作收尾、铺地与涂装顺序

6df0148a1440f60317f9.en: Assess local cabinet faults before replacing storage
6df0148a1440f60317f9.zh: 更换柜体前先检查局部故障

fe0a0145352ac1885774.en: Measure and plan new built-in storage
fe0a0145352ac1885774.zh: 测量和规划新的内置收纳

9aa1a104014b89101314.en: Plan access around occupants and the actual booking
9aa1a104014b89101314.zh: 结合住户安排确认施工进出时间

b8bacc8e5e2c61025cf3.en: Separate priority repairs from optional upgrades
b8bacc8e5e2c61025cf3.zh: 将优先维修与可选升级分开

60ccfc75aee26fdcf917.en: Put unreliable doors, loose fittings and unsafe stairs or rails at the top of a pre-sale repair list. Next consider damaged skirting, architraves and unfinished room junctions. Distinguish a defect from an optional upgrade: restoring a cupboard hinge may be enough without replacing the storage. These repairs improve the agreed components; their effect on a sale price or timing is uncertain.
60ccfc75aee26fdcf917.zh: 将不可靠的门、松动的配件以及不安全的楼梯或栏杆放在售前维修清单的顶部。接下来考虑损坏的踢脚线、门窗套线和未完工的房间连接处。将缺陷与可选升级区分开来：修复橱柜铰链可能就足够了，而无需更换收纳设备。这些维修改进了约定的组件；它们对销售价格或时间的影响是不确定的。

2aa68f1558097ab26ec1.en: If a tread, barrier or outdoor structure appears unsafe, avoid the affected area and arrange assessment. Do not test it again to decide whether it belongs on the list. A sticking door, failed latch and loose hinge may be three descriptions of one opening problem, so group symptoms by component instead of multiplying jobs before the cause is known.
2aa68f1558097ab26ec1.zh: 如果踏板、障碍物或室外结构看起来不安全，请避开受影响的区域并安排评估。不要再次测试它来决定它是否属于该列表。门卡住、闩锁失效和铰链松动可能是对一个打开问题的三种描述，因此按组件对症状进行分组，而不是在找出原因之前进行多次工作。

5d4ede44ed614e8428bc.en: Give each item a location and one clear observed issue: laundry door rubs at the bottom; kitchen drawer drops on the right; hallway skirting has a damaged length. Add the intended result, such as restoring operation or matching retained trim. A description is enough to start, with optional safe photos where they show more than the words.
5d4ede44ed614e8428bc.zh: 为每件物品提供一个位置和一个明显观察到的问题：洗衣房门底部有摩擦；厨房抽屉位于右侧；走廊踢脚线的长度已损坏。添加预期结果，例如恢复操作或匹配保留的装饰。描述就足以开始，可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片显示的不仅仅是文字。

d21278f8a06a4fd4b152.en: Mention flooring, painting and other work already planned, plus any known leak or pest assessment. Include your suburb and the person authorised to arrange access. A task list also helps distinguish necessary repairs from optional upgrades, so ask for separate items where you may choose to accept only part of the proposal.
d21278f8a06a4fd4b152.zh: 提及地板、油漆和其他已计划的工作，以及任何已知的泄漏或虫害评估。包括您所在的郊区和有权安排进出条件的人员。任务列表还有助于区分必要的维修和可选的升级，因此要求提供单独的项目，您可以选择仅接受部分建议。

3d4e375df41410258649.en: Fix-out generally refers to the finishing components of a build or renovation, such as internal doors and trims; the actual quote must name the requested work. New floor levels can affect door clearance and skirting junctions. Finishing a missing architrave after door replacement differs from repairing the structural frame, so describe both if they are affected.
3d4e375df41410258649.zh: 装修通常是指建筑或翻新的装修部件，例如内门和装饰；实际报价必须命名所请求的作品。新的楼层可能会影响门间隙和踢脚线连接处。更换门后完成缺失的门窗套线与修复结构框架不同，因此请描述两者是否受到影响。

52bea98f856a23bd673e.en: Agree who completes removal, fitting, caulking, priming and final painting. A fitted board is not necessarily a decorated room. Protecting new flooring and accessing walls behind furniture also require planning. The
52bea98f856a23bd673e.zh: 同意由谁完成拆卸、安装、填缝、底漆和最终涂漆。安装好的木板不一定是装饰好的房间。保护新地板和进入家具后面的墙壁也需要规划。的

e97b4d7476e26a8b68a9.en: explains the junction and sequencing questions that are useful before a sale photography date is set.
e97b4d7476e26a8b68a9.zh: 解释了在设定销售摄影日期之前有用的连接和排序问题。

352e8807fa9887d8a6bb.en: A failed hinge, runner or kickboard can be a defined repair to an existing kitchen or wardrobe. Hardware compatibility and sound mounting points determine the option. Full cabinet replacement is a different decision, with supply and installation responsibilities to agree. Do not assume a loose cupboard door requires a whole new kitchen, or that a new hinge solves a damaged panel.
352e8807fa9887d8a6bb.zh: 出现故障的铰链、滑轨或踢脚线可以是对现有厨房或衣柜的明确修复。硬件兼容性和完好安装点决定了选项。整个机柜更换是一个不同的决定，需要商定供应和安装责任。不要认为松动的橱柜门需要一个全新的厨房，或者新的铰链可以解决损坏的面板。

111e383c9d558f3f3265.en: For shelves in an uneven alcove, discuss the intended use, wall type, fixing positions and concealed-service considerations. A shelf is not safely specified by width alone. Electrical, plumbing and glazing tasks need their appropriate professionals. See
111e383c9d558f3f3265.zh: 对于凹凸不平的凹室中的架子，讨论其预期用途、墙壁类型、固定位置和隐藏式服务注意事项。仅通过宽度来指定架子是不安全的。电气、管道和玻璃任务需要合适的专业人员。参见

321aee3656e91d9354e4.en: for the repair checks that can keep this part of the list focused.
321aee3656e91d9354e4.zh: 用于修复检查，可以使列表的这一部分保持重点。

8fea2d8fe3935051d7d3.en: Built-in storage is fitted to the room, so its doors, drawers and fixing points must suit the measured space. Standard units may work with fitted edge details; an awkward opening may need separately manufactured components. Establish the product and who supplies or makes it before buying. Freestanding furniture has a different relationship to the walls and surrounding trim.
8fea2d8fe3935051d7d3.zh: 内置储物柜安装在房间内，因此其门、抽屉和固定点必须适合测量的空间。标准单元可与合适的边缘细节配合使用；一个尴尬的开口可能需要单独制造的组件。在购买前确定产品以及谁供应或制造该产品。独立式家具与墙壁和周围装饰有不同的关系。

ddb6a0df92d2263e2a49.en: For a wardrobe enquiry, include the space, intended storage, door arrangement, obstructions, existing units and finish expectations. Ask who supplies the product and who completes assembly and fitting. The
ddb6a0df92d2263e2a49.zh: 对于衣柜咨询，请包括空间、预期收纳空间、门布置、障碍物、现有单元和完成预期。咨询谁提供产品以及谁完成组装和安装。的

87da99a1fa5237d1e2f3.en: records that particular assembly and fitting scope; it does not establish a universal custom-manufacture service or a product partnership.
87da99a1fa5237d1e2f3.zh: 记录特定的装配和装配范围；它不建立通用的定制制造服务或产品合作伙伴关系。

e723b3b8b3cd2c794131.en: An occupied or tenanted property needs an authorised contact, agreed entry and a workable area. Mention keys, parking, furniture, pets and agent coordination when relevant. A proposed sale or inspection date helps explain your timing needs but does not guarantee availability. Confirm material lead times and accepted appointments with the team before relying on a completion date.
e723b3b8b3cd2c794131.zh: 占用或出租的财产需要授权联系人、同意进入和可用区域。相关时提及钥匙、停车位、家具、宠物和代理协调。拟议的销售或检查日期有助于解释您的时间需求，但不能保证可用性。在确定完成日期之前，先确认材料交付时间并与团队接受预约。

e8b9df23affe228e5d77.en: If an assessment reveals a larger moisture or structural problem, keep it visible in the work plan rather than treating it as a rushed touch-up. Ask the appropriate property professional about any sale documentation or disclosure questions. The carpenter’s scope describes the physical work and its limits; it cannot decide the transaction’s legal requirements.
e8b9df23affe228e5d77.zh: 如果评估发现较大的潮湿或结构问题，请将其在工作计划中保持可见，而不是将其视为仓促的修补。有关任何销售文件或披露问题，请咨询相应的房地产专业人士。木工的范围描述了体力工作及其限制；它无法决定交易的法律要求。

447375a76f57a2133c3b.en: Ask for labour, materials, supply responsibility, removal, finish and access to be clear for the accepted tasks. Confirm any minimum booking or assessment charge and whether GST is included. Grouping several items may make coordination easier, but it does not establish a discount or mean every task can be completed at one visit.
447375a76f57a2133c3b.zh: 要求明确接受的任务的劳动力、材料、供应责任、拆除、完成和进出条件。确认最低预约或评估费用以及是否包含 GST。将多个项目分组可能会使协调更容易，但这并不意味着折扣或意味着每项任务都可以一次完成。

4101831260ecc13a5441.en: for an on-site assessment. Ask the written repair plan and quote to distinguish priority defects from optional upgrades. This makes it easier to accept the necessary work and coordinate flooring, painting and access around the actual booking.
4101831260ecc13a5441.zh: 进行现场评估。询问书面维修计划和报价，以区分优先缺陷和可选升级。这样可以更轻松地接受必要的工作，并在实际预约时协调地板、油漆和通道。

cd1c6833b52adc6fc071.en: Can several repairs be assessed together?
cd1c6833b52adc6fc071.zh: 多项维修可以一起评估吗？

295380adf50f59d99dea.en: Provide one list with each item and location. The team can assess the requested tasks together and confirm the grouped scope, access and quote.
295380adf50f59d99dea.zh: 提供一份包含每个项目和位置的列表。团队可以一起评估所请求的任务并确认分组范围、现场进入条件和报价。

90e35a487f70633fd54e.en: Should every cupboard be replaced before a sale?
90e35a487f70633fd54e.zh: 销售前是否应该更换每个橱柜？

dc4828663b2d77fc2162.en: A local hinge, runner or panel fault should be assessed before assuming full replacement. New cabinetry is a separate measured scope and decision.
dc4828663b2d77fc2162.zh: 在进行完全更换之前，应评估局部铰链、抽屉滑轨或面板故障。新橱柜是单独衡量范围和决定的。

daad5ca7112346e363fe.en: What is the difference between a carpenter, a joiner and a cabinetmaker?
daad5ca7112346e363fe.zh: 木工、木作和木作之间有什么区别？

a0ef83d76eb0ffeb70dc.en: Carpentry includes on-site timber repair and installation; joinery focuses on fitted timber components, while cabinetmaking focuses on cabinets and storage units. Ellis confirms the measured design, supply and fitting arrangements for the work you request.
a0ef83d76eb0ffeb70dc.zh: 木工包括现场木材修理和安装；木作专注于安装木材组件，而橱柜制造则专注于橱柜和储物单元。 Ellis 确认您所要求的工作的测量设计、供应和安装安排。

d854a57c65d79cef3651.en: How are shelves fixed safely to different wall types?
d854a57c65d79cef3651.zh: 如何将架子安全地固定到不同类型的墙壁上？

bd2365bb3eba946378f5.en: The wall substrate, fixing locations and intended shelf load determine the fixing system. Ellis checks the installation area and concealed-service considerations before specifying the shelving and supports.
bd2365bb3eba946378f5.zh: 墙壁基材、固定位置和预期的货架负载决定了固定系统。 Ellis 在指定搁架和支撑之前检查安装区域和隐蔽服务注意事项。

346d095a4a37aa08383f.en: When do I need custom joinery instead of general carpentry?
346d095a4a37aa08383f.zh: 我什么时候需要定制木作而不是普通木工？

cd29605ee4087222efa5.en: Custom joinery suits measured alcoves, under-stair storage or fitted units where standard dimensions do not deliver the required layout. We measure the space and confirm design, materials and installation in your proposal.
cd29605ee4087222efa5.zh: 定制木作适合标准尺寸无法提供所需布局的测量凹室、楼梯下收纳空间或安装单元。我们测量空间并确认您提案中的设计、材料和安装。

d4f8c41a629df108c54a.en: What is the difference between built-in storage and freestanding furniture?
d4f8c41a629df108c54a.zh: 内置储物和独立式家具有什么区别？

43e3336d844b5b49cdd0.en: Built-in storage is measured and fixed to the property; freestanding furniture is a separate movable item. Built-in work requires checks of the available space, substrates and fixing locations.
43e3336d844b5b49cdd0.zh: 内置收纳已测量并固定在财产上；独立式家具是一个单独的可移动物品。内置工作需要检查可用空间、基材和固定位置。

a99460f4ecaab3741f3d.zh: 将几个小木工工作分组

6942c4c11d4f8099cd01.en: Understand custom joinery and built-in storage
6942c4c11d4f8099cd01.zh: 了解定制木作和内置收纳

95ee2342b266bcad31a6.en: Interior and renovation carpentry for shelving, timber panelling and unfinished room details. Layout, fixing surfaces and adjoining finishes guide the installation scope.
95ee2342b266bcad31a6.zh: 提供层板、木质墙面镶板及室内装修木作收尾。根据布局、固定基面和相邻饰面确认安装范围。

f9c1a6c33d404a55393f.en: Can one cupboard hinge or drawer runner be repaired? ↗
f9c1a6c33d404a55393f.zh: 一个橱柜铰链或抽屉滑轨可以维修吗？ ↗

66a6a83b46d85612f2ea.en: Carpentry Quote Cost Factors | Ellis Services Group
66a6a83b46d85612f2ea.zh: 木工报价：什么影响成本？ | Ellis Services Group

42a4b1913c88a28b5268.en: Compare carpentry quotes by labour, materials, access, finishing and visit charges. Understand hourly-rate questions without assuming a standard price.
42a4b1913c88a28b5268.zh: 按人工、材料、进出条件、收尾处理和上门费用比较木工报价。在不假设标准价格的情况下了解小时费率问题。

9f8d66b5eb9ccb700eeb.en: Carpenter using a tape measure on an upright timber member
9f8d66b5eb9ccb700eeb.zh: 木工在直立木材构件上使用卷尺

1130b9d50658cfcd620d.en: Illustrative detail: dimensions, access and the extent of work contribute to a measured quote. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
1130b9d50658cfcd620d.zh: 说明性细节：尺寸、现场进入条件和工作范围有助于衡量报价。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

957715ed4e8a29e9a911.en: Compare the completed job before comparing the price
957715ed4e8a29e9a911.zh: 在比较价格之前先比较已完成的工作

0519cd661c16f0ea31bf.en: Hourly work, fixed scope and allowances need clear terms
0519cd661c16f0ea31bf.zh: 写明计时收费、约定范围与预留项目

a9ed7906b85f06398c42.en: Hidden damage can increase the work required
a9ed7906b85f06398c42.zh: 隐藏的损坏会增加所需的工作量

39109580c82206a02d92.en: Materials and customer-supplied items change the proposal
39109580c82206a02d92.zh: 材料和客户提供的项目更改提案

eb9822367fab6a5e300f.en: Access, removal and decoration are real work items
eb9822367fab6a5e300f.zh: 进出条件、拆除和装饰是真正的工作项目

2f8e6e7e369554f88fda.en: Confirm assessment and minimum charges directly
2f8e6e7e369554f88fda.zh: 直接确认评估和最低费用

330825cfbb52d96c9d3a.en: Check the roles required by the work

d284e59f9530aed4feb8.en: Send a task list that supports a clear quote
d284e59f9530aed4feb8.zh: 发送支持明确报价的任务列表

60588191170ce523342e.en: Compare what each quote delivers: the parts to repair or replace, supplied materials, access, removal and finishing. An hourly rate covers labour on a stated basis; a board price covers material. Neither shows the whole job. A small sill defect may involve matching an old profile and arranging glazing access, while a longer straight trim run may be simpler to fit.
60588191170ce523342e.zh: 比较每个报价提供的内容：要维修或更换的零件、提供的材料、进出条件、拆卸和表面与收边处理。小时费率涵盖了规定的劳动力；一块板的价格涵盖了材料。两者都没有显示整个工作。小窗台缺陷可能涉及匹配旧型材并安排玻璃通道，而较长的直线装饰可能更容易安装。

781a66f8cf273e2f0803.en: Start with the component and the outcome you want: restore a closing door, replace a defined board group, fit matching trim or build a new deck. Then compare proposals for that same outcome. If one quote includes removal and decoration and another only installs supplied timber, the total prices answer different questions even if the job title looks identical.
781a66f8cf273e2f0803.zh: 从组件和您想要的结果开始：恢复关闭的门、更换定义的板组、安装匹配的装饰或构建新的露台。然后比较相同结果的建议。如果一份报价包括拆除和装饰，而另一份报价仅安装提供的木材，那么即使职位名称看起来相同，总价格也会回答不同的问题。

2be310572e1119c96cdb.en: Ask whether the proposed work is priced as an agreed scope, time-based labour or a combination with specified allowances. For time-based work, clarify what time and charges are included. For a quoted scope, check the assumptions and exclusions. The useful question is how the price is calculated for your accepted work, not which charging label is always better.
2be310572e1119c96cdb.zh: 询问拟议工作的定价是否为商定的范围、基于时间的劳动力或与指定预留项目与费用的组合。对于基于时间的工作，请明确包括哪些时间和费用。对于引用的范围，请检查假设和排除情况。有用的问题是如何计算您接受的作品的价格，而不是哪个收费标签总是更好。

0639d0a492506d666f16.en: An allowance for uncertain material or concealed work needs an explanation of what it covers and how it is reconciled. A safe photograph can help prepare an assessment, but it cannot establish every fixing point or hidden support. Ask what remains to be checked on site before treating an early estimate as a complete agreed price.
0639d0a492506d666f16.zh: 对不确定材料或隐蔽工作的预留项目与费用需要解释其涵盖的内容以及如何协调。一张安全的照片可以帮助准备评估，但它不能确定每个固定点或隐藏的支撑。在将早期估算视为完全商定的价格之前，询问现场还需要检查哪些内容。

2404693dcdce9cdba993.en: A soft sill corner may extend into the frame; a loose deck board may involve its support; a cupboard hinge may have damaged mounting timber. These distinctions affect labour and materials. The assessment should identify suitable retained components, the proposed replacement boundary and any inspection access required. A narrow visible patch is not necessarily a narrow repair.
2404693dcdce9cdba993.zh: 软门槛角可以延伸到框架中；松动的露台可能会影响其支撑；橱柜铰链可能损坏了安装木材。这些区别会影响劳动力和材料。评估应确定合适的保留部件、建议的更换边界以及所需的任何检查通道。狭窄的可见补丁不一定是狭窄的修复。

2ca12eff110827161e1a.en: Ask how further findings will be documented and when the price is reviewed. Additional work should have an explained scope and agreed price basis before it proceeds. The
2ca12eff110827161e1a.zh: 询问如何记录进一步的调查结果以及何时审查价格。额外的工作在进行之前应有解释的范围和商定的价格基础。的

bc69348a4dda21835e30.en: shows why apparently similar requests can become different construction scopes once the retained structure and intended layout are considered.
bc69348a4dda21835e30.zh: 说明了为什么一旦考虑到保留的结构和预期布局，明显相似的请求可能会变成不同的施工范围。

385761cc0e6d04eda597.en: Species, profile, dimensions, coating and hardware compatibility influence the specification. A common trim profile and a difficult match to old joinery can require different supply arrangements. Ask who orders the material, whether delivery is included and what happens if the selected item is unavailable. New material can remain visible beside weathered timber even after finishing.
385761cc0e6d04eda597.zh: 品种、轮廓、尺寸、涂层和硬件兼容性会影响规格。常见的装饰轮廓和与旧木作的困难匹配可能需要不同的供应安排。询问谁订购了材料，是否包括送货，以及如果所选项目缺货会发生什么。即使在完成后，新材料在风化木材旁边仍然可见。

218b540904b84eade235.en: Owner-supplied products still need suitability and dimensions checked before fitting is agreed. A door, hinge or runner that looks similar may not be compatible with the existing assembly. Confirm responsibility for missing or unsuitable components and any extra visit they could require. Buying first and asking the installer to make it fit can change the job rather than reduce its cost.
218b540904b84eade235.zh: 业主提供的产品在同意安装之前仍需要检查适用性和尺寸。看起来相似的门、铰链或滑轨可能与现有组件不兼容。确认丢失或不合适的组件的责任以及他们可能需要的任何额外访问。先购买并要求安装人员安装可能会改变工作而不是降低成本。

a31074681fe5a3feed7a.en: Mention height, stairs, narrow side access, occupied rooms and authorised entry arrangements. Safe equipment and protecting adjoining surfaces can be part of a small repair. Removal and disposal also need a defined boundary, especially with unknown old materials. A price for new timber alone should not be compared directly with one that includes dismantling and making good.
a31074681fe5a3feed7a.zh: 提及高度、楼梯、狭窄的侧面通道、占用的房间和授权的进入安排。安全设备和保护相邻表面可以是小型维修的一部分。清除和处置也需要一个明确的界限，特别是对于未知的旧材料。不应将新木材的价格单独与包括拆解和修复的价格直接进行比较。

978d688d57537984b07e.en: Clarify preparation, priming, painting, staining or oiling by area and product where relevant. Primed boards are not the same as final-painted trim, and new deck boards are not automatically a sanded and oiled deck. Ask who moves furniture and who finishes the wall or floor affected by the work. These questions make the handover understandable before booking.
978d688d57537984b07e.zh: 按相关区域和产品明确准备、底漆、涂漆、染色或涂油。涂底漆的板与最终涂漆的装饰不同，新的露台不会自动成为经过打磨和涂油的露台。询问谁搬动家具以及谁完成受工作影响的墙壁或地板。这些问题使得预约前的交接事宜变得容易理解。

0dab73dda78f0c1030da.en: Ask whether an assessment, call-out, travel or minimum booking charge applies to your enquiry, how it is calculated and whether any amount is credited against later work. Do not assume that requesting a quote includes a free visit. Actual arrangements need confirmation with the team, particularly when a visit is needed to identify hidden damage or a difficult profile.
0dab73dda78f0c1030da.zh: 咨询评估、上门服务、旅行或最低预约费用是否适用于您的咨询，其计算方式以及是否有任何金额计入后续工作。不要假设请求报价包括免费访问。实际安排需要与团队确认，特别是当需要进行访问以识别隐藏的损坏或难以匹配的截面造型时。

cdc17e55591903c1fb59.en: For several small jobs, send one list with locations and symptoms. Ask whether they can be assessed together and how the quote treats each task. Grouping work does not establish a discount or a guaranteed single visit. Confirm whether the price includes GST, agreed products, delivery and disposal, and ask about payment terms and quote validity before acceptance.
cdc17e55591903c1fb59.zh: 对于几项小型工作，请发送一份包含位置和症状的清单。询问是否可以一起评估它们以及报价如何对待每项任务。分组工作不提供折扣或保证单次访问。确认价格是否包含GST、约定产品、交货和处置，并在验收前询问付款条件和报价有效性。

921ede55232d3a73644c.en: A timber quote should identify relevant specialist responsibilities rather than imply that every task is general carpentry. Ask who handles glazing, locks, electrical or plumbing work, roof leaks, suspected asbestos, pest findings and structural or approval checks where they affect the project. The work and contracting arrangements determine which qualifications, licences and insurance evidence should be checked.
921ede55232d3a73644c.zh: 木材报价应确定相关的专业职责，而不是暗示每项任务都是一般木工。询问谁负责处理影响项目的玻璃、锁、电气或管道工程、屋顶漏水、疑似石棉、害虫发现以及结构或审批检查。工作和合同安排决定了应检查哪些资格、执照和保险证据。

8058b5c9cf5284b1039a.en: Request current qualifications, licence and insurance evidence relevant to the actual work, and identify the contracting entity. If a leak, glazing task or structural assessment must happen first, name that dependency and its responsible professional in the proposal. This makes the repair sequence and costs easier to compare without assuming that every trade is included.
8058b5c9cf5284b1039a.zh: 要求提供与实际工作相关的现有资格、执照和保险证据，并确定承包实体。如果必须首先发生泄漏、玻璃安装任务或结构评估，请在提案中注明该依赖性及其负责的专业人员。这使得维修顺序和成本更容易比较，而无需假设每笔交易都包括在内。

e888e71b40b0d193a3cd.en: Give Ellis your suburb, the component, symptoms, intended finish and access details. Optional safe photos and available product records help describe the task; do not dismantle or enter an unsafe area to obtain them. For new work, include the intended use and any plans. For repeat repairs, include the earlier scope and known cause if available.
e888e71b40b0d193a3cd.zh: 提供 Ellis 您的郊区、组成部分、症状、预期完成和进出条件详细信息。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片和可用的产品记录有助于描述任务；请勿拆卸或进入不安全区域获取它们。对于新工作，请包括预期用途和任何计划。对于重复维修，请包括早期范围和已知原因（如果有）。

a7c565aa617cadb543bb.en: or the appropriate entry in the

7649ab1a18f2e100e66d.en: . Before acceptance, check written inclusions, exclusions and how additional findings will be priced. Keep the accepted quote and agreed changes together, including the material specification and final finishing area.
7649ab1a18f2e100e66d.zh: 。在接受之前，请检查书面包含项、排除项以及其他发现结果的定价方式。将接受的报价和商定的变更放在一起，包括材料规格和最终表面与收边处理区域。

a166a28c1865254bc6a5.en: Can I get the final repair price from a photograph?
a166a28c1865254bc6a5.zh: 我可以从照片中得到最终的维修价格吗？

be82028f4f934d019710.en: A safe photo can help explain the request, but it does not establish concealed timber condition, fixing access or the complete repair extent. Ellis confirms the proposed work and quote after assessment.
be82028f4f934d019710.zh: 在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以帮助解释请求，但它不能确定隐藏的木材条件、固定通道或完整的修复范围。 Ellis 评估后确认拟议的工作和报价。

716ed9bf9d049a3e9635.en: Does an enquiry include a free visit?
716ed9bf9d049a3e9635.zh: 咨询是否包括免费上门？

0839d4c284297d98785c.en: Do not assume that it does. Ask the team to confirm any assessment, call-out or minimum booking charge before accepting the appointment.
0839d4c284297d98785c.zh: 不要假设它确实如此。在接受预约之前，请要求团队确认任何评估、上门服务或最低预约费用。

557e9f05638809fdd4c9.en: What should I send for several small jobs?
557e9f05638809fdd4c9.zh: 几个小工作我应该寄什么？

bc1ece630b29c2c8cde5.en: Send one task per line, the room or outdoor location, your suburb and access details. Optional safe photos can be emailed separately; a clear description is enough to start the enquiry.
bc1ece630b29c2c8cde5.zh: 每行发送一项任务、房间或室外位置、您的郊区和进出条件详细信息。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以单独通过电子邮件发送；清晰的描述足以开始咨询。

a0ac0fbefb05758bb573.en: Define a new deck or extension quote
a0ac0fbefb05758bb573.zh: 定义新的露台或扩展报价

2910758fdeb48b5ff660.en: Choose the carpentry service for your work
2910758fdeb48b5ff660.zh: 选择适合您工作的木工服务

058e3bfe79469ad682a5.en: Small timber repairs, from sticking doors and damaged trim to loose cupboard fittings. Several tasks can be described together, with each repair checked for suitable timber and hardware.
058e3bfe79469ad682a5.zh: 处理木门卡阻、收边线条破损、橱柜配件松动等小型木作维修。多个项目可一并说明，我们会分别检查木材与五金是否适合维修。

888a33242568c7d07762.en: Arrange an on-site assessment of the tasks you want included in the quote.
888a33242568c7d07762.zh: 对您想要包含在报价中的任务安排现场评估。

d48c06617d0130b47dfd.en: Should you repair an existing deck or rebuild it? ↗
d48c06617d0130b47dfd.zh: 您应该修复现有的露台还是重建它？ ↗

598d463c318bbf8e04c0.en: Deck Boards or Frame Repairs | Ellis Services Group
598d463c318bbf8e04c0.zh: 露台板或框架：什么需要修理？ | Ellis Services Group

85f5434ac291cd3910da.en: Separate worn deck boards from support problems. Learn what joists, bearers, posts and connections mean for a board-only repair or wider deck scope.
85f5434ac291cd3910da.zh: 将磨损的露台与支撑问题分开。了解托梁、支架、柱子和连接对于仅板维修或更广泛的露台范围意味着什么。

47527e92e6e32213cab4.en: Inspection of timber bearers, joists and connections below a deck
47527e92e6e32213cab4.zh: 检查露台下方的木梁、托梁和连接件

4223010c5b02300e1b52.en: Illustrative detail: the supports beneath the boards require a separate assessment from the walking surface. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
4223010c5b02300e1b52.zh: 说明性细节：板下方的支撑需要与行走表面分开评估。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

1d80315a47e0b1257874.en: Begin with the surface and the support system
1d80315a47e0b1257874.zh: 从表面和支撑系统开始

fd80fc206f761ee6fcc8.en: Check raised fixings and the timber holding them
fd80fc206f761ee6fcc8.zh: 检查翘起的紧固件与下方木材

ebb1b4086a9f512cd704.en: When a local board replacement is worth considering
ebb1b4086a9f512cd704.zh: 哪些情况下适合局部更换露台板

14873c6522182bee2770.en: When support findings change the job
14873c6522182bee2770.zh: 支撑结构损坏如何影响维修范围

6094ead07920fd76250f.en: Put sanding and oiling in the right place
6094ead07920fd76250f.zh: 区分木材维修与打磨上油

a35b0bd91962c5b0799f.en: Give the assessor the location and history
a35b0bd91962c5b0799f.zh: 向评估员提供位置和历史记录

437c5f54f246f361054a.en: Deck boards form the walking surface. Joists sit directly beneath them, bearers carry the joists, and posts and connections support the assembly. A worn board and a moving deck therefore need different checks. Board replacement is suitable only where the supports can hold the new boards and fixings; a tidy surface cannot demonstrate that concealed framing is sound.
437c5f54f246f361054a.zh: 露台板构成行走表面；托梁直接位于板下，承梁承托托梁，再由立柱与连接部件支撑。因此，板面磨损与整座露台晃动需要不同检查。只有原支撑足以固定新板及紧固件时，才适合单独换板；表面整洁并不能证明隐蔽框架完好。

ea6256c4870ff02aa2e2.en: A split around a screw, worn coating or raised edge tells you about the visible area. Softness or movement already noticed underfoot raises a safety question that cleaning cannot answer. Do not walk back over the spot to compare it with another board. Keep an unstable or visibly damaged area out of use while the assessment is arranged.
ea6256c4870ff02aa2e2.zh: 螺钉周围的裂痕、磨损的涂层或凸起的边缘告诉您可见区域。脚下已经注意到的柔软度或运动会引发清洁无法回答的安全问题。不要走回该位置并将其与另一块板进行比较。在安排评估期间，请勿使用不稳定或明显损坏的区域。

3f0703a15646fda742c8.en: A fixing can move because of the board, the fastener, the timber holding it or movement elsewhere in the assembly. Hammering it down may hide the symptom without establishing that it will hold. Several fixings lifting in one line give different information from one damaged board end. Describe that pattern and any earlier repair rather than adding more fixings before the visit.
3f0703a15646fda742c8.zh: 固定件可能会因板、紧固件、固定固定件的木材或组件中其他位置的移动而移动。敲定它可能会隐藏症状，但无法确定它是否会持续。一根线上的多个固定件从损坏的板端提供不同的信息。描述该模式和任何早期的修复，而不是在访问之前添加更多修复。

88edbc5a8665477e93c1.en: A replacement fixing needs sound timber beneath it. Inspection may require underside access or agreed board removal, because a top view cannot show every connection. If joists or other supports are damaged, repair them before fitting the new surface. Record any added work and price before extending the repair.
88edbc5a8665477e93c1.zh: 更换紧固件下方需要坚固的木材。检查可能需要从底部进入或同意拆除木板，因为顶视图无法显示每个连接。如果托梁或其他支撑件损坏，请在安装新表面之前对其进行修复。在延长维修之前记录所有增加的工作和价格。

11e183e6ee82b9382baf.en: Replacing a defined group of boards can preserve useful material where the surrounding surface and assessed supports remain suitable. The choice needs the board dimensions, the position of joins, fixing access and the condition at ends. A narrow damaged patch beside a stair or building junction may involve more detail than the same board area in an open middle section.
11e183e6ee82b9382baf.zh: 更换指定的一组木板可以保留有用的材料，而周围表面和评估的支撑仍然合适。选择需要考虑板尺寸、连接位置、固定通道和端部状况。楼梯或建筑物交界处旁边的狭窄损坏补丁可能比开放的中间部分中的相同板区域涉及更多细节。

923a726083f2dc17a66e.en: New timber can differ in colour and texture from weathered boards. Agree whether a reasonable material match or a broader appearance change is the goal. Sanding and coating retained boards are separate finishing decisions and may not make old and new timber identical. Ask to see the proposed material description before supply is ordered, particularly where the existing species is uncertain.
923a726083f2dc17a66e.zh: 新木材的颜色和纹理可能与风化板不同。就目标是合理的材料匹配还是更广泛的外观变化达成一致。打磨和涂覆保留的木板是单独的处理决定，可能不会使新旧木材相同。在订购之前要求查看建议的材料描述，特别是在现有物种不确定的情况下。

203a0f140bcbbbfc3174.en: Damaged joists, bearers, posts or building connections need their own assessment and repair scope. Reboarding over them can make future access harder while leaving the original fault. If adjoining components are affected, the visible board count is a poor measure of the repair extent. Safe access, the work sequence and any qualified structural input become part of deciding what can be retained.
203a0f140bcbbbfc3174.zh: 损坏的托梁、支架、柱子或建筑物连接需要单独的评估和维修范围。重新登录它们可能会使将来的进出条件变得更加困难，同时会保留原来的故障。如果相邻组件受到影响，则可见的木板数量并不能很好地衡量修复程度。安全通道、工作顺序和任何合格的结构输入都成为决定可以保留什么的一部分。

b0acd8dd9003615ec44a.en: Ask for the options to be explained once the condition is understood: local board repair, defined frame work or a wider rebuild proposal. The
b0acd8dd9003615ec44a.zh: 了解情况后要求解释选项：局部木板维修、定义的框架或更广泛的重建提案。的

3ca125d7d337a873a16b.en: compares these decisions in more detail. Neither a good-looking top nor the age of the deck alone settles which option is suitable.
3ca125d7d337a873a16b.zh: 更详细地比较了这些决策。漂亮的桌面和露台的年龄都不能单独决定哪种选择是合适的。

276f63a0792cf62b59cc.en: Surface care concerns cleaning, preparation and the protective finish. It does not restore a deteriorated support or prove the deck is safe. Resolve movement and damaged timber before agreeing an appearance-only treatment. WoodSolutions links finish maintenance to the selected coating and exposure, so a universal recoating interval is not a substitute for identifying your actual product.
276f63a0792cf62b59cc.zh: 表面护理涉及清洁、准备和保护性表面处理。它不能恢复受损的支撑或证明露台是安全的。在同意仅进行外观处理之前，先解决移动和损坏的木材问题。 WoodSolutions 将完成维护与所选涂层和曝光联系起来，因此通用重涂间隔不能替代识别您的实际产品。

b4d9ac5b78565e37074a.en: Where repair and care are both requested, ask whether preparation covers all boards or only replacements, which coating is proposed and how the existing finish affects compatibility. Read
b4d9ac5b78565e37074a.zh: 如果同时要求维修和保养，请询问准备工作是否涵盖所有板或仅覆盖替换板、建议采用哪种涂层以及现有饰面如何影响兼容性。阅读

fa96c68cc5c7956d2084.en: before comparing a small repair price with a complete cleaning and oiling quote. The treated area and preparation can be substantially different.
fa96c68cc5c7956d2084.zh: ，然后将小额维修价格与完整的清洁和上油报价进行比较。治疗区域和准备工作可能有很大不同。

5367793b52bd16d8453a.en: WoodSolutions: timber decking and finish maintenance

9fb16cdf79c798b6832e.en: Send the suburb, the affected part of the deck and the symptoms already noticed. Mention stairs, railings, a building junction, known leaks and earlier repairs. An overview from stable ground and any existing underside view can help, but do not crawl below an unsafe deck or lift boards for photographs. Plans, material records and previous scopes are useful if you already have them.
9fb16cdf79c798b6832e.zh: 发送郊区、受影响的露台部分以及已经注意到的症状。提及楼梯、栏杆、建筑物连接处、已知的泄漏和早期的维修。从稳定的地面和任何现有的底部视图进行概览会有所帮助，但不要爬到不安全的露台或升降板下方拍照。如果您已经拥有计划、材料记录和以前的范围，那么它们会很有用。

acaf2fa5b4a682285c7b.en: , compare the boards, support repairs, fixings, removal, access and finish listed in the quote. Identify any supports that could not be inspected initially and how later findings will be handled. A board-only price should be based on assessed supports, not an assumption that all concealed timber can stay.
acaf2fa5b4a682285c7b.zh: ，比较报价中列出的板、支持维修、固定、拆卸、进出条件和完成。确定最初无法检查的任何支撑以及如何处理后续检查结果。仅木板的价格应基于评估的支持，而不是假设所有隐藏的木材都可以保留。

17ac71b156de172068ee.en: Can good-looking boards hide a damaged frame?
17ac71b156de172068ee.zh: 漂亮的木板可以隐藏损坏的框架吗？

74aeb067965127fa9153.en: Yes. The condition of the exposed surface does not establish the condition of concealed supports or connections. Board and frame assessment are separate parts of the decision.
74aeb067965127fa9153.zh: 是的。暴露表面的状况并不构成隐藏支撑或连接的状况。露台板和框架评估是决策的独立部分。

f55fb1455f64ffcede55.en: Does replacing boards include sanding and oiling?
f55fb1455f64ffcede55.zh: 更换板材是否包括打磨和上油？

540e17700319f5c9d77c.en: Only if the quote includes that work. Confirm the area, preparation, coating and treatment of retained boards alongside the replacement scope.
540e17700319f5c9d77c.zh: 仅当报价包含该作品时。确认保留板的面积、准备、涂层和处理以及更换范围。

1520a01b7aefbeabd758.en: When can deck boards be replaced without rebuilding the frame?
1520a01b7aefbeabd758.zh: 什么时候可以在不重建框架的情况下更换露台？

643a9d2720595765b17d.en: Board-only replacement is specified after the supporting joists, bearers, posts and connections are assessed as suitable for retention. Where supports need repair, that work is included before the new boards are fitted.
643a9d2720595765b17d.zh: 在支撑托梁、支架、柱子和连接件被评估为适合保留后，指定仅更换板。如果支架需要维修，该工作将在安装新板之前完成。

f2e0c6aae73630080af1.en: Why do deck fixings work loose?
f2e0c6aae73630080af1.zh: 为什么露台固定件会松动？

e02055095595d2ba5221.en: Timber movement, deteriorated fixing material or unsuitable or damaged connections can loosen deck fixings. We check the board and supporting member together rather than simply adding another screw.
e02055095595d2ba5221.zh: 木材移动、固定材料劣化或连接不合适或损坏可能会松动露台固定件。我们将板和支撑件一起检查，而不是简单地添加另一个螺钉。

a55a966f46703f586d82.en: Deck repairs and board replacement for existing timber decks. Walking boards, fixings and supporting framing are assessed separately before choosing the repair extent.
a55a966f46703f586d82.zh: 为现有木露台提供维修与板材更换。先分别检查行走板面、紧固件及支撑框架，再确定需要处理的范围。

0c54329dab439bd64182.zh: 探索露台维修和板更换 ↗

fd32c7c5c46766a48cac.en: Why does timber rot return after a repair? ↗
fd32c7c5c46766a48cac.zh: 为什么木材修复后又会腐烂？ ↗

3933ef2e8fab0d964287.en: Fascia, Bargeboards & Eaves Explained | Ellis Services Group
3933ef2e8fab0d964287.zh: 檐口封板、山墙封边板和檐底有什么区别？ | Ellis Services Group

dbb7dc834e935e42a8b6.en: Identify fascia at the gutter edge, bargeboard at a gable and eaves lining underneath. Learn why material, moisture and safe access change the repair.
dbb7dc834e935e42a8b6.zh: 识别排水沟边缘的檐口封板、山墙处的隔板以及下面的屋檐衬里。了解为什么材料、湿度和安全通道会改变修复。

85b5350f4b4b11facec7.en: Carpenter examining deteriorated painted timber at the roof edge
85b5350f4b4b11facec7.zh: 木工检查屋顶边缘劣化的油漆木材

53c1dc41a1b9998b6b79.en: Illustrative detail: roof-edge timber and the adjacent eaves form different parts of the repair scope. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
53c1dc41a1b9998b6b79.zh: 说明性细节：屋顶边缘木材和相邻屋檐构成修复范围的不同部分。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

c35bacfb81ef25ef9061.en: Identify the roof-edge component from the ground
c35bacfb81ef25ef9061.zh: 从地面识别屋顶边缘组件

a0003974c5234d41b00f.en: Check water reaching the timber behind the gutter
a0003974c5234d41b00f.zh: 检查水到达排水沟后面的木材

d1013e62cb635b4c449d.en: Identify unknown eaves lining before disturbance
d1013e62cb635b4c449d.zh: 在拆动前识别未知的屋檐衬里

12fea853520527cfae5d.en: Local board repair or replacement along the edge?
12fea853520527cfae5d.zh: 沿边缘进行局部木板维修或更换？

1b64482cb94ffa6c4d1b.en: Height, access and making good affect the quote
1b64482cb94ffa6c4d1b.zh: 施工高度、通道与修补收尾如何影响报价

5e3b7fe69a81e65bccdd.en: Send a location, a water history and an overview
5e3b7fe69a81e65bccdd.zh: 提供损坏位置、受潮记录与整体照片

dfa090200d742d5722ee.en: Fascia runs along the lower roof edge beside the gutter; bargeboard follows a sloping gable edge. Eaves lining closes the underside of the overhang and may be a sheet material instead of timber. These parts meet at roof corners but require different repairs. Describe the position of the defect or use a ground-level overview if the name is unfamiliar.
dfa090200d742d5722ee.zh: 檐口封板沿着排水沟旁边的下屋顶边缘延伸；山墙封边板遵循倾斜的山墙边缘。屋檐衬里封闭了悬挑的下侧，可以是板材而不是木材。这些部件在屋顶拐角处相遇，但需要不同的维修。描述缺陷的位置，如果名称不熟悉，请使用地面概述。

b498596f122c802724e6.en: Describe whether the defect sits behind a gutter, on a sloping roof edge or underneath the overhang. Note a split, peeling coating, stain or sag already visible from safe ground. Do not climb onto the roof or lean a ladder against a deteriorated board for a closer view. The assessment must establish the material and fixing condition rather than rely on the component name alone.
b498596f122c802724e6.zh: 描述缺陷是否位于排水沟后面、倾斜屋顶边缘或悬挑下方。注意从安全地面上已经可见的裂缝、剥落的涂层、污渍或下垂。请勿爬上屋顶或将梯子靠在损坏的木板上以便近距离观察。评估必须确定材料和固定条件，而不是仅依赖组件名称。

f18827a8cb5ff909a3ce.en: A timber board behind a gutter can be repeatedly wetted by overflow, leaks or an adjoining roof-edge detail. Replacing the board without considering that route can leave the cause in place. Tell the assessor whether water spills during rain, whether a leak was repaired recently and whether the damage recurs at the same corner.
f18827a8cb5ff909a3ce.zh: 排水沟后面的木板可能会因溢出、泄漏或相邻的屋顶边缘细节而反复弄湿。在不考虑该路线的情况下更换木板可能会导致问题得不到解决。告诉评估员下雨时是否漏水、最近是否修复了泄漏以及同一角落是否再次出现损坏。

62f8d63d7dd15fb19914.en: The timber repair, leak correction and gutter removal or refitting should have named responsibilities. A roofing or guttering professional may be needed to stop the water before the board is finished. Nearby electrical fittings need the appropriate electrical work as well. Include these dependencies when comparing a full roof-edge repair with timber replacement alone.
62f8d63d7dd15fb19914.zh: 木材修复、渗漏纠正和排水沟拆除或改装应有指定的职责。在板完成之前，可能需要屋顶或排水沟专业人员来止水。附近的电气装置也需要适当的电气工作。在比较完整屋顶边缘修复与单独更换木材时，请包括这些依赖性。

f9e3e722b2cea70e3813.en: Eaves lining may be a sheet product rather than timber. An old painted panel cannot be reliably identified from its colour or a photo. Before disturbance, arrange the relevant material assessment, including an appropriately licensed asbestos specialist where suspected. Do not cut, drill, sand, pressure-clean or take a sample yourself to help with the quote.
f9e3e722b2cea70e3813.zh: 屋檐衬里可能是板材产品而不是木材。旧的油漆面板无法从颜色或照片中可靠地识别出来。在拆动之前，安排相关的材料评估，如果怀疑的话，包括由适当许可的石棉专家进行评估。请勿自行切割、钻孔、打磨、高压清洗或取样以帮助报价。

1c2142472c00f62f675c.en: ACT Government guidance explains that damaging or disturbing asbestos-containing material can release fibres and that tools can increase the release. Keep the material question separate from choosing a replacement panel. A quote can identify an assessment dependency before the repair is priced fully; it should not classify unknown lining as ordinary timber waste.
1c2142472c00f62f675c.zh: ACT 政府指南解释说，损坏或拆动含石棉材料会释放纤维，而工具会增加释放量。将材料问题与选择更换面板分开。报价可以在维修完全定价之前确定评估依赖性；不应将未知衬里归类为普通木材废料。

c1887102b74d30645017.en: ACT Government: asbestos risks in the home
c1887102b74d30645017.zh: ACT 政府：家庭中的石棉风险

3d3854014962f3a2aa49.en: A defined damaged length may suit local replacement when adjoining timber and fixings are suitable. Longer deterioration, connected damage or an unavailable profile can change the practical extent. For fascia, the gutter relationship matters; for bargeboard, the gable junction and finish matter. The visible length alone does not establish how much access is needed.
3d3854014962f3a2aa49.zh: 当相邻木材和紧固件合适时，规定的损坏长度可能适合当地更换。较长时间的恶化、相关损坏或不可用的截面造型可能会改变实际范围。对于檐口封板来说，排水沟关系很重要；对于山墙封边板来说，山墙连接处和饰面很重要。仅可见长度并不能确定需要多少现场进入条件。

13c36963a8032501a7dc.en: Ask what happens to the retained ends and connections, how the new profile meets the old work and whether painting stops at the replacement or continues along the edge. A patch of new paint may remain visible.
13c36963a8032501a7dc.zh: 询问保留的端部和连接会发生什么情况，新的轮廓如何与旧的作品相结合，以及绘画是否在替换处停止或沿着边缘继续。一小块新油漆可能仍然可见。

f418261a5511b0249437.en: can start with the component and symptom, then define the actual materials and repair boundary on site.
f418261a5511b0249437.zh: 可以从部件和症状开始，然后定义现场的实际材料和修复边界。

a183145e2c975b6bdc54.en: Working safely at a roof edge can require equipment and setup that are not apparent in a close-up. Tell the team about side access, gardens, overhead services, neighbouring property restrictions and occupied areas below. Do not promise access over a neighbour’s land without their permission. The access plan is part of the work, not an optional detail to settle after materials arrive.
a183145e2c975b6bdc54.zh: 在屋顶边缘安全工作可能需要在特写镜头中不明显的设备和设置。告诉团队有关侧面通道、花园、架空服务、邻近财产限制和下面占用区域的信息。未经邻居许可，请勿承诺进入邻居的土地。进出条件计划是工作的一部分，而不是材料到达后需要解决的可选细节。

9b9c22b91db7c26b1594.en: Compare removal, disposal, material identification, roof or gutter coordination and painting alongside the board replacement. Ask whether concealed support damage is an allowance, an exclusion or a finding to quote separately. Two proposals for the same visible length can differ because one includes reinstating adjoining components and the other only supplies the timber.
9b9c22b91db7c26b1594.zh: 比较拆除、处置、材料识别、屋顶或排水沟协调以及油漆和板更换。询问隐藏的支撑损坏是否属于预留项目与费用、排除或单独引用的调查结果。对于相同可见长度的两个提案可能会有所不同，因为一个包括恢复相邻的组件，而另一个仅提供木材。

4db12e0ce8ef72a92ac1.en: Give your suburb, the side of the building and the component’s position. Optional ground-level photos of the full edge and visible defect can show the pattern. Include any existing material records, earlier leak report or repair scope already available. A clear description is enough to begin if photographs cannot be taken safely.
4db12e0ce8ef72a92ac1.zh: 给出您所在的郊区、建筑物的侧面和组件的位置。可选的全边缘和可见缺陷的地面照片可以显示该图案。包括任何现有的材料记录、早期泄漏报告或现有的维修范围。如果无法安全拍照，清晰的描述就足以开始。

4d411af3225b28a4026e.en: Arrange the on-site assessment and identification of unknown lining before any disturbance. If the same board has failed again, read
4d411af3225b28a4026e.zh: 在扰动发生前安排对未知衬砌进行现场评估和识别。如果同一块板再次出现故障，请阅读

28623692613507763335.en: ; if damage continues down the wall, see
28623692613507763335.zh: ;如果损坏继续沿墙延伸，请参阅

49b6ef1c97a8f3642dea.en: . The repair should address the affected timber and the leak or wetting detail beside it.
49b6ef1c97a8f3642dea.zh: 。维修应解决受影响的木材及其旁边的泄漏或润湿细节。

a9d03a3f826332dc503d.en: Is every damaged eaves panel timber?
a9d03a3f826332dc503d.zh: 每个损坏的屋檐板都是木材吗？

6f7b093ce4150c22d1ca.en: No. Eaves linings can use different materials. Identify unknown lining before disturbance and use the qualified assessment pathway if asbestos is suspected.
6f7b093ce4150c22d1ca.zh: 否。屋檐衬里可以使用不同的材料。在拆动前识别未知的衬里，如果怀疑有石棉，则使用合格的评估途径。

c2835f9fe932e3f2cb0d.en: Should the gutter be checked when fascia rots?
c2835f9fe932e3f2cb0d.zh: 檐口封板腐烂时是否应该检查排水沟？

e5096b3e475c4a47d570.en: Yes. The water path near the gutter is relevant to the cause. The quote should distinguish timber repair from any required gutter or roof work.
e5096b3e475c4a47d570.zh: 是的。排水沟附近的水路与原因有关。报价应将木材修复与任何所需的排水沟或屋顶工程区分开来。

eca43ccd2841f5c82c2d.en: What is the difference between fascia, bargeboards and eaves lining?
eca43ccd2841f5c82c2d.zh: 檐口封板、隔板和屋檐衬里有什么区别？

6907dbbe7907da2aa5b4.en: Fascia follows the lower roof edge, a bargeboard follows a gable edge and eaves lining closes the underside. Material identification, water entry and access are checked for the actual component being repaired.
6907dbbe7907da2aa5b4.zh: 檐口封板沿着较低的屋顶边缘，挡风板沿着山墙边缘，屋檐衬里封闭下侧。对正在维修的实际部件进行材料识别、进水和进出条件检查。

c8d222373452cbd0e43d.en: Why does timber behind a gutter rot?
c8d222373452cbd0e43d.zh: 为什么排水沟后面的木材会腐烂？

b43bcbabb6f11ee541c6.en: Overflow, leaks, debris or deteriorated roof-edge details can repeatedly wet the timber. We assess the water path and define moisture-source work alongside the fascia replacement and finish.
b43bcbabb6f11ee541c6.zh: 溢出、泄漏、碎片或恶化的屋顶边缘细节可能会反复弄湿木材。我们评估水路并确定水分源工作以及面板更换和完成。

5779f482f6c216e3a11f.en: Access Canberra: asbestos assessor and removal licensing
5779f482f6c216e3a11f.zh: Access Canberra：石棉评估员和清除许可

f5c8e661b7a70a2c2443.en: Fascia, bargeboard and eaves repairs, with timber boards distinguished from underside lining. Material, water entry and safe roof-edge access determine the work.
f5c8e661b7a70a2c2443.zh: 维修檐口封板、山墙封边板和檐底，先区分木板与檐底衬板。材料、进水位置及屋面边缘的安全作业条件共同决定施工范围。

e2b007755f2e06e970b2.zh: 探索檐口封板和屋檐维修 ↗

2ea778b133d4ea62d8a8.en: Can a few damaged timber weatherboards be replaced? ↗
2ea778b133d4ea62d8a8.zh: 外墙木挂板局部损坏可以单独更换吗？ ↗

f0139ba007ba9025a603.en: Leaning Timber Fences | Ellis Services Group
f0139ba007ba9025a603.zh: 为什么木栅栏倾斜？ | Ellis Services Group

d05a56b6a8519d693131.en: A leaning fence may involve posts, rails or fixings. Learn how the affected length and support condition guide repair versus replacement decisions.
d05a56b6a8519d693131.zh: 倾斜围栏可能涉及柱子、栏杆或紧固件。了解受影响的长度和支撑条件如何指导修复与更换决策。

5bc90d8c11d9fcce87e9.en: Leaning timber paling fence with weathered rails and damaged lower boards
5bc90d8c11d9fcce87e9.zh: 倾斜的木栅栏，带有风化的栏杆和损坏的下板

39693a84c04bf8bee19d.en: Illustrative detail: posts, rails and palings are assessed together when a fence leans. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
39693a84c04bf8bee19d.zh: 说明性细节：当栅栏倾斜时，柱子、栏杆和栅栏会一起评估。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

a5321ad2e41074ece8b6.en: Look at the leaning pattern before counting palings
a5321ad2e41074ece8b6.zh: 在计算木板数之前先查看倾斜模式

93059f16a00ada9c41ad.en: Which posts, rails or palings need repair?
93059f16a00ada9c41ad.zh: 哪些柱子、栏杆或栅栏需要维修？

f9d230ac4fda8d7fb316.en: Can a post be replaced while keeping the fence boards?
f9d230ac4fda8d7fb316.zh: 可以在保留栅栏板的情况下更换柱子吗？

b17b576cfa5459b5bd25.en: Agree the match, height and gate relationship
b17b576cfa5459b5bd25.zh: 确认材料匹配、高度及与院门的衔接

202c93a72a8691ba56c1.en: Settle access and property arrangements before booking
202c93a72a8691ba56c1.zh: 预约前确认现场进入条件与业主安排

ccf085dce21c9f8a925c.en: Prepare a fence enquiry with the whole affected run
ccf085dce21c9f8a925c.zh: 说明整段受损围栏的情况

40b76ca8a9af103d6cf8.en: A timber fence can lean when a post, footing or rail connection fails, even if the palings look serviceable. Notice whether the lean is around one post or continues across several bays. That pattern helps direct the inspection; replacing surface boards alone cannot straighten a failed support. Include a dragging gate if it hangs from the affected run.
40b76ca8a9af103d6cf8.zh: 当柱子、基础或横档连接失效时，木栅栏可能会倾斜，即使栅栏看起来还可以使用。注意倾斜是围绕一根柱子还是持续跨越几个隔间。该模式有助于指导检查；仅更换表面板无法矫正失效的支撑。如果拖动门悬挂在受影响的运行中，请包括一个拖动门。

a82ff42c3db6a9805ed9.en: Record what changed: a storm, nearby ground work, a gate that now catches or a post base that looks deteriorated. These observations help explain the request but do not identify a single cause. Do not push the fence to test it, remove a paling to inspect behind it or stand beside a section that appears unstable.
a82ff42c3db6a9805ed9.zh: 记录发生的变化：风暴、附近的地面工程、现在卡住的院门或看起来破旧的柱基。这些观察结果有助于解释该请求，但不能确定单一原因。请勿推动栅栏进行测试、拆除栅栏以检查栅栏后面或站在看似不稳定的部分旁边。

e8ca03d1b3cb825e0603.en: Posts support the fence; rails connect the posts and carry the palings. An isolated broken paling may be a straightforward component replacement where the rail can hold a suitable fixing. A deteriorated post changes that conversation because the retained rails and palings need a support and connection plan. The assessor should explain which components are suitable to stay.
e8ca03d1b3cb825e0603.zh: 柱子支撑栅栏；横档连接柱子并承载栅栏。孤立的破损护板可以是简单的部件更换，其中横档可以容纳合适的固定件。恶化的柱子改变了这种对话，因为保留的横档和栅栏需要支撑和连接计划。评估员应解释哪些组件适合保留。

1e656ab9b7cd958efaf5.en: Damage near ground level also prompts questions about wetting, surrounding levels and the footing. A new post is not a complete specification on its own. Ask what support detail is proposed and how the rails, gate or adjoining panel will connect. Do not dig around the base or brace a failing fence yourself to establish the extent of decay.
1e656ab9b7cd958efaf5.zh: 地面附近的损坏也会引发有关潮湿、周围水平和基础的问题。新立柱本身并不是完整的规范。询问建议的支撑细节以及横档、门或相邻面板将如何连接。不要在底座周围挖掘或自己支撑损坏的栅栏来确定腐烂的程度。

88eae17a18e854204374.en: Partial repair may be possible when retained rails and palings remain suitable and can be handled without creating further damage. Keeping older material can reduce unnecessary replacement, but dismantling and refitting also involves labour and uncertainty. A section that looks sound from one side may have poor fixing points on the other, so retention should follow assessment.
88eae17a18e854204374.zh: 当保留的横档和栅栏保持合适并且可以在不造成进一步损坏的情况下进行处理时，可以进行部分修复。保留旧材料可以减少不必要的更换，但拆卸和改装也涉及劳动力和不确定性。从一侧看起来完好的部分在另一侧可能有较差的固定点，因此保留应该遵循评估。

62b6853f135e86940f11.en: Compare a longer replacement when several supports are damaged or the old rails and boards cannot be reconnected reliably. Include dismantling and refitting in both options. Keeping old palings saves new material only where their condition and fixing points make reuse practical; it can still require considerable handling.
62b6853f135e86940f11.zh: 当多个支撑损坏或旧横档和板无法可靠地重新连接时，比较较长的更换。两种选择都包括拆卸和改装。仅当旧木板的状况和固定点可以重复利用时，保留旧木板才能节省新材料；它仍然需要大量的处理。

24851f68f558afa693b5.en: A new board or post will often look different beside weathered timber. Check the proposed profile, dimensions and any painted or stained finish. If the fence line supports a gate, the gate’s swing, hinges and latch position need consideration as part of the repair. A gate problem can remain even after palings have been replaced.
24851f68f558afa693b5.zh: 新的木板或柱子在风化的木材旁边通常看起来会有所不同。检查建议的轮廓、尺寸以及任何涂漆或染色的饰面。如果栅栏线支撑院门，则在维修时需要考虑院门的摆动、铰链和闩锁位置。即使更换了栅栏后，院门问题也可能仍然存在。

4aba786a8972f5fa4fb0.en: Describe the existing arrangement and whether you want a local repair or a changed fence design. Altering height, layout or use introduces questions beyond matching an old board. Discuss relevant project requirements before accepting a changed design. Our
4aba786a8972f5fa4fb0.zh: 描述现有的布置以及您是否需要局部修复或更改围栏设计。改变高度、布局或用途会带来与旧板匹配之外的问题。在接受更改的设计之前讨论相关的项目要求。我们的

bc8e8d5122c79adc045a.en: explains why post movement and gate alignment belong together.
bc8e8d5122c79adc045a.zh: 解释了为什么后移动和门对齐是一体的。

7db5a09c2e40121c4714.en: A boundary fence repair can require access from both sides. Confirm the authorised property contacts, access permission, pets, planting and any restrictions before a visit. A written repair scope describes the physical work; it does not settle ownership, a disputed boundary or who must contribute. Seek the appropriate property or legal advice for those questions.
7db5a09c2e40121c4714.zh: 边界围栏修复可能需要从两侧进入。在进出条件前确认授权财产的联系方式、现场进入条件、宠物、种植和任何限制。书面维修范围描述了实际工作；它不解决所有权、边界争议或谁必须做出贡献的问题。针对这些问题寻求适当的财产或法律建议。

97eb657e523ff6072552.en: Ask whether the scope includes taking down the affected section, temporary access arrangements, disposal, post work, refitting retained boards and finishing. Tell the team if a tenant or neighbour needs to coordinate entry. Shared-owner approval and the contractor’s booking are separate matters, so do not assume an estimate alone authorises the physical work.
97eb657e523ff6072552.zh: 询问范围是否包括拆除受影响的部分、临时通道安排、处置、后期工作、重新安装保留的板和收尾处理。告诉团队租户或邻居是否需要协调进入。共有业主的批准和承包商的预约是不同的事情，因此不要假设仅估算就可以授权实际工作。

977d6df67e8e41ad3750.en: Send your suburb, an approximate affected length if known, the fence type and the change you have noticed. Optional safe photos should show the run from an accessible position, not only one damaged paling. Mention whether the gate is affected and whether both sides can be accessed. Existing repair records can help explain why a previous patch has failed.
977d6df67e8e41ad3750.zh: 发送您所在的郊区、受影响的大概长度（如果已知）、围栏类型以及您注意到的变化。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片应显示从可进入的位置开始的运行，而不仅仅是一个损坏的栅栏。提及院门是否受到影响以及两侧是否可以进入。现有的修复记录可以帮助解释之前的补丁失败的原因。

379117a5d424c8d4b357.en: , ask which posts, rails and palings need work and which can stay. Compare removal, footings, refitting, disposal and finish over the same affected length. Agree how newly exposed damage is handled before work begins, particularly where post bases cannot be fully inspected at the first visit.
379117a5d424c8d4b357.zh: ，询问哪些柱子、栏杆和栅栏需要维修，哪些可以保留。比较相同受影响长度的拆除、基础、改装、处置和饰面。就工作开始前如何处理新暴露的损坏达成一致，特别是在第一次访问时无法全面检查哨所基地的情况下。

7864cd55959abf2fb1ef.en: Can new palings straighten a leaning fence?
7864cd55959abf2fb1ef.zh: 新的栅栏可以拉直倾斜的栅栏吗？

24376106e82e4e360e47.en: Not when the lean comes from a post, footing or rail connection. Supporting components need assessment before the paling work is defined.
24376106e82e4e360e47.zh: 当倾斜来自柱子、基础或横档连接时则不然。在确定垫板工作之前，需要对支撑部件进行评估。

5db280b44df41c7c8443.en: Does the repair quote decide who pays for a shared fence?
5db280b44df41c7c8443.zh: 维修报价是否决定谁支付共享围栏的费用？

4c58497140181c4a016d.en: No. Confirm property and shared-owner arrangements separately. The quote identifies the physical work and access assumptions.
4c58497140181c4a016d.zh: 否。分别确认财产和共有人安排。报价确定了物理工作和进出条件假设。

08729b3f4142cad007d5.en: Why do timber fence posts rot at ground level?
08729b3f4142cad007d5.zh: 为什么木栅栏柱会在地面腐烂？

b251088dfb278735d7e2.en: Repeated moisture exposure around ground level can affect timber post bases. Ellis inspects the post, footing and surrounding drainage and specifies the replacement and connection detail for the affected fence section.
b251088dfb278735d7e2.zh: 地面周围反复暴露于湿气可能会影响木柱底座。 Ellis 检查柱子、基础和周围排水系统，并指定受影响围栏部分的更换和连接细节。

1c65f05b635b1f790b37.en: Timber paling and picket fence repairs, including posts, rails and damaged boards. Compare local repairs with replacement of the affected run after assessment.
1c65f05b635b1f790b37.zh: 维修木围栏的立柱、横档和损坏竖板。现场查看后，比较局部修补与更换受损围栏段的方案。

afccd4c3312caf263830.en: Why does a timber gate sag or stop latching? ↗
afccd4c3312caf263830.zh: 为什么木院门会下垂或停止锁定？ ↗

e7fb447cb3a34d2bd3d5.en: Loose Stairs & Handrails | Ellis Services Group
e7fb447cb3a34d2bd3d5.zh: 如果木楼梯或扶手松动，您该怎么办？ | Ellis Services Group

cacfbacad46283f3c3e4.en: Loose timber steps and handrails need their supports checked. Learn what to record safely and why a new screw or cosmetic repair may be insufficient.
cacfbacad46283f3c3e4.zh: 松动的木台阶和扶手需要检查其支撑。了解需要安全记录的内容以及为什么新螺丝或美容修复可能不够。

bc95cf67012859e8d75c.en: Timber stair treads and a handrail bracket fixed to the wall
bc95cf67012859e8d75c.zh: 木楼梯踏板和固定在墙上的扶手支架

13782aaf72cd9b0c2ca7.en: Illustrative detail: stair supports and handrail anchorage need assessment when movement is reported. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
13782aaf72cd9b0c2ca7.zh: 说明性细节：报告运动时楼梯支撑和扶手锚固需要评估。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

10072a7cfdca7b4ab5d0.en: Treat movement in a tread or rail as a safety issue
10072a7cfdca7b4ab5d0.zh: 踏板或扶手松动应作为安全问题处理

8605f6b3e9354f6de0cf.en: Identify the tread, stringer, rail and barrier
8605f6b3e9354f6de0cf.zh: 辨认踏板、梯梁、扶手与防护栏

9339c46b3161137f9c2a.en: Why replacing a fixing may leave the cause unresolved
9339c46b3161137f9c2a.zh: 为什么更换固定件可能无法解决问题

80caa041552469afeff8.en: A changed stair needs more than a matching board
80caa041552469afeff8.zh: 改变的楼梯需要的不仅仅是匹配的板

42ed0be54acabb4f53e1.en: Include supports, access and finishing in the quote
42ed0be54acabb4f53e1.zh: 在报价中包括支撑、进出条件和收尾处理

be55659b19c80fb8532b.en: Send observations from a safe position
be55659b19c80fb8532b.zh: 从安全位置发送观察结果

91451e27af1bcd4b8ff2.en: A loose tread or handrail needs the fixing and the material behind it checked together. Stop relying on the affected part and avoid the unsafe route while professional assessment is arranged. A bracket can look like the only fault even when its timber support is split or decayed; a cosmetic patch or extra screw does not establish safe support.
91451e27af1bcd4b8ff2.zh: 松动的踏板或扶手需要同时检查其固定和后面的材料。在安排专业评估的同时，停止依赖受影响的部位，避开不安全的路线。即使支架的木支架破裂或腐烂，支架也可能看起来像是唯一的缺陷。装饰性贴片或额外的螺钉无法建立安全支撑。

61d49244771af57ca1e5.en: Do not add weight, bounce on a tread or shake a rail to demonstrate movement. If the stair is the only access, tell the property contact and assessor promptly so access arrangements can be discussed. Keep children and visitors away from the affected area. New photos are optional; there is no reason to use an unsafe stair to obtain evidence.
61d49244771af57ca1e5.zh: 请勿通过增加重量、在踏板上弹跳或摇动导轨来演示移动。如果楼梯是唯一的通道，请立即告知酒店联系人和评估员，以便讨论通道安排。让儿童和访客远离受影响区域。新照片是可选的；没有理由使用不安全的楼梯来获取证据。

5985403b781401826fb6.en: The tread is the surface you step on. Supporting members and connections carry its load; a stringer is a sloping support beside or beneath the treads. A handrail provides a grip, while a balustrade or barrier has a fall-protection role. One stair can contain all of these, so describing “loose timber” alone may not establish the task.
5985403b781401826fb6.zh: 胎面是您踩踏的表面。支撑构件和连接件承受其载荷；纵梁是踏板旁边或踏板下方的倾斜支撑。扶手提供抓握力，而栏杆或屏障则具有防坠落作用。一个楼梯可以包含所有这些，因此仅描述“松散的木材”可能无法完成该任务。

8e49da614cb73a8787b9.en: Say whether movement was noticed at one tread, several steps, a landing, the rail or the barrier post. Mention whether the stair is inside or outdoors, where moisture appears and whether repairs were done before. This helps plan the assessment; it does not substitute for checking concealed connections and adjoining supports.
8e49da614cb73a8787b9.zh: 说出是否在一个踏板、几个台阶、一个平台、栏杆或栏杆处注意到移动。提及楼梯是在室内还是室外、出现湿气的地方以及之前是否进行过维修。这有助于规划评估；它不能代替检查隐藏连接和相邻支撑。

ef0b38d9c57a866077e2.en: A fixing needs suitable material and a compatible connection. If its substrate is split, deteriorated or moving, a new screw may not restore the intended support. The assessment should distinguish worn hardware from damaged timber and consider the nearby assembly. Several loose parts can point to a wider boundary than the first visible fitting.
ef0b38d9c57a866077e2.zh: 固定需要合适的材料和兼容的连接。如果其基材裂开、损坏或移动，新的螺钉可能无法恢复预期的支撑。评估应区分磨损的硬件和损坏的木材，并考虑附近的组件。多个松动部件可能指向比第一个可见配件更宽的边界。

f87a83bc39b0def2201f.en: Do not dismantle a rail or remove a tread to discover how it is supported. Local repair may be appropriate where the fault and retained components are defined. Supporting-member damage can require structural input and a different work sequence. Ask how the proposal establishes the retained components and which qualified checks are required before work starts.
f87a83bc39b0def2201f.zh: 请勿拆卸导轨或移除踏板来了解其支撑方式。在定义了故障和保留组件的情况下，局部修复可能是适当的。支撑构件损坏可能需要结构输入和不同的工作顺序。询问提案如何建立保留的组件以及在工作开始之前需要进行哪些合格检查。

9b368ba3e2a0dd1a6ba1.en: Replacing a component and changing a stair layout are different proposals. Dimensions, connections, intended use and the surrounding barrier arrangement matter when defining the repair. Do not use a generic height or “like-for-like” label as the approval decision. ACT Planning separates general exemption conditions from project-specific criteria and advises checking the actual work.
9b368ba3e2a0dd1a6ba1.zh: 更换组件和更改楼梯布局是不同的建议。在确定维修时，尺寸、连接、预期用途和周围的屏障布置都很重要。请勿使用通用身高或“同类”标签作为批准决定。 ACT 规划将一般豁免条件与项目特定标准分开，并建议检查实际工作。

c19e87db67278085e36a.en: Ask the relevant professionals to confirm building and planning requirements for the proposed repair, especially where supports or fall protection change. The method must suit the actual connections and supporting material. Keep the stair out of use where unsafe until the assessment and necessary work are resolved.
c19e87db67278085e36a.zh: 要求相关专业人员确认拟议维修的建筑和规划要求，特别是在支撑或坠落保护发生变化的情况下。该方法必须适合实际的连接和支撑材料。在评估和必要的工作得到解决之前，请勿在不安全的地方使用楼梯。

a4555477640b5a0a718e.en: ACT Planning: check if you need building approval
a4555477640b5a0a718e.zh: ACT 规划：检查是否需要建筑批准

963446a32ed3d6ff84d6.en: The quote should identify the component, retained supports, replacement material and connection work. Ask how access is managed while the stair is unavailable and whether adjoining finishes or barriers are included. A matching timber tread and a completed usable stair are not necessarily the same scope. Painting or coating should be listed separately from the support repair.
963446a32ed3d6ff84d6.zh: 报价应注明组件、保留的支撑、更换材料和连接工作。询问在楼梯不可用时如何管理通道，以及是否包括相邻的饰面或障碍物。匹配的木踏板和完整的可用楼梯不一定是同一范围。油漆或涂层应与支撑修复分开列出。

8d98afdfd7ad41c1711d.en: If deterioration appears outdoors, discuss the moisture route and the care information for the selected finish. Where more damage is found during agreed access, request the finding and revised scope before extra work proceeds. Clarify any use restrictions and the handover arrangements after the agreed repair. Avoid treating a new finish as proof that concealed supports were checked.
8d98afdfd7ad41c1711d.zh: 如果在室外出现恶化，请讨论所选饰面的防潮途径和护理信息。如果在同意的进出条件期间发现更多损坏，请在进行额外工作之前请求发现结果并修改范围。明确任何使用限制以及约定维修后的移交安排。避免将新饰面视为检查过隐藏支撑的证据。

f07c0560e07f4a7fbfa0.en: , provide your suburb, the affected stair or rail and what you already noticed. Mention whether another route exists, who authorises access and any available plans or repair records. Use existing safe photographs or a description; do not crawl beneath an unstable stair or lean over a loose barrier.
f07c0560e07f4a7fbfa0.zh: ，提供您所在的郊区、受影响的楼梯或栏杆以及您已经注意到的情况。提及是否存在另一条路线、谁授权进出条件以及任何可用的计划或维修记录。使用现有的在安全条件下拍摄的照片或描述；不要在不稳定的楼梯下爬行或倚在松散的障碍物上。

8d5b8e327a3651bded06.en: Mention a moving deck or landing connected to the stairs;
8d5b8e327a3651bded06.zh: 提及与楼梯相连的移动露台或平台；

49b0c449264ae405f671.en: explains why adjoining supports matter. The repair proposal should connect the visible fault to the parts carrying its load. Agree access during work, any use restrictions and the final finish alongside the repair itself.
49b0c449264ae405f671.zh: 解释了为什么相邻支撑很重要。维修建议应将可见故障与承载其负载的部件联系起来。就工作期间的进出条件、任何使用限制以及维修本身的最终完成达成一致。

fc79aa2073901b05440a.en: Is it safe to test a loose step with extra weight?
fc79aa2073901b05440a.zh: 用额外的重量测试松动的脚步是否安全？

ceec55411eca7ec5869d.en: No. Do not add weight or keep moving it to test stability. Avoid the affected area and arrange assessment of the component and supports.
ceec55411eca7ec5869d.zh: 否。不要增加重量或不断移动它来测试稳定性。避开受影响的区域并安排对组件和支撑的评估。

494ee79a10b9cdf3d002.en: Can a handrail problem be just a bracket?
494ee79a10b9cdf3d002.zh: 扶手问题难道只是支架的问题吗？

4319990825aee945145f.en: It can involve a bracket, but the joint and fixing substrate also matter. The retained fixing material must be suitable for the repair.
4319990825aee945145f.zh: 它可能涉及支架，但接头和固定基板也很重要。保留的固定材料必须适合修复。

355b0ed7cf83527063e7.en: Repairs to existing timber stairs and handrails, with treads, supports and anchorage assessed together. Safe access and applicable checks come before disturbance.
355b0ed7cf83527063e7.zh: 维修现有木楼梯和扶手，踏板、支撑与锚固部位一并检查。拆动前先确认安全通行条件及适用的专业检查。
