099be7cb759842bcb45a.en: Rotten Pergola Post Repairs | Ellis Services Group
099be7cb759842bcb45a.zh: 腐烂的凉棚柱是否需要修理或更换？ | Ellis Services Group

3c5220488a39ccb89ba2.en: A rotten pergola post affects connected supports. Learn why base condition, beams, footings and moisture need assessment before post repair or replacement.
3c5220488a39ccb89ba2.zh: 腐烂的凉棚柱会影响连接的支撑。了解为什么在维修或更换后需要评估基础条件、横梁、基础和湿度。

ca2746eb8bbac7bfa4eb.en: Renewed lower timber section at an outdoor post base
ca2746eb8bbac7bfa4eb.zh: 更新室外柱基的下部木材部分

a8292226d50b468dadc8.en: Illustrative detail: the lower post and surrounding junctions are considered when planning a post repair. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
a8292226d50b468dadc8.zh: 说明性细节：在规划后期修复时要考虑较低的柱子和周围的连接处。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

23a613a0793ce3982773.en: A rotten post belongs to a connected structure
23a613a0793ce3982773.zh: 腐烂的柱子属于连通结构

b0cd93583e4296efe7e9.en: Check water collecting around the post base

90adb8242d600a0f2e26.en: Local repair, post replacement or wider timber work?
90adb8242d600a0f2e26.zh: 局部修补、更换立柱，还是扩大维修范围？

fbddfb6c897cd3d9a2d2.en: Check approval requirements for the proposed work
fbddfb6c897cd3d9a2d2.zh: 检查拟议工作的批准要求

d0b8cba3c44f9e5502c0.en: Define the connections, access and finish in the proposal
d0b8cba3c44f9e5502c0.zh: 在方案中写明连接、施工通道与饰面

e2c906721555202758f9.en: Prepare the enquiry without approaching a failing support
e2c906721555202758f9.zh: 避开不稳的支撑，安全说明施工需求

a20660f8f94537996d1a.en: A rotten pergola or verandah post cannot be considered separately from the beams, connections and roof it may carry. The soft base may be the first visible defect, while decay or poor connections elsewhere change the repair. Local repair and full post replacement both need assessment of the connected structure and a safe support sequence before anything is cut.
a20660f8f94537996d1a.zh: 腐烂的凉棚或阳台柱不能与其可能承载的横梁、连接件和屋顶分开考虑。软底座可能是第一个可见的缺陷，而其他地方的腐烂或连接不良会改变修复效果。局部修复和全面更换后都需要在切割之前对连接结构进行评估并确定安全支撑顺序。

798cbd54d2ea38610438.en: Keep clear of a structure showing movement, instability or falling material. Do not cut the post, excavate its footing or improvise props. Even an open pergola can depend on connections that are not apparent from a photograph. Tell the assessor about any roof, screens, attachments or recent changes so the whole arrangement can be considered.
798cbd54d2ea38610438.zh: 远离有移动、不稳定或掉落材料的结构。请勿切割柱子、挖掘其基础或临时搭建支柱。即使是开放式凉棚也可能依赖于照片中不明显的连接。告诉评估员任何屋顶、围挡、附件或最近的变化，以便考虑整个安排。

0ecac7283090c3056370.en: Water collecting beside the post, changed paving levels, debris and repeated wetting are useful observations. The condition of the base connection and footing also affects the option. A new post fitted into the same unresolved water trap may leave a recurrence problem. Describe when water appears and whether drainage or landscaping changed before the deterioration was noticed.
0ecac7283090c3056370.zh: 柱子旁边积水、改变铺路高度、碎片和反复润湿都是有用的观察结果。底座连接和基础的状况也会影响该选项。在同一未解决的积水器中安装新的柱子可能会再次出现问题。描述出现水的时间以及在发现恶化之前排水或景观是否发生变化。

f498edae42d21daed1f6.en: A photo can show the location but cannot establish timber condition below paint or inside a connection. The assessment may need agreed access and qualified structural input to define the boundary. Do not probe the base or expose a footing to obtain more detail. The repair plan should explain the moisture-source work as well as the replacement material.
f498edae42d21daed1f6.zh: 照片可以显示位置，但无法确定油漆下方或连接内部的木材状况。评估可能需要商定的现场进入条件和合格的结构输入来定义边界。请勿探测底座或暴露基础以获取更多细节。维修计划应解释湿气源工作以及更换材料。

aa0948d61f7f77f7e07b.en: A local base repair requires suitable retained timber and a connection that meets its supporting role. Replacing a full post still needs an appropriate connection and footing. If beams or adjoining posts are affected, the scope may extend beyond the first soft area. Ask which components remain and how that decision is supported.
aa0948d61f7f77f7e07b.zh: 局部基础修复需要合适的保留木材和满足其支撑作用的连接。更换完整的柱子仍然需要适当的连接和基础。如果横梁或相邻的柱子受到影响，范围可能会超出第一个软区域。询问保留哪些组成部分以及如何支持该决定。

821d7a25c1810c21d00c.en: Compare the complete work rather than the cost of a length of timber. Access, support planning, removal, fabrication, connections and finishing can differ between options. A patch that restores the outline is not automatically a structural repair. The
821d7a25c1810c21d00c.zh: 比较完整的工作而不是一段木材的成本。不同选项的进出条件、支撑规划、移除、制造、连接和收尾处理可能有所不同。恢复轮廓的修补程序并不自动进行结构修复。的

33f2b78e1f317c225c13.en: explains why sound retained material and the wetting route both matter.
33f2b78e1f317c225c13.zh: 解释了为什么完好保留材料和润湿路径都很重要。

79b00cb65848b3249644.en: Adding a roof, changing a footprint or altering supports can change the project from a local repair to an alteration proposal. ACT Planning lists specific criteria for pergolas and shade structures alongside general building-approval conditions. Confirm the requirements for the actual work; a label such as “pergola repair” does not decide them.
79b00cb65848b3249644.zh: 添加屋顶、改变占地面积或改变支撑可以将项目从局部修复更改为改建提案。 ACT 规划列出了凉棚和遮阳结构的具体标准以及一般建筑审批条件。确认实际工作的要求； “凉棚维修”之类的标签并不能决定它们。

7e698545a652240f5910.en: Building approval and development approval are separate checks, and property constraints may also apply. Ask the relevant design professional, builder or building certifier to review the proposed work and identify the documents needed. Compare existing drawings with the structure as it stands, including any added roof or screens.
7e698545a652240f5910.zh: 建筑审批和开发审批是单独的检查，财产限制也可能适用。要求相关设计专业人员、建筑商或建筑认证机构审查拟议的工作并确定所需的文件。将现有图纸与现有结构进行比较，包括任何添加的屋顶或围挡。

03b5a20e0bd7776fdd41.en: For a repair quote, identify the affected posts and beams, retained components, proposed material and connections. Ask how concealed findings will be handled and which specialist roles are included. Overhead electrical fittings and roof or gutter defects need their relevant qualified pathways. They should not disappear inside a general timber replacement allowance.
03b5a20e0bd7776fdd41.zh: 对于维修报价，请确定受影响的柱子和横梁、保留的组件、建议的材料和连接。询问如何处理隐藏的调查结果以及包括哪些专家角色。架空电气配件和屋顶或天沟缺陷需要相关的合格路径。它们不应该在一般木材替代预留项目与费用中消失。

73a8990694223a8caed5.en: Discuss access around planting, paving, stored items and adjoining property. Confirm whether the finish covers repaired areas or a wider visible assembly, and who makes good disturbed surfaces. Matching an aged stain exactly may be difficult. The accepted scope should explain the completed boundary, including disposal and any care information, rather than end at “replace post”.
73a8990694223a8caed5.zh: 讨论种植、铺路、储存物品和毗邻财产周围的通道。确认饰面是否覆盖修复区域或更广泛的可见组件，以及谁制作了良好的扰动表面。精确匹配老化污渍可能很困难。接受的范围应解释完整的边界，包括处置和任何护理信息，而不是以“替换立柱”结束。

8f842d44812709976cd3.en: Send your suburb, the location of the post and the symptoms already visible. From safe ground, an overview can show the structure and attachments; a base detail is optional only where safely accessible. Include known leaks, drainage changes and available plans. Do not climb, enter beneath an unstable structure or test the post to provide more evidence.
8f842d44812709976cd3.zh: 发送您所在的郊区、立柱的位置以及已经可见的症状。从安全地面上，可以概览结构和附件；只有在安全可及的情况下，基础细节才是可选的。包括已知的泄漏、排水系统的变化和可用的计划。请勿攀爬、进入不稳定结构下方或测试立柱以提供更多证据。

23da27ee7544322b8df3.en: to arrange an on-site assessment. Include any nearby loose steps or rails;
23da27ee7544322b8df3.zh: 安排现场评估。包括附近任何松动的台阶或栏杆；

1bc9132b192e8c4d33c1.en: explains those connected concerns. Select replacement timber only after the supporting role, connection and moisture problem have been established.
1bc9132b192e8c4d33c1.zh: 解释了这些相关的问题。只有在确定了支撑作用、连接和潮湿问题后才选择替换木材。

87dcb8b091af430402e6.en: Can the post be replaced without checking the beams?
87dcb8b091af430402e6.zh: 可以在不检查横梁的情况下更换立柱吗？

42e00928f2ea1b8449bb.en: The connected structure and load path need assessment first. A new post does not resolve damaged beams, connections or an unsuitable footing.
42e00928f2ea1b8449bb.zh: 连接结构和载荷路径需要首先评估。新的柱子并不能解决损坏的横梁、连接件或不合适的基础问题。

a3aa5391dc742dc53fbf.en: Does a replacement post automatically avoid approval checks?
a3aa5391dc742dc53fbf.zh: 替换职位是否会自动避免审批检查？

136da28322856bd5050d.en: No. Confirm the actual repair or alteration and applicable ACT requirements rather than assuming that every replacement has the same status.
136da28322856bd5050d.zh: 否。确认实际维修或改动以及适用的 ACT 要求，而不是假设每次更换都具有相同的状态。

55b9e22245f017f97006.en: How do I check whether pergola works need building or development approval in the ACT?
55b9e22245f017f97006.zh: 如何检查凉棚工程是否需要 ACT 中的建设或开发批准？

31070a8c0e0134eeae3e.en: Ellis reviews the existing structure and proposed repair or alteration to identify the applicable ACT project checks before work is agreed. A changed roof, footprint or support arrangement is not assumed to have the same requirements as a local timber repair.
31070a8c0e0134eeae3e.zh: Ellis 审查现有结构和拟议的维修或改造，以确定在同意工作之前适用的 ACT 项目检查。改变的屋顶、占地面积或支撑布置不被认为具有与当地木材修复相同的要求。

10001e2c1065de98c6bb.en: Repairs to existing pergola and verandah timber. Posts, beams, connections and attached materials are considered together before defining replacement or local repair.
10001e2c1065de98c6bb.zh: 维修现有凉棚与廊檐的木结构。综合检查立柱、横梁、连接件及附属材料后，再确定局部维修或更换范围。

55a0d929b2dac00dc7de.zh: 探索凉棚和阳台木材修复 ↗

2a669ae696e25ef4bb74.en: What should you do about a loose timber stair or handrail? ↗
2a669ae696e25ef4bb74.zh: 如果木楼梯或扶手松动，您该怎么办？ ↗

b8ea0c2f700d4ccbb7f5.en: Repair or Rebuild an Existing Deck? | Ellis Services Group
b8ea0c2f700d4ccbb7f5.zh: 您应该修复现有的露台还是重建它？ | Ellis Services Group

853264e7747d0254794a.en: Compare deck board repairs, frame repairs and rebuilding. Condition, retained supports and proposed layout guide the scope, quote and ACT checks.
853264e7747d0254794a.zh: 比较露台板维修、框架维修和重建。条件、保留的支撑和建议的布局指导范围、报价和 ACT 检查。

e37a2811bfbbf06dfe55.en: Timber deck bearers and joists being examined from below
e37a2811bfbbf06dfe55.zh: 从下面检查木露台支架和托梁

60d9537a08a0bbbe43f0.en: Illustrative detail: the condition of supports and connections informs a repair-or-rebuild decision. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
60d9537a08a0bbbe43f0.zh: 说明性细节：支撑和连接的状况决定修复或重建。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

52daef02f9596b3caf4c.en: Start with condition and the layout you need
52daef02f9596b3caf4c.zh: 从条件和您需要的布局开始

cfdd5f34a6c207fb407c.en: Inspect the boards, supports and connections

0c5060229a785bfdda40.en: When local board repair is suitable
0c5060229a785bfdda40.zh: 哪些情况下适合局部维修露台板

8a395095aed13bbca3b9.en: Frame and connection repairs need their own plan
8a395095aed13bbca3b9.zh: 框架和连接维修需要自己的计划

e7cffea638b142acfa5b.en: When damage or a new layout leads to rebuilding
e7cffea638b142acfa5b.zh: 当损坏或新布局导致重建时

afd4a8a8856412892b74.en: Confirm building and planning responsibilities for the actual proposal
afd4a8a8856412892b74.zh: 确认实际提案的建筑和规划责任

aad93c0724b344357ed0.en: From assessment to a written quote

0b2fc8c89dc555e14a07.en: Repair may suit isolated board, connection or support damage where the surrounding structure can stay. Rebuilding becomes worth comparing when several connected parts are damaged or a new footprint, height or stair position is needed. The number of worn boards alone cannot decide: a tidy surface may hide poor supports, while an older deck may still contain serviceable timber.
0b2fc8c89dc555e14a07.zh: 维修可能适用于周围结构可以保留的隔离板、连接或支撑损坏。当多个连接部件损坏或需要新的占地面积、高度或楼梯位置时，重建就变得值得比较。仅凭磨损板的数量并不能决定：整洁的表面可能隐藏着不良的支撑，而旧的露台可能仍然包含可用的木材。

deb8309c1b159292f46a.en: Separate your two questions: what needs work now, and what would you like to change? A deck that could be repaired locally may still not suit a proposed extension or new stair position. Conversely, an appearance concern may only require defined surface care once defects are assessed. Tell the assessor both the observed problem and your intended use before asking for one headline price.
deb8309c1b159292f46a.zh: 将您的两个问题分开：现在需要做什么，您想改变什么？可以在本地修复的露台可能仍然不适合拟议的扩建或新的楼梯位置。相反，一旦评估了缺陷，外观问题可能只需要指定的表面护理。在询问总体价格之前，请告诉评估员所观察到的问题和您的预期用途。

11697e206501e8e63f0e.en: Stop using an unstable or visibly damaged area while assessment is arranged. Do not lift boards, crawl underneath an unsafe deck or add weight to test movement. Existing plans, earlier repair records and safely available photographs can help describe the structure. They do not confirm that concealed timber or connections are suitable for retention.
11697e206501e8e63f0e.zh: 在安排评估期间，停止使用不稳定或明显损坏的区域。请勿举起木板、在不安全的露台下爬行或增加重量来测试移动。现有的计划、早期的维修记录和安全可用的照片可以帮助描述结构。他们不确认隐藏的木材或连接是否适合保留。

47df0389f4a1a0bfb048.en: Ask the assessment to distinguish the surface, supporting joists and bearers, posts, footings, building connections, stairs and barriers where present. The accessibility of these parts affects what can be established. If some areas cannot be checked initially, the quote should explain that uncertainty and the agreed inspection or variation process before covering them with new boards.
47df0389f4a1a0bfb048.zh: 要求评估人员区分表面、支撑托梁和支架、柱子、基础、建筑物连接、楼梯和障碍物（如果存在）。这些部分的可进出条件性会影响可以建立的内容。如果某些区域最初无法检查，则报价应在用新板覆盖它们之前解释不确定性以及商定的检查或变更过程。

0b79c98db7e8b81bab66.en: A local board repair can suit a defined defect with suitable adjacent boards and retained supports. Its scope should name the boards, joins, fixing work and finishing boundary. Damaged ends beside a stair or wall may involve different access from boards in an open area. Ask how the proposed replacement relates to the existing layout rather than counting surface boards alone.
0b79c98db7e8b81bab66.zh: 局部板修复可以通过合适的相邻板和保留的支撑来适应确定的缺陷。其范围应命名板材、连接处、固定工作和表面与收边处理边界。楼梯或墙壁旁边的损坏端部可能涉及从开放区域的木板进入的不同通道。询问拟议的更换与现有布局有何关系，而不是仅计算表面板。

47d8b8d9b5755f558ea0.en: New timber may differ in colour, texture or dimensions from the weathered surface. Agree a practical match and whether preparation or coating will include retained boards. Surface appearance and support condition are separate decisions. See
47d8b8d9b5755f558ea0.zh: 新木材的颜色、纹理或尺寸可能与风化表面不同。就实际匹配以及准备或涂层是否包括保留板达成一致。表面外观和支撑条件是单独的决定。参见

3259a61838db9b283e61.en: for the distinction before comparing a board-only proposal with broader work.
3259a61838db9b283e61.zh: 在将仅限露台板的提案与更广泛的工作进行比较之前进行区分。

5cda7fac656e2c9ad52d.en: Defined damage in a joist, bearer, post or connection can lead to a support repair rather than a complete rebuild, where the retained assembly is suitable. The repair method, safe sequence and any structural professional input need to follow the actual condition. A fresh walking surface cannot compensate for an affected support or an unsuitable connection.
5cda7fac656e2c9ad52d.zh: 托梁、支架、柱子或连接处的明确损坏可能会导致支撑修复，而不是完全重建（在保留组件合适的情况下）。修复方法、安全顺序以及任何结构专业输入都需要根据实际情况进行。新的行走表面无法弥补受影响的支撑或不合适的连接。

5179d99a9a2bf143d6ca.en: Ask which connected components will be checked, how access is provided and whether the wetting cause is included. A building junction or repeatedly damp corner deserves attention as a detail, not merely another replacement length. Where additional damage is found, the finding and proposed revised boundary should be explained before work beyond the accepted scope proceeds.
5179d99a9a2bf143d6ca.zh: 询问将检查哪些连接组件、如何提供进出条件以及是否包括受潮原因。建筑物交界处或反复潮湿的角落作为细节值得关注，而不仅仅是另一个替换长度。如果发现额外损坏，则应在超出可接受范围的工作继续进行之前解释发现的结果和拟议的修订边界。

a3f26ad84a8176a17112.en: Rebuilding may provide a clearer option where several parts need work together or the retained structure does not suit the new design. Compare removal, site preparation, supports, boards, stairs, barriers and finish on the same basis. A rebuild quote should state what, if anything, is retained. Do not assume that “new deck” includes every adjoining landscape or drainage item.
a3f26ad84a8176a17112.zh: 在多个部件需要协同工作或保留的结构不适合新设计的情况下，重建可以提供更清晰的选择。在相同的基础上比较拆除、场地准备、支撑、木板、楼梯、障碍物和饰面。重建报价应说明保留哪些内容（如果有）。不要假设“新露台”包括所有相邻的景观或排水项目。

9f31660e4fbc7ea7d3f9.en: An extension also needs the existing and new systems considered together. The proposed material, connections and access may change the design. Discuss the intended furniture and use without assuming an old frame can accept a new surface or added area. The
9f31660e4fbc7ea7d3f9.zh: 扩展还需要将现有系统和新系统一起考虑。提议的材料、连接和通道可能会改变设计。讨论预期的家具和用途，不要假设旧框架可以接受新的表面或增加的区域。的

f2f254f66cc9af383540.en: helps identify the product questions to settle before supply.
f2f254f66cc9af383540.zh: 有助于确定供应前需要解决的产品问题。

d36eb9e89de7a33e963e.en: ACT guidance treats development approval and building approval as separate matters. A possible exemption from one does not settle the other, and general conditions sit alongside project-specific criteria. Ask the relevant professionals to check the actual repair, rebuild or extension. There is no single low-height shortcut that confirms every deck project’s requirements.
d36eb9e89de7a33e963e.zh: ACT 指南将开发审批和建筑审批视为单独的事项。一项可能的豁免并不能解决另一项的问题，一般条件与项目特定标准并存。请相关专业人员检查实际修复、改建或扩建情况。没有单一的低高度捷径可以满足每个露台项目的要求。

bf530c1fb97b6cf5b12b.en: Keep existing drawings and approvals available, and ask who checks the new proposal and obtains any required documents. Describe an extension, altered stairs or a changed barrier explicitly. Those changes need to appear in both the construction proposal and the approval review, so a quote for board replacement is not mistaken for permission to alter the whole deck.
bf530c1fb97b6cf5b12b.zh: 保留现有图纸和批准，并询问谁检查新提案并获取任何所需文件。明确描述扩建、改变的楼梯或改变的障碍物。这些更改需要出现在施工提案和审批审查中，因此更换板的报价不会被误认为是允许更改整个露台。

544deddeaca2d4abdc1a.en: Our written quote identifies the agreed retained and replaced components, materials, fixings, removal, access and finishing. Confirm which specialist checks and project requirements apply, how additional findings are recorded and which parts remain outside the scope. A written variation should state the added work, price basis and scheduling effect before that extra work proceeds.
544deddeaca2d4abdc1a.zh: 我们的书面报价确定了商定的保留和更换的组件、材料、固定件、拆卸、进出条件和收尾处理。确认适用哪些专家检查和项目要求、如何记录其他发现以及哪些部分不在范围内。书面变更应说明在进行额外工作之前增加的工作、价格基础和日程安排效果。

7292cede7446a0424500.en: Send the observed symptoms, intended layout, suburb and available records. Use
7292cede7446a0424500.zh: 发送观察到的症状、预期布局、郊区和可用记录。使用

a375d9c5c5fa952103d1.en: for a new layout. Compare the same removal, supports, boards, stairs and finish across proposals; a cheaper board-only price answers a different question from rebuilding the structure.
a375d9c5c5fa952103d1.zh: 用于新布局。比较不同提案中相同的拆除、支撑、木板、楼梯和饰面；更便宜的纯木板价格解决了与重建结构不同的问题。

ee47c63142cd75680efc.en: Compare board repair, frame repair and rebuilding
ee47c63142cd75680efc.zh: 比较板修复、框架修复和重建

8371b00a62905686f73b.en: Defined board damage with supports assessed as suitable for retention.
8371b00a62905686f73b.zh: 定义的板损坏，且支撑评估为适合保留。

c70437c2b8138ba9bef9.en: Specified boards, fixings, adjoining details and finish.
c70437c2b8138ba9bef9.zh: 指定的板、紧固件、毗邻细节和饰面。

38cbb8e26bf6c62c4397.en: Defined supporting-member or connection damage with a suitable repair option.
38cbb8e26bf6c62c4397.zh: 通过合适的修复选项确定支撑构件或连接损坏。

2b67498fe275a2bcce0f.en: Support components, safe sequence, inspection access and moisture source.
2b67498fe275a2bcce0f.zh: 支持组件、安全顺序、检查通道和水分源。

79941ada308a2d17787c.en: Connected defects or a changed layout requiring a new construction scope.
79941ada308a2d17787c.zh: 连接缺陷或需要新施工范围的更改布局。

4123bf5354a4f1413a11.en: Removal, new deck system, materials, access and applicable ACT checks.
4123bf5354a4f1413a11.zh: 拆除、新露台系统、材料、通道和适用的 ACT 检查。

e67f1fdf90479b29203f.en: Can new boards solve a damaged frame?
e67f1fdf90479b29203f.zh: 新板可以解决损坏的框架吗？

86755ca5cb5db461a2b8.en: No. Supporting timber and connections need assessment and repair where affected before board replacement is agreed.
86755ca5cb5db461a2b8.zh: 否。在同意更换木板之前，需要对受影响的支撑木材和连接进行评估和修复。

085e6610d5c0f4cf8f73.en: Can I decide from the percentage of damaged boards?
085e6610d5c0f4cf8f73.zh: 我可以根据损坏板的百分比来确定吗？

01c8983c36ea7c6ec691.en: No. Board count does not establish the condition of the supports, connections or retained timber. Compare the assessed repair options.
01c8983c36ea7c6ec691.zh: 否。木板计数不能确定支撑、连接或保留木材的状况。比较评估的修复方案。

e5716a427da2cc2f684c.en: What happens if more damage is found?
e5716a427da2cc2f684c.zh: 如果发现更多损坏怎么办？

e0c87969f00bf3236599.en: The finding should be documented and explained. A written variation confirms added work, the pricing basis and scheduling effect before that work proceeds.
e0c87969f00bf3236599.zh: 应记录并解释调查结果。书面变更确认增加的工作、定价基础和进度安排效果，然后再进行工作。

0001c77e29aecfebc093.en: Does a low deck automatically avoid approval checks?
0001c77e29aecfebc093.zh: 低露台是否会自动避免批准检查？

1162ede6983d2b397000.en: No. The actual repair, new construction or extension needs the applicable ACT building and planning checks.
1162ede6983d2b397000.zh: 否。实际维修、新建或扩建需要适用的 ACT 建筑和规划检查。

ede4eee5de21304027d5.zh: 询问 Ellis 关于你的套牌

999ef68a0e148d85f7a6.en: New decks and extensions planned around the footprint, height, intended use and site. Footings, supports, drainage and the specified board system are considered together.
999ef68a0e148d85f7a6.zh: 根据场地范围、高度和用途规划新建或扩建露台。基础、支撑、排水与选定的露台板系统一并考虑。

f8c60592251f8bd541d4.zh: 探索新的露台构造和扩展 ↗

6a356ecc27fb11f876d1.en: Rotten Window Sill Repairs | Ellis Services Group
6a356ecc27fb11f876d1.zh: 腐烂的木窗台可以修复吗？ | Ellis Services Group

380a9f18d9a66197c6bb.en: Understand when a rotten window sill may suit a local timber repair, what affects replacement scope, and why adjoining frames and drainage matter.
380a9f18d9a66197c6bb.zh: 了解腐烂的窗台何时适合当地木材修复、影响更换范围的因素以及为什么相邻框架和排水系统很重要。

1cf9edbbc04ece85e732.en: Decayed timber and peeling paint at a window sill and lower frame
1cf9edbbc04ece85e732.zh: 窗台和下框的木材腐烂，油漆剥落

75db7a5135308167c2e6.en: Illustrative detail: damage at the sill-to-frame junction helps explain why the extent and moisture source need checking. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
75db7a5135308167c2e6.zh: 说明性细节：窗台与框架连接处的损坏有助于解释为什么需要检查程度和水分来源。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

065f914b3e127f69796d.en: A soft corner does not define the whole repair
065f914b3e127f69796d.zh: 局部松软不能代表全部维修范围

0cea536efbb3ed406fdf.en: Why the sill shape and water route matter
0cea536efbb3ed406fdf.zh: 窗台造型与排水路径为什么重要

c8b91e569673aaaa9239.en: Compare a splice with replacing the sill

b1ff7790c1c672304b83.en: Separate glazing, sash operation and timber work
b1ff7790c1c672304b83.zh: 分别确认玻璃、窗扇启闭与木材维修

9505a495035a76eddba8.en: Match the profile and agree the painted boundary
9505a495035a76eddba8.zh: 匹配截面造型并确认涂装范围

c4461849dd18b16ab97e.en: Details to send about a damaged sill
c4461849dd18b16ab97e.zh: 发送有关损坏的窗台的详细信息

588edca10103f3e23635.en: A rotten sill can sometimes be repaired with a fitted replacement section, also called a splice, where the surrounding timber can support the joint. Decay through the sill or into the side frame may require a longer replacement. Peeling paint and staining show where to investigate, but their edges are not reliable boundaries for cutting away damaged timber.
588edca10103f3e23635.zh: 腐烂的窗台有时可以用合适的替换部分（也称为接头）来修复，周围的木材可以支撑接头。穿过门槛或进入侧框架的腐烂可能需要更长的更换时间。剥落的油漆和污渍表明了需要调查的地方，但它们的边缘并不是切割受损木材的可靠边界。

fab6393e832246b6933a.en: Record what is already visible: cracked coatings, open joints, staining or a change in window operation. Do not dig into the sill to find the edge of the damage. The on-site assessment should establish the component condition, the likely moisture route and any inspection access required before deciding between a splice, sill replacement or wider frame work.
fab6393e832246b6933a.zh: 记录已经可见的内容：涂层破裂、接缝开裂、污渍或窗户操作的变化。不要挖掘窗台来寻找损坏的边缘。在决定拼接、窗台更换或更宽的框架之前，现场评估应确定组件状况、可能的潮湿路径以及所需的任何检查通道。

27acc8f2f4347ad56fcf.en: A sill is more than a horizontal piece of timber under glass. Its profile, projection and junctions affect how the opening sheds water. Ends meet the side frames and may be concealed by other trim. A replacement that looks similar from indoors can still change an outside detail, so discuss function as well as appearance when choosing the repair.
27acc8f2f4347ad56fcf.zh: 窗台不仅仅是玻璃下的一块水平木材。它的轮廓、投影和连接处会影响开口的排水方式。末端与侧框相接，并可能被其他装饰隐藏。从室内看起来相似的替换件仍然可以改变外部细节，因此在选择维修时请讨论功能和外观。

8c43cddc32f71fdaa027.en: WoodSolutions describes timber-window durability as a combination of exposure, materials and maintenance, with resistance to water entry also relevant. If dampness follows rain, the leak needs attention alongside timber work. Repainting alone cannot establish that the wetting route has been corrected. Tell the team about previous sealing or leak work and which side becomes wet.
8c43cddc32f71fdaa027.zh: WoodSolutions 将木窗的耐久性描述为暴露、材料和维护的组合，与防水性也相关。如果雨后潮湿，则需要在木材加工的同时注意渗漏。仅重涂并不能确定进水路径已得到纠正。告诉团队之前的密封或泄漏工作以及哪一侧变湿。

49a587d83de2b35aad6f.en: WoodSolutions: timber windows, moisture and maintenance

97868026f34bef697122.en: A local splice replaces a defined damaged section while retaining suitable timber around it. This may preserve the existing opening and its character, but it relies on a viable join and a compatible profile. Longer sill replacement can be more practical where damage is continuous or the retained ends cannot provide suitable connections. Neither option follows a universal percentage rule.
97868026f34bef697122.zh: 局部拼接取代了指定的损坏部分，同时在其周围保留了合适的木材。这可以保留现有的开口及其特征，但它依赖于可行的连接和兼容的截面造型。当损坏持续或保留端无法提供合适的连接时，较长的窗台更换可能更实用。这两种选择都遵循通用的百分比规则。

8f2d2f3f10b270f7dc96.en: The replacement needs an agreed profile, material and protection for exposed edges. Surface filler may finish an appropriate repair but cannot substitute for sound timber at the connection. If the adjoining jamb or sash is damaged, include that work when comparing local repair with replacement of more of the opening.
8f2d2f3f10b270f7dc96.zh: 更换件需要商定的型材、材料以及对暴露边缘的保护。表面填料可以完成适当的修复，但不能替代连接处的完好木材。如果相邻的门框或窗框损坏，在比较局部维修和更换更多开口时，请包括该工作。

a2272a611c436ce372c8.en: A sash is the frame holding the glass within the opening. A sash that drops, sticks or appears painted shut has an operating problem that is distinct from the sill repair. If it will not stay open, stop relying on it to support itself. Do not wedge it open, force it free or dismantle balances and cords to diagnose the fault.
a2272a611c436ce372c8.zh: 窗框是将玻璃固定在开口内的框架。窗扇掉落、粘住或看起来被漆封闭的情况所存在的操作问题与窗台修理不同。如果它不能保持开放，就停止依赖它来支持自己。请勿将其楔入、强行释放或拆卸天平和电线来诊断故障。

f0dc8c39bba3b965b23b.en: Keeping the outer frame does not automatically mean glass can remain untouched. Access, the glass condition and retention details may require a glazier. Ask which specialist arrangements are needed and who coordinates them. Replacing glass, improving glazing performance and repairing timber are different scopes;
f0dc8c39bba3b965b23b.zh: 保留外框并不意味着玻璃可以保持不变。通道、玻璃状况和保留细节可能需要玻璃工。询问需要哪些专家安排以及由谁来协调。更换玻璃、改善玻璃性能和修复木材是不同的范围；

d7ead2b607e0270ac878.en: is the starting point for defining the timber work.
d7ead2b607e0270ac878.zh: 是定义木材作品的起点。

12f9877f800651c905d6.en: Photographs of the whole window and the affected corner help discuss a match. A measured section or supplier profile may still be needed before ordering. Species, dimensions, existing finishes and access around the opening affect the proposal. A visually close profile should also preserve the intended drainage detail, rather than merely reproducing an indoor edge.
12f9877f800651c905d6.zh: 整个窗户和受影响角落的照片有助于讨论比赛。订购前可能仍需要测量截面或供应商资料。物种、尺寸、现有饰面和开口周围的通道都会影响提案。视觉上接近的轮廓还应该保留预期的排水细节，而不仅仅是再现室内边缘。

4e4701fc1c53519865e4.en: Confirm whether preparation, priming and final painting include the entire sill, the repaired area or surrounding frame. Local paint can stand out beside an aged coating. On a property with heritage controls or specific consent conditions, flag those records before alterations are planned and confirm the relevant professional advice. This guide does not decide what changes a particular property permits.
4e4701fc1c53519865e4.zh: 确认准备、底漆和最终喷漆是否包括整个窗台、修复区域或周围框架。本地油漆可以在老化涂层旁边脱颖而出。对于具有遗产控制或特定同意条件的财产，在计划改建之前标记这些记录并确认相关的专业建议。本指南不决定特定属性允许进行哪些更改。

2ef1b9fe47db5ad05e5a.en: Include your suburb, the window type if known, the affected corner and whether water appears during rain. Mention earlier repairs, an unreliable sash and any difficulty accessing the outside. Optional photos should come from safe ground or a normal indoor position. Do not lean out, climb or remove paint to make the damage clearer.
2ef1b9fe47db5ad05e5a.zh: 包括您所在的郊区、窗户类型（如果已知）、受影响的角落以及下雨时是否出现水。提及早期的维修、不可靠的窗框以及进入外部的任何困难。可自行提供的照片应来自安全地面或正常的室内位置。不要探身、攀爬或清除油漆以使损坏更明显。

a3e24efd906314c47d65.en: Ask the quote to distinguish timber, leak investigation, glazing, access, removal and painting. If more decay is found after agreed opening-up, review the finding and proposed change before extra work begins. For an earlier patch that has failed again,
a3e24efd906314c47d65.zh: 询问报价以区分木材、泄漏调查、玻璃、通道、拆除和油漆。如果在商定的开放后发现更多腐烂，请在额外工作开始之前审查发现结果和提议的更改。对于再次失败的早期补丁，

6086a0eec9db040b3716.zh: 为什么木材会再次腐烂

161143f45df53eff1456.en: explains how the water source and adjoining timber affect the next repair.
161143f45df53eff1456.zh: 解释了水源和相邻木材如何影响下一次修复。

85a99c4b405c7049c17f.en: Can a repair match the existing sill profile?
85a99c4b405c7049c17f.zh: 修复是否可以与现有的窗台轮廓相匹配？

ae42ea4d729a86b1b070.en: Measurements and available materials establish the proposed match. Profile and drainage function matter together; confirm the sample or dimensions and finishing scope before replacement timber is ordered.
ae42ea4d729a86b1b070.zh: 测量结果和可用材料建立了建议的匹配。外形和排水功能同时重要；在订购替换木材之前，请确认样品或尺寸以及表面与收边处理范围。

96152aea8e6a87efb71e.en: Will painting stop the sill rotting again?
96152aea8e6a87efb71e.zh: 油漆会再次阻止窗台腐烂吗？

c12531963f2149ff0db7.en: A suitable coating helps protect sound timber, but recurring water entry or trapped moisture also needs attention. Painting over deterioration does not establish a sound repair.
c12531963f2149ff0db7.zh: 合适的涂层有助于保护完好的木材，但反复进水或滞留的水分也需要注意。在损坏处涂漆并不能实现良好的修复。

429155cf61da98338d07.en: How can I tell whether a timber window sill is rotten?
429155cf61da98338d07.zh: 如何判断木质窗台是否腐烂？

096a9832e9bcdcf3a0bf.en: Softness, broken coatings and deteriorated joints can indicate sill damage. Do not remove timber to investigate; Ellis checks the sill and adjoining frame on site to define the damage and moisture source.
096a9832e9bcdcf3a0bf.zh: 柔软、涂层破损和接缝恶化可能表明门槛损坏。请勿移除木材进行调查； Ellis 现场检查窗台和相邻框架，以确定损坏和潮湿源。

487cfcd62e58c2bfde9e.en: When can a timber window be repaired rather than replaced?
487cfcd62e58c2bfde9e.zh: 木窗什么时候可以修理而不是更换？

0a0d0736244460a1df95.en: A repair retains timber and connections that are suitable for continued use and replaces the affected sections. We assess the complete opening before comparing local repair with wider frame or sill replacement.
0a0d0736244460a1df95.zh: 修复保留适合继续使用的木材和连接并替换受影响的部分。在将局部修复与更宽的框架或窗台更换进行比较之前，我们会评估完整的开口。

60a204c24a4e5bf67567.en: Why will a sash window not stay open?
60a204c24a4e5bf67567.zh: 为什么推拉窗不能保持打开状态？

e87f272b2c8c0b77d4cc.en: A sash that drops can have a balance, cord, hardware or fixing fault. Stop relying on the unsupported sash and arrange an assessment; Ellis checks the mechanism and timber support before defining the repair.
e87f272b2c8c0b77d4cc.zh: 坠落的窗扇可能存在天平、绳索、硬件或固定故障。停止依赖无支撑的窗框并安排评估； Ellis 在确定修复之前检查机械装置和木材支撑。

862eda58d5e9c725ea02.en: Timber window repairs for damaged sills, lower rails and frame sections. Compare local replacement with wider repairs while considering glass retention and water entry.
862eda58d5e9c725ea02.zh: 处理窗台、窗扇下横档及木窗框受损的问题。结合玻璃能否保留和进水原因，比较局部更换与扩大维修的方案。

8f4549e6d1d163d0dc00.en: Why does a timber door stick after rain? ↗
8f4549e6d1d163d0dc00.zh: 为什么木门在雨后会卡住？ ↗

c15f62716396aa983017.en: Skirting After New Flooring | Ellis Services Group
c15f62716396aa983017.zh: 新地板铺设后踢脚线应如何规划？ | Ellis Services Group

6f6cfa28429fe158e711.en: Plan skirting after new flooring by checking profile, thickness, floor levels and adjoining trim. Clarify removal, caulking and painting in the quote.
6f6cfa28429fe158e711.zh: 通过检查轮廓、厚度、地板水平和相邻装饰来规划新地板后的踢脚线。澄清报价中的拆除、填缝和涂漆。

90a8116c0cd03c842c16.en: White skirting and door architrave beside a timber floor transition
90a8116c0cd03c842c16.zh: 木地板过渡旁边的白色踢脚线和门窗套线

fe41a3afe36bbc13a143.en: Illustrative detail: the trim profile and floor junction need to be considered together. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
fe41a3afe36bbc13a143.zh: 说明性细节：装饰轮廓和地板连接处需要一起考虑。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

36fe70c93bed18a58058.en: A new floor changes more than the skirting height
36fe70c93bed18a58058.zh: 新地板的变化不仅仅是踢脚线高度

590960fe286817e52e21.en: Agree the sequence with the flooring installer
590960fe286817e52e21.zh: 与地板安装人员商定顺序

a6aa17dd607ea83f96dd.en: Match height, thickness and the shaped edge
a6aa17dd607ea83f96dd.zh: 匹配高度、厚度和形状边缘

6b9467177847da0c7b0a.en: Local damage and swollen boards need different decisions
6b9467177847da0c7b0a.zh: 区分局部破损与受潮膨胀

5f9bcf6c403b2c468e88.en: Confirm whether the quote includes painting
5f9bcf6c403b2c468e88.zh: 确认报价是否包含喷漆

88348939b2419d2eac2a.en: What to send before the on-site measure
88348939b2419d2eac2a.zh: 现场测量前需要发送什么

c74b1d136d5e54451f48.en: A changed floor level can leave a gap below existing skirting or alter the door clearance. Possible finishes include refitting suitable boards, replacing the skirting or using a compatible finishing trim. Choose the detail with the flooring system, finished level and adjoining architraves in mind. Removing old skirting can also leave wall damage that needs making good.
c74b1d136d5e54451f48.zh: 改变的地板高度可能会在现有踢脚线下方留下间隙或改变门间隙。可能的饰面包括重新安装合适的板、更换踢脚线或使用兼容的饰面装饰。选择细节时要考虑到地板系统、成品层和相邻的门窗套线。拆除旧踢脚线也会留下需要修复的墙壁损坏。

d3254b979dc81774f36a.en: Do not fill every visible gap before asking the flooring installer which edge detail applies. Some gaps serve the flooring system’s movement requirements. For example, Quick-Step Bloom instructions keep its floor free to move beneath wall-fixed skirting. That is product-specific guidance, not a universal gap dimension or sealant rule for every timber, laminate or hybrid floor.
d3254b979dc81774f36a.zh: 在询问地板安装人员适用哪种边缘细节之前，请勿填充每个可见的间隙。一些间隙满足地板系统的移动要求。例如，Quick-Step Bloom 指令可使其地板在墙壁固定踢脚线下方自由移动。这是特定于产品的指南，而不是适用于每种木材、强化木地板或混合地板的通用间隙尺寸或密封剂规则。

f1ba9997638bff294188.en: Quick-Step Bloom: product-specific floor and skirting instructions
f1ba9997638bff294188.zh: Quick-Step Bloom：特定产品的地板和踢脚线说明

6d0f7bd582f61e238d92.en: Settle the floor’s finished height and perimeter requirements before final trim fitting. Old skirting may be reusable if it can be removed without breaking and still suits the new level. Brittle material, thick paint and earlier fixings can make that difficult. Check the boards on site before relying on reuse in the material order.
6d0f7bd582f61e238d92.zh: 在最终装饰安装之前确定地板的成品高度和周长要求。如果旧踢脚线可以在不破裂的情况下拆除并且仍然适合新的水平，则可以重复使用。易碎的材料、厚厚的油漆和较早的紧固件会使这变得困难。在依赖材料订单中的重复使用之前，请在现场检查木板。

5b06d46560f83d0c8558.en: Coordinate flooring, skirting and painting dates so each person understands the handover. Ask who protects the new floor, moves furniture and makes good wall marks. Where door clearance has reduced, include that as its own task with the door construction checked. A quote for skirting should not silently assume that trimming every door is included or permissible.
5b06d46560f83d0c8558.zh: 协调地板、踢脚线和油漆日期，以便每个人都了解交接事宜。询问谁负责保护新地板、移动家具以及在墙壁上做良好的标记。如果门间隙减少，则将其作为其自身任务并检查门结构。踢脚线的报价不应默默地假设包括或允许修剪每扇门。

59cbb64cda9ed8dcf4d7.en: Skirting finishes the wall-to-floor junction; architraves finish around door and window openings. They meet at doorways, so height alone is not enough for a match. Thickness, the shaped top edge and the way the boards return into an opening can be conspicuous beside retained trim. A taller board may also expose or cover different areas of existing wall finish.
59cbb64cda9ed8dcf4d7.zh: Skirting finishes the wall-to-floor junction; 门窗套线 finish around door and window openings.他们在门口相遇，因此仅凭身高不足以进行比赛。 Thickness, the shaped top edge and the way the boards return into an opening can be conspicuous beside retained trim. A taller board may also expose or cover different areas of existing wall finish.

7cafbc45002dbc044c13.en: Send an overview of retained trim and a safe close-up of its profile. Measurements and a sample may be needed on site. Decide whether you want continuity with another room or a new profile throughout the area. Confirm the selected material, dimensions and finish before buying customer-supplied boards, especially where an advertised profile has a different thickness.
7cafbc45002dbc044c13.zh: Send an overview of retained trim and a safe close-up of its profile.现场可能需要测量和样品。决定您是否想要与另一个房间保持连续性，或者在整个区域中使用新的截面造型。在购买客户提供的板材之前，请确认所选材料、尺寸和表面处理，特别是在广告中的型材具有不同厚度的情况下。

3cc1f9dcca9cd96607f4.en: A small impact or chewed section can sometimes be treated locally where surrounding material is suitable and a finish can be agreed. Water-damaged MDF or timber needs the moisture source addressed first. A swollen board may no longer offer the profile or fixing surface required, so ask for a material assessment rather than assuming drying or filler will restore it.
3cc1f9dcca9cd96607f4.zh: A small impact or chewed section can sometimes be treated locally where surrounding material is suitable and a finish can be agreed.受水损坏的中密度纤维板或木材需要首先解决水分来源。膨胀的板可能不再提供所需的轮廓或固定表面，因此要求进行材料评估，而不是假设干燥或填充物可以恢复它。

869151622fd152fd8449.en: Replacement of a defined length can avoid changing an entire room, but joins, available profiles and the paint boundary influence appearance. Ask whether an isolated section or a full wall length gives the more workable finish. If the leak is recent, confirm which moisture-source work has been completed before new trim is installed. Do not seal over ongoing dampness to meet a painting date.
869151622fd152fd8449.zh: 更换指定长度可以避免改变整个房间，但连接处、可用轮廓和油漆边界会影响外观。询问隔离部分或整个墙长是否能提供更可行的饰面。 If the leak is recent, confirm which moisture-source work has been completed before new trim is installed. Do not seal over ongoing dampness to meet a painting date.

f205e29a8cd97829f707.en: Quotes can include different stages: removal, supply, cutting and fitting, fixing holes, caulking, priming or final painting. Primed material is not the same as a completed painted finish. Ask which surface the caulking applies to, how wall damage will be handled and where decoration stops. Any treatment beside a floating floor must respect the selected flooring instructions.
f205e29a8cd97829f707.zh: Quotes can include different stages: removal, supply, cutting and fitting, fixing holes, caulking, priming or final painting. Primed material is not the same as a completed painted finish.询问填缝适用于哪个表面、如何处理墙壁损坏以及装饰在哪里停止。 Any treatment beside a floating floor must respect the selected flooring instructions.

67c5169dbce8f21db29f.en: Corners, returns, short lengths around cabinets and junctions at architraves can take more attention than a simple perimeter measurement suggests. Access to furniture-covered walls and protection of the new floor also affect the work. Use
67c5169dbce8f21db29f.zh: 角落、回程、橱柜周围的短长度以及门窗套线处的连接处可能比简单的周长测量更需要注意。 Access to furniture-covered walls and protection of the new floor also affect the work.使用

a64abc033a255bfad8ea.en: to define the measured scope rather than comparing board supply prices with a complete room finish.
a64abc033a255bfad8ea.zh: to define the measured scope rather than comparing board supply prices with a complete room finish.

3c552ca5dc1efaf5eab8.en: Include the rooms, your suburb, whether flooring is installed or planned and which trim is staying. Give the flooring product or installer’s edge requirements if available. Optional photos of the wall junction, a corner and a doorway help show the relationship between components. A room perimeter can start the conversation, but it does not replace a measured fitting list.
3c552ca5dc1efaf5eab8.zh: 包括房间、您的郊区、地板是否已安装或计划以及保留哪种装饰。如果有的话，请提供地板产品或安装人员的边缘要求。墙壁连接处、角落和门口的可选照片有助于显示组件之间的关系。房间周长可以引发对话，但它不能取代测量的配件清单。

584847ceae71d623bf92.en: Ask Ellis to record the profile, supply responsibility, removal, floor protection and painting in the installation plan and quote. Mention rubbing doors as a separate item; the
584847ceae71d623bf92.zh: Ask Ellis to record the profile, supply responsibility, removal, floor protection and painting in the installation plan and quote.将摩擦门作为单独的项目提及；这

12e4da04d272fc5ba1d4.en: explains why clearance should be checked before trimming. Fit the trim to the completed floor detail and agree how the new finish meets existing paint.
12e4da04d272fc5ba1d4.zh: 解释了为什么在修剪之前应检查间隙。将装饰与已完成的地板细节相匹配，并同意新饰面如何与现有油漆相匹配。

04b4d9669d95d7b6d558.en: Should new skirting match only the old board height?
04b4d9669d95d7b6d558.zh: 新踢脚线是否应该仅与旧板高度匹配？

b0048f0d848a694435a2.en: No. Thickness and the shaped profile also affect the join to retained trim. Compare a sample or measured profile and agree the material and finish.
b0048f0d848a694435a2.zh: 否。厚度和成形轮廓也会影响保留装饰的连接。比较样品或测量的轮廓并同意材料和表面处理。

f0e733c331b4f409e1ea.en: Is painting included with skirting installation?
f0e733c331b4f409e1ea.zh: 踢脚线安装是否包含油漆？

5591b1326fbf4af81a67.en: Confirm it in the quote. Removal, supply, fitting, caulking, priming and final painting are separate inclusions to agree.
5591b1326fbf4af81a67.zh: 在报价中确认。拆除、供应、安装、填缝、底漆和最终涂漆是单独的内容，需要商定。

f5c0f6d1414377d90a88.en: Skirting finishes the wall-to-floor junction; architraves finish around openings. Ellis measures the profile, height and adjoining trim before specifying matching supply and installation.
f5c0f6d1414377d90a88.zh: 踢脚线完成墙壁与地板的连接处；门窗套线围绕开口完成。 Ellis 在指定匹配的供应和安装之前测量轮廓、高度和相邻装饰。

8a2c97946e82745c535e.en: How can replacement skirting match an existing profile?
8a2c97946e82745c535e.zh: 替换踢脚线如何与现有型材相匹配？

28fedc07aab1b9bf308e.en: We measure the existing height, thickness and shaped profile and compare suitable materials or samples. The selected match and finish are agreed before new trim is ordered.
28fedc07aab1b9bf308e.zh: 我们测量现有的高度、厚度和形状轮廓，并比较合适的材料或样品。在订购新装饰之前，已就选定的匹配和饰面达成一致。

c99da4cdf05ecd825981.en: Skirting board and architrave installation and replacement. Match the existing profile and plan wall, floor and opening junctions before fitting new trim.
c99da4cdf05ecd825981.zh: 安装或更换踢脚线与门窗套线。施工前先匹配原有截面造型，并协调墙面、地板及门窗洞口的交接细节。

09c67c3a830ae4e55471.zh: 探索踢脚线和门窗套线 ↗

75e54379926c9242e662.en: Contact Ellis for an on-site measure and an installation plan and quote.
75e54379926c9242e662.zh: 请联系 Ellis 获取现场测量以及安装计划和报价。

620661b28dfb84f6bf65.en: Arrange your on-site measure and quote

732fde781f9716b5bbe8.en: Send the rooms, flooring stage and your suburb. Profile photos are optional.
732fde781f9716b5bbe8.zh: 发送房间、地板舞台和您的郊区。个人资料照片是可选的。

ecc11e2adf0494f6a5dc.en: Timber Deck Maintenance | Ellis Services Group
ecc11e2adf0494f6a5dc.zh: 木露台维护：保养还是修理？ | Ellis Services Group

5eed9135e89dd86d98d6.en: Plan timber deck maintenance. Separate cleaning and coating care from loose boards, damaged supports and repair decisions before booking work.
5eed9135e89dd86d98d6.zh: 计划木材露台维护。在预约工作之前，将清洁和涂层护理与松动的板、损坏的支撑和维修决定分开。

401b19e44662895fd90c.en: Timber deck surface after the recorded repairs, cleaning and oiling in Melba
401b19e44662895fd90c.zh: Melba 中记录的修理、清洁和涂油后的木露台表面

f2c9d3031382285aa96c.en: Melba: board repairs before cleaning and oiling
f2c9d3031382285aa96c.zh: Melba：清洁和涂油前的木板维修

f75c7b76781498dd2528.en: Resolve board defects before treating the enquiry as surface care alone. At Melba in May 2025, our carpentry team repaired raised and distorted boards, then carried out cleaning and surface preparation before applying Cabot’s oil-based decking oil. The project connects the repair decision with the later coating work.
f75c7b76781498dd2528.zh: 在将咨询单独视为表面护理之前解决木板缺陷。 2025 年 5 月Melba，我们的木工团队修复了凸起和扭曲的木板，然后进行清洁和表面处理，然后涂上Cabot’s 油性露台木油。该项目将修复决策与后续的涂层工作联系起来。

ea65a6465ab8900b8f0d.en: The photographs show the weathered surface, cleaning, oil application and finished appearance. For another deck, the existing coating and timber condition determine the preparation and compatible product; the surface photographs cannot show concealed supports.
ea65a6465ab8900b8f0d.zh: 照片显示了风化表面、清洁、涂油和成品外观。对于另一个露台，现有的涂层和木材状况决定了准备和兼容的产品；表面照片无法显示隐藏的支撑。

bfc4122e94851a362f21.en: See the Melba deck repairs, cleaning and oiling record
bfc4122e94851a362f21.zh: 参见 Melba 露台修理、清洁和加油记录

477828858ec019cf5a9f.en: Confirmed Ellis project: the Melba timber deck following repairs, cleaning and oiling in May 2025. The surface photograph does not establish the condition of concealed supports.
477828858ec019cf5a9f.zh: 已确认 Ellis 项目：Melba 木露台于 2025 年 5 月进行维修、清洁和涂油。表面照片未确定隐藏支撑的情况。

5e84ee9be8d3cfef0313.en: Distinguish deck surface care from timber repair
5e84ee9be8d3cfef0313.zh: 区分露台表面护理和木材修复

a136d859332abdf0f9af.en: Observe from accessible ground without testing the structure
a136d859332abdf0f9af.zh: 从可接近的地面观察而不测试结构

596d5d3faf8403990afc.en: Identify the timber and existing coating where possible
596d5d3faf8403990afc.zh: 尽可能识别木材和现有涂层

e16b7ff4b4052c9f4576.en: Resolve board and support defects before treating the finish
e16b7ff4b4052c9f4576.zh: 在处理饰面之前解决板和支撑缺陷

7f8b325908038354768f.en: Use exposure and product instructions to plan future care
7f8b325908038354768f.zh: 根据日晒雨淋情况与产品说明安排保养

ca6bc6c3337f9380b6a3.en: Check preparation, product and access costs
ca6bc6c3337f9380b6a3.zh: 检查准备、产品和现场作业条件与费用

d53666b0fff97cde8024.en: Details to send and maintenance records to keep
d53666b0fff97cde8024.zh: 要发送的详细信息和要保存的维护记录

270a99e970cf797e1d17.en: A faded deck may need cleaning and a renewed coating; a loose board or moving support needs repair assessment first. Ellis provides stand-alone deck cleaning and oiling as well as carpentry repairs. These jobs can be combined, but cleaning, preparation and coating cannot restore a deteriorated support or establish the condition beneath the boards.
270a99e970cf797e1d17.zh: 褪色的露台可能需要清洁和更新涂层；松动的木板或移动的支架需要首先进行修复评估。 Ellis 提供独立的露台清洁和涂油以及木工维修。这些工作可以结合起来，但清洁、准备和涂层不能恢复恶化的支撑或建立板下的条件。

f8f6ded49987afb3c6bb.en: Start with what you have already noticed and what result you want. If the issue is an aged finish on otherwise assessed suitable timber, define the preparation and coating scope. If a board moves or feels soft, describe that existing symptom without testing it again. Combining care and repair is possible as an agreed proposal, but the two decisions should remain understandable.
f8f6ded49987afb3c6bb.zh: 从您已经注意到的内容以及您想要的结果开始。如果问题是在其他经过评估的合适木材上进行老化处理，请定义准备和涂层范围。如果一块板移动或感觉变软，请描述现有症状，而无需再次测试。作为商定的建议，可以将护理和修复结合起来，但这两个决定应该保持可以理解的状态。

e2ece7254be1dcde971a.en: Note rough edges, broken finish, debris at a junction or water remaining after rain where visible safely. Do not lift boards, crawl under an unsafe deck, lean over a loose rail or add weight to test movement. Keep an unstable or visibly damaged area out of use while assessment is arranged. A description is enough to start if new photos would require unsafe access.
e2ece7254be1dcde971a.zh: 注意安全可见处的粗糙边缘、破损表面、接合处的碎片或雨后残留的水。请勿举起木板、在不安全的露台下爬行、靠在松动的栏杆上或增加重量来测试移动。在安排评估期间，请勿使用不稳定或明显损坏的区域。如果新照片需要不安全的进出条件，那么描述就足以开始。

12ca28d6dd0ffdd61a11.en: Mention stairs, barriers, building connections and earlier repairs. Existing plans and product records can help explain the layout. A surface-care request should still make known defects visible to the team before the booking is discussed. Hiding a loose board beneath furniture or postponing the symptom until coating day can leave the preparation scope unresolved.
12ca28d6dd0ffdd61a11.zh: 提及楼梯、障碍物、建筑物连接和早期维修。现有的计划和产品记录可以帮助解释布局。在讨论预约之前，表面护理请求仍应让团队看到已知的缺陷。将松散的木板隐藏在家具下面或将症状推迟到涂漆日可能会使准备范围得不到解决。

dae9a5891c8667966eae.en: Look for the old quote, coating container, product record or care instructions already held with the property. “Deck oil” may not identify the formulation or compatibility requirements. Timber species, previous finish and exposure all matter when discussing the next treatment. Do not apply a test coating or strip a patch simply to identify the old finish before professional advice.
dae9a5891c8667966eae.zh: 查找酒店已持有的旧报价、涂层容器、产品记录或保养说明。 “露台油”可能无法确定配方或兼容性要求。在讨论下一步处理时，木材种类、之前的处理和暴露都很重要。在获得专业建议之前，请勿仅仅为了识别旧面漆而涂上测试涂层或剥去补丁。

88227b58e575c5cc7bb3.en: WoodSolutions advises following the coating manufacturer’s recommendations when recoating. Ask whether retained boards and new repair timber require different preparation and how the proposed product suits the existing surface. Keep the agreed product identity with the scope. A universal annual oiling instruction cannot replace the guidance for the actual finish and its condition.
88227b58e575c5cc7bb3.zh: WoodSolutions 建议重涂时遵循涂料制造商的建议。询问保留的板材和新的修复木材是否需要不同的准备以及拟议的产品如何适合现有的表面。保留商定的产品标识和范围。通用年度涂油说明不能取代实际表面处理及其状况的指导。

0d7a98bc5354e8a7e5a1.en: A care quote should describe the treated area, preparation and selected coating. “Restoration” can mean different things, from cleaning to board replacement, so ask what will actually happen. Furniture handling, protection of adjoining walls or plants and debris removal can also affect the job. Sanding is not automatically appropriate for every board condition or previous coating.
0d7a98bc5354e8a7e5a1.zh: 护理报价应描述治疗区域、准备工作和所选涂层。 “恢复”可能意味着不同的事情，从清洁到更换木板，所以要询问实际会发生什么。家具搬运、相邻墙壁或植物的保护以及碎片清除也会影响工作。打磨并不自动适合每种板材状况或先前的涂层。

339d3482fe211e6c31bc.en: Cabot’s Natural Decking Oil guidance explains how preparation changes with the existing surface and sets weather limits for that product. Check the directions for the coating actually selected. The Melba record identifies Cabot’s oil-based decking oil but not its exact formulation, coat count or drying schedule, so use it to understand the work stages rather than copy an application method.
339d3482fe211e6c31bc.zh: Cabot’s Natural Decking Oil 产品说明会按原表面状况区分准备方法，并列出该产品的天气条件限制。实际施工应查阅所选涂料的具体说明。Melba 项目仅确认使用了 Cabot’s 油性露台木油，未记录具体配方、涂刷遍数或干燥安排，因此案例用于了解施工阶段，不应直接照搬涂刷方法。

8ba5c537709d1fecf089.en: Cabot’s: Natural Decking Oil preparation and care
8ba5c537709d1fecf089.zh: Cabot’s Natural Decking Oil：施工准备与保养说明

b7f125d5c9f973657d9e.en: A raised edge, split end or loose fixing may involve the board and the supporting material beneath it. Repeated movement or deteriorated connections should not be priced only as another coat of oil. The assessment needs to identify suitable retained components and any repair boundary. New boards may remain visually different from weathered retained material after the agreed finish.
b7f125d5c9f973657d9e.zh: 凸起的边缘、分叉的末端或松动的固定可能会涉及木板及其下方的支撑材料。反复移动或连接恶化不应仅仅作为另一层油来定价。评估需要确定合适的保留部件和任何维修边界。在商定的饰面后，新板可能在视觉上与风化的保留材料有所不同。

8b4c9665595feff38084.en: For widespread or connected defects, compare
8b4c9665595feff38084.zh: 对于广泛存在或相关的缺陷，比较

6442d70a545d9eaa0dda.en: before committing to surface work. A clean deck can still have a support problem. The Melba sequence above shows board repair followed by preparation and oiling; it does not establish that every deck has the same condition or needs the same sequence.
6442d70a545d9eaa0dda.zh: 在进行表面工作之前。干净的露台仍然可能存在支撑问题。上面的 Melba 顺序显示了木板维修，然后是准备和上油；它并没有规定每副牌都具有相同的条件或需要相同的顺序。

1a9d3a6c351624a37447.en: Sun, repeated wetting, sheltered areas and debris collection can produce uneven wear across one deck. Discuss those patterns rather than assuming the entire surface needs treatment on one fixed calendar. WoodSolutions relates recoating to finish and exposure and recommends removing debris before recoating. Use the selected product’s instructions for the actual care method.
1a9d3a6c351624a37447.zh: 阳光、反复弄湿、遮蔽区域和碎片收集可能会在一层露台上产生不均匀磨损。讨论这些图案，而不是假设整个表面都需要在一个固定的日历上进行处理。 WoodSolutions 将重涂与表面与收边处理和曝光联系起来，并建议在重涂之前清除碎屑。请使用所选产品的说明来了解实际的护理方法。

31c6e5e442f9e37e90ea.en: Keep an eye on changes visible during normal safe use, and report new movement or softness as a repair enquiry. Do not try to compensate for a wet junction by adding repeated coating without reviewing the source. If you are considering changing board material to alter the care commitment, read
31c6e5e442f9e37e90ea.zh: 密切关注正常安全使用过程中可见的变化，并报告新的移动或柔软情况作为维修咨询。在未检查来源的情况下，请勿尝试通过添加重复涂层来补偿湿接点。如果您正在考虑更换露台板材料以改变护理承诺，请阅读

9b82e695ea1b03a1c1b2.zh: 木材与复合材料露台板

f37d630dd1c10887d033.en: Confirm the area, product supply, preparation, repairs, access and disposal in the quote. Ask whether the finish includes only repaired boards or the retained surface as well. Different preparation allowances can explain different prices for decks of a similar area. No universal coating life, drying time or maintenance cost is promised by the phrase “cleaning and oiling”.
f37d630dd1c10887d033.zh: 确认报价中的区域、产品供应、准备、维修、进出条件和处置。询问饰面是否仅包括修复的木板或保留的表面。不同的准备预留项目与费用可以解释相似区域的露台的不同价格。 “清洁和上油”一词并未承诺通用的涂层寿命、干燥时间或维护成本。

ce638313584271678419.en: Agree weather and access arrangements under the selected product instructions, including when the area can be used and who confirms that at handover. Tell the team about furniture, pets and the only access route to the house. If repair findings change the job, ask for the added work and price basis to be explained before the extra work proceeds.
ce638313584271678419.zh: 根据所选产品说明商定天气和出入安排，包括何时可以使用该区域以及由谁在移交时确认。告诉团队有关家具、宠物和进入房子的唯一通道的信息。如果维修结果改变了工作，请在进行额外工作之前要求解释增加的工作和价格基础。

cc242df8d66e835cfb5c.en: , provide your suburb, the intended treated area, coating information if known and any defects already noticed. Use
cc242df8d66e835cfb5c.zh: ，提供您所在的郊区、预期处理区域、涂层信息（如果已知）以及已注意到的任何缺陷。使用

c0b842ea94f6bc14786a.en: where movement or timber damage is the main issue. Optional safe overview and detail photos, earlier scopes and available product records help the team prepare the assessment.
c0b842ea94f6bc14786a.zh: 移动或木材损坏是主要问题。可选的安全概览和详细照片、早期范围和可用产品记录可帮助团队准备评估。

6f4b07930529139480ec.en: Keep the repair details, coating name and care instructions with the property records. At the next visit, this lets the team check compatibility and see which boards were replaced. Note uneven wear or new movement as it appears during normal use; finish maintenance and a developing support fault need different responses.
6f4b07930529139480ec.zh: 将维修详细信息、涂层名称和保养说明与财产记录一起保存。在下次访问时，团队可以检查兼容性并查看更换了哪些板。注意正常使用过程中出现的不均匀磨损或新运动；完成维护和出现支持故障需要不同的响应。

2103fb1db592fa3cd9de.en: How often should my timber deck be oiled?
2103fb1db592fa3cd9de.zh: 我的木露台应该多久上油一次？

f75b8a445e8503d4850d.en: Use the guidance for the actual coating, timber and exposure rather than a universal interval. Identify the existing finish before selecting a care product or agreeing a recoating scope.
f75b8a445e8503d4850d.zh: 使用实际涂层、木材和暴露的指南，而不是通用间隔。在选择护理产品或商定重涂范围之前先确定现有的饰面。

e6bf78fda4edfc6afc08.en: Can a new finish make a loose deck safe?
e6bf78fda4edfc6afc08.zh: 新的饰面可以使松散的露台安全吗？

b0c6d7f77b30a056965e.en: No. Coating work does not establish the condition of supporting timber or connections. Avoid the unsafe area and arrange assessment of the movement or damage.
b0c6d7f77b30a056965e.zh: 否。涂层工作不构成支撑木材或连接的条件。避开不安全区域并安排对移动或损坏的评估。

5a11762af8a75f9765d3.en: Does a deck repair quote automatically include sanding and oiling?
5a11762af8a75f9765d3.zh: 露台维修报价是否自动包括打磨和上油？

54e6220eba2ada31cfa3.en: No. The quote must identify any preparation, coating products and areas included. Ask Ellis to confirm the finishing scope; it is separate from deciding which timber needs repair.
54e6220eba2ada31cfa3.zh: 否。报价必须注明所包含的任何准备工作、涂层产品和区域。请Ellis确认收尾处理范围；它与决定哪种木材需要修理是分开的。

26646f8ea6878aeb7abb.en: Sticking Timber Doors After Rain | Ellis Services Group
26646f8ea6878aeb7abb.zh: 为什么木门在雨后会卡住？ | Ellis Services Group

d60be25d0c3c1f19e4c6.en: Why timber doors stick after rain, what the rubbing point can tell you, and why hinges, clearance and moisture need checking before trimming.
d60be25d0c3c1f19e4c6.zh: 为什么木门在雨后会粘在一起，摩擦点可以告诉您什么，以及为什么在修剪之前需要检查铰链、间隙和湿度。

aa02280afd4300251659.en: Illustrative detail: the hinge and frame are among the areas checked when a timber door sticks. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
aa02280afd4300251659.zh: 说明性细节：当木门卡住时，铰链和框架是要检查的区域。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

dedd6e54ac6eb97e2464.en: Why a door changes after wet weather
dedd6e54ac6eb97e2464.zh: 雨后木门为什么容易卡阻

f9638ba43770f31e38fa.en: Check hinges, frame and door clearance
f9638ba43770f31e38fa.zh: 检查铰链、框架和门间隙

cd292870bf62a950c029.en: What to record without taking the door apart
cd292870bf62a950c029.zh: 不拆门也能记录的问题表现

0a24dac2e542176f9003.en: Choose between adjustment, jamb repair and replacement
0a24dac2e542176f9003.zh: 选择调整、门框维修和更换

cda108e0879cc96e656d.en: Address the wetting route and the finish together
cda108e0879cc96e656d.zh: 同时处理进水原因与表面保护

5960d684616bac0b30f7.en: What to include in a door repair quote
5960d684616bac0b30f7.zh: 门维修报价中应包含哪些内容

c79ee9e6d603c31fecae.en: Rain can change the moisture in a timber door or frame and reduce the gaps that let it close. The position of the scrape matters: a swollen edge, loose hinge or thick paint can look similar, while new flooring can reduce only the bottom clearance. Record when the fault appears and whether it eases in dry weather before deciding that the door needs trimming.
c79ee9e6d603c31fecae.zh: 雨水可能改变木门或门框的含水状态，使关门所需的间隙变小。要先看清摩擦位置：门边膨胀、铰链松动或油漆过厚可能出现相似表现，而新铺地板可能只影响底部间隙。决定是否修整门边前，应记录问题出现的时间，以及天气干燥后是否缓解。

e14e0d53f2e601c4cf39.en: Adjustment and finishing requirements depend on the door’s manufacturer and construction. Hume provides care and finishing support for its doors; use the guidance for your own product to establish whether an adjustment is permitted and how any exposed edges must be finished. Identify the door before agreeing the work, rather than applying one trimming allowance to every leaf.
e14e0d53f2e601c4cf39.zh: 调整方法和表面处理要求取决于门的制造商及构造。Hume 提供门产品的保养与涂装说明；应查阅自己所用产品的资料，确认允许的调整方式及新露出门边的保护要求。先辨认门的类型再约定施工，不能把同一种修边余量用于所有门扇。

a903162e001def9401aa.en: Hume Doors: product care and finishing support
a903162e001def9401aa.zh: Hume 门：产品保养和收尾处理支持

aec8a9b770d6162ca855.en: The jamb is the side of the frame where the hinge or closing edge sits. The architrave is the trim covering the junction between frame and wall. A split in the jamb around a hinge affects the fixing point; a mark on the architrave may only affect the finish. Tell the assessor which part is damaged, or send a whole-opening photo if the names are unfamiliar.
aec8a9b770d6162ca855.zh: 门框侧边是安装铰链或与门扇闭合边接触的部位；门窗套线则遮盖门框与墙面的接缝。铰链附近的门框开裂会影响固定，套线上的划痕可能只影响饰面。请说明损坏部位；不熟悉部件名称时，提供整个门洞的照片也有帮助。

7b20e8ab49bf656ea3d4.en: Note whether the top corner drops, one edge rubs throughout closing, or the leaf swings freely but the latch misses. A door that closes without latching needs an alignment and hardware check, rather than automatic edge removal. Several changing gaps, a soft lower jamb or fresh wall cracks deserve a wider assessment. Do not push, lift or slam the leaf to demonstrate the problem.
7b20e8ab49bf656ea3d4.zh: 留意门扇上角是否下垂、关门时某一边是否持续摩擦，或门扇能自由转动但门闩无法对准。门能关上却闩不住，应先检查对位与五金，而不是直接削边。如果多处间隙都在变化、门框下部松软或墙面新出现裂缝，应扩大检查范围。请勿推、抬或猛关门来演示问题。

84d94385f0324dcfc366.en: From the usual standing position, photograph the full opening, the rubbing location and any existing broken coating. Include both sides if they are safely accessible. Mention an exposed entry, a recently repaired leak, new flooring or a previous adjustment. There is no need to scrape paint, probe soft timber or remove a hinge to make the enquiry useful.
84d94385f0324dcfc366.zh: 可在平常站立的位置拍摄整个门洞、摩擦部位和已有的涂层破损；能够安全拍到时，再提供两侧照片。请说明入户门是否受日晒雨淋、近期是否处理过漏水，以及是否新铺地板或调整过门。咨询前不需要刮漆、探查松软木材或拆卸铰链。

eb63dd744c6adde8f672.en: Keep a reliable way in and out of the home. If the door is jammed or cannot secure the property, explain that when contacting the team so the appropriate response can be discussed. A heavy leaf, glazed panel or unsupported hinge can create a handling hazard. Locks, glass and identified fire-rated doors need their relevant specialist pathway and product requirements.
eb63dd744c6adde8f672.zh: 请确保家中仍有可靠的进出通道。如果门卡死或无法保障房屋关闭安全，联系团队时应说明，以便讨论处理安排。沉重门扇、玻璃面板或缺乏支撑的铰链可能带来搬动风险；锁具、玻璃和有明确防火等级的门，须按相应专业要求及产品规定处理。

1e508d28b2f7aa30b13f.en: Adjustment may suit a sound door and frame once the cause is known. A loose hinge needs firm timber at its screws before the door can be aligned. If a jamb section is decayed, local replacement may keep the rest of the opening; damage continuing through connected joints can require a larger repair.
1e508d28b2f7aa30b13f.zh: 原因明确且门扇、门框仍完好时，可以考虑调整。松动铰链的螺丝必须有坚实木材固定，之后才能校正门扇。门框某段腐朽时，局部更换可能保留其余部分；如果损坏已延伸到相连接头，则可能需要扩大维修。

f9d39d4c52c8302cc0fd.en: Trimming is a material change, not a diagnostic test. A leaf that is trimmed while wet may have an excessive gap later, and construction can limit what can be removed. Not every internal door has the same edge allowance. The proposal should identify the door type, permitted adjustment and protection of newly exposed edges, rather than applying one cutting rule to every leaf.
f9d39d4c52c8302cc0fd.zh: 削边会实际改变门扇，不应用来试探故障原因。木门受潮时削掉的材料，在干燥后可能留下过大间隙；门的构造也会限制可去除的部分。不同内门的修边余量并不相同，方案应写明门的类型、允许的调整和新露出边缘的保护方式。

62a168cef51d8d0c04c1.en: If moisture reaches the lower jamb or leaf, replacing a damaged piece alone leaves a separate question about the source. Discuss weather exposure, surrounding junctions and any known leak with the assessor. A coating helps protect suitable timber, but paint is not evidence that the material beneath it is sound. Repeated damage after a patch warrants another look at the cause.
62a168cef51d8d0c04c1.zh: 如果门框下部或门扇持续受潮，只更换受损木材并没有解决进水原因。应与查看人员说明日晒雨淋、周边接缝和已知漏水情况。涂层有助于保护合适的木材，但油漆完好不能证明内部木材完好；补修后再次损坏，应重新检查原因。

2558ae0abd81d0d155e5.en: Confirm whether the work includes preparation, priming, painting or staining of the adjusted area, and whether adjoining surfaces are included. A local finish can be visible beside older paint. Our guide to
2558ae0abd81d0d155e5.zh: 确认工作是否包括调整区域的准备、底漆、涂漆或染色，以及是否包括相邻表面。在旧油漆旁边可以看到局部饰面。我们的指南

47fc66e2765a09f20514.en: explains why the repair boundary and the moisture route belong in the same conversation.
47fc66e2765a09f20514.zh: 解释了为什么修复边界和湿气路径属于同一对话。

05a088d34d3002a39c2a.en: Send your suburb, the door location, the closing symptom and its timing. Add safe overview and detail photos if convenient, plus any product label or previous repair record already available. Tell the team whether it is the main access door and whether pets, tenants or restricted entry affect the visit. Do not remove the door to obtain measurements.
05a088d34d3002a39c2a.zh: 请提供所在城区、门的位置、关门问题和出现时间。方便时可附安全拍摄的整体及细节照片，以及已有的产品标签或维修记录。请说明是否为主要进出门，宠物、租户或进场限制是否影响上门安排。不要为获取尺寸而自行拆门。

d92a4f634ca4b4afb850.en: Ask the quote to distinguish alignment, timber replacement, door or hardware supply and edge finishing. A large or glazed door also needs suitable handling and any required glazing input. Start with
d92a4f634ca4b4afb850.zh: 询问报价以区分对齐、木材更换、门或硬件供应以及边缘处理。大门或玻璃门还需要适当的处理和任何所需的玻璃输入。开始于

e885d6b87f173628e653.en: and establish the cause before accepting a trimming-only proposal, then agree the closing and latch operation the repair should restore.
e885d6b87f173628e653.zh: 并在接受仅修整建议之前确定原因，然后同意维修应恢复的关闭和闩锁操作。

c5d499f0ba6cc4058977.en: Will the door free up when the weather dries?
c5d499f0ba6cc4058977.zh: 天气干燥时门会打开吗？

cdd6e3ea9c13ad6d4045.en: It may if seasonal timber movement is the cause. Repeated rubbing, water damage or an unreliable latch still warrants assessment; drying does not repair soft timber or loose hinge fixings.
cdd6e3ea9c13ad6d4045.zh: 如果季节性木材伸缩变形是原因，则可能是这样。反复摩擦、水渍或不可靠的闩锁仍然需要评估；干燥不能修复软木材或松动的铰链固定件。

d9079f026fd82ce9a55a.en: Should I sand the edge that catches?
d9079f026fd82ce9a55a.zh: 我应该打磨卡住的边缘吗？

9165764d8076e3912592.en: First establish the cause, door construction and permitted adjustment. Sanding or planing can remove useful material and coatings without correcting a moving hinge or frame.
9165764d8076e3912592.zh: 首先确定原因、门结构和允许的调整。打磨或刨削可以去除有用的材料和涂层，而无需校正移动的铰链或框架。

9248dfbeabe132b08f8e.en: Why does a timber door stick after wet weather?
9248dfbeabe132b08f8e.zh: 为什么木门在潮湿的天气后会卡住？

a9a75e214df547886775.en: Moisture changes can affect door and frame dimensions. Ellis checks clearance, hinges, exposed edges and water entry before specifying adjustment or timber repair.
a9a75e214df547886775.zh: 湿度变化会影响门和框架尺寸。 Ellis 在指定调整或木材修复之前检查间隙、铰链、暴露边缘和进水情况。

f7e73a64e2f458578868.en: Why will a door close but not latch?
f7e73a64e2f458578868.zh: 为什么门会关上但不会闩锁？

22d9464e88437efe733e.en: The latch and strike can become misaligned through hinge movement, frame movement or reduced clearance. We inspect the complete opening and repair the cause before setting the final latch alignment.
22d9464e88437efe733e.zh: 闩锁和锁扣可能会因铰链移动、框架移动或间隙减小而错位。在设置最终的闩锁对齐之前，我们会检查整个开口并修复原因。

f05d01726d543baa0a68.en: What is the difference between a door jamb and an architrave?
f05d01726d543baa0a68.zh: 门框和门窗套线有什么区别？

665e2ca36d2a2bb10f2c.en: The jamb forms the side of the door frame and supports hardware or the closing edge. An architrave is the trim around the opening. We check both when damage extends beyond the visible finish.
665e2ca36d2a2bb10f2c.zh: 侧柱形成门框的侧面并支撑硬件或关闭边缘。门窗套线是开口周围的装饰。当损坏超出可见饰面范围时，我们会检查两者。

30824b5a6d994228dc86.en: Timber door and frame repairs for scraping, poor latching, loose hinges and damaged jambs. The opening is checked before adjustment or replacement is specified.
30824b5a6d994228dc86.zh: 维修木门摩擦、门闩对位不良、铰链松动和门框损坏等问题。确定调整或更换方案前，先检查整个门洞及相关部件。

cbec402c55172a838e77.zh: 腐烂的木窗台可以修复吗？ ↗
