7fcc27015e6b62b3b2fb.zh: 木材与复合材料露台板：比较什么 | Ellis Services Group

b7c3084d17e67da60641.en: Compare timber and composite decking: care, surface heat, product instructions and quote inclusions, with site needs considered.
b7c3084d17e67da60641.zh: 比较木材和复合材料露台板：护理、表面热量、产品说明和报价内容，并考虑现场需求。

681b09e13df2607856bf.en: Mitchell: subframe construction and composite board fitting
681b09e13df2607856bf.zh: Mitchell：露台支撑龙骨结构和复合板安装

0a4630d7005a6bf77c23.en: At Mitchell in August 2025, the Ellis carpentry team carried out site levelling, subframe construction and WPC board installation. The photographs show the frame, board fitting and completed edges. This example helps identify the construction items to compare alongside the chosen board product.
0a4630d7005a6bf77c23.zh: 2025 年 8 月 Mitchell，Ellis 木工队进行了场地平整、副架施工和 WPC 板安装。照片显示了框架、板件和完成的边缘。此示例有助于识别要与所选板材产品进行比较的建筑项目。

b1f1dd3a285d33408c27.en: The first supplied photograph shows the frame already in place, followed by board fitting and completed details. Confirm the exact board system, supply responsibilities and site requirements for your own proposal.
b1f1dd3a285d33408c27.zh: 第一张提供的照片显示框架已经就位，然后是板安装和完成的细节。确认您自己的提案的确切露台板制度、供应责任和场地要求。

2925dd7a77f1685948da.en: See the Mitchell composite deck stages and recorded scope
2925dd7a77f1685948da.zh: 请参阅 Mitchell 复合材料露台阶段和记录范围

f1cbc77880933b9788d6.en: Confirmed Ellis project: the completed composite deck in Mitchell, August 2025. This photograph shows the installed surface; it is not a performance comparison between materials.
f1cbc77880933b9788d6.zh: 已确认 Ellis 项目：2025 年 8 月 Mitchell 完成的复合材料露台。这张照片显示了安装的表面；这不是材料之间的性能比较。

86315c995cd8dce84b2d.en: Compare the boards, supports and complete deck
86315c995cd8dce84b2d.zh: 比较木板、支撑物和完整的露台

e9dec7ef9db128dccd7f.en: Think about sun, colour and everyday use
e9dec7ef9db128dccd7f.zh: 考虑阳光、颜色和日常使用

9bdcf65a42d27fae1265.en: Check whether existing framing can support new boards
9bdcf65a42d27fae1265.zh: 检查现有框架是否可以支持新板

a375ae2f84ffced17c5e.en: Edges, stairs and connections are part of the material choice
a375ae2f84ffced17c5e.zh: 边缘、楼梯和连接是材料选择的一部分

6fe764e2ebd500166012.en: Compare supply, construction and finish together
6fe764e2ebd500166012.zh: 一起比较供应、施工和完成

3b2cab951c19cef4dd2d.en: Keep product records and project responsibilities clear
3b2cab951c19cef4dd2d.zh: 保持产品记录和项目职责清晰

96ffbd1253ebeebee0e9.en: Confirm the decking product before ordering
96ffbd1253ebeebee0e9.zh: 订购前确认露台板产品

faff5fd8bd6c86efab2d.en: Compare a complete deck: the board product, supports, fixings and finished edges. Timber species and composite ranges differ, so a colour sample alone cannot settle the choice. Start with whether the project is a new build, extension or replacement surface, then consider exposure, everyday use and the care you are prepared to carry out.
faff5fd8bd6c86efab2d.zh: 比较完整的露台：板产品、支撑、固定件和成品边缘。木材种类和复合材料范围不同，因此仅凭颜色样本无法确定选择。首先考虑该项目是否是新建、扩建或更换表面，然后考虑暴露、日常使用以及您准备进行的护理。

fe1b4f907e10b084d0c3.en: For timber, identify the species, board dimensions and coating proposal. For composite, identify the manufacturer, range, board system and associated fixing and edge components. Ask who supplies each item and which instructions apply. Ellis Services Group’s carpentry team installs composite decking. Confirm the product and site arrangement in the accepted proposal, which needs to specify the actual system.
fe1b4f907e10b084d0c3.zh: 对于木材，确定树种、板材尺寸和涂层建议。对于复合材料，请确定制造商、系列、板材系统以及相关的固定和边缘组件。询问每件物品的供应商以及适用的说明。 Ellis Services Group 的木工团队安装复合材料露台板。确认已受理的提案中的产品和场地布置，需要具体说明实际系统。

b8f80deadbb48eec0d46.en: Timber appearance and care depend on the selected finish and exposure. Composite also has cleaning and care requirements. ModWood publishes different care documents for its products, so use the document for the proposed range rather than assuming one method fits all composite boards. “Low maintenance” still needs a practical explanation of cleaning, stains and the owner’s responsibilities.
b8f80deadbb48eec0d46.zh: 木材外观和护理取决于所选的饰面和暴露。复合材料也有清洁和护理要求。 ModWood 为其产品发布了不同的护理文档，因此请使用建议范围内的文档，而不是假设一种方法适合所有复合板。 “低维护”仍然需要对清洁、污渍和业主的责任进行实际解释。

f1722260c1f622ada204.en: Ask what routine care is expected, which products are compatible and what records should be kept. If a proposal compares lifetime costs, check the assumptions about future cleaning, recoating, repairs and replacement. No material is universally cheaper over its life. Your priorities may include preserving a timber appearance, reducing coating work or matching an existing area; describe them before choosing a product.
f1722260c1f622ada204.zh: 询问需要进行哪些常规护理、哪些产品兼容以及应保留哪些记录。如果提案比较生命周期成本，请检查有关未来清洁、重涂、维修和更换的假设。没有一种材料在其使用寿命期间普遍更便宜。您的优先事项可能包括保留木材外观、减少涂层工作或匹配现有区域；在选择产品之前先描述一下它们。

770b15f32b7e06a2bfd4.en: ModWood: installation and product care documents

1f2a87123b17513e25ff.en: An exposed deck and a shaded area have different use conditions. Ask the supplier about the exact range and colour under the expected exposure, particularly where barefoot use matters. Trex qualifies its heat-mitigating products: they can still become hot in sustained direct sun and high temperatures. That is not a universal measured temperature comparison between all timber and composite products.
1f2a87123b17513e25ff.zh: 暴露露台和阴影区域有不同的使用条件。向供应商询问预期暴露下的确切范围和颜色，特别是在赤脚使用很重要的情况下。 Trex 对其散热产品进行了鉴定：在持续的阳光直射和高温下，它们仍然会变热。这并不是所有木材和复合材料产品之间通用的测量温度比较。

772401f05e2dfd4a1e87.en: A sample can show texture and colour but cannot reproduce every season or outdoor condition. Discuss shade, intended furniture, pets and how the space will be used. If the proposal includes slip or fire-performance claims, ask for the current product-specific evidence and its relevant installation conditions. A board category alone should not be treated as proof of suitability for every location.
772401f05e2dfd4a1e87.zh: 样品可以显示纹理和颜色，但无法再现每个季节或室外条件。讨论遮阳、预期的家具、宠物以及空间的使用方式。如果提案包含滑移或防火性能声明，请索取当前产品特定的证据及其相关安装条件。单独的露台板类别不应被视为适合每个位置的证明。

2fdd83cfbe5a6846cb1c.en: Trex: composite decking and hot weather qualifications
2fdd83cfbe5a6846cb1c.zh: Trex：复合材料露台板和炎热天气资格

09e0b2bf25e7f7bd5c61.en: Changing boards does not establish that old supports can be reused. The joists, bearers, posts and connections need assessment, and the proposed system’s support and fixing requirements need checking. Old fixing positions or a familiar board width are not enough to confirm compatibility. Ask how retained framing will suit the selected board system and what work is allowed for if it does not.
09e0b2bf25e7f7bd5c61.zh: 更换板并不意味着旧支架可以重复使用。托梁、承载件、柱子和连接件需要评估，拟议系统的支撑和固定要求需要检查。旧的固定位置或熟悉的板宽度不足以确认兼容性。询问保留框架如何适合所选的露台板系统，如果不适合，可以进行哪些工作。

e0d69740544422801165.en: Use the technical documents for the selected manufacturer and range to check support spacing, fixing methods and edge details. The linked ModWood directory is one example, not identification of the boards at your property. Resolve damaged supports before choosing a surface conversion; the
e0d69740544422801165.zh: 使用所选制造商和系列的技术文件来检查支撑间距、固定方法和边缘细节。链接的 ModWood 目录只是一个示例，而不是您财产中木板的标识。在选择表面转换之前解决损坏的支撑；的

0a09fc6cd6222a3dd711.zh: 解释了需要检查的内容。

9bc716fec335e09d05f4.en: The visible walking surface meets walls, thresholds, outer edges, steps and sometimes rails or screens. Those details need to work with the chosen product and layout. A material-only square-metre comparison can overlook components and labour at these junctions. Ask what the proposal includes for edge treatment and how it relates to adjoining surfaces.
9bc716fec335e09d05f4.zh: 可见的行走表面与墙壁、门槛、外边缘、台阶、有时还有栏杆或围挡相交。这些细节需要与所选的产品和布局配合使用。仅对材料进行平方米比较可能会忽略这些连接处的组件和劳动力。询问提案中包括哪些边缘处理内容以及它与相邻表面的关系。

97619c7711ae973ddcc5.en: For an extension, consider the old and new areas together. A visual match may be limited by weathering, product changes or different board dimensions. For a rebuild, clarify whether the footprint and access arrangement stay the same. The
97619c7711ae973ddcc5.zh: 对于扩展，请同时考虑新旧区域。视觉匹配可能会受到风化、产品变化或不同板尺寸的限制。对于重建，请明确占地面积和通道安排是否保持不变。的

31f71fc6cdd9d9755118.en: helps separate those scope choices before the product is selected.
31f71fc6cdd9d9755118.zh: 有助于在选择产品之前区分这些范围选择。

e58f7c39f3bc997aa98a.en: Put the complete footprint, supports, boards, fixings, removal, access and finishing beside the price. Confirm who orders the product and whether delivery and disposal are included. Timber coating work and a composite system’s fitting components may appear in different parts of the proposal, so request an explanation rather than assuming one line item covers them all.
e58f7c39f3bc997aa98a.zh: 将完整的占地面积、支撑、板、固定件、拆卸、进出条件和收尾处理放在价格旁边。确认谁订购了该产品以及是否包括交付和处置。木材涂层工作和复合系统的配件可能会出现在提案的不同部分，因此请要求解释，而不是假设一个项目涵盖了所有这些。

05030563e9f63bc45806.en: Ground preparation, difficult entry and changes to stairs or barriers can influence the completed cost. Ask what is retained, what is replaced and how concealed findings affect the quote. Our
05030563e9f63bc45806.zh: 地面准备、进入困难以及楼梯或障碍物的改变可能会影响完成的成本。询问保留什么、替换什么以及隐藏的发现如何影响报价。我们的

d175d60281b602606b00.en: explains why a low board price cannot decide between two full installations. Compare the accepted scope and ongoing care obligations as well as the initial amount.
d175d60281b602606b00.zh: 解释了为什么低板价格无法在两个完整安装之间做出决定。比较接受的范围和持续护理义务以及初始金额。

1143543b5b20293bfc38.en: Ask for the current installation, care and warranty documents for the selected product. Read the warranty conditions and who provides it; a manufacturer’s document is not a blanket promise about every part of the installed deck. Confirm the agreed construction and supply responsibilities separately. Keep the quote, product identity and any variations together for future maintenance or repair enquiries.
1143543b5b20293bfc38.zh: 索取所选产品的当前安装、维护和保修文件。阅读保修条件以及提供者；制造商的文件并不是对已安装露台的每个部分的一揽子承诺。分别确认约定的施工和供应责任。将报价、产品标识和任何变体保存在一起，以便将来进行维护或维修咨询。

9a7ce6c34ba018f9dfca.en: The actual new build, extension or repair also needs its applicable project checks confirmed with the relevant professionals. Material selection alone does not resolve approvals or structural suitability. The Mitchell project record above demonstrates one installation sequence and recorded scope, not a guarantee that another site will use the same preparation, supports or products.
9a7ce6c34ba018f9dfca.zh: 实际的新建、扩建或维修还需要与相关专业人员确认其适用的项目检查。仅材料选择并不能解决批准或结构适用性的问题。上面的 Mitchell 项目记录展示了一个安装顺序和记录的范围，并不保证另一个站点将使用相同的准备、支持或产品。

a12a960c978183dbe79d.en: Send your suburb, intended use, approximate layout if known and whether an existing deck is involved. Include available plans and product preferences, plus the care commitment you want to discuss. Optional safe photographs can show the area and access. Do not enter an unsafe deck space to supply measurements or an underside view.
a12a960c978183dbe79d.zh: 发送您的郊区、预期用途、大致布局（如果已知）以及是否涉及现有露台。包括可用的计划和产品偏好，以及您想要讨论的护理承诺。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以显示该区域和通道。请勿进入不安全的露台空间进行测量或底面视图。

185c343a404ce53b1d28.en: for WPC fitting. Before ordering, settle the exact board range, compatible fixings, support design and who supplies each item. Keep the product’s care instructions with the quote so future cleaning and repairs refer to the deck actually installed.
185c343a404ce53b1d28.zh: 用于 WPC 配件。订购之前，请确定确切的板卡范围、兼容的固定件、支持设计以及每个项目的供应商。保留产品的保养说明和报价，以便将来的清洁和维修参考实际安装的露台。

2c085afe07335ac74954.zh: 木材和复合材料产品规格

3cb59cbddde5f88367fd.en: Record the timber species, dimensions and finish.
3cb59cbddde5f88367fd.zh: 记录木材种类、尺寸和饰面。

e782e244d9abb1aaaf9e.en: Record the manufacturer, range and board system.
e782e244d9abb1aaaf9e.zh: 记录制造商、范围和板系统。

423e1c92d2a2e6a6465e.en: Check the selected coating and timber-care instructions.
423e1c92d2a2e6a6465e.zh: 检查所选涂层和木材护理说明。

e8c3bc0c8d34d51bb609.en: Check product-specific cleaning and care instructions; do not assume no maintenance.
e8c3bc0c8d34d51bb609.zh: 检查产品特定的清洁和保养说明；不要假设没有维护。

c13ddb16938d1f4ca118.en: Discuss the exposed location and intended use.
c13ddb16938d1f4ca118.zh: 讨论暴露位置和预期用途。

0aaa5ed72f183b1931d1.en: Check the exact range and heat qualifications; composite can still become hot.
0aaa5ed72f183b1931d1.zh: 检查准确的范围和热量资格；复合材料仍然会变热。

a73118083702f5d442b1.en: Assess supports and connections before retaining them.
a73118083702f5d442b1.zh: 在保留支撑和连接之前对其进行评估。

f6ec27a7dda7c2c28aa5.en: Assess supports and confirm compatibility with the specified board system.
f6ec27a7dda7c2c28aa5.zh: 评估支持并确认与指定板系统的兼容性。

6d9766f92abf1f58f694.en: Include supply, framing work, finishing and access.
6d9766f92abf1f58f694.zh: 包括供应、框架工作、装修和进入。

d2557b6e35267051f559.en: Include the complete specified system and installation arrangements.
d2557b6e35267051f559.zh: 包括完整的指定系统和安装安排。

50474e08ae63556f9e31.zh: 复合材料露台板免维护吗？

8017f69ee57cb4c3a70e.en: Do not assume that it is. Use the care instructions for the exact product, and keep cleaning requirements separate from assessment of supports and connections.
8017f69ee57cb4c3a70e.zh: 不要假设它是。使用具体产品的保养说明，并将清洁要求与支撑和连接的评估分开。

a475891206fe3042411e.en: Can composite boards be fitted to my existing timber frame?
a475891206fe3042411e.zh: 复合板可以安装到我现有的木框架上吗？

8cd850a920df22d16e74.en: That cannot be decided from the board type alone. The existing frame needs assessment and the proposed system’s support and fixing requirements need confirmation before retention is agreed.
8cd850a920df22d16e74.zh: 这不能仅从板类型来决定。在同意保留之前，需要确认现有框架需求评估以及拟议系统的支持和固定要求。

313dc9bb0e39707f431f.en: Does Ellis offer every decking material described here?
313dc9bb0e39707f431f.zh: Ellis 是否提供此处描述的所有装饰材料？

1dd90ba5a8c1061d8213.en: Ellis installs timber and composite decks. Ask about the exact board product you are considering and agree supply, compatible fixings and installation details before ordering.
1dd90ba5a8c1061d8213.zh: Ellis 安装木材和复合材料露台。订购前询问您正在考虑的具体板产品并同意供应、兼容固定件和安装详细信息。

becd04bd04303bb877b9.en: Plan a new timber deck or extension
becd04bd04303bb877b9.zh: 规划新的木露台或扩建部分

d8705c9f6aeaf6cdf35b.en: Assess an existing deck before changing boards
d8705c9f6aeaf6cdf35b.zh: 在更换板之前评估现有的套牌

a33bd040640343e6a8c4.en: Compare the inclusions in a carpentry quote
a33bd040640343e6a8c4.zh: 比较木工报价中的内容

710b54154cb7abd65aeb.en: Arrange an on-site measure to discuss the deck layout, board product and construction quote.
710b54154cb7abd65aeb.zh: 安排现场测量，讨论露台布局、板材产品和施工报价。

dc405947865acdcd56cc.en: Timber Deck Maintenance: Care or Repair? ↗
dc405947865acdcd56cc.zh: 木露台维护：保养还是修理？ ↗

6caae3672fba05eb7de5.zh: 外墙木挂板局部损坏可以单独更换吗？ | Ellis Services Group

dc3508076b7b02da2ddc.en: Local weatherboard replacement depends on the timber profile, overlap and condition behind the board. Learn what affects matching and repair extent.
dc3508076b7b02da2ddc.zh: 当地外墙木挂板的更换取决于木材轮廓、重叠和板后面的状况。了解影响匹配和修复程度的因素。

16f017b6e6499dfe4858.en: Painted weatherboards meeting a window sill and exterior trim
16f017b6e6499dfe4858.zh: 与窗台和外部装饰相接的涂漆外墙木挂板

553d7fe4203c7fef12c9.en: Illustrative detail: board laps and adjoining openings affect how a local replacement is scoped. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
553d7fe4203c7fef12c9.zh: 说明性细节：板圈和相邻开口会影响本地更换的范围。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

98cf2eb9b51ea1fef0cb.en: Check the cracked board and adjoining wall
98cf2eb9b51ea1fef0cb.zh: 检查破裂的木板和毗邻的墙壁

bca4048c3ed7112484f8.en: Matching the face also means matching the profile
bca4048c3ed7112484f8.zh: 外观匹配也需确认挂板截面造型

c288ead7e5e734ebfd7f.en: What the assessment may need to check behind the board
c288ead7e5e734ebfd7f.zh: 检查挂板背后可能涉及哪些部件

47446f74a3990edde870.en: Confirm the material before cutting or removing
47446f74a3990edde870.zh: 切割或移除前确认材料

3117333310c6b6930eef.en: Access and the finishing boundary can dominate a small repair
3117333310c6b6930eef.zh: 小型维修也需确认现场作业条件与饰面范围

2ef60c4c6a11b46cb875.en: Details to send about damaged weatherboards
2ef60c4c6a11b46cb875.zh: 发送有关损坏外墙木挂板的详细信息

659d6463f9eface94fc9.en: Individual timber weatherboards can sometimes be replaced where the adjoining boards and supports remain sound. The repair still needs to follow the board’s profile and overlap. A split end beneath a window or a stain that returns after rain also calls for checking the water route and backing; repainting the visible mark will not correct damage behind it.
659d6463f9eface94fc9.zh: 有时可以在相邻板和支撑保持完好的情况下更换单独的木质外墙木挂板。修复仍然需要遵循木板的轮廓和重叠。窗户下方的裂口或雨后再次出现的污渍也需要检查水路和支撑；重新粉刷可见标记并不能修复其后面的损坏。

9f39710ae592a09335de.en: Tell the team where the damage sits: under a window, near a corner, beside a downpipe or across an exposed wall. Note any known leak and earlier patch. Do not pull a board away to see behind it. Photos from accessible ground can show the pattern; inspection access and material identification should be agreed before the wall is disturbed.
9f39710ae592a09335de.zh: 告诉团队损坏的位置：窗户下面、角落附近、落水管旁边或裸露的墙壁上。注意任何已知的泄漏和早期补丁。不要拉开一块板来查看其后面。从可到达的地面拍摄的照片可以显示这种模式；在扰动墙壁之前，应就检查通道和材料标识达成一致。

7b67284dd0a261079c6f.en: Weatherboards overlap to form the wall’s outer layer. Thickness, shaped profile, exposed face and junction details affect how a replacement meets retained boards. A similar colour or nominal width is not enough to establish compatibility. Ask how the proposed board relates to the existing lap, corners and openings, particularly where the original profile is no longer readily available.
7b67284dd0a261079c6f.zh: 外墙木挂板重叠形成墙的外层。厚度、形状轮廓、暴露面和连接细节会影响更换件与保留板的接触方式。相似的颜色或标称宽度不足以建立兼容性。询问拟议的板与现有的搭接部、拐角和开口有何关系，特别是在原始轮廓不再可用的情况下。

e021e5e7af619b0a9b12.en: A sample or measured profile may be needed before supply. Local replacement can preserve useful cladding but may show a colour or texture difference after finishing. A longer section can sometimes create a more workable junction or finish. The reason should be explained in the proposal rather than assuming that every cracked end requires replacing the whole wall.
e021e5e7af619b0a9b12.zh: 供应前可能需要样品或测量的轮廓。局部更换可以保留有用的包层，但在完成后可能会出现颜色或纹理差异。较长的部分有时可以创建更可行的连接或饰面。提案中应解释原因，而不是假设每个开裂的一端都需要更换整面墙。

20605206482f48348a34.en: When a board is removed, the material holding its fixings and the adjoining framing can be checked where accessible. A new face board needs sound support and a working drainage detail. Before removal, establish what can already be inspected and how further damage will be recorded and quoted if it becomes visible.
20605206482f48348a34.zh: 当一块板被拆除时，可以在可触及的地方检查固定其固定件和相邻框架的材料。新的面板需要良好的支撑和有效的排水细节。在拆除之前，确定哪些内容已经可以检查，以及如果发现进一步的损坏，将如何记录和报价。

374e44fe5b5472caa0b0.en: If the damaged area is next to a window, coordinate the two scopes rather than treating the junction as somebody else’s problem. The
374e44fe5b5472caa0b0.zh: 如果受损区域靠近窗户，请协调两个瞄准镜，而不是将连接处视为其他人的问题。的

37af12ae7c660be2c976.en: explains why the opening and its drainage details matter. Roof leaks, glazing, electrical items or structural damage require their relevant professional input before timber reinstatement proceeds.
37af12ae7c660be2c976.zh: 解释了为什么开口及其排水细节很重要。屋顶漏水、玻璃、电气或结构损坏需要相关的专业意见，然后才能进行木材修复。

085fdb7d35ff5fc7bbf0.en: This guide concerns timber weatherboards. Fibre-cement, metal and composite systems can have different details and are not automatically covered by a timber-repair proposal. Older or unknown sheet materials behind or beside the affected section need identification before disturbance. A painted surface cannot establish that an unknown product is safe to cut or discard.
085fdb7d35ff5fc7bbf0.zh: 本指南涉及外墙木挂板。纤维水泥、金属和复合材料系统可能有不同的细节，并且不会自动包含在木材修复建议中。受影响部分后面或旁边的较旧或未知的片状材料需要在拆动之前进行识别。涂漆表面无法证明未知产品可以安全切割或丢弃。

08b344124a1c8477f539.en: Where asbestos is suspected, use the qualified assessment pathway and do not take a sample yourself. ACT guidance warns that disturbing asbestos-containing material, including with cutting and sanding tools, can release fibres. Tell the team about existing material reports or property restrictions. Keep this assessment dependency visible in the scope rather than treating all removed cladding as ordinary timber waste.
08b344124a1c8477f539.zh: 如果怀疑存在石棉，请使用合格的评估途径，不要自行取样。 ACT 指南警告称，令人不安的含石棉材料（包括使用切割和打磨工具）可能会释放纤维。告诉团队现有的材料报告或财产限制。保持这种评估依赖性在范围内可见，而不是将所有拆除的覆层视为普通木材废物。

f0dc82f98f59a109e639.en: A short board high on a wall can involve more access setup than several low boards in an open area. Mention narrow side access, planting, neighbouring property restrictions and services on the wall. The repair method also needs to protect adjoining boards and openings. Do not climb or reach past an unstable surface to provide a close-up.
f0dc82f98f59a109e639.zh: 墙上高的短板可能比开放区域中的几块低板涉及更多的进出条件设置。提及狭窄的侧面通道、种植、邻近财产限制和墙上的服务。修复方法还需要保护相邻的木板和开口。请勿攀爬或越过不稳定的表面来拍摄特写。

c5ca5f3c8d1b2c269b42.en: Ask whether the quote includes removal, disposal, preparation, priming and final painting. Agree whether finishing covers the new boards, a wall section or the full elevation. New paint on old cladding may remain visible, and an exact aged match cannot be assumed. Comparing only the board length overlooks the access and decoration that define the completed result.
c5ca5f3c8d1b2c269b42.zh: 询问报价是否包括拆卸、处置、准备、底漆和最终喷漆。商定饰面是否覆盖新板、墙体部分或整个立面。旧包层上的新油漆可能仍然可见，并且不能假设与旧的完全匹配。仅比较板长度会忽略定义完成结果的通道和装饰。

6eba04dfae3bccd669ab.en: , include your suburb, wall location, approximate affected area if known and any water history. Optional safe overview and detail photos help explain the profile and nearby openings. Existing material records and earlier repair scopes are helpful; a clear description is enough if photographs are not safe.
6eba04dfae3bccd669ab.zh: ，包括您的郊区、围墙位置、大致受影响区域（如果已知）以及任何用水历史。可选的安全概览和细节照片有助于解释轮廓和附近的开口。现有的材料记录和早期的维修范围很有帮助；如果照片不安全，清晰的描述就足够了。

d9f24c277ff2d0e7f0c4.en: Discuss which lengths can stay, how corners and window junctions will be matched, and where painting should stop. If an earlier patch has failed again, read
d9f24c277ff2d0e7f0c4.zh: 讨论可以保留哪些长度，如何匹配角落和窗户连接处，以及应该在哪里停止绘画。如果早期的补丁再次失败，请阅读

82fb25762b2d65f3929c.en: . Keep water-source work and the replacement board in the same repair plan so a newly painted face does not conceal the unresolved fault.
82fb25762b2d65f3929c.zh: 。将水源工作和更换板保持在同一维修计划中，这样新涂漆的表面就不会掩盖未解决的故障。

6caf6c2edfd5bffde0fe.en: Can I match a board using only its face width?
6caf6c2edfd5bffde0fe.zh: 我可以仅使用板面宽度来匹配板吗？

8253106607d72bbf682f.en: No. Thickness, edge profile and overlap also determine how it joins the wall. Measure the existing profile and confirm the proposed material.
8253106607d72bbf682f.zh: 否。厚度、边缘轮廓和重叠也决定了它如何连接墙壁。测量现有轮廓并确认建议的材料。

1971759750473b742361.en: Does one cracked board mean the entire wall needs replacing?
1971759750473b742361.zh: 一块板破裂是否意味着整面墙需要更换？

496148a23acde3bebb2e.en: Not automatically. The damage pattern, adjoining boards, backing and water entry determine whether a local repair is suitable.
496148a23acde3bebb2e.zh: 不会自动。损坏模式、相邻板、背衬和进水情况决定了是否适合进行局部修复。

2b4d89a9318fe9a5c535.en: Timber weatherboard repairs for split, softened or weathered boards. Replacement lengths follow the existing profile, laps, backing and water path.
2b4d89a9318fe9a5c535.zh: 维修开裂、松软或风化的外墙木挂板。更换时需结合原板截面、搭接方式、背后支撑与排水路径。

a7cc81a3a672ada4be81.en: Fascia, bargeboard and eaves: what is the difference? ↗
a7cc81a3a672ada4be81.zh: 檐口封板、山墙封边板和檐底有什么区别？ ↗

6c474f746a0acaf5ada0.en: Sagging Timber Gates | Ellis Services Group
6c474f746a0acaf5ada0.zh: 为什么木院门会下垂或停止锁定？ | Ellis Services Group

c0b70abd4a0227ddca25.en: Understand how posts, hinges, a gate frame and ground clearance affect sagging. Identify useful observations before a timber gate repair assessment.
c0b70abd4a0227ddca25.zh: 了解门柱、铰链、门框和离地间隙如何影响下垂。在木院门修复评估之前确定有用的观察结果。

51475c9a91eb47ecd66b.en: Timber gate hinge, latch and adjoining support post
51475c9a91eb47ecd66b.zh: 木院门铰链、门闩和相邻支撑柱

d23fe40cbf473fcacbdb.en: Illustrative detail: hinges, latch alignment and the support post are checked as one gate assembly. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
d23fe40cbf473fcacbdb.zh: 说明性细节：铰链、闩锁对齐和支撑柱作为一个门组件进行检查。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

f9ea5fef623965a5d00d.en: A latch problem can begin at the post
f9ea5fef623965a5d00d.zh: 门闩问题也可能来自立柱位移

4ed2d5a09916ad9cd9d8.en: Loose hinges need a suitable fixing point
4ed2d5a09916ad9cd9d8.zh: 松动的铰链需要合适的固定点

d70bef2817de93cf0b6b.en: Dragging can follow rain or a change in the ground
d70bef2817de93cf0b6b.zh: 下雨或地面变化后可能会拖动

1e2edf589796c0f7a886.en: Compare retaining the leaf with replacing the assembly
1e2edf589796c0f7a886.zh: 比较保留门扇与更换组件

79d2690be0dd7a050166.en: Agree access and who supplies the gate hardware
79d2690be0dd7a050166.zh: 同意进出条件以及谁提供门硬件

08c1d76e8f0ffd7623af.en: Describe the movement, then arrange the repair assessment
08c1d76e8f0ffd7623af.zh: 说明松动情况，再安排现场检查

bf617eee85d567d4a1d9.en: A gate’s weight passes through its frame and hinges into the post. Loose hinge fixings, a distorted frame or a moving post can lower the latch side until it drags or misses the catch. Moving the latch may hide the symptom briefly. The repair needs to address the part that changed before final clearance and latch alignment are set.
bf617eee85d567d4a1d9.zh: 门的重量穿过其框架并铰入门柱。铰链固定件松动、框架扭曲或移动的柱子可能会降低闩锁侧，直至其拖拽或错过卡扣。移动闩锁可能会暂时隐藏该症状。维修需要解决在设置最终间隙和闩锁对齐之前发生更改的部分。

17478c4159b8397a3e67.en: Note whether the top and bottom gaps have changed, the latch side has dropped or the post appears out of line. These are observations rather than tests of strength. Do not hang on the leaf, lift it while swinging or push the post to see how far it moves. Keep clear if the gate looks unstable or could fall.
17478c4159b8397a3e67.zh: 注意顶部和底部间隙是否发生变化、闩锁侧是否下降或柱是否出现脱线。这些是观察而不是力量测试。不要挂在门扇上，在摆动时抬起它或推动柱子看看它移动了多远。如果院门看起来不稳定或可能掉落，请保持距离。

da3b4257d21bde3332f2.en: A hinge can be loose because its hardware is damaged or because the timber supporting the screws has split or deteriorated. Replacing screws does not establish that the remaining material can hold them. A post with a sound upper face can still have a problem at its base. Ask the assessment to distinguish hardware work from timber and support repair.
da3b4257d21bde3332f2.zh: 铰链可能会松动，因为其硬件损坏或支撑螺钉的木材已裂开或损坏。更换螺钉并不表明剩余材料可以固定它们。具有良好上表面的柱子在其底部仍然可能存在问题。要求评估人员区分硬件工作和木材工作并支持维修。

d2e47bf639adeee7e375.en: A sound gate frame can sometimes stay while its hinges or post are repaired. A badly distorted frame or decayed fixing timber may need more extensive replacement. New hardware must suit the gate’s weight, dimensions and connection points; fitting a new leaf to a failing post can repeat the original fault.
d2e47bf639adeee7e375.zh: 声门框架有时会在其铰链或柱子被修理时留下来。严重扭曲的框架或腐烂的固定木材可能需要更广泛的更换。新硬件必须适合院门的重量、尺寸和连接点；将新的门扇安装到故障柱上可能会重复原来的故障。

9da0bf12a010cad255ff.en: A gate that drags throughout its swing presents a different pattern from one that catches on a newly raised paving edge. Wet-weather timber movement, soil buildup or a changed ground level can also reduce clearance. Record when it happens and whether the gate becomes easier to use in dry conditions. Avoid forcing it across the obstruction to demonstrate the problem.
9da0bf12a010cad255ff.zh: 在整个摆动过程中拖动的门呈现出与卡在新凸起的铺路边缘上的门不同的图案。潮湿天气下木材移动、土壤堆积或地面高度变化也会减少间隙。记录发生这种情况的时间以及门在干燥条件下是否变得更容易使用。避免强行穿过障碍物来展示问题。

a43366c55fad3cb5d7a6.en: Cutting the lower edge before checking alignment can leave an unnecessary gap while the leaf continues to sag. Agree the intended swing, clearance and latch operation together. If the gate supports a particular access or safety function, explain that use before alterations are proposed. Pool barriers, powered gate equipment and access-control systems need their relevant specialist requirements assessed separately.
a43366c55fad3cb5d7a6.zh: 在检查对齐之前切割下边缘可能会在门扇继续下垂时留下不必要的间隙。就预期的摆动、间隙和闩锁操作达成一致。如果院门支持特定的访问或安全功能，请在建议更改之前解释其用途。泳池屏障、电动门设备和访问控制系统需要单独评估其相关的专业要求。

7a267ced73aa67e1b571.en: Retaining an otherwise suitable leaf can preserve a matching fence appearance. Its size, weight, condition and available hardware still need to suit the repaired supports. A new leaf fitted to a failing post may develop the same symptom. Conversely, replacing a post does not correct every distorted gate frame, so ask which part is driving the proposed scope.
7a267ced73aa67e1b571.zh: 保留原本合适的门扇可以保留匹配的栅栏外观。它的尺寸、重量、状况和可用硬件仍然需要适合修复后的支架。安装在失效柱上的新门扇可能会出现相同的症状。相反，更换柱子并不能纠正每个扭曲的门框，因此请询问哪个部分正在驱动建议的范围。

334af1d52a85d61474ff.en: When comparing options, include the post or footing work, leaf repair, hinges, latch, removal and finish. Discuss whether new timber will match the weathered fence closely enough for your needs. A changed opening width or design should be described explicitly. Read
334af1d52a85d61474ff.zh: 比较选项时，包括柱子或基础工作、门扇维修、铰链、闩锁、拆除和饰面。讨论新木材是否与风化的围栏足够接近以满足您的需求。应明确描述更改的开口宽度或设计。阅读

ac2bdc6ae8e44bcc98fe.en: if the supporting fence line is moving as well.
ac2bdc6ae8e44bcc98fe.zh: 如果支撑栅栏线也在移动。

50dfb4a42c51dd6d9033.en: A side gate may be the only route to a backyard. Mention pets, security, tenant access and anything that prevents the opening being unavailable during work. Confirm permission for access from either side and who needs to be present. Hardware supplied by the owner needs compatibility checked before installation is agreed; a similar-looking latch may not fit the existing arrangement.
50dfb4a42c51dd6d9033.zh: 侧门可能是通往后院的唯一路线。提及宠物、安全、租户通道以及任何妨碍工作期间开放的因素。确认任何一方的进出条件许可以及谁需要在场。业主提供的硬件在同意安装之前需要检查兼容性；外观相似的闩锁可能不适合现有的布置。

5acf995f567b3af229db.en: Ask whether priming, painting or staining the repaired areas is included and whether disposal covers the old post or leaf. Ground work and concealed findings can change the scope. Request the process for approving additional work before it begins, rather than treating a photograph as a final price for every part of the assembly.
5acf995f567b3af229db.zh: 询问修复区域是否包括底漆、油漆或染色，以及处理是否覆盖旧柱子或门扇。基础工作和隐藏的发现可能会改变范围。在开始之前请求批准额外工作的流程，而不是将照片视为装配每个部分的最终价格。

5a068b66e7e4c21ae092.en: Send your suburb, the gate location and whether it drags, misses the latch or has loose hinge fixings. Optional safe photos of the whole opening, the hinges and the post base are useful if they can be taken without moving the gate. Include any known change to paving, drainage or the adjoining fence.
5a068b66e7e4c21ae092.zh: 发送您所在的郊区、院门位置以及它是否拖拉、错过门闩或铰链紧固件是否松动。如果可以在不移动门的情况下拍摄整个开口、铰链和柱底座的可选在安全条件下拍摄的照片，则非常有用。包括对铺路、排水系统或毗邻围栏的任何已知更改。

05038c5d6a93c39d200b.en: , discuss the supports, full swing and latch operation together. If the lock or latch mechanism has failed, identify the appropriate locksmith or hardware work separately. The quote should state post and frame repairs, hinges, latch, disposal and finish so each option describes a complete working assembly.
05038c5d6a93c39d200b.zh: ，一起讨论支撑、全摆和闩锁操作。如果锁或闩锁机构发生故障，请单独确定适当的锁匠或硬件工作人员。报价应说明柱和框架的维修、铰链、闩锁、处置和表面处理，以便每个选项都描述一个完整的工作组件。

072aeff13ee7c86decc7.en: Can moving the latch fix a sagging gate?
072aeff13ee7c86decc7.zh: 移动门闩可以修复下垂的门吗？

e1efd9a39b909f09df06.en: It may allow temporary closure but will not restore a loose hinge fixing, distorted leaf or moving post. Identify the support problem before final latch alignment.
e1efd9a39b909f09df06.zh: 它可能允许暂时关闭，但不会恢复松动的铰链固定、扭曲的门扇或移动的柱子。在最终闩锁对齐之前确定支撑问题。

d0e6dc96ec5fc6379c3a.en: Does a timber gate repair include its motor?
d0e6dc96ec5fc6379c3a.zh: 木院门维修是否包括电机？

70b9d363a04bb083ca22.en: Powered drives and electrical or access-control faults need their relevant qualified service. Confirm the timber, hardware and powered-system responsibilities separately.
70b9d363a04bb083ca22.zh: 动力驱动器和电气或访问控制故障需要相关的合格服务。分别确认木材、硬件和动力系统的责任。

11b3aa59c2df31114374.en: Why does a timber gate sag?

29dce64cb04865b22006.en: A moving post, loose hinge fixings or a distorted gate frame can change the clearance and latch position. We repair or adjust the affected parts as an assembly and check operation at completion.
29dce64cb04865b22006.zh: 移动的柱子、松动的铰链固定件或扭曲的门框可能会改变间隙和闩锁位置。我们将受影响的部件作为一个组件进行修理或调整，并在完成后检查操作情况。

e945113d3d40fdb6e547.en: Timber gate repairs for dragging garden and side gates, loose hinges, damaged frames and moving posts. Alignment is checked across the complete gate assembly.
e945113d3d40fdb6e547.zh: 处理花园院门和侧院门拖地、铰链松动、门框损坏或立柱位移等问题。检查整个院门组件的对位情况后，再确定维修。

930c43d8eaad4bba1d90.en: Recurring Timber Rot | Ellis Services Group
930c43d8eaad4bba1d90.zh: 为什么木材修复后又会腐烂？ | Ellis Services Group

266f34c01fb69941479d.en: Recurring timber rot can point to continuing moisture, hidden decay or a poor junction. Learn what needs checking before another patch or paint finish.
266f34c01fb69941479d.zh: 反复出现的木材腐烂可能表明持续潮湿、隐藏的腐烂或连接不良。了解在进行另一次修补或涂漆之前需要检查哪些内容。

ca25550afa0a9658afc2.en: Deteriorated painted timber at a window sill and frame junction
ca25550afa0a9658afc2.zh: 窗台和框架连接处的油漆木材变质

4001de35392fcf3f3e4b.en: Illustrative detail: visible decay illustrates the need to investigate the water path as well as the affected timber. This existing service image is not a documented project record.
4001de35392fcf3f3e4b.zh: 说明性细节：可见的腐烂表明需要调查水路以及受影响的木材。此现有服务映像不是文档化的项目记录。

fbd6e59d84fda939f4ae.en: Find why the same timber keeps getting wet
fbd6e59d84fda939f4ae.zh: 找出为什么同一块木材总是变湿

e4d1b4c61927a30a6234.en: Weathering, decay and insect damage are different questions
e4d1b4c61927a30a6234.zh: 风化、腐烂和虫害是不同的问题

cc2457b0f06c74c26939.en: Look beyond the paint to the wetting route
cc2457b0f06c74c26939.zh: 超越油漆，关注进水路径

6af8f928b728ed042ec5.en: Why the retained timber matters as much as the new piece
6af8f928b728ed042ec5.zh: 为什么保留的木材与新木材一样重要

48940def7896b0d26b0f.en: Use the component’s own repair and finishing detail
48940def7896b0d26b0f.zh: 使用组件自己的修复和收尾处理细节

7b5334ec4407d850068c.en: Give the repair history and agree the next decision
7b5334ec4407d850068c.zh: 给出维修历史并同意下一步决定

088f9d18e11767abdf0e.en: Rot can return when water still reaches the timber, a joint traps moisture or decay extends beyond the earlier patch. Look at the repair history as well as the new damage: which pieces were replaced, which stayed, and whether a leak or drainage fault was corrected. Another surface patch will not resolve a continuing water source or damaged timber hidden beside it.
088f9d18e11767abdf0e.zh: 当水仍然到达木材时，腐烂可能会再次出现，接缝处会积聚水分，或者腐烂会延伸到先前的补丁之外。查看维修历史以及新的损坏：哪些部件被更换，哪些部件保留，以及泄漏或排水故障是否得到纠正。另一个表面补丁无法解决持续存在的水源或隐藏在其旁边的受损木材的问题。

5ec60432690208406dfc.en: Keep the earlier scope, photos and product information if available. A description such as “fixed and painted” may not distinguish timber replacement from filler and finish work. Note whether the same corner failed, a nearby section now looks affected or the defect followed a new leak. This history helps the assessor investigate the pattern without relying on guesswork.
5ec60432690208406dfc.zh: 保留早期的范围、照片和产品信息（如果有）。诸如“固定和涂漆”之类的描述可能无法区分木材更换与填料和饰面工作。注意是否是同一个角落发生了故障，附近的部分现在看起来受到了影响，或者缺陷是在新的泄漏之后发生的。这段历史有助于评估者调查模式，而无需依赖猜测。

15e50ad07267403031c6.en: A grey or worn surface describes appearance; it does not establish the condition of the timber below. Decay can affect material and connections, while insect damage has a separate cause and can occur alongside dampness. A photo is not a reliable way to identify all three. Report the existing symptom without scraping, probing or opening the structure yourself.
15e50ad07267403031c6.zh: 灰色或磨损的表面描述外观；它没有确定下面木材的状况。腐烂会影响材料和连接，而虫害则有单独的原因，并且可能与潮湿一起发生。照片并不是识别这三者的可靠方法。报告现有的症状，而无需自行刮擦、探测或打开结构。

73f1572d065e4261e2d0.en: If pest activity is suspected, arrange the qualified pest assessment and retain its findings. Treatment of active pests and reinstatement of damaged timber are separate work scopes. A treatment record does not certify that a bearer, jamb or other component remains structurally suitable. Supporting members need the appropriate structural assessment before a replacement plan is agreed.
73f1572d065e4261e2d0.zh: 如果怀疑有虫害活动，请安排合格的虫害评估并保留其结果。处理活跃害虫和恢复受损木材是不同的工作范围。处理记录并不能证明支架、门框或其他部件在结构上仍然合适。在同意更换计划之前，支持成员需要进行适当的结构评估。

fd6e054496b95483c1d0.en: Water reaches components in different ways. A fascia may be wetted by a leaking gutter, a sill by a failed opening detail, and a post by soil contact or irrigation. WoodSolutions’ moisture-affected timber resources support checking the exposure and condition together. Describe where and when water appears rather than asking for the same filler or coating at every location.
fd6e054496b95483c1d0.zh: 水以不同的方式到达组件。檐口封板可能因排水沟漏水而被弄湿，窗台可能因开口细节失效而被弄湿，柱子可能因土壤接触或灌溉而被弄湿。 WoodSolutions 受潮湿影响的木材资源支持同时检查暴露情况和状况。描述水出现的地点和时间，而不是要求每个位置都使用相同的填料或涂层。

2a42c65e40b383d87fb5.en: Identify which professional is responsible for the source and how that work coordinates with the timber repair. Roofing, plumbing or drainage defects may need their respective specialists. Avoid closing the repair up while the cause remains unresolved. An instruction to “seal everything” should be clarified against the component’s intended drainage and ventilation details.
2a42c65e40b383d87fb5.zh: 确定负责来源的专业人员以及该工作如何与木材修复相协调。屋顶、管道或排水缺陷可能需要各自的专家。避免在原因仍未解决时停止维修。应根据组件的预期排水和通风细节澄清“密封所有部件”的说明。

f3e8ab3b778c7ae33153.zh: WoodSolutions：有关受潮湿影响的木材的资源

7ad551264596be8ac358.en: A replacement section needs suitable retained material and connections. Damage extending behind paint or into a junction may make the repair larger than the visible soft spot. A local splice is considered where its boundary and connection can be justified; widespread or connected damage can require replacement of the full component or a wider assembly.
7ad551264596be8ac358.zh: 更换部分需要合适的保留材料和连接。损坏延伸到油漆后面或进入连接处可能会使修复范围大于可见的软点。在边界和连接合理的情况下考虑局部拼接；大范围或相关的损坏可能需要更换整个部件或更广泛的组件。

002dd25476347dd735aa.en: Filler can be part of a specified surface repair, but it cannot be assumed to restore every rotten timber member. The supporting role of the component matters. Do not cut away decay, remove a post or expose framing as a trial repair. Agree inspection access, any structural input and the response to further findings before disturbance.
002dd25476347dd735aa.zh: 填料可以是指定表面修复的一部分，但不能假设可以修复每个腐烂的木材构件。组件的支持作用很重要。请勿切除腐烂物、拆除柱子或暴露框架来进行试修。在拆动之前同意检查进出条件、任何结构输入以及对进一步调查结果的响应。

73649d1bb041b443bb67.en: For a window, profile and water shedding need consideration; at a fascia, the gutter and roof edge may influence access and recurrence. A deck repair needs boards and supporting components separated. Our
73649d1bb041b443bb67.zh: 对于窗户，需要考虑型材和防水；在檐口封板上，排水沟和屋顶边缘可能会影响进入和重复。露台维修需要将板和支撑部件分开。我们的

6a12020e89d7e9d0d912.en: explain these boundaries in their own settings.
6a12020e89d7e9d0d912.zh: 在他们自己的设置中解释这些边界。

434481cb97b1b4e4d7e7.en: Ask what material is proposed, how cut or exposed areas are protected and whether the quote includes final paint, stain or oil. Maintenance depends on the selected product and exposure. A new coating does not remove an ongoing leak or establish sound concealed timber. Keep the care instructions with the repair record so future changes can be described against the actual specification.
434481cb97b1b4e4d7e7.zh: 询问建议使用什么材料，如何保护切割或暴露区域以及报价是否包括最终油漆、污渍或油。维护取决于所选的产品和暴露程度。新涂层不能消除持续的泄漏或建立完好隐藏的木材。将保养说明与维修记录放在一起，以便可以根据实际规格描述未来的更改。

0b67498165b9313b1ecf.en: , send your suburb, the component, the repeated location and any known leak or pest findings. Optional safe overview and detail photos can explain the issue. Mention access restrictions and previous concealed findings. If a load-bearing member, deck, stair or overhead structure appears unstable, avoid the affected area while professional advice is arranged.
0b67498165b9313b1ecf.zh: ，发送您所在的郊区、组件、重复位置以及任何已知的泄漏或害虫发现结果。可选的安全概览和详细照片可以解释该问题。提及进出限制和之前隐藏的发现。如果承重构件、露台、楼梯或架空结构显得不稳定，请避开受影响的区域，同时安排专业建议。

315daf1a3a8845adab42.en: Compare the timber replacement, moisture-source work, access, removal and finish in the proposal. Ask which specialist checks are needed and how extra decay will be documented before more material is removed. Keep the repair and coating records: if damage returns, they help distinguish a new leak from a problem continuing at the original joint.
315daf1a3a8845adab42.zh: 比较提案中的木材更换、湿气源工作、通道、拆除和完成。询问需要哪些专家检查以及在移除更多材料之前如何记录额外的腐烂。保留维修和涂层记录：如果损坏再次出现，它们有助于区分新的泄漏和原始接头处持续存在的问题。

276f6e005dcbeee7b864.en: Will filler and paint prevent recurring rot?
276f6e005dcbeee7b864.zh: 填料和油漆能防止反复腐烂吗？

38518c07e85abcbea192.en: They do not remove a continuing moisture source or establish sound supporting timber. The component condition and water path determine the repair.
38518c07e85abcbea192.zh: 它们不会消除持续的湿气源或建立完好的支撑木材。部件状况和水路决定修复。

96c19647c709b19b95ae.en: What should I keep from an earlier repair?
96c19647c709b19b95ae.zh: 早期维修中我应该保留什么？

6b39eba45bbe924f2ffa.en: Keep the quote, photographs, material and coating details and any leak or pest reports. They help compare what was repaired with the location of new damage.
6b39eba45bbe924f2ffa.zh: 保留报价、照片、材料和涂层详细信息以及任何泄漏或害虫报告。它们有助于将修复的内容与新损坏的位置进行比较。

0c247c47ef8a383147dd.en: What is the difference between surface weathering and timber rot?
0c247c47ef8a383147dd.zh: 表面风化和木材腐烂有什么区别？

98dd268bc9b7fb5b44d1.en: Surface weathering affects the exposed finish or timber surface; decay can compromise the material and connections beneath it. Appearance alone does not establish soundness, so we inspect the affected section before quoting.
98dd268bc9b7fb5b44d1.zh: 表面风化影响裸露的饰面或木材表面；腐烂会损害其下面的材料和连接。仅凭外观并不能确定可靠性，因此我们在引用之前检查受影响的部分。

3b1fb847f19b78ed4f86.en: Why does repaired timber keep rotting?
3b1fb847f19b78ed4f86.zh: 为什么修复后的木材会不断腐烂？

20db544a5a6ac893c5b8.en: Persistent moisture or damage extending beyond an earlier patch can cause repeat deterioration. Our repair plan identifies the water path, removes affected material to suitable retained timber and defines the protective finish.
20db544a5a6ac893c5b8.zh: 持续的湿气或损坏超出了早期补丁的范围，可能会导致重复恶化。我们的修复计划确定了水路，将受影响的材料去除到合适的保留木材上，并确定了保护性饰面。

f1dae6722e03074f2cc3.en: How is suspected termite damage different from timber decay?
f1dae6722e03074f2cc3.zh: 疑似白蚁损害与木材腐烂有何不同？

fc24748534ea38637c7f.en: Decay and insect damage have different causes and can coexist. Ellis assesses the remaining timber and uses available pest findings to plan the repair; suspected active pest activity requires treatment before replacement is completed.
fc24748534ea38637c7f.zh: 腐烂和虫害有不同的原因，并且可以共存。 Ellis 评估剩余木材并使用可用的害虫调查结果来计划修复；怀疑活跃的害虫活动需要在更换完成之前进行处理。

830636875f9f5a3ccde0.en: How can I check the approval requirements for structural timber repairs in the ACT?
830636875f9f5a3ccde0.zh: 如何查看 ACT 中结构木材修复的批准要求？

da7cffc09df49c496dbd.en: The proposed work, supporting structure and site conditions determine the relevant ACT checks. Our assessment and work plan identify those requirements before structural timber is disturbed; unsafe affected areas should not be used while awaiting assessment.
da7cffc09df49c496dbd.zh: 拟议的工作、支撑结构和现场条件决定了相关的 ACT 检查。我们的评估和工作计划在结构木材受到拆动之前确定了这些要求；在等待评估期间，不应使用不安全的受影响区域。

a0c4e56d7bb7ac78f56f.en: Rotten timber repair depends on the damaged component and why it keeps getting wet. A local replacement needs sound adjoining timber; decay in a support needs structural assessment.
a0c4e56d7bb7ac78f56f.zh: 腐朽木材的维修范围取决于受损部件及持续受潮的原因。局部更换需要周边木材仍然完好；支撑部件腐朽则需要结构评估。
