No shared completion date, product specification or individual suburb is assigned across the collection.
97887be4317773808e00.zh: 每个示例都以不同的方式使用楼梯下方的空间。照片显示了一个带架子的高柜子、无把手的门布局、凹进的把手和拉手。整个系列中没有指定共享的完成日期、产品规格或单个郊区。

fefec5d73761983d02b4.zh: 规划收纳物品的取放方式

89165c2b28d9ef4001b3.en: Use the gallery to discuss access, appearance and storage layout. The measurements, components and fitting requirements for your own staircase are confirmed separately in the proposal.
89165c2b28d9ef4001b3.zh: 使用图库讨论通道、外观和收纳布局。您自己的楼梯的尺寸、组件和安装要求在提案中单独确认。

9af08d2cc0ed7c6ee67f.en: Tall open cupboard with shelves below a timber staircase
9af08d2cc0ed7c6ee67f.zh: 高大的开放式橱柜，木楼梯下方有架子

ec45f8593bebd46f15a7.zh: 成品收纳示例 - 开放式搁架。

2bae1bd64bc51e9b4bf0.en: White handleless cupboard fronts following the stair slope
2bae1bd64bc51e9b4bf0.zh: 楼梯斜坡后的白色无把手橱柜正面

f2ccf760bc0635180bfa.zh: 成品收纳示例 — 无把手面板。

a8545bc0741c7fcf71c1.zh: 成品收纳示例 - 嵌入式把手。

911d53b9f8e4442382c9.en: Under-stair cupboard fronts with tall pull handles
911d53b9f8e4442382c9.zh: 带高拉手的楼梯下橱柜正面

4b651162e41a03b589a7.zh: 成品收纳示例 - 拉手。

55a2aa1005045b8000d9.en: Built-in Wardrobes Canberra | Ellis Services Group
55a2aa1005045b8000d9.zh: 嵌入式衣柜安装 | Ellis Services Group

93f9ee16f090945e092f.en: Built-in wardrobe installation in Canberra. Ellis measures, assembles and fits selected storage products, with a photographed IKEA installation in Pearce.
93f9ee16f090945e092f.zh: 堪培拉的内置衣柜安装。 Ellis 测量、组装和安装选定的收纳产品，并在 Pearce 中拍摄 IKEA 安装。

40d27da3e8b82ae04fb2.en: Plan storage around what must fit
40d27da3e8b82ae04fb2.zh: 围绕必须适合的物品规划收纳

42405600e55fd6a383fc.en: Start with hanging space, folded items, drawers and shelf access. Describe the room, available wall and how the wardrobe will be used. Consider door and drawer travel, the bed, windows and existing trim. Hanging rails need enough height, drawers need space to open, and shelves must remain reachable once nearby furniture is in place.
42405600e55fd6a383fc.zh: 从悬挂空间、折叠物品、抽屉和架子通道开始。描述房间、可用的墙壁以及衣柜的使用方式。考虑门和抽屉的行程、床、窗户和现有的装饰。挂轨需要足够的高度，抽屉需要打开空间，并且一旦附近的家具就位，架子必须保持可触及的状态。

bfd0fda1f411772380a5.en: Measure the opening before ordering components
bfd0fda1f411772380a5.zh: 在订购组件之前测量开口

839b265a1b68fdb09749.en: An opening can vary in width from floor to ceiling. Skirting, uneven walls and the finished floor affect how units fit and how doors open. Ellis takes installation measurements and checks fixing surfaces before the product dimensions and edge details are agreed.
839b265a1b68fdb09749.zh: 开口的宽度从地板到天花板可能有所不同。踢脚线、不平坦的墙壁和成品地板会影响单元的安装方式以及门的打开方式。 Ellis 在商定产品尺寸和边缘细节之前进行安装测量并检查固定表面。

5bf8f1847d342abbc5d6.en: Wardrobe measure, product supply and fitting quote
5bf8f1847d342abbc5d6.zh: 衣柜测量、供料与安装报价

6d2d2fe55bdc9658c32c.en: An on-site measure establishes the fitted layout. The Pearce project uses IKEA products assembled and installed by Ellis; the quote needs to identify:
6d2d2fe55bdc9658c32c.zh: 现场测量确定了合适的布局。 Pearce项目使用Ellis组装和安装的IKEA产品；报价需要确定：

ce9bc308fc6f47a052cb.en: Product supply: record the selected units and hardware, who orders them and who supplies them after the measured fit is agreed.
ce9bc308fc6f47a052cb.zh: 产品供应：记录选定的单元和硬件，在测量配合达成一致后，由谁订购以及由谁提供。

acb4ac1b74523df24c62.en: Installation: identify assembly, fitting and the specified edge and finishing details in the carpentry quote.
acb4ac1b74523df24c62.zh: 安装：确定木工报价中的组装、装配以及指定的边缘和饰面细节。

07e188067ead2f929e65.en: Manufacture: IKEA supplies the wardrobe products shown at Pearce. Any separately manufactured components for a different layout need an identified supplier and specification.
07e188067ead2f929e65.zh: 制造商：IKEA 提供 Pearce 所示的衣柜产品。任何针对不同布局单独制造的组件都需要确定的供应商和规格。

1604b3f9b62566c90306.en: Allow for edges, existing trim and service access
1604b3f9b62566c90306.zh: 预留收边、原有线条与管线检修空间

6b2e810c3ef0d8386058.en: Fitted edges bridge the gap between the selected units and adjoining walls or trim. Their finish should be considered with the doors, handles and surrounding room. Keep necessary service access available. Electrical changes need the relevant qualified trade before fitting, and removal of old cabinetry or room decoration must be included if requested.
6b2e810c3ef0d8386058.zh: 装配边缘弥补了所选单元与相邻墙壁或装饰之间的间隙。应考虑门、把手和周围房间的饰面。保持必要的服务进出条件可用。电气变更需要相关合格的专业人员才能安装，如果需要，还必须包括拆除旧橱柜或房间装饰。

3b9359e7b4e47a4c6051.en: Details to send about your wardrobe
3b9359e7b4e47a4c6051.zh: 发送有关您衣柜的详细信息

50c3c9c4207cd4714549.en: Tell us your suburb, the storage you need and whether products have already been selected or bought. A sketch or safe room photo is optional. Include the product names and any components already delivered so suitability and missing parts can be checked before fitting.
50c3c9c4207cd4714549.zh: 告诉我们您所在的郊区、您需要的收纳空间以及是否已选择或购买产品。草图或安全室照片是可选的。包括产品名称和任何已交付的组件，以便在安装前检查适用性和缺失的部件。

b5e05567a3b6e5defa98.en: Yes. Our carpentry team can assess and quote assembly and fitting of the agreed IKEA products. Confirm component suitability, supply and any finishing details before ordering.
b5e05567a3b6e5defa98.zh: 是的。我们的木工团队可以对商定的 IKEA 产品的组装和安装进行评估和报价。订购前请确认组件的适用性、供应和任何加工细节。

230b98b70c31a969b1f6.en: The photographed Pearce case is IKEA product assembly and installation. A different enquiry may need different product or manufacture arrangements, which must be identified in its own proposal.
230b98b70c31a969b1f6.zh: 所拍Pearce 案例为IKEA 产品组装安装。不同的询价可能需要不同的产品或制造安排，这必须在其自己的提案中确定。

32eca9b9a5bb872a02c7.en: Can you repair an existing wardrobe instead?
32eca9b9a5bb872a02c7.zh: 您可以修理现有的衣柜吗？

1eb0007225487379ad6e.en: Describe the hinge, runner, door or shelf fault. Existing cabinet repairs may be the more appropriate starting point than a new built-in installation.
1eb0007225487379ad6e.zh: 描述铰链、滑轨、门或架子故障。现有机柜维修可能是比新的内置安装更合适的起点。

6dc288e391cf72bd45dc.en: Ellis project photography supplied for this service.
6dc288e391cf72bd45dc.zh: Ellis 为此服务提供项目摄影。

7bd9661a21b40cbc4d2c.en: Explore the photographed project behind this service.
7bd9661a21b40cbc4d2c.zh: 探索这项服务背后的拍摄项目。

fe1622121158c819e481.en: Cupboard & Drawer Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
fe1622121158c819e481.zh: 柜门与抽屉维修 | Ellis Services Group

aca0d2b29d857212cab8.en: Cabinet door and drawer repairs in Canberra. Identify hinges, runners and damaged fixing material, then confirm compatible parts, panel repairs and finish.
aca0d2b29d857212cab8.zh: 堪培拉的橱柜门和抽屉维修。识别铰链、滑轨和损坏的固定材料，然后确认兼容零件、面板维修和表面处理。

4a22bf3981ef5c12f0fa.en: Built-in storage and cabinetry at a Canberra home
4a22bf3981ef5c12f0fa.zh: 堪培拉住宅的内置收纳空间和橱柜

2f9d9796a7697ae67296.en: Distinguish hardware faults from panel damage
2f9d9796a7697ae67296.zh: 区分硬件故障和面板损坏

9ac3db733eb92c31db75.en: A dropped cupboard door can have a loose hinge or damaged screw holes in the panel. A sticking drawer may involve its runner, box or alignment. Repairing these items differs from replacing a kitchen or manufacturing new cabinetry. Name the affected door, drawer, wardrobe fitting or kickboard.
9ac3db733eb92c31db75.zh: 掉落的橱柜门可能会导致铰链松动或面板上的螺丝孔损坏。抽屉卡阻可能涉及其滑轨、盒子或对齐方式。修理这些物品与更换厨房或制造新橱柜不同。列出受影响的门、抽屉、衣柜配件或踢脚线。

047f76fae356ccd56a59.en: Optional photos of the open and closed unit, hinge or runner and any visible part number help identify the fitting. Note rubbing, tilting or swelling. Solid timber, MDF and particleboard need different fixing decisions; water-swollen board may not provide a sound hinge fixing. Do not remove a heavy door for photos.
047f76fae356ccd56a59.zh: 打开和关闭装置、铰链或抽屉滑轨的可选照片以及任何可见的零件编号有助于识别配件。注意摩擦、倾斜或肿胀。实木、中密度纤维板和刨花板需要不同的固定决策；水膨胀的板可能无法提供牢固的铰链固定。不要为了拍照而拆除沉重的门。

67f5088b1c248b50d073.en: A cabinet door that drops, rubs or will not close
67f5088b1c248b50d073.zh: 柜门掉落、摩擦或无法关闭

161e3ba7bf89218db4e0.en: A loose hinge or damaged fixing point in the cabinet panel
161e3ba7bf89218db4e0.zh: 柜体面板上的铰链松动或固定点损坏

a13140ef097c4c01473f.en: A drawer runner that sticks or fails, or a loose kickboard
a13140ef097c4c01473f.zh: 抽屉滑轨粘住或失效，或浮板松动

ccfaf638308a3ec7cd27.en: Choose compatible hinges and drawer runners
ccfaf638308a3ec7cd27.zh: 选择兼容的铰链和抽屉滑轨

14170d61a37d71374f1b.en: A hinge must match the door position, opening clearance and mounting points. A runner must suit the drawer dimensions and fixing arrangement as well as its length. Older fittings may need a compatible alternative. Adjustment works only if the remaining hardware and the material around it can hold securely.
14170d61a37d71374f1b.zh: 铰链必须与门位置、开口间隙和安装点相匹配。滑轨必须适合抽屉尺寸、紧固件及其长度。较旧的配件可能需要兼容的替代品。仅当剩余硬件及其周围的材料能够牢固固定时，调整才有效。

d754573a8675b940b88a.en: Water-swollen MDF or particleboard may not provide a sound fixing point after drying. A plumbing leak needs the relevant trade before damaged panels are replaced; glazed or mirrored panels need suitable glazing expertise. Matching a replacement panel to aged laminate or paint may be limited.
d754573a8675b940b88a.zh: 水膨胀的中密度纤维板或刨花板在干燥后可能无法提供良好的固定点。管道泄漏需要进行相关处理，然后才能更换损坏的面板；玻璃或镜面面板需要合适的玻璃专业知识。将替换面板与老化的层压板或油漆相匹配可能会受到限制。

4bfb422d778fea30433f.en: Include the affected item and suburb. Safe photos are optional.
4bfb422d778fea30433f.zh: 包括受影响的项目和郊区。在安全条件下拍摄的照片是可选的。

eca3b9e1d08171936abd.en: Cabinet inspection, parts and panel finish
eca3b9e1d08171936abd.zh: 检查柜体、五金与面板饰面

e3019188884b02205794.en: The on-site assessment checks the fitting, surrounding panel and available replacement parts. The quote separates alignment, hardware supply, fixing-point repair, panel replacement and finish. A full storage redesign belongs with custom joinery so its layout, product supply and fitting can be priced separately.
e3019188884b02205794.zh: 现场评估检查配件、周围面板和可用的更换零件。报价将对准、硬件供应、固定点维修、面板更换和表面处理分开。完整的收纳重新设计属于定制木作，因此其布局、产品供应和配件可以单独定价。

d58b9e6d52752e7553c5.en: Send the cabinet location, fault and suburb, with any visible part number or existing product record. Optional safe photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au; do not remove a heavy panel to photograph its fittings.
d58b9e6d52752e7553c5.zh: 发送机柜位置、故障和郊区，以及任何可见的零件号或现有产品记录。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au；请勿拆下沉重的面板来拍摄其配件。

74a07f6e05058c505495.en: Cupboard hinges and runners: hardware or fixing damage? ↗
74a07f6e05058c505495.zh: 橱柜铰链和滑轨：硬件或固定损坏？ ↗

2d72cc01167fa3990cbf.en: Cabinet Door & Drawer Repairs work photos
2d72cc01167fa3990cbf.zh: 橱柜门和抽屉维修工作照片

46b04b3957a4bbfc7a6a.en: Illustrative timber and connection photographs. These images are not a documented record of this enquiry or a promised repair method.
46b04b3957a4bbfc7a6a.zh: 说明性木材和连接照片。这些图像不是本次调查的书面记录或承诺的修复方法。

a8e6fc356e569bcb9bb8.en: Close view of a cabinet door hinge and shelf fitting
a8e6fc356e569bcb9bb8.zh: 柜门铰链和搁板配件的近视图

3a8ebec5fdb7e3aa6266.en: Ellis repairs cupboard hinges and their fixing points without treating a single fitting fault as a full-kitchen replacement. We check compatible hardware and quote the affected doors and panels.
3a8ebec5fdb7e3aa6266.zh: Ellis 修理橱柜铰链及其固定点，无需将单个配件故障视为整个厨房的更换。我们检查兼容的硬件并报价受影响的门和面板。

9a9f05ce4e3dd0320b04.en: We identify the existing runner, drawer dimensions and fixing condition, then check compatible available parts. The quote confirms the selected runner and any drawer or cabinet repair included.
9a9f05ce4e3dd0320b04.zh: 我们确定现有的滑轨、抽屉尺寸和固定条件，然后检查兼容的可用零件。报价确认了所选的滑轨以及包括的任何抽屉或橱柜维修。

8ead70e7e9234e718e24.en: Ellis checks the wardrobe door rollers, guides, track and alignment. We identify the cause of derailment and quote the compatible hardware and adjustment or repair required.
8ead70e7e9234e718e24.zh: Ellis 检查衣柜门滚轮、导轨、轨道和对齐情况。我们确定脱轨原因并报价兼容的硬件以及所需的调整或维修。

774db67aa5d9b64e9341.en: Arrange your carpentry assessment and quote
774db67aa5d9b64e9341.zh: 安排木作现场查看与报价

9228f5f522c06072d348.en: Composite Decking Canberra | Ellis Services Group
9228f5f522c06072d348.zh: 复合材料露台安装 | Ellis Services Group

10847711983e3e973ce6.en: Composite decking installation in Canberra. Ellis carpentry plans the site, subframe and WPC boards, with a real Mitchell project and a scoped quote.
10847711983e3e973ce6.zh: 堪培拉复合材料露台板安装。 Ellis 木工规划场地、露台支撑龙骨和 WPC 板，并提供真实的 Mitchell 项目和范围报价。

b0d0225d945649c9ff0d.en: Plan the boards, subframe and finished edges
b0d0225d945649c9ff0d.zh: 规划露台板、支撑龙骨与收边

25c1439194cc7ce03104.en: A deck layout must work with ground levels, door thresholds and the space needed for furniture and movement. Steps and connections to an existing deck affect the supports as well as the visible boards. WPC means wood-plastic composite; the selected board system must suit the supporting frame and its fixing details.
25c1439194cc7ce03104.zh: 露台布局必须与地面、门槛以及家具和活动所需的空间配合。现有露台的台阶和连接会影响支撑以及可见的木板。 WPC表示木塑复合材料；所选的板系统必须适合支撑框架及其固定细节。

fc1e22392ac11ed2e270.en: Specify the subframe and the selected WPC system
fc1e22392ac11ed2e270.zh: 指定露台支撑龙骨和所选的 WPC 系统

34cd7e16e8e0fe1e9301.en: Ellis carries out site preparation, subframe construction and board fitting. The subframe is the structure beneath the boards. Its layout, condition and connections must suit the selected range and installation instructions. Existing supports need assessment before reuse; new boards cannot correct damaged framing.
34cd7e16e8e0fe1e9301.zh: Ellis 进行场地准备、露台支撑龙骨施工和板安装。露台支撑龙骨是板下方的结构。其布局、条件和连接必须适合所选范围和安装说明。现有支架在重新使用前需要评估；新板无法修复损坏的框架。

a51d0c481f3c796452c6.en: Choose the product before settling the finish
a51d0c481f3c796452c6.zh: 先确认产品，再确定颜色与收边

9825c775b0960eb1f44a.en: Composite and WPC describe a material category, not one installation system. Agree the exact supplier, range, dimensions, colour and applicable product instructions in the proposal. Composite still needs cleaning and can become hot in direct sun. Check the exact product’s care and exposure guidance.
9825c775b0960eb1f44a.zh: 复合材料和 WPC 描述一种材料类别，而不是一种安装系统。同意提案中的确切供应商、范围、尺寸、颜色和适用的产品说明。复合材料仍然需要清洁，并且在阳光直射下会变热。检查确切的产品护理和暴露指南。

aacc297360a67763c613.en: Site measure and composite deck quote
aacc297360a67763c613.zh: 现场测量和复合材料露台报价

9a5b1af2d41d7e1e59b1.en: At the on-site measure, we check the footprint, levels, access and proposed board system. The quote brings these items together:
9a5b1af2d41d7e1e59b1.zh: 在现场测量中，我们检查占地面积、楼层、通道和建议的露台板系统。报价将这些项目结合在一起：

079dd414a84b5e605fd3.en: Supply: confirm who orders the selected boards, fixings and edge components, and which product instructions apply.
079dd414a84b5e605fd3.zh: 供应：确认谁订购了选定的板、固定件和边缘组件，以及适用哪些产品说明。

e35df923b814aee61c07.en: Construction: identify site preparation, subframe work, board fitting, perimeter finish and any steps or railings.
e35df923b814aee61c07.zh: 施工：确定场地准备、露台支撑龙骨工作、板安装、周边饰面以及任何台阶或栏杆。

a172b37c6ef05d9b8bd9.en: Site work: include access, removal, disposal and the relevant structural and ACT approval responsibilities.
a172b37c6ef05d9b8bd9.zh: 现场工作：包括进入、拆除、处置以及相关的结构和 ACT 批准职责。

08fa1ab7c7bf9e9148be.en: Send your suburb, intended use and an approximate description of the space. Existing plans and safe photographs are useful if available, but you do not need to dismantle anything or enter a confined space. Mention any existing deck to remove or extend, and include the product range if already selected.
08fa1ab7c7bf9e9148be.zh: 发送您的郊区、预期用途和空间的大致描述。如果有的话，现有的计划和在安全条件下拍摄的照片很有用，但您不需要拆除任何东西或进入密闭空间。提及要移除或扩展的任何现有平台，并包括产品范围（如果已选择）。

c8e115003d926022943c.en: Yes. Ellis Services Group’s carpentry team installs composite decking. The quote identifies the selected product, subframe, board fitting and finishing for your site.
c8e115003d926022943c.zh: 是的。 Ellis Services Group 的木工团队安装复合材料露台板。报价标明了为您的场地选择的产品、露台支撑龙骨、板件和饰面。

e8b8ead018703b41ebbd.en: Can you keep my existing frame?
e8b8ead018703b41ebbd.zh: 你能保留我现有的框架吗？

0062e0f0d42561174a49.en: Only after its condition and compatibility with the proposed board system are assessed. Retaining a frame is a separate decision from choosing the new surface.
0062e0f0d42561174a49.zh: 需先评估现有框架的状况，以及它与拟采用露台板系统是否匹配。是否保留框架，与选择哪种新板面是两个不同的决定。

d1dfb06ff1d23d696b03.en: Is this the same as timber deck construction?
d1dfb06ff1d23d696b03.zh: 这与木露台结构相同吗？

cc0938c795e5fef64e2c.en: The site-planning questions overlap, but the board system, fixings and care instructions must match the specified product. Compare the complete scope rather than treating all boards as interchangeable.
cc0938c795e5fef64e2c.zh: 场地规划问题重叠，但板系统、紧固件和保养说明必须与指定产品相匹配。比较完整的范围，而不是将所有板视为可互换的。

9d6faf8d043d6b29974a.zh: 比较木材和复合材料露台板

36029dfbc75b69486c57.en: Custom Joinery Canberra | Ellis Services Group
36029dfbc75b69486c57.zh: 定制木作与嵌入式收纳 | Ellis Services Group

04e2caa87b6957f35529.en: Custom joinery and built-in storage in Canberra. Confirm the measured layout, materials, hardware, manufacture and installation before ordering.
04e2caa87b6957f35529.zh: 堪培拉的定制木作和内置收纳。订购前请确认测量的布局、材料、硬件、制造和安装。

c5b4ee1a7d5fdd390654.en: Made-to-fit shelving and built-in storage planned around the room and what you need to store. The measured layout determines suitable products, any required manufacture and the fitted finish.
c5b4ee1a7d5fdd390654.zh: 按房间条件与收纳用途规划贴合尺寸的层板和嵌入式收纳。量尺后的布局用于确认合适产品、所需制作及安装收边。

9719e086efe3a20cf9b7.en: Plan shelves, wardrobes and built-in storage
9719e086efe3a20cf9b7.zh: 规划架子、衣柜和内置储物空间

a11b70e0e9edbd7ea3bc.en: An alcove, wardrobe or under-stair unit starts with what it needs to hold. Hanging space, shelves, drawers and cupboards need different depths and opening room. Keep vents, switches and service access available. Repairing a hinge on an existing unit belongs with cabinet repairs rather than a new storage layout.
a11b70e0e9edbd7ea3bc.zh: 壁龛、衣柜或楼梯下的单元首先要考虑它需要容纳什么。悬挂空间、架子、抽屉和橱柜需要不同的深度和开口空间。保持通风口、开关和维修通道可用。修理现有单元上的铰链属于橱柜修理，而不是新的收纳布局。

b4d34377b1462ca2a0a5.en: Show the opening, skirting, nearby doors, vents and power points. Clearance for doors and drawers matters as much as storage depth. Note uneven walls or a sloping ceiling; rough dimensions do not establish final fit or a wall’s suitability for heavy cabinets.
b4d34377b1462ca2a0a5.zh: 显示开口、踢脚线、附近的门、通风口和电源点。门和抽屉的间隙与收纳深度一样重要。注意不平坦的墙壁或倾斜的天花板；粗略尺寸并不能确定最终的安装尺寸或墙壁是否适合重型橱柜。

7f8f536dc8c7e6b304a9.en: An alcove that needs measured shelving

40e0a4b6427fbc159348.en: Cabinet doors that need a matched replacement

24d9eb46504c4c0a0f4d.en: Measure clearances and choose suitable components
24d9eb46504c4c0a0f4d.zh: 测量间隙并选择合适的组件

88b3a03d4e31cace6113.en: Measurements at several heights reveal uneven walls, floors and sloping ceilings. A suitable layout allows doors and drawers to open without hitting nearby furniture or trim. Standard products fitted to the space differ from components requiring specialist manufacture; establish which approach the proposed unit uses.
88b3a03d4e31cace6113.zh: 多个高度的测量显示出不平坦的墙壁、地板和倾斜的天花板。合适的布局允许门和抽屉打开而不会撞到附近的家具或装饰。安装在该空间中的标准产品不同于需要专业制造的组件；确定拟议单位使用哪种方法。

0a5f991d27231b8e0cae.en: The fixing material must suit the unit and its intended load. Structural walls, stairs and concealed services need their applicable checks; electrical and plumbing changes require the relevant trade. Matching new doors or panels to aged cabinetry may need an agreed visual compromise.
0a5f991d27231b8e0cae.zh: 固定材料必须适合设备及其预期负载。结构墙、楼梯和隐蔽设施需要进行适当的检查；电气和管道的变更需要相关专业人员。将新门或面板与旧橱柜相匹配可能需要达成一致的视觉妥协。

aaa0e50b52f32f1cdc77.en: Joinery design, supply and fitting proposal
aaa0e50b52f32f1cdc77.zh: 木作设计、供应和安装建议

47063dd988890f3944c2.en: At the on-site measure we check dimensions, fixing surfaces and adjoining finishes. The installation plan and quote identify the drawing or layout to approve, materials, hardware, finish, manufacture or supply responsibilities, delivery, fitting and making-good. Agree the process for design revisions before ordering.
47063dd988890f3944c2.zh: 在现场测量中，我们检查尺寸、固定表面和相邻饰面。安装计划和报价确定了要批准的图纸或布局、材料、硬件、饰面、制造或供应责任、交付、安装和修补。订购前同意设计修改流程。

8a1aad013f865de4a94e.en: Send the intended storage use and suburb, with optional sketches or preferred layouts to brian@elliservices.com.au. For IKEA products, identify the selected components so their assembly and fitting can be assessed.
8a1aad013f865de4a94e.zh: 将预期收纳用途和郊区以及可选草图或首选布局发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。对于 IKEA 产品，识别所选组件，以便评估其组装和装配。

757c2dd5b444eedc42a0.en: When existing cabinet hardware needs repair rather than new storage ↗
757c2dd5b444eedc42a0.zh: 当现有橱柜硬件需要维修而不是新收纳时 ↗

c0b772e9fe4ea9ac0fbc.en: Repair an existing cupboard or wardrobe fitting ↗
c0b772e9fe4ea9ac0fbc.zh: 修理现有的橱柜或衣柜配件 ↗

2a98dafba36c8447adc9.en: Plan on-site shelving and interior timber installation ↗
2a98dafba36c8447adc9.zh: 规划现场货架和室内木材安装 ↗

0e74667de14008a01790.en: . The Pearce record shows IKEA assembly and fitting.
0e74667de14008a01790.zh: 。 Pearce 记录显示 IKEA 装配和装配。

ff1cbe0832fc749e2e32.en: . The gallery shows different completed projects.
ff1cbe0832fc749e2e32.zh: 。画廊展示了不同的已完成项目。

79e4db437bb661e6b043.en: Custom Joinery & Built-in Storage work photos
79e4db437bb661e6b043.zh: 定制木作和内置收纳工作照片

371556cdf31e93c51038.en: Start with Ellis and describe the wardrobe you need. We measure the space and confirm the design, manufacture and fitting arrangements, materials, finish and installation scope in the proposal.
371556cdf31e93c51038.zh: 从 Ellis 开始并描述您需要的衣柜。我们测量空间并确认提案中的设计、制造和安装安排、材料、饰面和安装范围。

9eeba7e5e302528b0429.en: We measure the retained cabinets, door layout and hinges and review the proposed material and finish. The quote confirms the manufacture and fitting arrangements for the new doors.
9eeba7e5e302528b0429.zh: 我们测量保留的橱柜、门布局和铰链，并审查建议的材料和饰面。报价确认了新门的制造和安装安排。

12a55d023460df263a64.en: Contact Ellis about under-stair storage. We measure the available space and check stair clearances, supports and concealed-service requirements before defining the storage layout and installation quote.
12a55d023460df263a64.zh: 请联系 Ellis 了解有关楼梯下收纳的信息。在确定收纳布局和安装报价之前，我们会测量可用空间并检查楼梯间隙、支撑和隐蔽服务要求。

abc09ab3a0d032d32246.en: What should a built-in wardrobe proposal identify?
abc09ab3a0d032d32246.zh: 内置衣柜提案应确定什么？

b3b79c4a72f84118baa4.en: The measured layout, storage use, doors and drawer clearance, materials, hardware, finish, manufacture or supply arrangements, fitting and making-good. Ask which drawing or sample you approve before ordering.
b3b79c4a72f84118baa4.zh: 测量的布局、收纳用途、门和抽屉间隙、材料、硬件、饰面、制造或供应安排、安装和制作。订购前询问您批准哪种图纸或样品。

dc5262bec3f48f8f0b35.en: Send the space, intended use and your suburb. Plans and safe photos are optional.
dc5262bec3f48f8f0b35.zh: 发送空间、预期用途和您的郊区。计划和在安全条件下拍摄的照片是可选的。

2b1424aefdf19c01cf5a.en: Deck Building Canberra | Ellis Services Group
2b1424aefdf19c01cf5a.zh: 新建与扩建露台 | Ellis Services Group

8b778210b74421309111.en: New timber decks and extensions in Canberra. Plan the footprint, supports, drainage, materials and access, with applicable ACT checks scoped before work.
8b778210b74421309111.zh: 堪培拉的新木露台和扩建。规划占地面积、支撑、排水、材料和通道，并在工作前进行适用的 ACT 检查。

3825804461c3229d53e1.en: New timber deck framing and joists during construction
3825804461c3229d53e1.zh: 施工期间新的木露台框架和托梁

45c62c4d326f7e24ed90.en: Plan a new footprint or extension
45c62c4d326f7e24ed90.zh: 规划新的占地面积或扩建

e95bcb64cd51ca499d83.en: A new deck or extension begins with intended use, footprint, height and connection to the house. Board replacement on an existing deck belongs with deck repairs. An extension needs existing supports and connections assessed; the old deck cannot be assumed suitable for additional work.
e95bcb64cd51ca499d83.zh: 新的露台或扩建部分从预期用途、占地面积、高度以及与房屋的连接开始。现有露台上的板更换属于露台维修。扩建需要评估现有的支持和连接；旧露台不能被认为适合进行额外的工作。

a3fcfd9d150daabea1a5.en: Describe doors opening onto the deck, ground slope, drainage, boundaries and material access. Existing plans and safe photos help explain the layout. They cannot establish soil conditions, boundary position or existing framing capacity.
a3fcfd9d150daabea1a5.zh: 描述通向露台、地面坡度、排水、边界和材料通道的门。现有的平面图和在安全条件下拍摄的照片有助于解释布局。他们无法确定土壤条件、边界位置或现有框架能力。

2c39685b3a79820fc191.en: An existing deck is beyond practical board repair
2c39685b3a79820fc191.zh: 现有露台超出了实际的板修复范围

03e2ca7e56118b3b166e.en: A new outdoor platform is being planned
03e2ca7e56118b3b166e.zh: 正在规划一个新的户外平台

9302bd27afe6253a0102.en: A deck extension needs scope and approval checks
9302bd27afe6253a0102.zh: 露台扩展需要范围和批准检查

c870a4761dc99adad296.en: Plan footings, board layout and drainage
c870a4761dc99adad296.zh: 规划基础、板布局和排水

3050385e15507658ef21.en: The layout must allow for door thresholds, water movement, footings, stairs and railings. Timber species and finish or the exact composite board system determine compatible fixings and support details. For an extension, existing framing and connections need assessment before new work is attached.
3050385e15507658ef21.zh: 布局必须考虑到门槛、水流、基础、楼梯和栏杆。木材种类和饰面或确切的复合板系统决定了兼容的固定件和支撑细节。对于扩建，在附加新作品之前需要评估现有框架和连接。

81c8e95ca14438e1254c.en: Development approval and building approval are separate checks. The relevant professionals must confirm both, and any engineering needed for the proposal; area or low height alone does not decide this. Excavation, drainage, retaining work and electrical changes also need named responsibilities.
81c8e95ca14438e1254c.zh: 开发审批和建筑审批是分开检查的。相关专业人员必须确认该提案所需的任何工程；面积或低高度本身并不能决定这一点。挖掘、排水、挡土工作和电气改造也需要指定职责。

ae6428a05a850ff32fce.en: Deck measurements, approvals and construction quote
ae6428a05a850ff32fce.zh: 露台测量、批准和施工报价

51b83bad0bbe1a63fd45.en: At the on-site measure we review the site and construction details. The installation plan and quote set out footprint, height, board product, framing, footings, stairs or railings, site preparation, removal, disposal and finish. Identify who supplies each item and handles approvals. Compare these complete inclusions rather than a board-only square-metre price.
51b83bad0bbe1a63fd45.zh: 在现场测量中，我们审查场地和施工细节。安装计划和报价列出了占地面积、高度、板材产品、框架、基础、楼梯或栏杆、场地准备、拆除、处置和完成。确定谁供应每件物品并处理批准。比较这些完整的内容，而不是仅比较木板的平方米价格。

ec8c642bcba90148007d.en: Send your suburb, intended use and whether the deck is new or an extension. Optional plans, dimensions and safe photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
ec8c642bcba90148007d.zh: 发送您的郊区、预期用途以及露台是新的还是扩建的。可选平面图、尺寸和在安全条件下拍摄的照片可通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

ee32ceaca215691bfe6a.en: When an existing deck needs rebuilding rather than board repair ↗
ee32ceaca215691bfe6a.zh: 当现有露台需要重建而不是木板修理时 ↗

45ac37cdf5e1def5d972.en: Timber vs composite decking: compare the product and scope ↗
45ac37cdf5e1def5d972.zh: 木材与复合材料露台板：比较产品和范围 ↗

e58920d169a9d5a02556.en: What to check in a carpentry construction quote ↗
e58920d169a9d5a02556.zh: 在木工施工报价中检查什么 ↗

9450550f960387f7f337.en: ACT guidance on checking whether building approval is needed
9450550f960387f7f337.zh: ACT 检查是否需要建筑审批的指南

2aac5bd42f4c5aba3012.zh: 。 2025 年 8 月。复合材料露台板 / WPC。

7e0b2a87024a81b08eec.en: New Deck Construction & Extensions work photos
7e0b2a87024a81b08eec.zh: 新露台施工和扩建工作照片

401d05cb72b2987f30f6.en: Deck framing and joists before the walking surface is installed.
401d05cb72b2987f30f6.zh: 安装行走面之前的露台框架和托梁。

b2a2f55330f3abb10e1d.en: Completed new timber deck at a Canberra home
b2a2f55330f3abb10e1d.zh: 堪培拉住宅的新木露台竣工

38f6cf6e43b386dd4ded.en: Timber boards, edges and steps in the completed outdoor space.
38f6cf6e43b386dd4ded.zh: 已完工的室外空间中的木板、边缘和台阶。

33d464866a1fc457bdeb.en: We check the deck footprint, height, location, supports, access and use, then confirm applicable ACT development and building approval requirements and qualified project assessments before construction is agreed.
33d464866a1fc457bdeb.zh: 我们检查露台占地面积、高度、位置、支撑、通道和使用，然后在同意施工之前确认适用的 ACT 开发和建筑审批要求以及合格的项目评估。

489554da5b789136b27d.en: What information helps compare new deck quotes?
489554da5b789136b27d.zh: 哪些信息有助于比较新露台报价？

b8cfa0f2a0217d62a24f.en: Use the same footprint, height, board specification, support system, access, removal and finish. Ask which project checks and supply arrangements each proposal includes before comparing the price.
b8cfa0f2a0217d62a24f.zh: 使用相同的占地面积、高度、木板规格、支撑系统、通道、拆卸和表面处理。在比较价格之前询问每个提案包括哪些项目检查和供应安排。

34deaaa0832a236d3e7b.en: Deck Cleaning & Oiling Canberra | Ellis Services Group
34deaaa0832a236d3e7b.zh: 露台清洗与上油 | Ellis Services Group

e4cb64777d923789b3e9.en: Deck cleaning and oiling in Canberra. Ellis assesses board condition, scopes preparation and coating, and shows its Melba repair and oiling project.
e4cb64777d923789b3e9.zh: 堪培拉的露台清洁和加油。 Ellis 评估木板状况、范围准备和涂层，并展示其 Melba 维修和涂油项目。

78125ce2457143b922d3.en: Check board repairs before renewing the finish
78125ce2457143b922d3.zh: 在更新饰面之前检查木板维修情况

6113034265e90b10ff5a.en: A faded coating is a surface-care issue; a raised board edge, loose fixing or movement may need timber repair. Describe both if they occur together. Do not use an unstable area or test it again for a photograph. Suitable boards and supports are needed before cleaning and a renewed finish are considered.
6113034265e90b10ff5a.zh: 涂层褪色属于表面护理问题；凸起的板边缘、松动的固定或移动可能需要木材修复。如果两者同时出现，请描述它们。请勿使用不稳定的区域或再次测试照片。在考虑清洁和更新饰面之前，需要合适的板和支撑件。

c2e7bb6e0b50a9ba34b9.en: Repair timber before cleaning and oiling
c2e7bb6e0b50a9ba34b9.zh: 在清洁和上油之前修复木材

3e80c608b9642baefd70.en: Ellis provides stand-alone deck cleaning and oiling as well as carpentry repairs. Cleaning removes surface contamination and preparation readies suitable timber for its selected coating. Neither step replaces damaged boards or restores failing connections. Repair defects first, then settle the preparation needed for old and replacement timber.
3e80c608b9642baefd70.zh: Ellis 提供独立的露台清洁和涂油以及木工维修。清洁可去除表面污染物，并为所选涂层准备合适的木材。这两个步骤都不能更换损坏的板或恢复失败的连接。首先修复缺陷，然后解决旧木材和更换木材所需的准备工作。

26b1dbb3575d5ea1d6e3.en: Identify the existing finish and proposed product
26b1dbb3575d5ea1d6e3.zh: 确定现有的成品和建议的产品

3d8206f95bc8bb012198.en: If you know the previous coating, send its name or an earlier product record. The selected cleaning, preparation and oiling method depends on the existing surface, timber and proposed finish. Confirm the exact product and care information rather than assuming that every oil or cleaning method is interchangeable.
3d8206f95bc8bb012198.zh: 如果您知道以前的涂层，请发送其名称或早期的产品记录。所选择的清洁、准备和上油方法取决于现有的表面、木材和建议的饰面。确认准确的产品和保养信息，而不是假设每种油或清洁方法都是可以互换的。

31e74931d22bfd777359.zh: 露台评估和表面护理报价

7a348bfcfdf3f0f6ab28.en: The on-site assessment checks the existing surface and any reported defects. The quote separates timber repair from cleaning and oiling:
7a348bfcfdf3f0f6ab28.zh: 现场评估检查现有表面和任何报告的缺陷。引文将木材修复与清洁和上油分开：

81e3c5725472c8041fb5.en: Board repairs: identify the defects to address before cleaning or oiling; surface work does not repair deteriorated supports.
81e3c5725472c8041fb5.zh: 木板维修：在清洁或上油之前确定需要解决的缺陷；表面工作不能修复损坏的支撑。

7d0c5acc75a7b4615244.en: Surface care: confirm the treated area, preparation, selected product and who supplies it. Keep the product’s care information with the agreed scope.
7d0c5acc75a7b4615244.zh: 表面护理：确认处理区域、准备工作、所选产品以及供应商。将产品的保养信息保留在约定的范围内。

8c06f2ff7e9a67d4c1b1.en: Access and use: agree protection of nearby surfaces, furniture handling and debris removal. Use the selected product’s weather and drying instructions to agree when the area can be used.
8c06f2ff7e9a67d4c1b1.zh: 进出条件和使用：同意保护附近表面、家具处理和碎片清除。使用所选产品的天气和干燥说明来同意何时可以使用该区域。

11b25a88639757a4203c.en: Include your suburb, the area involved, the problems you have noticed and any previous coating details. Safe photos are optional. Mention stairs, furniture and access through the house if they affect the work. The Melba project below shows board repairs followed by cleaning, preparation and oiling.
11b25a88639757a4203c.zh: 包括您所在的郊区、涉及的区域、您注意到的问题以及任何以前的涂层详细信息。在安全条件下拍摄的照片是可选的。如果楼梯、家具和房屋通道影响工作，请提及。下面的 Melba 项目显示了木板维修，然后是清洁、准备和上油。

41167935178382f53cad.en: Can I book cleaning and oiling without replacing the deck?
41167935178382f53cad.zh: 我可以预约清洁和加油而不更换露台吗？

bcd7e4ea133b33c54549.en: Yes. Ellis offers deck cleaning and oiling. The deck’s condition is assessed first, and the quote identifies any repairs and the surface-care scope.
bcd7e4ea133b33c54549.zh: 是的。 Ellis 提供露台清洁和涂油服务。首先评估露台的状况，然后报价确定任何维修和表面护理范围。

3283baa83b3ca9cc3d1e.en: Does sanding or oiling fix an unstable deck?
3283baa83b3ca9cc3d1e.zh: 打磨或上油是否可以修复不稳定的露台？

052305f08c9dea15575a.en: No. Surface preparation and coating do not correct unsafe supporting timber or connections. Avoid the affected area and request an assessment.
052305f08c9dea15575a.zh: 否。表面处理和涂层不能纠正不安全的支撑木材或连接。避开受影响的区域并请求评估。

c4d322b361c594a43736.en: Will the same oil be used as in the Melba project?
c4d322b361c594a43736.zh: 是否会使用与 Melba 项目中相同的油？

44ec112609bc2d54ac07.en: That project used Cabot’s oil-based decking oil. Your product is selected for the assessed surface and agreed finish; a past product choice is not a universal recommendation.
44ec112609bc2d54ac07.zh: 该项目使用 Cabot’s 油性露台木油。您的产品将根据评估的表面和商定的表面处理进行选择；过去的产品选择并不是普遍推荐。

123c72bcffdac6f320f7.zh: 讨论您的露台护理咨询

f21c94c8bf58d6d463b5.en: Deck Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
f21c94c8bf58d6d463b5.zh: 露台维修与木板更换 | Ellis Services Group

dd79119177492e84ad45.en: Deck repairs and board replacement in Canberra. Compare damaged boards with support repairs and define timber, fixings, access, disposal and finish.
dd79119177492e84ad45.zh: 堪培拉的露台维修和木板更换。将损坏的木板与支撑修复进行比较，并定义木材、固定件、通道、处置和饰面。

35310642f37b86094741.en: Distinguish damaged boards from failing supports
35310642f37b86094741.zh: 区分损坏的板和失效的支撑

4f270e27609a4db9ed4f.en: A split or softened deck board may be a local replacement; a springy area, moving post or failed connection needs a support check. Walking boards do not show whether the joists are sound. Describe whether the concern is a few boards, one area or movement across the deck.
4f270e27609a4db9ed4f.zh: 裂开或软化的露台板可以作为本地替代品；弹性区域、移动柱或连接失败需要进行支撑检查。走板不能显示托梁是否完好。描述所关心的是几块木板、一个区域还是整个露台上的移动。

da5011ab3cbb4c031a58.en: Note lifted fixings, soft board ends, changed gaps and recurring dampness near edges or steps. Show any safely accessible underside. Stop using an unstable area and do not enter an unsafe space for photos. Sanding and oiling improve the surface finish; they do not repair decay or failing connections.
da5011ab3cbb4c031a58.zh: 注意抬起的固定件、软板端部、变化的间隙以及边缘或台阶附近反复出现的潮湿。显示任何可安全触及的底面。停止使用不稳定区域，不要进入不安全的空间拍照。打磨、涂油提高表面光洁度；它们不能修复损坏或失效的连接。

c5ae8d0c45aa8b21a090.en: Individual deck boards that have deteriorated

eab0b0a4c6ba008a292f.zh: 固定件松动或板不平整

0bcf37f013f36b05dfae.en: An older deck needing a repair-versus-replacement decision
0bcf37f013f36b05dfae.zh: 旧露台需要修复还是更换决策

b8b06456f2b1aa290abe.en: Repair supports before fitting replacement boards
b8b06456f2b1aa290abe.zh: 在安装更换板之前修复支撑

e530880aaf540cd94d4e.en: Joists are the members directly beneath the boards; bearers and posts support them. Replacement boards need suitable joists, drainage gaps and compatible fixings. A low deck may need agreed opening-up to inspect these parts. New boards should not cover unresolved support damage.
e530880aaf540cd94d4e.zh: 托梁位于露台板正下方，由承梁和立柱支撑。更换露台板需要合适的托梁、排水间隙与匹配的紧固件。较低的露台可能需要经确认后打开部分板面进行检查。不能用新板盖住尚未处理的支撑损坏。

5b91004c8a9a8a7a08ab.en: New boards may look different from weathered timber even with a matching profile. Cleaning, sanding and oiling concern surface preparation and finish; they cannot repair decay or a failed connection. An extension or changed layout needs a construction proposal with the relevant structural and ACT checks.
5b91004c8a9a8a7a08ab.zh: 即使具有匹配的轮廓，新板也可能看起来与风化木材有所不同。清洁、打磨和上油涉及表面准备和表面与收边处理；它们无法修复损坏或失败的连接。扩建或更改布局需要一份包含相关结构和 ACT 检查的施工方案。

bca9b8b0107de9950f6c.en: Deck assessment, repair options and surface care
bca9b8b0107de9950f6c.zh: 露台评估、修复选项和表面护理

39cefe6a97af3e3580b8.en: The on-site assessment separates local board repair, frame and connection repairs, and rebuilding. The quote lists timber, fixings, access, removal, disposal and the area to prepare or coat. For deck restoration, specify whether you want surface care, repairs or both; the term alone does not describe the work.
39cefe6a97af3e3580b8.zh: 现场评估分为局部板修复、框架和连接修复以及重建。报价列出了木材、紧固件、通道、拆除、处置以及准备或涂层的区域。对于露台修复，请指定您是否需要表面护理、维修或两者兼而有之；该术语本身并不能描述这项工作。

923fad41d15b28038736.en: Send your suburb, the affected area and any movement already noticed. Mention low ground clearance or an enclosed underside. Optional safe photographs and existing reports can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
923fad41d15b28038736.zh: 发送您所在的郊区、受影响的区域以及已经注意到的任何活动。提及低离地间隙或封闭的底部。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片和现有报告可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

6d2d0144c4acc01f529a.en: Deck boards or supporting frame: defining the repair ↗
6d2d0144c4acc01f529a.zh: 露台板或支撑框架：定义修复 ↗

a771d41238be5dea139f.en: Compare local repair, support repairs and rebuilding ↗
a771d41238be5dea139f.zh: 比较本地修复、支持修复和重建 ↗

a6613ac466adef57f1f1.en: Timber deck maintenance: when care becomes a repair enquiry ↗
a6613ac466adef57f1f1.zh: 木露台维护：当护理变成维修咨询时 ↗

6c01ad4e89bf59d42276.zh: 。 2025 年 5 月。Cabot’s 油性露台木油。

006918234aa41287ea78.en: Deck Repairs & Board Replacement work photos
006918234aa41287ea78.zh: 露台维修和板更换工作照片

460a250743d0ac5f0a94.en: The overall deck and close board view illustrate the walking surface, perimeter and fixing positions. Those surface details do not establish the condition of the framing beneath.
460a250743d0ac5f0a94.zh: 整体露台和近板视图说明了行走表面、周边和固定位置。这些表面细节并不能确定下面框架的状况。

09823f007b92100430f0.en: Close view of timber deck boards, edge trim and fixings
09823f007b92100430f0.zh: 木露台、边缘装饰和固定件的近距离视图

0a5004db4206cfecd7eb.en: We inspect the damaged boards and supporting joists, bearers, posts and fixings together. The quote specifies individual board replacement where the retained support is sound, or the support repairs needed first, rather than treating every damaged board as a full rebuild.
0a5004db4206cfecd7eb.zh: 我们一起检查损坏的板和支撑托梁、支架、柱子和固定件。报价指定在保留的支撑完好的情况下更换单个板，或者首先需要维修支撑，而不是将每个损坏的板视为完全重建。

9d76b14c548babb733ed.en: Sanding and oiling renew the surface finish; loose or damaged boards, movement, soft supports and failing connections need repair. Ellis checks the walking surface and frame and specifies the repairs before the finishing stage.
9d76b14c548babb733ed.zh: 打磨和涂油更新表面光洁度；松动或损坏的板、移动、软支撑和失效的连接需要维修。 Ellis 检查行走表面和框架，并在完成阶段之前指定修复情况。

8e66b3f74454542411d5.en: We compare the existing timber dimensions, profile and finish with available materials and finish samples. Existing weathering affects the appearance of a match, so you approve the proposed timber and finishing approach before replacement boards are ordered.
8e66b3f74454542411d5.zh: 我们将现有木材尺寸、轮廓和饰面与可用材料和饰面样品进行比较。现有的风化会影响火柴的外观，因此您在订购更换板之前批准了提议的木材和饰面方法。

d52b2359e4ec2e23fe20.en: Is a restoration quote the same as a deck repair quote?
d52b2359e4ec2e23fe20.zh: 修复报价与露台修复报价相同吗？

72c3407cb320f7192238.en: Not necessarily. Ask which boards and supports are assessed or replaced, and whether the proposal is only surface preparation and coating. Ellis confirms the accepted repair and finishing inclusions after assessment.
72c3407cb320f7192238.zh: 不一定。询问评估或更换哪些板和支撑，以及建议是否只是表面处理和涂层。 Ellis 在评估后确认接受的修复和表面与收边处理内含物。

0cad68e63c90dbdb3335.en: Timber Door & Frame Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
0cad68e63c90dbdb3335.zh: 木门与门框维修 | Ellis Services Group

9853beef82f44e6fa6eb.en: Timber door and frame repairs in Canberra. Check hinges, jambs, latch alignment and floor clearance, then compare adjustment with damaged-section replacement.
9853beef82f44e6fa6eb.zh: 堪培拉的木门和框架维修。检查铰链、侧柱、闩锁对齐和地板间隙，然后将调整与损坏部分的更换进行比较。

87c29b0393e73ff27d88.en: Find why the door scrapes or will not latch
87c29b0393e73ff27d88.zh: 找出门刮擦或锁不上的原因

9511b64a019bbca40b88.en: A sticking timber door can come from a dropped hinge, swollen edge, moving jamb or changed floor level. The leaf and frame work as one opening: changing the strike plate alone may leave the original fault. Note whether the door rubs at the head, floor or latch side and whether the gaps change along the opening.
9511b64a019bbca40b88.zh: 木门卡阻可能是由于铰链掉落、边缘肿胀、门框移动或地板高度变化造成的。门与框合为一开口，单独更换冲击板可能会留下原来的故障。注意门的头部、地板或锁闩侧面是否摩擦，以及间隙是否沿开口变化。

e650f5fcf8bf45ddb184.en: Soft timber at an external jamb is a different repair from a sound internal door needing clearance after new flooring. Tell us when the fault started and whether it changes after rain. A damaged frame can sometimes be repaired while retaining the leaf, provided its condition, dimensions and fit remain suitable.
e650f5fcf8bf45ddb184.zh: 外部侧柱处的软木材与完好的内门在新地板铺设后需要间隙的修复不同。告诉我们故障何时开始以及雨后是否会改变。有时可以在保留门扇的同时修复损坏的框架，只要其状况、尺寸和配合保持合适。

49e36e5712291b6e0ba5.en: A door rubbing after new flooring

1585a342067ad1a0e3b5.en: A latch that misses the strike plate

3b0ffd366101caa1b03c.en: Split timber around a hinge or a soft door jamb
3b0ffd366101caa1b03c.zh: 将铰链或软门框周围的木材劈开

4d03dfb47ecd33e24413.en: Repair the jamb, hinges or door leaf

084a5bd6cadbce79bf73.en: The door leaf is the moving panel; the jamb is the frame beside it. Hinges need sound timber at both fixing points. A local jamb repair can keep a serviceable leaf, while widespread decay or distortion may call for replacement. Trimming only suits a door whose construction permits the required amount to be removed.
084a5bd6cadbce79bf73.zh: 门扇为活动面板；门框是它旁边的框架。铰链的两个固定点都需要坚固的木材。局部门框修复可以保持门扇可用，而大范围的腐烂或变形可能需要更换。修边仅适用于其结构允许去除所需量的门。

db4f37efa698fa68391e.en: A replacement internal door needs the right thickness, measured width and height, compatible hinges and latch preparation. Buying a similar-looking leaf does not ensure a direct fit. Glass needs a glazier, lock cylinders and security mechanisms need a locksmith, and fire-rated doors or powered access require specialist checks.
db4f37efa698fa68391e.zh: 更换内门需要正确的厚度、测量的宽度和高度、兼容的铰链和闩锁准备。购买外观相似的门扇并不能确保直接适合。玻璃需要玻璃工，锁芯和安全装置需要锁匠，防火门或电动通道需要专家检查。

6d8a725ce5ea765a5404.en: During the on-site assessment we inspect closing gaps, hinge support, jamb fixings and floor clearance. The quote sets out adjustment or replacement, door and hardware supply, removal and edge finishing. New floor coverings and exposed thresholds affect the required clearance and protection against moisture.
6d8a725ce5ea765a5404.zh: 在现场评估期间，我们检查闭合间隙、铰链支撑、侧柱固定件和地板间隙。报价列出了调整或更换、门和硬件供应、拆卸和边缘处理。新的地板覆盖物和暴露的门槛会影响所需的间隙和防潮保护。

8ec21b38ca4a08eb6510.en: Tell Ellis which door is affected, when the fault occurs and your suburb. Include whether it is the main entrance and whether a replacement has already been bought. Optional safe photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
8ec21b38ca4a08eb6510.zh: 告诉 Ellis 哪扇门受到影响、故障发生的时间以及您所在的郊区。包括是否是主入口以及是否已经购买了替代入口。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

85b11b6c60d5f01b4fec.en: Understand adjustment before replacing a sticking door ↗
85b11b6c60d5f01b4fec.zh: 更换粘门之前了解调整 ↗

70c2fc55ff5f03660f61.en: Compare door fitting and repair quote inclusions ↗
70c2fc55ff5f03660f61.zh: 比较门配件和维修报价内容 ↗

2198ea79efe141cd61fc.en: Timber Door & Frame Repairs work photos
2198ea79efe141cd61fc.zh: 木门和框架维修工作照片

dd41d1df893784390eed.en: Close view of a timber door hinge and frame
dd41d1df893784390eed.zh: 木门铰链和框架的近视图

45b77ae01d2559598656.en: Completed painted timber door frame repair detail
45b77ae01d2559598656.zh: 已完成的涂漆木门框维修细节

022a03d597ad41f27e44.en: Painted frame and threshold after timber repair.
022a03d597ad41f27e44.zh: 木材修复后涂漆的框架和门槛。

b8ac5e199a01e2635b0a.en: Yes. We check the finished floor level, door construction, permitted trimming allowance and required clearance before specifying the adjustment. Your quote includes the suitable trimming and edge finishing for the door.
b8ac5e199a01e2635b0a.zh: 是的。在指定调整之前，我们会检查完工的地板水平、门结构、允许的修剪余量和所需的间隙。您的报价包括门的合适修边和边缘处理。

bc4ac9e943f163cae089.en: A timber alignment fault can often be repaired. Ellis checks the leaf, hinges, jamb and strike to distinguish dropped hinges or frame damage from a faulty lock mechanism. The quote defines the timber work; lock and security mechanism repairs need the appropriate locksmith service.
bc4ac9e943f163cae089.zh: 木材对齐错误通常可以修复。 Ellis 检查门扇、铰链、侧柱和锁板，以区分铰链掉落或框架损坏是否因锁机构故障而导致。报价定义了木材工作；锁和安全装置的维修需要适当的锁匠服务。

80ed131b03e930a88c15.en: We assess the frame damage and the condition and fit of the retained door. The quote identifies the frame sections to replace and the door, hardware and finish to retain.
80ed131b03e930a88c15.zh: 我们评估框架损坏情况以及保留门的状况和安装情况。报价标明了要更换的框架部分以及要保留的门、硬件和饰面。

a72006f37cd902770c8b.en: We inspect the rollers, track, guides and accessible hardware first. The repair quote identifies the required access opening and reinstatement, so wall work is defined before the repair proceeds.
a72006f37cd902770c8b.zh: 我们首先检查滚轮、轨道、导轨和可触及的硬件。维修报价确定了所需的通道开口和恢复，因此在维修进行之前就确定了墙壁工作。

84ea14d88a55e82a1883.en: What should I decide before buying a replacement internal door?
84ea14d88a55e82a1883.zh: 在购买替换内门之前我应该​​做什么决定？

e68c38573561fa6945cc.en: First confirm the measured opening, construction, permissible trimming and hardware requirements with the team. Ask whether your proposed fitting task is accepted and which supply, removal and finishing items the quote includes.
e68c38573561fa6945cc.zh: 首先与团队确认测量的开口、结构、允许的修剪和硬件要求。询问您提议的装配任务是否被接受以及报价包括哪些供应、拆卸和收尾处理项目。

97b8796724cb839ce623.en: Fascia & Eaves Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
97b8796724cb839ce623.zh: 檐口封板与檐底维修 | Ellis Services Group

9898bbe909af6e8b2adc.en: Fascia, bargeboard and eaves repairs in Canberra. Distinguish timber from lining, check gutter-side damage and confirm access, replacement and finishing.
9898bbe909af6e8b2adc.zh: 堪培拉的檐口封板、山墙封边板和屋檐维修。区分木材和衬里，检查排水沟侧面的损坏并确认进入、更换和收尾处理。

ab48df7724834dc47f42.en: Painted exterior timber, fascia and eaves at a Canberra home
ab48df7724834dc47f42.zh: 堪培拉住宅的外部木材、檐口封板和屋檐的油漆

e4a1e98cf44043a2ff46.en: Identify fascia, bargeboard or eaves lining
e4a1e98cf44043a2ff46.zh: 辨认檐口封板、山墙封边板与檐底板

28677924ae8289ad3a4c.en: Fascia runs along the lower roof edge beside the gutter; a bargeboard follows the sloping gable edge. Eaves lining closes the underside and may be a board material rather than solid timber. Soft fascia, a split bargeboard and stained lining therefore need different material and repair decisions.
28677924ae8289ad3a4c.zh: 檐口封板沿着排水沟旁边的下屋顶边缘延伸；一个山墙封边板沿着倾斜的山墙边缘。屋檐衬里封闭下侧，可能是板材而不是实木。因此，柔软的面板、分体式山墙封边板和染色的衬里需要不同的材料和修复决策。

250ba046c486969a0872.en: Look from ground level for peeling paint near a gutter joint, softened board ends, loose fixings or water tracking behind the gutter. Note overflow during rain. The visible face may hide damaged fixings behind the gutter; do not climb to prepare an enquiry.
250ba046c486969a0872.zh: 从地面观察排水沟接头附近是否有剥落的油漆、软化的板端、松动的固定件或排水沟后面的水迹。下雨时注意溢出。可见面可能会将损坏的紧固件隐藏在排水沟后面；不要爬上去准备咨询。

f5d2603e9a3425fbf4e0.en: Soft or peeling timber fascia near a gutter
f5d2603e9a3425fbf4e0.zh: 排水沟附近柔软或剥落的木质面板

e30dc30ff3eccdaa91a1.en: A split or weathered bargeboard at a gable
e30dc30ff3eccdaa91a1.zh: 山墙处的裂开或风化的山墙封边板

ab08bce45954ecedb92d.en: A damaged eaves lining or soffit edge that needs material checks
ab08bce45954ecedb92d.zh: 损坏的屋檐衬里或拱腹边缘，需要进行材料检查

c31c25970ce77b1da8ed.en: Check the gutter-side timber and unknown lining
c31c25970ce77b1da8ed.zh: 检查天沟边木材和未知衬里

360765e744bf57a90376.en: Behind a damaged fascia, gutter brackets and their fixing timber may also be affected. The board profile, joints and roof-edge connections determine how a replacement can meet the existing work. Leaks, overflow and gutter refitting need roofing or guttering input alongside the timber repair.
360765e744bf57a90376.zh: 在损坏的面板后面，天沟支架及其固定木材也可能受到影响。板的轮廓、接头和屋顶边缘连接决定了替换件如何满足现有工作。漏水、溢流和排水沟整修需要在木材修复的同时进行屋顶或排水沟的投入。

2207979145c78263cd24.en: Unknown old eaves lining must be identified before disturbance. Suspected asbestos requires qualified assessment and the appropriate removal process; do not cut or sample it yourself. Electrical fittings at the eaves also need their relevant specialist checks.
2207979145c78263cd24.zh: 在拆动之前必须识别未知的旧屋檐衬里。疑似石棉需要进行合格的评估和适当的清除过程；请勿自行切割或取样。屋檐处的电气装置也需要相关的专家检查。

70d024b93541f11912cf.zh: 屋顶边缘通道、更换和喷漆

72ec807e2a76d804860d.en: At the on-site assessment we check accessible timber, the water path and safe access. The quote identifies replacement lengths and profiles, access equipment, gutter work, joint treatment, disposal and painting. Confirm who repairs leaks or flashing and whether any lining replacement is included.
72ec807e2a76d804860d.zh: 在现场评估中，我们检查可接近的木材、水路和安全通道。报价确定了更换长度和型材、通道设备、排水沟工作、接缝处理、处置和喷漆。确认由谁来修理泄漏或防水以及是否包括任何衬里更换。

f5f3a02d82ab37e8b2e3.en: Send the affected roof edge and suburb, with any known lining material or earlier leak report. Optional ground-level photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
f5f3a02d82ab37e8b2e3.zh: 发送受影响的屋顶边缘和郊区，以及任何已知的衬里材料或早期的泄漏报告。可选的地面照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

7d69ef5a772a499889ef.zh: 檐口封板、山墙封边板和屋檐：哪部分需要维修？ ↗

a045275a64f172aba564.zh: Ellis Services Group 评估并更换损坏的面板木材。在确认维修范围和价格之前，我们会检查屋顶边缘、天沟支撑、湿气来源和安全通道。

Material handling and replacement are defined in the work plan; do not cut or sample unknown lining yourself.
d4c7dee2522b238295c9.zh: 我们在报价前识别衬里材料，检查其状况并计划安全进入。疑似石棉在拆动前通过合格途径进行评估。工作计划中规定了物料搬运和更换；请勿自行切割或取样未知衬里。

cc670d77c6a10e37edb2.zh: 堪培拉的室内木工，用于货架、镶板和翻新装修。确认预期用途、墙壁紧固件、材料连接处和安装范围。

4c1a5cfa95ad8f080f5c.en: Finished built-in shelving, wall panelling and interior joinery at a Canberra home
4c1a5cfa95ad8f080f5c.zh: 堪培拉住宅的成品内置搁架、墙板和室内木作制品

513b88eb10b769a658dc.zh: 层板、墙面镶板与装修收尾

8af69f0938c7698f41af.en: Interior fix-out can include shelves, timber panelling, fillers and junctions left unfinished after renovation. Identify the room and each fitted detail. Skirting and architraves have their own service page; a complete built-in storage layout belongs with custom joinery.
8af69f0938c7698f41af.zh: 内部装修可包括翻新后未完成的架子、木镶板、填充物和连接处。确定房间和每个安装细节。踢脚线和楣板有自己的服务页面；完整的内置收纳布局属于定制木作。

f1b3c1a6bcfb2f5c76bd.en: Show the wall or alcove, nearby openings and existing finishes. Mention patched plaster, uneven corners, damp marks or fittings that must stay accessible. Explain the intended shelf load and use: books, display objects and storage tubs place different demands on supports.
f1b3c1a6bcfb2f5c76bd.zh: 显示墙壁或壁龛、附近的开口和现有饰面。提及必须保持可触及的修补灰泥、凹凸不平的角落、潮湿痕迹或配件。解释预期的货架负载和用途：书籍、展示物品和储物桶对支撑有不同的要求。

bee32da4eca1ffa0805e.en: Interior timber details that need measuring and fitting
bee32da4eca1ffa0805e.zh: 需要测量和安装的室内木材细节

e4423735893cb6ccc0b9.en: Plan supports, corners and room junctions
e4423735893cb6ccc0b9.zh: 规划支撑、拐角和房间连接处

c0435151c4c1902eafec.en: Shelves need supports suited to their intended load and the wall material behind the finish. Timber wall panelling needs a layout around doors, corners, skirting and sockets. Standard shelving fitted on site differs from a complete cabinet requiring a measured design and component manufacture.
c0435151c4c1902eafec.zh: 搁架需要适合其预期负载的支撑以及饰面后面的墙壁材料。木墙板需要在门、角落、踢脚线和插座周围进行布局。现场安装的标准搁架与需要经过测量设计和部件制造的完整橱柜不同。

057a3c7ecb0496ad289c.en: Panelling is a decorative installation, not a waterproofing system. Electrical changes, plumbing, wet-area systems and work on load-bearing walls need the relevant qualified professionals. Heavy fixtures cannot be specified from the appearance of the wall alone.
057a3c7ecb0496ad289c.zh: 镶板是一种装饰装置，而不是防水系统。电力变更、管道、湿区系统和承重墙工作需要相关的合格专业人员。重型固定装置不能仅从墙壁的外观来指定。

7cc871940d83a2339d6c.en: At the on-site measure we check dimensions, fixing locations, concealed services and adjoining finishes. The installation plan and quote identify material supply, wall preparation, fitting, edge details and coating. Agree the sequence with flooring, plastering and cabinetry work before pieces are cut.
7cc871940d83a2339d6c.zh: 在现场测量中，我们检查尺寸、固定位置、隐蔽设施和毗邻饰面。安装计划和报价确定材料供应、墙壁准备、安装、边缘细节和涂层。在切割部件之前，请与地板、抹灰和橱柜工作的顺序达成一致。

4a9ceafb06e2f4d40767.en: Send the room, intended shelf use or panel layout and your suburb. Optional sketches, plans or safe photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au. Mention finishes that are still due to change.
4a9ceafb06e2f4d40767.zh: 发送房间、预期的货架用途或面板布局以及您的郊区。可选的草图、计划或在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。提及仍需更改的饰面。

635f88de27ff89303d75.zh: 我们在多个点测量凹室并检查固定基材和预期的货架负载。报价定义了实际墙壁的架子尺寸、支撑、划线和饰面。

8fc2dc79880df5187d95.zh: 不要假设这些包含物。木材安装范围确定安装和饰面；电气变化、湿区系统和其他专业工作需要他们自己确认的要求和责任。

e49dee35d013bf30499b.zh: 凉棚与廊檐木结构维修 | Ellis Services Group

a929154f29e80bd7b82a.en: Pergola and verandah timber repairs in Canberra. Assess post bases, beams, footings and attachments before defining support, replacement, access and finish.
a929154f29e80bd7b82a.zh: 堪培拉的凉棚和阳台木材维修。在定义支撑、更换、通道和饰面之前，评估柱基、横梁、基础和附件。

585e06cf0aaee19bc361.en: Separate screen damage from support damage
585e06cf0aaee19bc361.zh: 区分围挡板损坏与支撑损坏

9ee7efaba45c062dfae8.en: Repairing an existing pergola can concern a weathered screen batten, soft post base or damaged beam connection. These parts have different roles. Identify whether the structure is open or roofed and attached to the house; a roof support differs from a decorative screen board.
9ee7efaba45c062dfae8.zh: 修复现有凉棚可能涉及风化的屏板条、软柱底座或损坏的横梁连接。这些部分具有不同的作用。确定该结构是开放式的还是有屋顶的并与房屋相连；屋顶支撑不同于装饰屏板。

c2dc8131519cd81d2565.en: From ground level, describe softened bases, split joints, sagging or loose boards. Note pooling beside a footing, raised paving or irrigation near timber. Do not climb, lean on a suspect member or cut away a damaged post to investigate it.
c2dc8131519cd81d2565.zh: 从地面开始，描述软化的底座、裂开的接缝、下垂或松动的木板。注意基脚旁边的水池、高架路面或木材附近的灌溉。请勿攀爬、倚靠可疑成员或砍掉受损的柱子进行调查。

8c5a3d1ed0f5aff43239.en: Check the post, beam and connected structure

84c7a43e6eebb3b6e127.en: A post supports connected beams and possibly a roof. A local base repair needs suitable timber above it and an assessed connection; wider decay can require replacement of the post or adjoining members. The footing, roof attachments, temporary support and necessary engineering must be resolved before a post is disturbed.
84c7a43e6eebb3b6e127.zh: 柱子支撑连接的梁，也可能支撑屋顶。当地的基础修复需要其上方合适的木材和经过评估的连接；更广泛的腐烂可能需要更换柱子或相邻的成员。在柱子受到拆动之前，必须解决基础、屋顶附件、临时支撑和必要的工程问题。

02276352141f4c550acc.en: Adding a roof, changing the footprint or altering supports needs the applicable ACT approval checks. Roofing, drainage and electrical tasks require the relevant professionals. Ground contact and repeated wetting at a post base need attention alongside timber replacement.
02276352141f4c550acc.zh: 添加屋顶、改变占地面积或改变支撑需要适用的 ACT 批准检查。屋顶、排水和电气任务需要相关专业人员。在更换木材的同时，还需要注意柱基的地面接触和反复润湿。

6fe66931ea6737df2a4e.zh: 凉棚评估、支撑和收尾处理

f5da79c58481af3a5d61.en: The on-site assessment considers the assembly, moisture source and access. The quote identifies the members to keep or replace, timber, connections, safe support sequence, removal and finish. Painting or staining a local repair may remain visible beside older timber.
f5da79c58481af3a5d61.zh: 现场评估考虑装配、湿气来源和通道。报价确定了要保留或更换的构件、木材、连接、安全支撑顺序、拆除和完成。局部修复的油漆或染色可能在旧木材旁边仍然可见。

706fcdb2a19e86a46a38.en: Send your suburb and describe the affected structure, roofing and connection to the house. Optional safe ground-level photos or drawings can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
706fcdb2a19e86a46a38.zh: 发送您所在的郊区并描述受影响的结构、屋顶和与房屋的连接。可选的安全地面照片或图纸可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

3caed1555cdea9161fdd.zh: 凉棚柱腐烂：修复程度、支撑和湿度 ↗

a8fdd849eac8a63bd603.zh: 凉棚和阳台木材维修工作照片

5389b09f94d654ecac49.en: The post-base detail draws attention to the junction between retained and replacement timber. Its suitability for a particular structure follows assessment of the post, connections and footing.
5389b09f94d654ecac49.zh: 柱基细节引起人们对保留木材和替换木材之间的连接处的注意。其对特定结构的适用性取决于对柱子、连接和基础的评估。

664020bc762e84917c98.en: Repaired timber post base at a pergola or verandah
664020bc762e84917c98.zh: 凉棚或阳台上修复的木柱底座

95a5cc8a441eb55801bb.en: Renewed timber at the lower section of an outdoor post.
95a5cc8a441eb55801bb.zh: 室外柱子下部的更新木材。

0ada53c81642f147d171.en: We assess the pergola post together with its beams, connections, supports and load path before disturbance. Your repair plan defines safe temporary support, sound components to retain, replacement timber and the required structural or approval checks before the post is removed.
0ada53c81642f147d171.zh: 我们在拆动前评估凉棚柱及其横梁、连接件、支撑件和传力路径。您的维修计划定义了安全的临时支撑、要保留的完好部件、更换木材以及拆除柱子之前所需的结构或批准检查。

ed8dda398127fcd5769b.en: Rotten Timber Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
ed8dda398127fcd5769b.zh: 腐朽木材维修 | Ellis Services Group

ba3aff2777f162174619.en: Rotten timber repairs in Canberra. Identify moisture sources, sound retained sections and replacement needs, with finishing and access scoped before work.
ba3aff2777f162174619.zh: 堪培拉的腐烂木材修复。确定水分来源、完好的保留部分和更换需求，并在工作前确定收尾处理和进入范围。

d78751c791fcc33c0ef0.en: Locate decay and the source of wetting
d78751c791fcc33c0ef0.zh: 查找腐朽部位与受潮原因

ee5cb033a040f13e415c.en: Soft or crumbling timber can occur at a sill, jamb, fascia, weatherboard or outdoor member. The location matters: decorative trim and a load-bearing post cannot be repaired on the same assumptions. Name the component and affected length rather than requesting a general rot patch.
ee5cb033a040f13e415c.zh: 松软或易碎的木材可能出现在窗台、侧柱、檐口封板、外墙木挂板或室外构件处。位置很重要：装饰装饰和承重柱不能在相同的假设下修复。命名组件和受影响的长度，而不是请求一般的腐烂补丁。

61a978ac80a9995db68e.en: Recurring paint failure, softened end grain, open joints and trapped debris can point to repeated wetting. Record whether damage follows rain, irrigation or a known leak. Decay and insect damage can coexist, but pest activity needs a pest professional’s assessment; appearance alone does not identify it.
61a978ac80a9995db68e.zh: 反复出现的油漆失效、软化的端粒、开放的接缝和残留的碎片可能表明反复润湿。记录是否因下雨、灌溉或已知泄漏而造成损坏。腐烂和虫害可以共存，但害虫活动需要害虫专业人士的评估；仅凭外观并不能识别它。

f20e84f19b040cfe235e.en: Soft timber at an exterior opening

f1850d2a0cf0a630340d.en: A damaged section requiring on-site inspection
f1850d2a0cf0a630340d.zh: 需要现场检查的损坏部分

81a4b82a1f850db514b3.en: Replace decay back to sound timber
81a4b82a1f850db514b3.zh: 更换腐朽部分并连接到完好木材

07c3bac5b5daef56cd98.en: A fitted repair section needs sound timber at the joint and a connection suited to the component. Decay continuing through the joint may require a longer replacement or the whole member. Filler can finish an appropriate surface repair, but filler and paint do not restore the strength of decayed supporting timber.
07c3bac5b5daef56cd98.zh: 安装的维修部分需要在接缝处使用坚固的木材以及适合该部件的连接。通过接头继续腐烂可能需要更长的更换时间或整个构件。填料可以完成适当的表面修复，但填料和油漆不能恢复腐烂支撑木材的强度。

10c765b7d068acddfcd9.en: Roofing or plumbing defects must be addressed by the relevant trade, and load-bearing damage needs qualified assessment before disturbance. A dry surface after a dry spell does not prove that the earlier water path has stopped or that concealed timber is sound.
10c765b7d068acddfcd9.zh: 屋顶或管道缺陷必须由相关专业人员解决，承重损坏需要在拆动前进行合格评估。干燥期后表面干燥并不能证明先前的水路已经停止或隐藏的木材是完好的。

21028c0393dd7b512e2f.en: Assess the damage and agree the protective finish
21028c0393dd7b512e2f.zh: 评估损坏情况并同意保护性表面处理

07469d1dcd861eef9c12.en: The on-site assessment checks the affected component, adjoining timber and likely moisture source. The quote covers removal, replacement timber, fixings, access and coating preparation. If opening the agreed area reveals further decay, the finding and added work are discussed before the repair is extended.
07469d1dcd861eef9c12.zh: 现场评估检查受影响的部件、相邻木材和可能的水分源。报价涵盖拆除、更换木材、紧固件、通道和涂层准备。如果打开约定的区域后发现进一步腐烂，则在延长修复之前会讨论发现的情况和增加的工作。

234c16d19cbac20a5287.en: Send the timber location, repeated wetting or earlier repair history and your suburb. Optional safe photos and existing leak or pest reports can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
234c16d19cbac20a5287.zh: 发送木材位置、重复润湿或早期维修历史以及您所在的郊区。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片和现有泄漏或害虫报告可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。
