d83249fd1ea7c61084c0.zh: 为什么木材修复后又会腐烂 ↗

af61c61b79b6ec1371aa.en: Damaged exterior timber is removed to prepare the repair.
af61c61b79b6ec1371aa.zh: 损坏的外部木材被移除以准备修复。

c35119faac4ea3bdfe1f.en: Close view of a finished painted timber window detail
c35119faac4ea3bdfe1f.zh: 成品彩绘木窗细节特写

27f36dc97ec3fc98c910.en: A repaired timber junction with a protective painted finish.
27f36dc97ec3fc98c910.zh: 修复后的木材连接处，涂有保护性漆面。

372090d07c53e3910c47.en: Deteriorated painted timber frame and sill before repair assessment
372090d07c53e3910c47.zh: 修复评估前劣化的涂漆木框架和窗台

2823ce602227a24dc9d6.en: Decay at the lower frame and sill junction.
2823ce602227a24dc9d6.zh: 下框架和门槛连接处腐烂。

309cd321340c485f7d07.en: The moisture source needs attention alongside the damaged timber. Ellis checks recurring wetting, joints, coatings and nearby water paths, then defines timber replacement and finishing. Any roofing, plumbing or pest work must be confirmed with the relevant specialist before the repair sequence is agreed.
309cd321340c485f7d07.zh: 除了受损木材之外，还需要注意水分来源。 Ellis 检查经常性的润湿、接缝、涂层和附近的水路，然后确定木材的更换和表面与收边处理。在商定维修顺序之前，任何屋顶、管道或害虫工程都必须得到相关专家的确认。

1fa5b6e534ac9fe664b1.en: We define the repair joint at sound timber and check the role of the affected component. The quote identifies the sections to retain and replace and the moisture detail to address.
1fa5b6e534ac9fe664b1.zh: 我们在完好的木材上定义修复接头并检查受影响部件的作用。报价指出了要保留和更换的部分以及要解决的湿度细节。

b3b8753136c8cd7fdaf2.en: Skirting & Architraves Canberra | Ellis Services Group
b3b8753136c8cd7fdaf2.zh: 踢脚线与门窗套线 | Ellis Services Group

fe3481b7c2cf99360c62.en: Skirting boards and architraves in Canberra. Measure profiles and floor junctions, then confirm removal, supply, installation, caulking and painting inclusions.
fe3481b7c2cf99360c62.zh: 堪培拉的踢脚线和楣板。测量型材和地板连接处，然后确认拆卸、供应、安装、填缝和喷漆内容。

c1434180e4b786ce0333.en: Match the profile and finished junction
c1434180e4b786ce0333.zh: 匹配线条造型与完成面交接

5492ccfb812042ab5afe.en: Skirting boards finish the wall-to-floor junction; architraves finish around doors and windows. A match involves height, thickness, shaped profile and material, not just colour. State whether you want a short repair beside retained trim or a changed profile throughout a room.
5492ccfb812042ab5afe.zh: 踢脚线完成墙壁与地板的连接处；门窗周围有门窗套线。匹配涉及高度、厚度、形状轮廓和材料，而不仅仅是颜色。说明您是否想要在保留的装饰旁边进行短暂修复，或者改变整个房间的轮廓。

13e061b4c8ddbdc1b60a.en: Identify missing lengths after flooring, open mitres, swollen boards and trim pulled from the wall. Timber and manufactured boards such as MDF respond differently to moisture and edge damage. Swollen material needs its water source checked before replacement; an open joint alone does not mean the whole run has failed.
13e061b4c8ddbdc1b60a.zh: 识别地板、开放斜角、膨胀的板和从墙上拉下的装饰后缺失的长度。木材和人造板（如中密度纤维板）对潮湿和边缘损坏的反应不同。膨胀材料更换前需检查水源；单独的开放接头并不意味着整个运行失败。

cd9781c724dfd7f733d2.zh: 门窗套线部分损坏或缺失

ad227596f5fda56a4a81.en: A trim profile that needs matching

2653dbe8989cc04b0739.en: Fit trim to the floor and adjoining openings
2653dbe8989cc04b0739.zh: 协调收边线条、地面和相邻门窗洞口

df240e26517d629f5a99.en: The finished floor level and flooring system determine when and how skirting is fitted. Corners, returns and architrave junctions need more than a perimeter measurement. If a new floor makes a door rub, its clearance must be checked separately. Skirting does not solve a door fault.
df240e26517d629f5a99.zh: 成品地板水平和地板系统决定何时以及如何安装踢脚线。角落、回程和门窗套线连接处需要的不仅仅是周长测量。如果新地板使门产生摩擦，则必须单独检查其间隙。踢脚线不能解决门故障。

ff6ebf285668ecb5ee16.en: MDF and timber can differ in edge durability and response to wetting. Choose the material for the room and selected coating; a moisture-resistant description does not establish suitability for every wet location. The source of swollen trim must be addressed before new lengths are installed.
ff6ebf285668ecb5ee16.zh: MDF 和木材在边缘耐用性和对润湿的响应方面可能有所不同。选择房间的材料和所选的涂层；防潮描述并不适用于所有潮湿的地方。在安装新长度之前，必须解决装饰件肿胀的根源。

b2fa9df9dd60b81501c8.zh: 收边线条的测量、供料与涂装

9fa922ebe1a2b64e9ea9.en: At the on-site measure we check profiles, openings, corners and final floor levels. The installation plan and quote specify removal, disposal, supplied or customer-supplied trim, joints, caulking, priming and painting. An older profile may need an agreed close match, and adjoining wall or floor repairs must be listed separately.
9fa922ebe1a2b64e9ea9.zh: 在现场测量中，我们检查轮廓、开口、拐角和最终楼层水平。安装计划和报价指定了拆卸、处置、提供或客户提供的装饰、接头、填缝、底漆和涂漆。较旧的截面造型可能需要商定的紧密匹配，并且相邻墙壁或地板的维修必须单独列出。

bf717f04c6e956f08623.en: Send the rooms or openings, suburb and flooring stage. Optional profile photos or plans can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au. Check the selected profile and dimensions before buying lengths.
bf717f04c6e956f08623.zh: 发送房间或空缺、郊区和楼层舞台。可选的个人资料照片或计划可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。购买长度之前，请检查所选的型材和尺寸。

9778f772870ac8b5146f.en: Plan skirting around the finished floor level ↗
9778f772870ac8b5146f.zh: 在完成的楼层周围规划踢脚线 ↗

ffc6f49f187c9c06123b.zh: 协调其他房间收尾处理细节 ↗

b2d2049565fcd731617e.zh: 踢脚线和门窗套线工作照片

01ada0c0976bf5ccc4d2.en: Skirting, door surrounds and floor transitions illustrate why profile height, thickness and adjoining levels matter together. A safe close-up of existing trim can help discuss the match before the on-site measure.
01ada0c0976bf5ccc4d2.zh: 踢脚线、门框和地板过渡区说明了为何型材高度、厚度和相邻水平面共同重要。对现有装饰进行安全特写有助于在现场测量之前讨论比赛。

1d69ef03e789e6b74a34.en: Close view of skirting board, door trim and floor transition
1d69ef03e789e6b74a34.zh: 踢脚线、门饰和地板过渡的近视图

159ba4bd29c2e5f452b5.en: Ellis measures the existing skirting profile, height and room lengths and reviews available matching material. Supply, installation, joints and finishing are defined in your quote.
159ba4bd29c2e5f452b5.zh: Ellis 测量现有踢脚线轮廓、高度和房间长度，并审查可用的匹配材料。供应、安装、接头和表面与收边处理均在您的报价中定义。

10d5acf3b4570604a16b.en: We check the condition and fixings of the existing skirting and the finished floor level. The scope identifies boards to retain or replace, removal, refitting and finishing.
10d5acf3b4570604a16b.zh: 我们检查现有踢脚线和成品地板的状况和固定情况。该范围确定了要保留或更换、拆除、改装和修整的板。

7b8065de98bd09703f71.en: Small Carpentry Jobs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
7b8065de98bd09703f71.zh: 小型木工项目 | Ellis Services Group

a8cbbff0550f9e155c99.en: Small carpentry jobs in Canberra. Group doors, trim and cupboard repairs in a task list, with materials, access and quote arrangements confirmed before booking.
a8cbbff0550f9e155c99.zh: 堪培拉的小型木工工作。将门、装饰和橱柜维修分组到任务列表中，并在预约前确认材料、进出条件和报价安排。

df9c31e5f09844f1ebeb.en: Timber side gate showing weathered and renewed sections
df9c31e5f09844f1ebeb.zh: 木质侧门显示风化和更新部分

f2f07dcb7e6138fbd8d4.en: Doors, trim, shelves and cupboard fittings
f2f07dcb7e6138fbd8d4.zh: 门、装饰、架子和橱柜配件

b63386e2683e0e314870.en: A short repair list can include a sticking timber door, loose shelf, damaged skirting and a cupboard hinge. These items may suit one enquiry, but each needs its own material and fixing check. Write one task per line, grouped by room or outdoor area, and say whether the priority is operation, appearance or replacing a damaged part.
b63386e2683e0e314870.zh: 一份简短的维修清单可以包括卡住的木门、松动的架子、损坏的踢脚线和橱柜铰链。这些项目可能适合一项咨询，但每一项都需要自己的材料和固定检查。每行写一个任务，按房间或室外区域分组，并说明优先级是操作、外观还是更换损坏部件。

faeeae11f51197ac39a5.en: Describe what happens in normal use: the door scrapes the floor, a shelf moves at its bracket, or trim has swollen near a wet area. Note recent flooring, painting or leaks. This helps distinguish a small adjustment from damaged supporting material; do not dismantle an item for photos.
faeeae11f51197ac39a5.zh: 描述正常使用时会发生什么情况：门刮伤地板、架子在支架上移动，或者装饰在潮湿区域附近肿胀。注意最近的地板、油漆或渗漏情况。这有助于区分微小的调整和损坏的支撑材料；请勿为了拍照而拆卸物品。

c5dd5153fb4a947f0e58.en: A list of small repairs before a sale or tenancy change
c5dd5153fb4a947f0e58.zh: 出售或租赁变更前的小修缮清单

c1a22bb64b42deb26ba0.en: Interior and exterior timber items that need attention
c1a22bb64b42deb26ba0.zh: 需要注意的室内外木材物品

9480be8e45c611637ec7.en: Adjust a sound fitting or replace damaged material
9480be8e45c611637ec7.zh: 调整完好配件或更换损坏的材料

6b808fd534288e8c00f9.en: A loose shelf bracket needs a firm fixing surface; tightening a screw in damaged material may leave it loose again. A sticking door needs its hinges and clearances checked, while replacement trim needs a matching profile. These checks determine whether adjustment, new hardware or timber replacement is appropriate.
6b808fd534288e8c00f9.zh: 松动的搁板支架需要牢固的固定表面；拧紧损坏材料上的螺钉可能会使其再次松动。卡住的门需要检查其铰链和间隙，而更换装饰件需要匹配的轮廓。这些检查确定调整、新硬件或木材更换是否合适。

292bf5bc4fba07ed91d9.en: Electrical, plumbing, glazing and load-bearing work need the relevant qualified professional. Include known leaks or damaged supports in the list so these dependencies can be resolved before the carpentry is booked.
292bf5bc4fba07ed91d9.zh: 电气、管道、玻璃和承重工作需要相关合格的专业人员。在列表中包括已知的泄漏或损坏的支撑，以便可以在预约木工之前解决这些依赖性。

5d9ed8b403666a30281d.en: Assessment and quote for a mixed repair list
5d9ed8b403666a30281d.zh: 多个维修项目的现场查看与报价

10824c68b77ce8a67620.en: At the on-site assessment, we check the listed components, fixing points and access. The quote identifies the accepted tasks, labour, materials, hardware, removal, disposal and any painting. Ask about assessment, call-out or minimum booking charges before accepting a visit; an hourly rate alone does not describe the completed work.
10824c68b77ce8a67620.zh: 在现场评估中，我们检查列出的组件、固定点和通道。报价确定了接受的任务、劳动力、材料、硬件、拆除、处置和任何油漆。在接受拜访之前询问评估、上门服务或最低预约费用；仅每小时费率并不能描述已完成的工作。

0e80d6b43adbe789f1d7.en: Send your task list, suburb and priorities, with one item per line. For an occupied home or tenancy, name the authorised access contact. Optional safe photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au; a description is enough to start.
0e80d6b43adbe789f1d7.zh: 发送您的任务列表、郊区和优先级，每行一项。对于有人居住的房屋或租赁，请注明授权进出条件联系人。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au；一个描述就足以开始。

1de270ac8a143995c977.en: Planning a small repair list before selling a home ↗
1de270ac8a143995c977.zh: 在出售房屋之前规划一份小型维修清单 ↗

ff405808eead3321eeec.en: Send your small-repair list to Ellis ↗
ff405808eead3321eeec.zh: 将您的小修清单发送至 Ellis ↗

2d75820a34730b2165f6.en: Weathered and renewed sections of a timber side gate.
2d75820a34730b2165f6.zh: 木质侧门的风化和更新部分。

ee91ce1ac065802e25f9.en: Can I compare a small-job quote using an hourly rate alone?
ee91ce1ac065802e25f9.zh: 我可以仅使用小时费率来比较小规模工作报价吗？

bbf954be9cf6e74e6b7f.en: Not reliably. Compare the task list, material supply, access, disposal and finishing as well as the labour pricing basis. Ask Ellis to confirm any visit or minimum booking charge for your enquiry.
bbf954be9cf6e74e6b7f.zh: 不可靠。比较任务清单、材料供应、获取、处置和收尾处理以及劳动力定价基础。请联系 Ellis 确认您咨询的任何上门查看费用或最低预约费用。

850c5a63c0277ac0d522.en: Structural Timber Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
850c5a63c0277ac0d522.zh: 承重木结构维修 | Ellis Services Group

07d9e843aa9a00ea39b6.en: Structural timber repairs in Canberra. Define damaged members, assessment, engineering and ACT requirements before agreeing support and replacement work.
07d9e843aa9a00ea39b6.zh: 堪培拉的结构木材维修。在同意支持和更换工作之前，定义受损构件、评估、工程和 ACT 要求。

d0fa61b6d5b79245f319.en: Structural timber repair enquiries for damaged framing, joists, bearers and supports. The affected member needs qualified assessment and any necessary engineering before a repair method is agreed.
d0fa61b6d5b79245f319.zh: 承接受损木框架、托梁、承梁和支撑部件的维修咨询。约定维修方法前，应由具备相应资质的人员评估受损构件，并完成必要的工程设计或检查。

063d0eb183110250a4f3.en: Timber bearers and joists inspected below an existing deck
063d0eb183110250a4f3.zh: 在现有露台下方检查木梁和托梁

5f255af88b73242511c5.en: A joist, bearer, framing member or support post can carry loads beyond the damaged area. Splits, sagging, decay and reported insect damage need assessment of the member and connections. A patch cannot be selected from one exposed face or photograph.
5f255af88b73242511c5.zh: 托梁、支架、框架构件或支撑柱可以将负载承载到损坏区域之外。裂缝、下垂、腐烂和报告的虫害需要对构件和连接进行评估。无法从一张曝光的脸部或照片中选择色块。

4d2be86b0cf6b06dd21c.en: Describe the member’s location and provide engineer, pest or leak reports if available. Timber repair after termite treatment is separate from diagnosing or treating active infestation. Do not remove finishes, enter unsafe subfloor spaces or test a suspect area with weight for an enquiry.
4d2be86b0cf6b06dd21c.zh: 描述会员的位置并提供工程师、虫害或泄漏报告（如果有）。白蚁处理后的木材修复与诊断或治疗活动性侵扰是分开的。请勿拆除饰面、进入不安全的底层地板空间或用重量测试可疑区域进行咨询。

98a8d039b1f2ad9b7e47.en: Timber damage remaining after pest treatment
98a8d039b1f2ad9b7e47.zh: 虫害处理后剩余的木材损坏

ea23ca48e0e1575fb0f9.en: Movement or softness in a load-bearing component
ea23ca48e0e1575fb0f9.zh: 承重部件的运动或柔软度

bd5bc6bfa101ad4df809.en: The member’s role and connections determine how loads pass through the structure. Damage in a bearer can affect several joists above it; an isolated surface view cannot establish what is safe to keep. Qualified structural assessment, necessary engineering and approval checks come before choosing replacement sections or temporary support.
bd5bc6bfa101ad4df809.zh: 成员的角色和联系决定荷载如何通过结构。支架损坏可能会影响其上方的多个托梁；孤立的表面视图无法确定什么是安全保存的。在选择替换部分或临时支撑之前，需要进行由具备相应资质的人员进行结构评估、必要的工程和批准检查。

93ee176d93c5fe10c3d0.en: Leak correction and active pest treatment belong with their respective specialists. A termite treatment record does not establish the remaining strength of damaged timber. Do not remove finishes or disturb a support while inspection and the safe work sequence are unresolved.
93ee176d93c5fe10c3d0.zh: 泄漏修复和积极的害虫处理属于各自的专家。白蚁处理记录并不能确定受损木材的剩余强度。在检查和安全工作顺序未解决时，请勿拆除饰面或拆动支撑。

d377d1cf9aa5fa0aa10c.en: The on-site assessment and repair proposal must identify who performs the structural inspection and any engineering, how inspection access is provided, and which members, connections and temporary supports are involved. The quote records the agreed work; concealed findings are discussed before additional replacement proceeds.
d377d1cf9aa5fa0aa10c.zh: 现场评估和维修建议必须确定谁执行结构检查和任何工程、如何提供检查通道以及涉及哪些构件、连接和临时支撑。报价记录了约定的工作；在额外的更换收益之前讨论隐藏的发现。

bca57be313038338ce90.en: Send the component location, suburb and any existing engineer, pest or leak reports. Optional safe photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au. Avoid the affected area if it appears unstable.
bca57be313038338ce90.zh: 发送组件位置、郊区和任何现有的工程师、害虫或泄漏报告。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。如果受影响的区域看起来不稳定，请避开它​​。

90aafa41acd6035f79ed.en: Moisture causes to address alongside damaged supporting timber ↗
90aafa41acd6035f79ed.zh: 湿气导致损坏的支撑木材旁边出现 ↗

e4416edd6e1f615b9191.zh: 结构木材修复工作照片

f1c82e52efb29ce860ba.en: Bearers, joists and connections below a timber deck.
f1c82e52efb29ce860ba.zh: 木露台下方的支架、托梁和连接件。

001bf42f22603d58a643.en: Yes. Existing termite-treatment and pest reports help define the enquiry. Timber replacement still needs assessment of the members and connections, with qualified structural and engineering requirements confirmed before a scope is priced. Treatment records do not establish the remaining strength of timber.
001bf42f22603d58a643.zh: 是的。现有的白蚁处理和害虫报告有助于确定调查范围。木材更换仍需要对构件和连接进行评估，并在范围定价之前确认合格的结构和工程要求。处理记录并不能确定木材的剩余强度。

a808bfc27695608d7800.en: Timber Fence Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
a808bfc27695608d7800.zh: 木围栏维修 | Ellis Services Group

9da3560bdb0315557205.en: Timber fence repairs in Canberra for posts, rails, palings and pickets. Compare retained sections with replacement and confirm boundary access and disposal.
9da3560bdb0315557205.zh: 堪培拉的木栅栏维修，用于柱子、横档、栅栏和围栏竖条。将保留的部分与替换的部分进行比较，并确认边界进出条件和处置。

608101add64c6537a05e.en: Completed timber fence with renewed posts and rails
608101add64c6537a05e.zh: 已完成的木栅栏，带有更新的柱子和栏杆

e626180fb7d35721dd37.en: A leaning run differs from a broken paling
e626180fb7d35721dd37.zh: 整段围栏倾斜与单块竖板破损的区别

2c3baa478f10e3af0ef5.en: A missing paling may need one replacement board; a leaning section can involve a post base, footing or rail connection. We assess posts, rails and palings together before choosing local repair or replacing a longer run. Identify the style, affected length and whether a gate hangs from the damaged post.
2c3baa478f10e3af0ef5.zh: 缺失的木板可能需要一块更换板；倾斜部分可能涉及柱底座、基础或轨道连接。在选择局部维修或更换较长线路之前，我们会一起评估立柱、栏杆和栅栏。确定样式、受影响的长度以及门是否悬挂在损坏的柱子上。

b7b2f44f706223659cd3.en: Record loose boards, broken rails, a lean and softness near ground level. Show both sides only where access is permitted and safe. Note irrigation, soil build-up and drainage near posts. Do not push an unstable fence to demonstrate movement; photos cannot establish its below-ground condition.
b7b2f44f706223659cd3.zh: 记录松动的木板、破损的横档、接近地面的倾斜和柔软度。仅在允许且安全的情况下显示两侧。注意柱子附近的灌溉、土壤堆积和排水。请勿推动不稳定的栅栏来演示移动；照片无法确定其地下状况。

dada1e0344d2551d84b5.en: A post or rail showing damage
dada1e0344d2551d84b5.zh: 显示损坏的柱子或栏杆

519ef66ef364e81ebb90.en: Check the posts and rail connections

6df9bd1193c6c583266e.en: Posts carry the rails, and the rails carry the palings. Replacing one failing post may require adjacent rails and boards to be taken down and refitted. Their condition and fixing points determine what can stay. A different fence height, line or style also changes the work beyond a local repair.
6df9bd1193c6c583266e.zh: 柱子承载着横档，横档承载着栅栏。更换一根失效的柱子可能需要拆除并重新安装相邻的横档和板。它们的状况和固定点决定了什么可以留下来。不同的栅栏高度、线条或样式也会改变局部修复之外的工作。

e9c749fd72f325767a6b.en: Boundary position, permission for access and owner agreement must be settled before shared-boundary work. A carpentry quote describes the physical repair; it does not decide either owner’s contribution. Retaining structures, metal fences and safety barriers have different requirements.
e9c749fd72f325767a6b.zh: 边界位置、进入许可和业主协议必须在共享边界工作之前解决。木工报价描述了物理修复；它不决定任何所有者的贡献。挡土结构、金属围栏和安全屏障有不同的要求。

8e2928eae1ce45b81af8.en: Fence measurements, access and quote inclusions
8e2928eae1ce45b81af8.zh: 栅栏测量、进出条件和报价内容

6fab1974abf39c14f9d2.en: During the on-site assessment we check alignment, accessible post bases and rail-to-post connections. The quote identifies the affected length, posts, rails, boards, footings, disposal and finish. Gardens, narrow side paths and neighbour-side access can affect how the section is reached and dismantled.
6fab1974abf39c14f9d2.zh: 在现场评估期间，我们检查对齐情况、可触及的柱底座以及轨与柱的连接。报价中标明了受影响的长度、柱子、导轨、木板、基础、处置和饰面。花园、狭窄的小路和邻居侧的通道可能会影响该部分的到达和拆除方式。

20456eff25b61f330cc1.en: Send your suburb, the affected fence length and whether a gate hangs from the damaged section. Optional safe photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
20456eff25b61f330cc1.zh: 发送您所在的郊区、受影响的围栏长度以及受损部分是否悬挂着院门。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

ff90f9d5c984c6443f17.en: Leaning paling fences: posts, rails and repair options ↗
ff90f9d5c984c6443f17.zh: 倾斜栅栏：柱子、栏杆和维修选项 ↗

1db78e8369475a0369be.en: The finished fence run with renewed posts, rails and timber palings.
1db78e8369475a0369be.zh: 完工的围栏配有更新的柱子、栏杆和木栅栏。

2e894ca0eaeb49674842.en: Leaning timber fence with weathered rails and damaged lower palings before repair
2e894ca0eaeb49674842.zh: 倾斜的木栅栏，其栏杆已风化，下层木板在修复前已损坏

90ab256ac284451dd206.en: Leaning fence sections and damaged lower palings before the repair work.
90ab256ac284451dd206.zh: 修复工作前栅栏部分倾斜且下部木板损坏。

32085b888670e9409a7f.en: Ellis Services carpenter fixing renewed timber rails to fence posts
32085b888670e9409a7f.zh: Ellis 服务木工将更新的木轨固定到栅栏柱上

8f613b2a2defcc84620c.en: New timber rails are fitted and fixed to the fence posts.
8f613b2a2defcc84620c.zh: 新的木栏杆安装并固定在栅栏柱上。

e1cc027dc64a2f03503f.en: Close view of renewed timber fence rails and bolted post connections
e1cc027dc64a2f03503f.zh: 更新的木栅栏横档和螺栓柱连接的近距离视图

e538b694d1541ba5cb3f.en: A close view of the renewed rail-to-post connections and fixings.
e538b694d1541ba5cb3f.zh: 更新后的轨到柱连接和紧固件的近距离视图。

9f9e8e7cd658d24f4795.en: Ellis checks the posts, rails, palings, fixings and affected fence length on site. We compare local support repairs with replacement and identify sound sections to retain. Your quote explains the support work, materials and access included in each option so you can choose the scope.
9f9e8e7cd658d24f4795.zh: Ellis 检查现场的柱子、栏杆、栅栏、紧固件和受影响的围栏长度。我们将本地支撑维修与更换进行比较，并确定要保留的完好部分。您的报价解释了每个选项中包含的支持工作、材料和现场进入条件，以便您可以选择范围。

b2a7ed3d0c2775697b90.en: Timber Gate Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
b2a7ed3d0c2775697b90.zh: 木院门维修 | Ellis Services Group

cf83ed1674d8dbcf1d07.en: Timber gate repairs in Canberra. Check sagging frames, hinge fixings, posts, latches and clearance before comparing adjustment with timber replacement.
cf83ed1674d8dbcf1d07.zh: 堪培拉的木院门维修。在将调整与木材更换进行比较之前，检查下垂的框架、铰链紧固件、支柱、闩锁和间隙。

74a8565fba618b63602d.en: Timber boundary gate and fence at a Canberra home
74a8565fba618b63602d.zh: 堪培拉住宅的木质边界门和栅栏

3e401e5b14d41221765d.en: Find what changes the gate alignment

637ea294e124a3a826b4.en: A dragging timber gate can have a sagging frame, loose hinge fixings or a moving post. Raising the latch or shortening the bottom edge may leave the cause. Identify whether it is a garden or side-access gate and where it catches during normal operation.
637ea294e124a3a826b4.zh: 拖动木院门可能有下垂的框架、松动的铰链固定件或移动的柱子。升高闩锁或缩短底部边缘可能会留下原因。确定它是花园门还是侧门，以及正常运行时卡在哪里。

b7eb7e54bf50aa52022c.en: Show the closed gate, gaps, hinge fixing points and post base safely. Mention new paving, fence repair or seasonal swelling after rain. If the post moves with the gate, the support needs attention before final hinge and latch alignment can be set.
b7eb7e54bf50aa52022c.zh: 安全地显示关闭的门、间隙、铰链固定点和柱座。提及新铺路、栅栏修复或雨后季节性肿胀。如果立柱随门移动，则在设置最终铰链和闩锁对齐之前需要注意支撑件。

732452228d857c7a2692.en: A gate that drags or will not close

4512ea979babf6666ee8.en: A hinge pulling away from timber

f22c6280af4cbd8bb543.en: A soft or moving gate post

74fcd999eddcd3d74bdc.en: Repair the post, hinges or gate frame

6cda02c8f08671c67cc2.en: Hinges transfer the gate’s weight to the post and need sound fixing timber. Adjustment or new hardware may suit a sound assembly. A distorted or decayed gate frame may need local repair or replacement, while a moving post still needs attention before final alignment.
6cda02c8f08671c67cc2.zh: 铰链将门的重量转移到门柱上，需要完好固定木材。调整或新硬件可能适合完好组件。扭曲或腐烂的门框可能需要局部修复或更换，而移动的柱子在最终对齐之前仍然需要注意。

d7ed27679d4a1eb040f9.en: A motorised drive or wiring requires a qualified gate or electrical specialist. Safety-barrier gates and fixings into masonry have their own requirements. Timber work must not bypass those checks or alter a safety function without appropriate assessment.
d7ed27679d4a1eb040f9.zh: 电动驱动器或接线需要合格的门或电气专家。安全屏障门和砖石固定件有其自己的要求。在没有适当评估的情况下，木材加工不得绕过这些检查或改变安全功能。

94c88f77672457fdb600.zh: 院门间隙、五金与收边处理

e721923f0615f8f84e7c.en: The on-site assessment checks the post, accessible footing, hinges, latch and gate frame together. The quote lists post or frame work, hardware supply, removal and finish. Clearance must allow for the finished path and the full swing; mention new paving, planting or shared access that affects the opening.
e721923f0615f8f84e7c.zh: 现场评估同时检查柱子、可触及的基础、铰链、门闩和门框。报价列出了柱子或框架、硬件供应、拆卸和表面处理。间隙必须允许完成路径和全挥杆；提及影响开口的新铺路、种植或共享通道。

93a1ffdd8e4b494bfa76.en: Send the gate location, fault and suburb. Optional safe photographs can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au. Mention pets or security needs if the gate is the only access to the yard.
93a1ffdd8e4b494bfa76.zh: 发送门位置、故障和郊区。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。如果院门是通往院子的唯一通道，请提及宠物或安全需求。

b5eed221c1018edb4f85.en: Why timber gates sag: hinges, frames and posts ↗
b5eed221c1018edb4f85.zh: 为什么木院门下垂：铰链、框架和门柱 ↗

c8a670c521cd8bef8ad2.en: Close view of timber gate hinge, latch and fence post
c8a670c521cd8bef8ad2.zh: 木院门铰链、门闩和栅栏柱的近视图

f48511466bbf1405bbaf.en: Carpenters building a timber gate and fence
f48511466bbf1405bbaf.zh: 木工建造木院门和栅栏

4b96cd1f1c1d68e8f4d0.en: Posts, fence panels and gate hardware being fitted on site.
4b96cd1f1c1d68e8f4d0.zh: 现场安装柱子、栅栏板和院门硬件。

4c3b4bf8bcc34de00d59.en: Contact Ellis for a sagging timber gate. We check the post, hinges, frame, latch and clearance on site and confirm the adjustment, support repair or replacement in your quote.
4c3b4bf8bcc34de00d59.zh: 请联系 Ellis 了解下垂的木院门。我们在现场检查立柱、铰链、框架、闩锁和间隙，并在您的报价中确认调整、支持维修或更换。

7d99bcb6638ecc02d817.en: We assess the gate leaf as well as its posts and hinges. The quote identifies the existing gate components suitable for retention and the support or hardware repairs required.
7d99bcb6638ecc02d817.zh: 我们评估门叶及其门柱和铰链。报价确定了适合保留的现有门组件以及所需的支持或硬件维修。

a4edd8234bf3fa94b954.en: Stair & Handrail Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
a4edd8234bf3fa94b954.zh: 木楼梯与扶手维修 | Ellis Services Group

a754eed6c106449066a5.en: Timber stair and handrail repairs in Canberra. Assess loose treads, supports, rail joints and anchorage, then define access, replacement and finishing.
a754eed6c106449066a5.zh: 堪培拉的木楼梯和扶手维修。评估松动的踏板、支撑、钢轨接头和锚固，然后确定通道、更换和修整。

00dbccb1d6a03eb5a2e7.en: Timber stairs and handrail inside a Canberra home
00dbccb1d6a03eb5a2e7.zh: 堪培拉住宅内的木楼梯和扶手

a5e95dba15d7622f640c.en: Locate movement in the step or rail
a5e95dba15d7622f640c.zh: 查找台阶或扶手松动的位置

578460ed7b3389732f76.en: A loose tread, damaged step edge and moving handrail need different checks. Tread support and handrail anchorage are safety-critical components: a screw or cosmetic patch cannot be selected without assessing the supporting material. This page concerns existing repairs rather than a new staircase design.
578460ed7b3389732f76.zh: 松动的胎面、损坏的台阶边缘和移动的扶手需要不同的检查。踏板支撑和扶手锚固是安全关键组件：在不评估支撑材料的情况下无法选择螺钉或装饰补片。本页涉及现有的维修而不是新的楼梯设计。

48335208185578c07503.en: Describe the affected step, rail joint or bracket and whether it is internal or external. A safe view of the flight and landing gives context. Avoid using an unstable area or relying on a moving rail, and do not add weight to demonstrate movement for a photograph.
48335208185578c07503.zh: 描述受影响的台阶、导轨接头或支架以及其是内部还是外部。飞行和着陆的安全视图提供了背景信息。避免使用不稳定的区域或依赖移动的轨道，并且不要增加重量来展示照片的移动。

ed93f4d89cf744f46e44.en: Check tread supports and handrail anchors
ed93f4d89cf744f46e44.zh: 检查踏板支撑和扶手锚固件

7634e3be5e85c666b75a.en: A tread is the surface underfoot; a stringer is a sloping member supporting the steps. A rail bracket needs sound material behind it. A local replacement may suit an isolated fault, but movement through the flight, landing or barrier needs assessment of the connected supports and any necessary structural input.
7634e3be5e85c666b75a.zh: 胎面是脚下的表面；纵梁是支撑台阶的倾斜构件。导轨支架后面需要坚固的材料。局部替换可能适合孤立的故障，但通过飞行、着陆或障碍物的移动需要对连接的支撑和任何必要的结构输入进行评估。

6fa69ea9f63d69e507c4.en: Changing a stair layout or barrier design is different from replacing a damaged component. The connection, anchorage and applicable ACT requirements must be established before work. A matching board or fresh coat of paint does not establish that a stair is safe.
6fa69ea9f63d69e507c4.zh: 更改楼梯布局或屏障设计与更换损坏的组件不同。工作前必须确定连接、锚固和适用的 ACT 要求。匹配的木板或新油漆并不能证明楼梯是安全的。

77647b9cb790487a3de6.en: Stair assessment, access and repair inclusions
77647b9cb790487a3de6.zh: 楼梯评估、通道和维修内容

72154d7b87b4edf7275c.en: At the on-site assessment we check accessible treads, risers, supports, rail joints and fixing material. The quote names replacements, connections, access and finish, including how entry is managed while the stair is unavailable. Outdoor steps also need drainage and weather exposure considered.
72154d7b87b4edf7275c.zh: 在现场评估中，我们检查可触及的踏板、立管、支撑、钢轨接头和固定材料。报价中提到了替换、连接、通道和完成，包括在楼梯不可用时如何管理入口。室外台阶还需要考虑排水和天气暴露。

b4d444f5c9e86b3a03bb.en: Send the affected step or rail, your suburb and any existing plans or repair reports. Optional photos from a safe position can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au. Mention if there is no alternative access route.
b4d444f5c9e86b3a03bb.zh: 发送受影响的台阶或栏杆、您所在的郊区以及任何现有的计划或维修报告。可选的安全位置照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。提及是否没有替代的通行路线。

9d278daa9621e248e8de.en: Loose stairs and handrails: supporting timber and fixings ↗
9d278daa9621e248e8de.zh: 楼梯和扶手松动：支撑木材和紧固件 ↗

17721650e82f2ed309a9.en: Timber Stair & Handrail Repairs work photos
17721650e82f2ed309a9.zh: 木楼梯和扶手维修工作照片

6e66665e18e0a49e5cd1.en: The stair view and handrail close-up illustrate different support points: tread edges, rail joints and wall connections. A surface view does not establish the condition of concealed anchorage.
6e66665e18e0a49e5cd1.zh: 楼梯视图和扶手特写说明了不同的支撑点：踏板边缘、导轨接头和墙壁连接。表面视图并不能确定隐蔽锚地的条件。

05734cb8de4d7e338ed7.en: Close view of a timber handrail, stair edge and wall fixing
05734cb8de4d7e338ed7.zh: 木质扶手、楼梯边缘和墙壁紧固件的近视图

07a179c133955c9f3d44.en: Contact Ellis to arrange a safe stair assessment. We check treads, supports, fixings and handrail anchorage and confirm the qualified checks and repair scope required. Avoid using an unstable area until assessed.
07a179c133955c9f3d44.zh: 联系 Ellis 安排安全楼梯评估。我们检查踏板、支撑、紧固件和扶手锚固，并确认合格的检查和所需的维修范围。在评估之前避免使用不稳定的区域。

d9fa669a94679ca2ad50.en: Timber Weatherboard Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
d9fa669a94679ca2ad50.zh: 外墙木挂板维修 | Ellis Services Group

2ca43c7825c0551b63c1.en: Timber weatherboard repairs in Canberra. Match profiles and laps, inspect accessible backing and define replacement lengths, water-source checks and finish.
2ca43c7825c0551b63c1.zh: 堪培拉的外墙木挂板维修。匹配型材和搭接圈，检查可触及的背衬并确定更换长度、水源检查和表面处理。

36599fbb18fda8ad1f78.en: Painted weatherboard exterior at a Canberra home
36599fbb18fda8ad1f78.zh: 堪培拉一处房屋的彩绘外墙木挂板外墙

64ef1a22e73b909e49a5.en: Locate damaged boards and adjoining junctions
64ef1a22e73b909e49a5.zh: 找到损坏的木板和相邻的连接处

ad1bca63149f9e2f8ed1.en: A cracked weatherboard can be a local repair; repeated dampness across several boards needs the water path investigated. The board profile and lap, ends, corners and window junctions influence replacement. Timber boards do not establish a repair method for metal, fibre-cement or composite cladding systems.
ad1bca63149f9e2f8ed1.zh: 外墙木挂板破裂可以进行局部修复；几块木板反复受潮，需要检查水路。板的轮廓以及搭接、端部、拐角和窗口连接处会影响更换。木板没有建立金属、纤维水泥或复合材料覆层系统的修复方法。

9f672355b39e552da204.en: Record split ends, cupping, loose fixings and staining that returns after rain. Show the whole wall and damaged area safely, noting gutters, windows and ground level. Do not remove boards to expose hidden framing for an enquiry.
9f672355b39e552da204.zh: 记录分叉、拔罐、松动的固定件以及雨后重新出现的污渍。安全地显示整面墙和受损区域，注意排水沟、窗户和地面。请勿拆除木板以暴露隐藏的框架以供咨询。

511ff1ca3d607873fb42.zh: 破裂或裂开的外墙木挂板

dcc7171cfd5291ceccb5.en: Moisture damage beneath an exterior coating
dcc7171cfd5291ceccb5.zh: 外部涂层下方的湿气损坏

80bcc25a6a90df0d07f2.en: Match the profile and check behind the cladding
80bcc25a6a90df0d07f2.zh: 匹配挂板截面并检查板后结构

d43c30a0b53e2fb42331.en: A replacement board must meet the existing shaped profile and overlap, or lap. Accessible backing and fixings need to hold it securely. Opening a damaged section can reveal decay or a water route behind the face; replacing the board alone will not correct those faults.
d43c30a0b53e2fb42331.zh: 替换板必须符合现有的形状轮廓和重叠或搭接。需要使用可触及的背衬和紧固件来牢固地固定它。打开损坏的部分可以看到腐烂的部分或面部后面的水路；仅更换木板并不能解决这些故障。

935004863ebcfa9c29d1.en: Flashing, drainage and structural framing problems need their relevant professional input before timber is reinstated. Unknown older materials beside or behind the cladding must be identified before disturbance. A timber-board repair is not a method for metal, fibre-cement or composite cladding.
935004863ebcfa9c29d1.zh: 在木材恢复之前，防水、排水和结构框架问题需要相关的专业意见。在拆动之前必须识别包层旁边或后面的未知旧材料。木板修复不适用于金属、纤维水泥或复合材料覆层。

187090dc0b9ab1fb118d.en: Weatherboard inspection, access and paint extent
187090dc0b9ab1fb118d.zh: 挂板检查、施工通道与涂装范围

35ce953d356a61163ede.en: The on-site assessment measures the profile, overlap and affected lengths. The quote lists removal, matching timber, joints, access, disposal and preparation or painting. Agree whether paint covers the new lengths, a wall section or a whole elevation; new stock and paint may remain visible beside weathered work.
35ce953d356a61163ede.zh: 现场评估测量轮廓、重叠和受影响的长度。报价列出了拆除、匹配木材、接缝、通道、处置和准备或涂漆。商定油漆是否覆盖新的长度、墙体部分或整个立面；在风化的作品旁边，新的原料和油漆可能仍然可见。

f795aa80abdd98089806.en: Send the wall location, approximate damaged length, known leak history and suburb. Optional safe overview and detail photos can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
f795aa80abdd98089806.zh: 发送墙壁位置、大致损坏长度、已知泄漏历史和郊区。可选的安全概览和详细照片可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

20529ae0590836c7e5fd.en: Weatherboard damage: local replacement and backing checks ↗
20529ae0590836c7e5fd.zh: 外墙木挂板损坏：局部更换和支撑检查 ↗

f147629cf91f7c89281f.zh: 外墙木挂板维修工作照片

71f47ed65869c503c84b.en: Close view of weatherboard and timber window trim
71f47ed65869c503c84b.zh: 外墙木挂板和木窗饰的近景

29baf7e7acf78f2812f0.en: Yes. Ellis measures the board profile and lap and checks surrounding timber, fixings and water entry. Your quote identifies the individual board lengths to replace, the proposed matching profile, backing checks and finish.
29baf7e7acf78f2812f0.zh: 是的。 Ellis 测量板材轮廓和搭接并检查周围的木材、固定件和进水口。您的报价确定了要更换的单个板的长度、建议的匹配截面造型、支持检查和表面处理。

5a12f7500f594c27d9f3.en: Timber Window Repairs Canberra | Ellis Services Group
5a12f7500f594c27d9f3.zh: 木窗维修 | Ellis Services Group

b3a7c2548688f81c698a.en: Timber window and sill repairs in Canberra. Assess sound retained timber, existing profiles, glazing access and water entry before defining replacement.
b3a7c2548688f81c698a.zh: 堪培拉的木窗和窗台维修。在确定更换之前，评估完好的木材、现有型材、玻璃通道和进水口。

f412759de212d9848736.en: Separate sill damage from the whole window
f412759de212d9848736.zh: 区分窗台局部损坏与整窗问题

35ccf51e93318b7ac13f.en: A rotten sill does not automatically mean the complete window must be replaced. Local replacement may suit damage with sound adjoining timber and suitable joints; decay extending into the lower rail or frame needs a wider scope. A sticking sash can involve its hardware or balance, rather than the sill alone.
35ccf51e93318b7ac13f.zh: 腐烂的窗台并不意味着必须更换整个窗户。局部更换可能会因完好的相邻木材和合适的接缝而受到损坏；衰减延伸到较低的导轨或框架需要更广泛的范围。粘贴窗扇可以涉及其硬件或平衡，而不仅仅是窗台。

a308b1e009c2644e503d.en: Describe peeling paint, soft sill ends, open joints or a sash that sticks or drops. Show the complete opening and where rain reaches it from a safe position. Avoid probing timber or removing glass. An unsupported sash should not be relied on while awaiting assessment.
a308b1e009c2644e503d.zh: 描述剥落的油漆、软的窗台端部、开放的接头或粘住或掉落的窗扇。显示完整的开口以及雨水从安全位置到达的位置。避免探测木材或移除玻璃。在等待评估时不应依赖无支撑的窗扇。

fb7925e95488baf6fe7e.en: Soft or damaged timber at a sill
fb7925e95488baf6fe7e.zh: 窗台上的木材变软或损坏

c3e6b6d9c43c580f4acd.en: A frame that needs assessment before replacement
c3e6b6d9c43c580f4acd.zh: 更换前需要评估的框架

4dc7464abfb6b534ba6b.en: Check drainage, frame joints and sash movement
4dc7464abfb6b534ba6b.zh: 检查排水、框架接头和窗扇移动

aff92d047fc00d70396a.en: The sill’s slope and drip edge help water run away from the opening. Replacement timber needs to preserve these details and meet sound frame joints. A sash is the frame holding the glass: sticking can involve paint or alignment, while a dropping sash may involve cords, pulleys or balances that need separate checking.
aff92d047fc00d70396a.zh: 窗台的斜坡和滴水边缘有助于水从开口处流走。替换木材需要保留这些细节并满足框架接缝的要求。窗扇是固定玻璃的框架：粘贴可能涉及油漆或对齐，而掉落的窗扇可能涉及需要单独检查的绳索、滑轮或天平。

ecc9bf943ac950df57ae.en: Glass can stay only where its condition and repair access allow. Removal, reglazing and glass replacement need a glazier before timber is disturbed. Do not rely on an unsupported sash or dismantle its mechanism. Aluminium frames and double-glazing systems need their supplier or specialist.
ecc9bf943ac950df57ae.zh: 玻璃只能保留在其状况和维修操作空间允许的情况下。在木材受到拆动之前，拆除、重新安装玻璃和更换玻璃需要安装玻璃工。请勿依赖无支撑的窗扇或拆除其机构。铝框架和双层玻璃系统需要供应商或专家。

a928e414264e608869b2.zh: 窗户评估、玻璃安装和油漆

69f9fa5d95520eee5f26.en: An on-site assessment checks sill ends, lower rails, frame junctions and accessible fixings. The quote names the sections to replace, the profile match, glazing responsibilities, access and painting. Heritage requirements must be checked before changing controlled profiles or materials; fresh paint may remain visible beside an aged finish.
69f9fa5d95520eee5f26.zh: 现场评估检查门槛端、下轨、框架连接处和可触及的紧固件。报价中列出了要更换的部分、轮廓匹配、玻璃责任、通道和油漆。在更改受控型材或材料之前，必须检查遗产要求；在老化的饰面旁边可能仍然可以看到新的油漆。

d82a8bb708c07513595d.en: Send the window location, symptoms and suburb, and say whether it must remain operable during work. Optional safe photographs and any product details can be emailed to brian@elliservices.com.au.
d82a8bb708c07513595d.zh: 发送窗口位置、症状和郊区，并说明其在工作期间是否必须保持可操作状态。可选的在安全条件下拍摄的照片和任何产品详细信息可以通过电子邮件发送至 brian@elliservices.com.au。

51f0e4d8ef787623fdaa.en: Compare local sill repair with wider timber work ↗
51f0e4d8ef787623fdaa.zh: 将局部窗台修复与更广泛的木材工作进行比较 ↗

e3d090a24e4aefdf371d.en: Understand the moisture-source and retained-timber checks ↗
e3d090a24e4aefdf371d.zh: 了解水分来源和保留木材检查 ↗

3892d27c606b2e2da075.en: Close view of a painted timber window sill in wet weather
3892d27c606b2e2da075.zh: 潮湿天气下彩绘木窗台的近距离视图

dd77ba0d4facf2545617.en: Water-damaged painted timber sill and frame before repair assessment
dd77ba0d4facf2545617.zh: 维修评估前水损坏的涂漆木窗台和框架

ebc5d9138fead2e20360.en: Deteriorated paint and timber at an exposed opening.
ebc5d9138fead2e20360.zh: 暴露开口处的油漆和木材变质。

12715668f7cbcfa1344a.en: Carpenter repairing a timber window sill and frame
12715668f7cbcfa1344a.zh: 木工修理木窗台和框架

6bc2e8adf785f2447b18.en: Replacement timber is fitted and secured at the damaged opening.
6bc2e8adf785f2447b18.zh: 将替换木材安装并固定在损坏的开口处。

3c2c7b01b9d73b0390d8.en: We inspect the sill, adjoining frame and surrounding timber, trace the moisture source and define the damaged area. Your quote identifies local timber replacement and any wider window repairs needed to reach sound material. Contact Ellis for your on-site assessment and repair quote.
3c2c7b01b9d73b0390d8.zh: 我们检查窗台、相邻框架和周围的木材，追踪水分来源并确定受损区域。您的报价确定了当地的木材更换以及为获得完好材料所需的任何更广泛的窗户维修。请联系 Ellis 获取现场评估和维修报价。

ba724ecdb750bbea4415.en: Contact Ellis for an assessment of your timber sash window. We check the sash, frame, sill, operation and accessible fittings, then confirm the timber repair and hardware work in your quote.
ba724ecdb750bbea4415.zh: 联系 Ellis 对您的木窗扇进行评估。我们检查窗扇、框架、窗台、操作和可触及的配件，然后在您的报价中确认木材维修和硬件工作。

9c436208137e8cd545f8.en: Does a faulty sash always mean replacing the whole timber window?
9c436208137e8cd545f8.zh: 有缺陷的窗扇是否总是意味着更换整个木窗？

3abc455370bbb89f0e2e.en: No conclusion follows from that symptom alone. The operating mechanism, fixing timber, frame and sill need assessment. The proposal should distinguish component work from wider timber replacement and any separate glazing requirements.
3abc455370bbb89f0e2e.zh: 仅从该症状无法得出任何结论。操作机构、固定木材、框架和窗台需要评估。该提案应将构件工作与更广泛的木材更换和任何单独的玻璃要求区分开来。

f82985bcb3d0737143d1.en: Under-stair Storage Canberra | Ellis Services Group
f82985bcb3d0737143d1.zh: 楼梯下收纳柜安装 | Ellis Services Group

d60f85ed962c3892a11e.en: Under-stair storage installation in Canberra. Ellis plans access, measures the space and fits agreed cabinetry; browse different completed storage projects.
d60f85ed962c3892a11e.zh: 堪培拉的楼梯下收纳空间安装。 Ellis 规划通道、测量空间并安装商定的橱柜；浏览不同已完成的收纳项目。

debc6ce53953b2f0fb29.en: Decide what the space needs to store
debc6ce53953b2f0fb29.zh: 按需要收纳的物品规划空间

f508ec0040f7dd3a67a0.en: List the items you want to reach regularly and those that can sit deeper inside. Shelves, cupboards and drawers offer different access in a sloping space. Door travel and the surrounding walkway matter as much as the total volume. Start with the intended use rather than choosing a door style alone.
f508ec0040f7dd3a67a0.zh: 列出您想要经常触及的项目以及那些可以放在更深处的项目。架子、橱柜和抽屉在倾斜的空间中提供了不同的通道。门行程和周围的走道与总体积一样重要。从预期用途开始，而不是单独选择门样式。

8117009be84c3dfae976.en: Measure the slope and keep necessary access
8117009be84c3dfae976.zh: 测量坡度并保留必要的通道

6412e1263381d392ea4a.en: The highest part of the opening may suit taller items, while shallower shelves or drawers can make lower spaces easier to reach. Door travel must leave the adjoining walkway usable. Keep necessary access to services and the stair structure; do not remove lining or cut the stair to obtain enquiry measurements.
6412e1263381d392ea4a.zh: 开口的最高部分可能适合较高的物品，而较浅的架子或抽屉可以使较低的空间更容易到达。门行程必须使相邻的走道可用。保留必要的服务通道和楼梯结构；请勿拆除衬里或切割楼梯来获取咨询尺寸。

dacb772e03b338079004.en: Choose cabinetry and fitted edge details
dacb772e03b338079004.zh: 确定柜体与贴合收边方案

2112a1470734f9a19efe.en: Ellis assembles and fits the selected storage components. Standard cabinetry may suit some measured openings; other layouts need separately specified fabrication or fitted edge pieces. The gallery shows different completed projects with shelving and varied handles, so each example offers a layout reference rather than a common product specification.
2112a1470734f9a19efe.zh: Ellis 组装并安装选定的收纳组件。标准橱柜可能适合某些尺寸的开口；其他布局需要单独指定的制造或安装的边缘件。该画廊展示了不同的已完成项目，配有架子和各种把手，因此每个示例都提供了布局参考，而不是通用的产品规格。

da3946c7904255ec0081.zh: 楼梯下测量及安装报价

976376435de5ab2a5d7e.en: The on-site measure checks the slope, fixing surfaces and door clearances. Agree these details before purchasing cabinetry:
976376435de5ab2a5d7e.zh: 现场测量检查坡度、固定面和门间隙。购买橱柜前请同意以下详细信息：

dffb130b91a1fec8ccd9.en: Layout and access: confirm the measured slope, cupboard or drawer opening, door travel and the access that must remain available beside and below the stair.
dffb130b91a1fec8ccd9.zh: 布局和通道：确认测量的坡度、橱柜或抽屉开口、门行程以及楼梯旁边和下方必须保持可用的通道。

c1e6a4bdb8d9d00bf504.en: Components: agree materials, hardware, product suitability and who supplies the cabinetry; confirm any fabrication requirements before ordering.
c1e6a4bdb8d9d00bf504.zh: 组成部分：同意材料、硬件、产品适用性以及橱柜供应商；订购前确认任何制造要求。

5ceafe0084aaf01cc7fb.en: Fitted boundary: include fitting, edge treatment and making-good, plus any agreed removal and decoration. Compare the finish with the adjoining stair and skirting.
5ceafe0084aaf01cc7fb.zh: 安装边界：包括安装、边缘处理和修补，以及任何商定的拆除和装饰。将饰面与相邻的楼梯和踢脚线进行比较。

7e9e8d9b4031477fe2e1.en: Prepare an enquiry without dismantling the stairs
7e9e8d9b4031477fe2e1.zh: 在不拆除楼梯的情况下准备咨询

78a52ff5bcc89dbcd9d6.en: Send your suburb, what you need to store and whether you prefer cupboards, drawers or accessible shelves. Approximate dimensions and safe photos can help explain the space. Mention any existing doors, skirting or access panels that must remain.
78a52ff5bcc89dbcd9d6.zh: 发送您所在的郊区、您需要存放的物品以及您是否喜欢橱柜、抽屉或方便使用的架子。大致尺寸和在安全条件下拍摄的照片可以帮助解释该空间。提及必须保留的任何现有门、踢脚线或检修板。

d7e164d3736d0b15cdef.en: Can Ellis fit storage below my staircase?
d7e164d3736d0b15cdef.zh: Ellis 可以在楼梯下方放置储物空间吗？

2c23a5b3429103ec1da0.en: Yes. Our carpentry team measures and plans the accepted storage installation around the available space, selected components and access requirements.
2c23a5b3429103ec1da0.zh: 是的。我们的木工团队围绕可用空间、选定的组件和进出条件要求来测量和规划可接受的收纳安装。

a97a0e4a4ea59c404a5d.en: Are the gallery pictures one before-and-after project?
a97a0e4a4ea59c404a5d.zh: 画廊图片是一个前后项目吗？

7d828de9cf9f7cf29c9b.en: No. They show completed storage installations from different projects. They are presented separately, without an invented construction sequence.
7d828de9cf9f7cf29c9b.zh: 不。它们展示了不同项目的已完成收纳装置。它们是单独呈现的，没有发明的构建顺序。

557b7e0b9376fc45d2db.en: It depends on the measured opening, slope, access and chosen layout. Confirm product suitability and any finishing or fabrication requirements before ordering.
557b7e0b9376fc45d2db.zh: 这取决于测量的开口、坡度、通道和所选布局。订购前请确认产品的适用性以及任何表面与收边处理或制造要求。

40f6d9721166c9ebfe97.en: Explore the photographed completed-project collection behind this service.
40f6d9721166c9ebfe97.zh: 探索此服务背后拍摄的已完成项目集合。
